reviews.text: Great food, ambiance, and overall great date night.
reviews.author: Kylie

reviews.text: Service was great and personable. The lemon spaghetti is always delicious.
reviews.author: Tara

reviews.text: Had a very enjoyable experience at Luna. Food and service were excellent. The team that provided service to us were fun, knowledgeable about all entrees, and had perfect timing on when to help us. We had the risotto, lobster tortellini, crispy Brussels sprouts, focaccia bread, and hazelnut cream puffs which were all outstanding. 5 star experience at Luna.
reviews.author: brad

reviews.text: Food exceptional, service impeccable and price was perfect. Nice evening.
reviews.author: Randall

reviews.text: Excelente servicio y comida. Buena calidad de los alimentos
reviews.author: Alejandro

reviews.text:
Not sure if this restaurant is run by Giada or merely name affiliated. Either way, Luna felt more corporate than we expected. That means, the  venue is more casual (jeans, sneakers and shorts worn by most guests), the service is quick and efficient, they will sell "Giada Merch" and the food is good but not special.
The service team was extremely polite and engaging, working as a team to ensure service is prompt. However, there were periods where wine glasses were empty. They seemed rushed and that us feel rushed. This was resolved when we asked them to slow down.  Ask for the cracked pepper if you want comical relief of sorts. The food was above average and tasted authentic, but was still giving "we created this is a test kitchen" somehow. The Frito misto with lemon aoli was good, though a little chewy. The caprese salad was really well done, but use of heirloom tomatoes would  have made it perfection. The lemon pasta, cooked al denté, was noteworthy. It was not overpowering and quite easy to share. However the shrimp was tough and devoid of flavor. It should be noted, they will split the plates for you and the presentation is still quite nice!  The petit filet was a disappointment. While cooked to requested medium rare temp, the potato portion was stripped of any flavor when making into puree.
Overall, the setting was modern, clean and well staffed with knowledgeable people..we felt cared for, if only a bit rushed to turn the tables despite being there only 70 minutes from checkin to signing the check. They say to order and share, to taste and to explore. We just didn't feel that Luna understood what that means for spending $330 for two ppl. This restaurant delivered the basic experience, just not anything to rave about.  4 of 5 stars.
reviews.author: Kylie

reviews.text: Food and ambience were phenomenal. Alex took great care of us.
reviews.author: Nico

reviews.text: This was my second time at Luna. Loved the lemon spaghetti and everything else I tried. It was fabulous.
reviews.author: Colleen

reviews.text: Always a great experience never have any complaints with the food or staff
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text:
Muy rico toda la comida y el servicio excelente
Muy bonito lugar
reviews.author: Adolfo

reviews.text: It was a bit expensive. There are better options for much cheaper. They also charge a 4% fee on top of your bill for being part of the hotel. Service was excellent though!
reviews.author: Valerie

reviews.text: When comparing Luna to the ambience at other places, we like such as Dominicks, Eddie these and Mastros Luna is a notch down. The food was good, but in the case of the carbonara sauce, it didn’t live up to the description. Service was fine but when you get to value you find out that a 3.4% service fee is being added to your check this Restaurant pails in comparison to other upscale restaurants in Scottsdale
reviews.author: robert

reviews.text: We were out with friends.  The pizza was soggy and unappetizing.  One of our friend's Scallop Risotto was way too salty.  Disappointing enough to possibly never return.
reviews.author: DAVID

reviews.text: We came here to celebrate our wedding, and it was the perfect choice! It was just the two of us, but the atmosphere made the day feel so special. The food was amazing, the drinks were great, and the service was friendly and attentive without being over the top. We had such a wonderful time and couldn’t have asked for a better place to celebrate. We’ll definitely be back!
reviews.author: Natalia

reviews.text: Enjoyed great food as part of a wine paired dinner. Food was really good as was the service
reviews.author: Ted

reviews.text:
We had a wine pairing event dinner hosted by Closure wines.
The Chef presented each course with preparation details.
The wait staff delivered each course and pairing timely and efficiently.
Great Food, Great Atmosphere!
reviews.author: Marc

reviews.text: Love the food and the portions. Great creativity in the menu!
reviews.author: Jus2ofus

reviews.text: Great dinner at Luna. Our server was wonderful. The food was delicious and the restaurant was beautiful. Will definitely go back.
reviews.author: Christine

reviews.text: Sarah was an amazing server! She was attentive and helpful in helping select dishes for myself, so , DIL & grandson. The food and drinks were amazing!
reviews.author: Shannon

reviews.text:
Lovely food and presentation, plus a very knowledgeable and friendly server. 

But the wine menu is way overpriced and will probably keep us from returning. 

Fortunately, the restaurant did have a couple of bottles on a half-price offer ($50 instead of $100). We tried one of these and it was barely worth $50. Certainly glad we didn't pay $100 for it.
reviews.author: Steven

reviews.text:
Beautiful and elegant. Food was excellent! We had the focaccia, lobster arancini, Margherita pizza, filet and cacio e Pepe raviolo. And chocolate cloud for dessert.
Great experience from start to finish!
reviews.author: Karen

reviews.text: Delicious food! Great service and a beautiful restaurant. The waiter provided excellent recommendations. We will be back our next trip to Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Emilyy

reviews.text: We came here for a special celebration. The hostesses, wait staff and manager were all very hospitable and authentic. The food was pricey. We had two cocktails, bottled water, two plates of pasta, focaccia, brussel sprouts and the cookie plate for dessert for about 250(with tip). My husband had the lemon spaghetti. It was delicious. I had the pasta with à la vodka sauce, it was okay. The focaccia was kind of greasy and nothing to write home about, the Brussels were good, but very rich and too big of a serving. The cookies were 18$ for 4. I was underwhelmed by the cookies for that price, my daughter’s cookies she whips up quickly are ten times better. It’s a beautiful restaurant with a wonderful staff, overall a delightful experience, but, I was kind of hoping to have my socks knocked off. Oh, the purple rain cocktail was really good!
reviews.author: Joy

reviews.text: Went here for a girls dinner and had the best time! We ordered quite a bit but our favorite dish over all was the Lemon and shrimp pasta - it's light and fresh, yet creamy and filling. Everything could have been a bit hotter temperature-wise. Our server said he would course out our order, but I don't think he did. The food felt like it was sitting for a while. Yet, It was still delicious! The mocktails were fabulous and the vibe of the restaurant is great for a special occasion or just a nice evening out. I can't wait to come back!
reviews.author: Taylor

reviews.text: All the details to help make a birthday celebration memorable.   Only complaint would be their signature lemon pasta was lacking flavor this time in two of our entrees but great service and still was a nice enjoyable meal.
reviews.author: Dani

reviews.text: We had terrible service and the food was not the same, in a bad way.  We have dined here frequently, but I feel this will be the last time.  We were actually embarrassed by this experience as we  highly recommended this restaurant and it was definitely not to Giada's standards.  We drove 40 minutes to dine here and honestly we could've had a better experience at McDonalds.  So incredibly disappointed and disheartened by this whole experience.
reviews.author: Heidi

reviews.text: I've been to Luna a few times and I'm going to keep coming in many more times.  The food is delicious.  The wait staff is amazing.  The overall experience is always wonderful.  Make sure you ask for pepper because the pepper mill is crazy.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: Delicious food but a "cafe" atmosphere with lots of kids. While food and prices were indicative of "fine dining" atmosphere was not.  Service was fine but not exemplary. All in all a great dinner however.
reviews.author: Michele

reviews.text: Every thing was really good!  The restaurant was beautiful, food was great, the only down side was we were never offered refills on our drinks and waited so long to get the bill after our table was cleared that we had to find a server and send ours over so we could pay and go.
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text: Everything was prepared perfectly.  Service was good and the ambiance was wonderful.  Lemon pasta was awesome, caprese salad was really good but the best thing was the focaccia bread, it was heaven.  We'll definitely go back!
reviews.author: Lora

reviews.text: Lemon pizza and Lemon/shrimp pasta (with a lobster tail add-on) were both outstanding. They’ve solved the previously excessive noise level. Our server, Christian, was friendly, knowledgeable, a great ambassador for Luna. This restaurant is now on our regular go-to list. A perfect evening.
reviews.author: Stephen

reviews.text: Excellent dining experience. The lobster tortellini was sensational!
reviews.author: Austin

reviews.text: Unreal food, amazing staff, and great ambience. We had a great date at Luna!
reviews.author: Kayla

reviews.text: Super friendly hostess kicked things off. Our server, Melanie, knocked it out of the park. Signature lemon pasta was an easy choice that paid off. Strawberry soufflé was a bust, but by then we didn’t care.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: Christian helped us select the perfect wine for our meal. Chef Jenny delivered our salads herself and we had a nice chat about the food and her role at the restaurant. Both were friendly, courteous and knowledgeable and helped us enjoy the dining experience and ven more. Oh, and the food was awesome!
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: Amazing food and service. The pizza and pasta was some of the best I’ve had in Phoenix.
reviews.author: Ryan

reviews.text:
Finally, a restaurant where you can actually have a conversation! We had a lovely evening at Luna by Giada in the Caesars Republic Hotel. The food was delicious and the service was attentive and friendly from start to finish.
But what really stood out was the atmosphere. So many restaurants these days are deafening, bad acoustics, everyone shouting over each other. Luna gets it right. We could hear one another, talk, and actually enjoy the meal without straining. That alone will bring us back.
Highly recommend if you're looking for great food, good service, and a comfortable setting where the night is about the company and the meal, not the noise.
reviews.author: Devi

reviews.text: Delicious food with nice ambiance. We started with their focaccia bread and shrimp appetizer, and I had salmon for my entree. Everything was delicious!
reviews.author: Nazila

reviews.text: Always fabulous food and great customer service. It is a bit pricey for quantity of food. A $50+ charcuterie board should have more than 2 meat selections.
reviews.author: Stephanie

reviews.text: We participated in the Wine dinner. We had been to others at Giadas that were very good. I was disappointed in the quality of the Wine that was selected for the courses. It was a rather expensive dinner with some very mediocre wines.￼
reviews.author: deborah

reviews.text: Giada was a wonderful host and the evening could not have been better. Our server Christian was friendly and helpful and the support staff was on top of our needs throughout the evening. Luna was a great experience and I will most definitely return!
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.text: The food here is next level, so good and fresh. The service is great, very attentive to your needs but not hovering. It was a special event and Giada spent time will the patrons, she is a great warm person and very approachable. We love going to her restaurants. Great experience.
reviews.author: Hugh

reviews.text: We have been to Luna several times but last night was unmatched!  We were blessed with a visit from the owner!  She was so gracious with her time and was such a nice person in person!!  Unforgettable evening!
reviews.author: mark

reviews.text: Had the entire family for my 65th birthday. Food was great service was great and just love the ambience. Our server catered to the grandkids and us adults. Everyone was so friendly and courteous. We really love this place. Thanks for a great night be back again soon.
reviews.author: Bill

reviews.text: Always sensational! We love celebrating special occasions at Luna.
reviews.author: Catherine

reviews.text:
We had my bachelorette dinner here, and it was absolutely perfect! The restaurant went above and beyond to make the evening feel special. We were seated in a private room, which made it feel intimate and allowed our group to celebrate comfortably.

A huge thank you to Sarah, our waitress, who was incredible from start to finish. She was attentive, friendly, organized, and truly helped make the night memorable. The food, service, and overall atmosphere exceeded our expectations.

I’m so grateful to the entire team for helping create such a wonderful experience for such a special occasion. I highly recommend this restaurant for celebrations and special events!
reviews.author: Jeannette

reviews.text: Everything was fabulous. Will go back when in town.
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.text: Super pricey for what we ordered, empty. Great service and good food.
reviews.author: Judy

reviews.text: Expensive and small portions, lobster tasted dry and mealy. Told staff and was given replacement, which wasn’t any better. Waiter noticed we weren’t eating lobster and stayed away never asking if it was any better. There are better restaurants in Scottsdale, we won’t be returning.
reviews.author: Raymond

reviews.text:
Another wonderful experience at Luna.
Only bummer was no calamari, as we brought friends from out of town and talked up the calamari, lemon pasta and the focaccia bread and no calamari available they were bummed as we were as we talked it up!
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: I stayed at the Caesar’s Republic and a friend and I had dinner at Luna. We sat outside which was very beautiful and we split the citrus Cesar salad and each had the Lemon Spaghetti with shrimp. Everything was delicious and the wine selection was great. Our server was very attentive and knowledgeable. I would go back for sure.
reviews.author: Briana

reviews.text: Our experience here was pretty good. I don’t know if we would be back. Our service was excellent but my party thought the food was good but not amazing. We ordered the pesto pizza and loved the idea of the pesto with the arugula and pistachio but felt like it could use a little sweetness. Like a balsamic glaze drizzled over. It didn’t feel like the dish was finished. ￼The signature lemon spaghetti’s sauce was delicious and the presentation was lovely but the spaghetti noodles felt like such and odd choice after tasting it. The texture seemed off.
reviews.author: Emily

reviews.text: What a fabulous experience! The wine, the food, the staff all amazing. We had a great time and will without question return. Thank you for a wonderful evening
reviews.author: Vicci

reviews.text:
We have been here a number of times, and Luna always tries to do its best.  At times though, it falters a bit.

We were seated promptly this time at 4:58 pm -- different from previous visits when nobody was even at the front desk till 5 pm.

Julika greeted us soon thereafter, but had no idea whether we had been to Luna before.  Since many other high-end restaurants know repeat guests, why doesn't Luna have the ability to keep servers up to date?

She was very nice and smiled throughout the evening, very enthusiastic about the menu which she knew well -- we appreciated that.  But forgot lemon which we asked for 3 times.  She also forgot the olives we wanted for the cocktail.  We asked for horseradish which was entered into the order, but it never came with the filet -- kitchen error?

Although one of us is gluten-free, she described all the specials, which were not gluten-free, and never mentioned gluten-free alternatives for these.  So while these sounded enticing, we stuck with the main menu.

The food was good, as usual.  The arugula salad was dressed well, but several dead leaves were not removed before serving -- a lack of meticulous care in the kitchen.  Best thing was the parmigiano.

The caprese salad was excellent -- perfect heirloom tomatoes.

The White Negroni was a bit disappointing.  The bar was out of Gin Mare, which we ordered previously.  Instead, we settled for the Ha'penny Rhubarb gin.  This was not bad with juniper, rhubarb and berries, but we could not taste the Italicus Bergamotto in the glass.  So it didn't pack the herbal bitterness the previous White Negroni we had.

The filet was cooked perfectly.  Excellent port reduction.

Also loved the Two Wash Ranch chicken.  A fine Marsala sauce, and great non-grainy polenta.

We finished with a light fluffy strawberry souffle.  Julika was kind enough not to pour the sauce herself but let us do it,  This helped us manage the level of sweetness, which we appreciated.

In all, a good dinner.
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: The atmosphere in the restaurant was so loud it was impossible to enjoy dinner especially with the food being average at best.
reviews.author: Larry

reviews.text: The food was very good in the Services already. Unfortunately, because it’s attached to a hotel some of the clientele was less than desirable. They just went to the Hotel restaurant did not realize that they weren’t really just appropriately from the environment. I mean shorts and a polo shirt is fine, but this won’t be beyond that.  Baseball caps and dirty T-shirts and dirty jeans doesn’t seem appropriate for this restaurant
reviews.author: Travis

reviews.text: The food was good not exceptional for Giada. Extremely noisy and busy, dining room is adjacent to the bar. Service was extremely slow. The food was warm but the plates were very very hot, you could burn yourself especially if it was a small child. In my opinion pricey when comparing the food, service and noise.Public parking is very limited. I'd rate it a 3 out of 5.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text:
Great service - very attentive to ensure your experience is elite. Luna has cool ambience and vibes, too.

Food is delicious. The chef and the menu’s intention of being lighter coastal Italian hits the mark.
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.text:
Server was rushing us.  we ordered app and salad but certainly didn’t want them together.  She was pushing for main meal.   Thank goodness we held off so we could enjoy at a relaxed pace.

Other than that, it was a good as our experience has always been at Giada’s in Vegas.
reviews.author: Robin

reviews.text: The food was excellent. The waitress AMAZING! The atmosphere very nice. Just a tad too loud. Could have been better acoustics.
reviews.author: Carol

reviews.text: We had dinner at this restaurant on Mother's Day, which may have accounted for all the noise.  The service was fine, the meals were delicious.  The menu was not as extensive as we would have liked.  They also, in very small print, charge you a percentage of the meal for "venue fee".  I'm not accustomed to paying a percentage of my meal for a "venue fee" in any restaurant; there was nothing special about the look of this restaurant.  Being Mother's Day we expected the patrons to be a little nicer dressed.  The ladies all looked nice, but many of the men wore baseball hats during the meal and some were actually wearing shorts, a not so subtle insult to their mothers or wives.  Even for our beloved Phoenix, we thought that was a bit too much "California casual", especially on a special day celebrating mothers.  Very immature!  My wife asked for a Mai Tai, they didn't know how to make it.  She then asked for a Mojito, and they couldn't make that as well.  She settled for a glass of wine.  The chef's are great, the bartenders need training.
reviews.author: Emanuele

reviews.text: While beautiful and a special ambiance, the price was far too expensive for the value. $160 buffet and soft drinks aren't even included (I can understand not including alcohol, but no soft drinks is outrageous). The food was fine, most of it tasty but not worth the hefty price tag. No gluten friendly alternatives nor labels to determine if what was served was safe. The service was incredibly slow and our waitress was inattentive - had to practically beg for refills on those overpriced soft drinks. Overall, would not attend the special event again. Maybe the regular restaurant is better, but seems like they want to nickle and dime you.
reviews.author: Ciara

reviews.text: Service was poor and food selection has gone down. Very few options for vegetarians, everything was room temperature and we were checked on maybe 3 times. We’ve been a few times and this was by far the worst service and selection they’ve had. For $800 we expect better quality and friendlier staff.
reviews.author: Karsyn

reviews.text:
I was expecting a fine dining experience considering Chef Giada's reputation.  The menu was good, the dishes were designed well, so I give Chef Giada credit for that.  

But the execution was poor.  The spaghetti was stuck together, the shrimp was overcooked and the king crab leg was not flavorful.  Never had worse king crab leg, it lacked its usual sweet crag flavor.  And never have I ever paid so much for a 1/4 lb of king crab leg.  And the ambiance was very noisy, certainly not fine dining. Extremely disappointed.

On the good side, the wine list was impressive with options for a wide variety of palate and price point.  And the spaghetti noodles were homemade and al dente,,,,,, too bad the sauce was clumpy.  A touch more olive oil would have greatly improved the pasta.

Overall, I suspect that the local chef did not live up to the expectations and design of Chef Giada.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.text:
Not their fault but the traffic back up into & out of the parking lot/valet area was ridiculous.

Saw waitress twice: to take order & deliver the bill.

I had no opportunity to order a second drink bc everyone else was just refilling water glasses or dropping off food.

We had pizza & salad as appetizers to share. I asked  to have the 1/2 pizza we didn’t eat boxed BEFORE mains arrived- seated at a 2 top- they put the box down in the center of the table & we had to negotiate the rest of our meal around a box that took up ~1/2 of the table. (No bag for it was given so it couldn’t be set on the floor).

Mains were served with no silverware (initial setups taken when appetizers were complete). It took awhile to get the attention of the non waitress staff to get silverware so we could eat our meal.

The food was very good, but the service destroyed the experience.
reviews.author: Laurel

reviews.text: We went here for our 40th anniversary.  The ambiance, service, and food were excellent!  We were troubled that we were charged $1 per blue cheese stuffed olives for our martini plus $6 more for a premium brand!  Also our server kept recommending wines that were $500 plus per bottle - and on top of that we had the 3.5 percent admin fee to boot.  Small items for sure but they reflect us to not ever to return to this venue - sorry Giada!
reviews.author: Vic

reviews.text: As always, a great experience. The food is delicious and our server, Brandi, is amazing. Professional, friendly and fun!  Had a great time.
reviews.author: Deborah

reviews.text: Always a wonderful experience at Luna’s. Great service (we know all the servers by name, and do they). Dishes always delicious. Desserts oh wow! Vibe is natural & fun and not overdone.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Everything was great, including our server. The only thing that was a bit of an annoyance was having a reservation at 5 PM and there was no host available and the two bartenders were just watching a line form but did not get anyone to come take us to tables.
reviews.author: Joshua

reviews.text: Meatballs were cold and bacon wrapped dates undercooked.  Ceasar salad was horrible and lemon pizza had too much lemon and dough was tough.  I usually don't write bad reviews but this experience was bad all around.   Our server was nice but very nervous.
reviews.author: nancy

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience. I recommend make sure you have the bacon wrapped dates and I also recommend having the lemon spaghetti with tiger shrimp fantastic. Don’t forget the tiramisu. ￼
reviews.author: AJ

reviews.text: This was my second time and I look forward to coming back again, soon!
reviews.author: Rebekah

reviews.text:
I was really excited to take our friends and my family.  We sat outside and that may have been the mistake.
Service was horrible food was okay and drinks from the bar took forever to come to the table.
Won’t be back anytime soon
reviews.author: Chad

reviews.text: The service was very good.  The food wasn't worth the price.  It was good but not great.  They're are too many options in the area that offer good food and service.  I'm glad we tried it but probably won't go back.
reviews.author: Jacki

reviews.text: We dined at Luna for our anniversary and we were greeted at the door wishing us Happy Anniversary.  All the employees, waiter, servers, floor supervisor, and hostess, were all attentive and helpful in our decision for wine and entrees.  The appetizers , main course, and dessert were delicious!!!  We will be going back!!!!
reviews.author: Dennis

reviews.text:
Everything about Luna was terrific. My wife and I are not big eaters. We shared the lemon Caesar salad and signature shrimp spaghetti dishes. Every plate was split for us. I also ordered the caci de pepi raviolo side to taste. Everything was exceptional and excellent. We have never seen shrimp so large and flavorful.
So glad we went to this restaurant!!
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: Most amazing food I have eaten.  Staff was so good and on top of everything. The atmosphere was so welcoming and gorgeous.
reviews.author: Deanna

reviews.text: Service was off.   Server didn’t know menu and didn’t provide specials and pricing if specials and almost brought me an $84 bowl of pasta    Just not great.
reviews.author: Beth

reviews.text: While the food was very good, please be careful to watch your bill.  First of all, we asked to split a salad.  They charged us for two salads.  Then they had a special  to add a half of a king crab to the meal.   We agreed and shame on us for not asking the price but shame on them for not mentioning the price.  It was $140!!   We discussed with management and they adjusted the bill but in our opinion not adequately and we didn’t want to cause a scene so just let it go.  Enjoy the food but beware.
reviews.author: jayne

reviews.text: It was amazing!! I knew giada would not disappoint. Sine I was a little girl I would watch her on food network. Definitely going again.
reviews.author: Angelica

reviews.text: Amazing dinner. Wonderful staff and the food was perfection! The filet is a MUST!
reviews.author: Gabriela

reviews.text: Lemon pasta was heavy and too rich. We’ve ordered prior, was once delightful
reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.text: The lemon pasta was the standout dish of all the entrees that we ordered. Steak was cooked well but severely under seasoned. We were charged $4 for ice….in a whiskey on the rocks. Service and ambience were great. I don’t think we’ll be returning anytime soon.
reviews.author: Ashley

reviews.text:
We had a delicious, first visit to Luna by Giada.

The atmosphere was great and our service was wonderful.

The Focaccia Bread with Lemon Butter was very good.

I had Giada’s Signature Lemon Spaghetti with Shrimp, it was delicious.  My Sister in Law had the Penne Ala Vodka and enjoyed hers too.

The Tiramisu was more like a Chocolate Mouse that was very tasty but I wouldn’t consider it a Tiramisu.  It didn’t have any Espresso flavor to it.

We would go back.
reviews.author: KIM

reviews.text: We had a great experience at Luna. Great server, wonderful ambiance, loved the giant pepper mill, delicious food!! The cream puffs for dessert... AMAZING!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We had a great time and the service was impeccable. I’ve dined at Giada’s in Las Vegas at the Cromwell and I’ve been wanting to dine at Luna and didn’t disappoint.
reviews.author: Stuart

reviews.text: Service was terribly slow. Took over an hour to receive our meal. Wrong dishes were initially brought to us. Rather than asking if extra food should be boxed, it was disposed. Food was fair. They were very apologetic about the experience.
reviews.author: Dasa

reviews.text: It was incredible nice and the food very delicious
reviews.author: Cecilia

reviews.text:
I don't normally post negative reviews but this one must be shared.  I will start with a positive notes first.  The staff are amazing and friendly and the restaurant is beautiful we had a great view of the kitchen.

We had friends come in from Ohio for a visit and he is in love with Giada, has every cookbook, every video, and buys his girlfriend her clothing.  He was so looking forward to this dinner, which turned into an impromptu birthday dinner.  Nevertheless, sadly, the meal was such a disappointment.

There were six of us and we started with appetizers .  They weren't bad but nothing to write home about. We each got something different for dinner along with a couple of extra dishes for the table to try.  I had the Lemon spaghetti, the two shrimp were good but the pasta was more than al dente.  It was like glued together in the mound and had to use a knife to cut it. I took a few bites but that was all I could manage.  The arugula salad was tasty but more lettuce than pancetta or lemon peel.  The extra dish of pasta was super wet and limp.  I am not familiar with Giada but he is and said she would be mortified to see this dish on the table... actually when it was all over he said she would have not been pleased with anything we got. So with several dishes and a total of 6 drinks you would expect to drop some zordi. But the 3% venue fee was just another reason to roll my eyes. 

So in the end....the food wasn't worth the money or the hype and my friend left so disappointed he wanted to break up with a woman he has never met....
reviews.author: Irene

reviews.text:
Nothing special except the prices. Had the branzino- $56. It was fine. Again nothing special. Also lobster tortellini was good,not great - $49.
2 glasses of Pinot Grigio - $52 - obviously not worth it. Just for comparison-reflecting US restaurants- in Portugal same wine for entire bottle 14€. Roughly 10 times as much.  Had the Tiramisu or something that was called that.
Anyway, $300 later, meal for 2, will certainly keep us from ever returning
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text: Disappointed, My entree came out cold. By the time I received mine, everyone else has finished eating so I sent it back.
reviews.author: Lori

reviews.text: First time going here for our anniversary. The service was impeccable! From the front desk to our waitress. So professional. The food was delicious, you can taste the freshness of it. 100/100!! Can’t wait to go back soon!
reviews.author: Ambar

reviews.text: My wife and I had dinner at Luna to celebrate our anniversary. Everything was amazing! Our server was super friendly, the food came out quickly and was the perfect portion size. The food we ordered was so good and the flavor of each item was spectacular. I highly recommend Luna for anyone for a special occasion or just dinner out
reviews.author: Todd

reviews.text: We had a nice meal, good service, and and overall enjoyable dining experience. Would recommend to others!
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.text:
This was my third time to Luna. Each time we have had a problem. Service by the servers was wonderful the first and third time. But that there has been a problem with food or drinks every time.  I will not be going back.

But it's a beautiful restaurant and wonderful food. And most servers are excellent. But when mistakes are made by kitchen and bartenders managers should know how to take care of guests even if guests are nice and not making a fuss over the mistakes.

Problems that had had at the 3 visits. Pork came out rare- this was rectified fabulously by management (this was especially the when they first opened). Second time one of the guests food (birthday girl) was not put in with the others so didn't come together. Management did nothing, didn't even come to the table. Also didn't use the fun big pepper mill for birthday girl. Then last night wrong bottle of wine was brought. Fixed right away but new glass had a chip and cut my lip. Not a bad cut but manager came and we were really nice about it. In my opinion something should have been comped for that kind of mistake.
reviews.author: Nina

reviews.text: Great experience.   Our server Dara was knowledgeable and friendly   Angelo the manager runs a great operation.    Will be back
reviews.author: Jamuna

reviews.text: This is a very unfortunate review for one of our favs. Luna has been our neighborhood Italian go to for date night. It typically delivers some n every touch points; ambience, service, cuisine all top notch. While they checked most of those boxes this Sunday, service was significantly subpar. There was an incident with our meal receipt and the amount that was charged to our cc. The server (Patricia) presented the final receipt for $86 then proceeded to attempt to charge the cc for $218. Then cam to tell me there must be an issue as she tried to run it twice. The math says moly doesn’t match. Their manager on duty (Michael) quickly resolved and resubmitted payment for the correct amount but no explanation was given. Luckily our fraud protection declined the payment or there could have been a bigger problem. No one wants to feel cheated or taken advantage of but Luna by way of Patricia failed to check the service box. It’s our home, our neighborhood and our Luna so we will be back but with caution towards the service and server!
reviews.author: Milton

reviews.text: Lovely design.. great ceasar salad.. good salmon .. just ok  pasta alas . Terrible over sweet mocktails overpriced . Service has waiters who never look around but talk to  other waiters in a corner while clients use waving boat signals … but sweet and nice servers .. just need to have eyes on the clients.. the music can be so loud that one can not talk .
reviews.author: Claribel

reviews.text: My new favorite restaurant, the menu is perfect and everything was so so delicious!
reviews.author: Deborah

reviews.text: We are reoccurring and local customers. Our dinner and waiter in the dining room was great.
reviews.author: Emily

reviews.text: Very good but over priced for pasta. Food was on the salty side
reviews.author: Kelle

reviews.text:
You walk in to the beautiful restaurant expecting an amazing meal but we were completely let down.  First, drinks were expensive and watered down. Second we were given the wrong salad. Kids food also came out with salads and appetizers.
Food took another 45 minutes, where pasta came out COLD. We didn’t get checked in by our waitress at all during that time. We also ordered wine by the glass which didn’t come out until we were nearly done with our main course. The food was good but not spectacular. Also expensive for what it was. Needless to say we will not be returning. Skip this place if you’re thinking about it.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.text: New menu  is exciting! Had the Lobster Tortellini. Generous on the lobster. So good! The strawberry soufflé is supreme!
reviews.author: Carolyn

reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve been at Luna. My daughter and son-in-law brought me last Mother’s Day. Last night I brought a good friend to Luna for her birthday. The food was amazing. Service was good. Will absolutely be back.
reviews.author: Lana

reviews.text: First time at Luna. Sat outside—beautiful night. Salads came out fast but main dishes took a good 30–45 minutes & they had divided my meal into two and had forgotten my husband’s selection; however, they righted the error and comped his dish. Appreciated the gesture. The food was excellent. I had the arugula salad & my husband had the caprese salad. For pasta, I had the Lemon Shrimp—so tasty. They also treated us to an anniversary dessert. Not a cheap restaurant but we will be back despite some mishaps with service.
reviews.author: Johanna

reviews.text: Poor service. Prices have gone up and portions have gotten smaller. Service blames kitchen, kitchen blames server for half our tables orders that didn’t get submitted. Half of our tables food was out 20 minutes before the other half. No manager around or compensation made for the mishap. For these prices you’d expect better.
reviews.author: Joseph

reviews.text: Easter Brunch was disappointing. Much more enjoyable for dinner service.
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.text: It was a great Easter brunch. My family had a great time today.
reviews.author: Travis

reviews.text: Most amazing experience! Good and service was outstanding!
reviews.author: christi

reviews.text:
Food excellent.  Extra servers great.  Our server was nice and knowledgeable but had way too many tables and several larger parties.  Initial contact and eventually drink orders took at least 30 minutes.  Then delivery of drinks a long time.  Once good ordered, came quickly and great.  Extra servers kept water full and checked often.  I wanted a glass of wine with dinner but finally got as we finished dessert.  Again, it appeared the other large parties and computers were issue, not the server.  We were patient and did not reduce her tip, but it is a high priced meal!  The last time we were there our service as amazing do this was a lil disappointing, but did not ruin our evening.

You should check on others if large parties or have a separate server for cocktails or who can take orders.  Just saying.  We will return for food but thought you should know.
reviews.author: Tricia

reviews.text: Excellent experience. Food was creative but hearty. Husband said sausage pizza was one of the best he ever had. Lots of vegetarian choices. We will be back
reviews.author: Tiffney

reviews.text: TRULY AMAZING FROM THE MOMENT WE WALKED IN UNTIL THE MLMENT WE LEFT. I AM TYPING I. CAPS TO EMPHASIZE HOW AMAZING OUR DINNER AND THE STAFF WAS.
reviews.author: Dustin

reviews.text: Excellent all around. Great food and service, very nice wine list, cool ambience. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Doug

reviews.text: What a wonderful way to end our vacation.  Sarah (our waitress) was attentive, knowledgeable, and funny.  The food was superb.  Our teens loved their meals and we had a wonderful taste around the menu.  Highly recommend a visit!
reviews.author: Laurel

reviews.text: Great service, manager and staff were great. We had issues with my pasta. It was very salty, I had to send it back, it came back very salty again. Manager came over and was very accommodating and kind. I just ordered another pasta and it was better. Maybe that had a water issue being over salted for the pasta. They apologized and comped my dish along with a nice dessert. Very professional. Again, service was great and they took care of the problem. I just hope they get that resolved, a place like Luna shouldn’t have that issue when their specialty is pasta and the prices aren’t cheap. Maybe just  a one night issue. Overall, the flavors and the pizza was great. I look forward to coming again.
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.text: Phenomenal from start to finish. Service was stellar, F&B SO GOOD, ambience awesome. A+ all-around. Giada did this one right!
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: Whatever cleaning ingredients that were used in the hotel/restaurant were horrible and I had a reaction that I couldn't enjoy the food.  No way should a restaurant be that toxic that one couldn't smell or enjoy the food.  The food was below par in quality.  I've been here three other times and was quite satisfied.  Unfortunately, I will not be returning.
reviews.author: Thomas

reviews.text: Their signature lemon pasta with the shrimp is one of the best pasta dishes I’ve ever had. Focaccia with the dipping oil was good, the herb oil was our favorite. The vodka pasta was also fantastic!! Such a great restaurant
reviews.author: Sheridan

reviews.text: Loved everything we tried! The atmosphere and service were just as good as the cuisine!
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: This place had a slow and rocky start when it opened. It has worked out those issues and everything was delicious and our server was great! Definitely worth giving it a second try if you went during its first few months
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: The restaurant was beautiful. The food was very good, but my pasta was a bit salty. Some complimentary bread would have been nice. Service was excellent!
reviews.author: Liz

reviews.text: Unfortunately was not impressed at all with Italian cuisine
reviews.author: Anthony

reviews.text: We were so disappointed with our dinner last night. We had been there three weeks ago and the experience was exceptional. Once we arrived, we were seated in the bar area to a very nice table next to the windows. Our server was attentive at the beginning, bringing us drinks, taking our appetizer orders, etc., which came out very quickly. Then she proceeded to ghost us. We waited approximately 50 minutes between appetizer being cleared from the table and our dinners being delivered. We would never have gotten our dinner unless my husband got up from the table and asked somebody where our food was. When the food did arrive, my pasta was ice cold. My daughter‘s pasta was completely overcooked and mushy and over salted to the point where she could not eat it. My husband salmon was very good. We complained to the Server assistant that we wanted to see our server and she sent over the manager Michael the manager was very kind apologetic and wanted to know what all the problems were. Once he discovered that he did go back and take two of the pastas off the bill however, that was not going to help our ruined evening. For those prices, the food needs to be better. The service needs to be better. I am not sure we will go back.
reviews.author: Elisa

reviews.text: Special night at Luna celebrating our 30th wedding anniversary! Service by Megan was outstanding and the entire wait and bus staff were incredible. Food is so well made, presented wonderfully and full of great flavor. From appetizers to dessert, a top night for the four of us to enjoy.
reviews.author: Randy

reviews.text: The food was outstanding, as was the service. Prices are on the high side, and then they add a 3.5% administrative fee (whatever that is), and charge you $12 (plus a 50 cent convenience fee) for parking. Server also recommended a “special” which was just the regular dish + a market priced lobster (I didn’t expect a “special” to cost more than $100, but shame on me!) Definitely a ‘special occasion’ kind of place, but I can’t see anyone going there for ‘Saturday dinner.’
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.text: The food was top notch. Perfect balance of flavors in each dish. High quality. The K4 farm steak was so juicy and tender. The best steak I’ve had. Our waitress Melanie was wonderful. Friendly and kind. The environment felt relaxed but also upscale. Just had such a nice evening.
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text: Food and service was amazing, look fwd to coming back
reviews.author: Mario

reviews.text: Good food and service, lemon pasta was over cooked and mushy.
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Everything was perfect! My friend was visiting from out of town and Luna was her first meal request.
reviews.author: Maureen

reviews.text: The food and drinks were delicious. The staff was extremely friendly and attentive. Great dining experience.
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.text: The lemon pizza was amazing as was the lemon pasta!  The desserts were great too, we tried several of them. Our waitress was very helpful and the service was spot on
reviews.author: cathy

reviews.text: Staying at the hotel. Tuna appetizer was fantastic. Great pastas too. Wait staff worked together really well
reviews.author: Clare

reviews.text:
Come to Area for Baseball Spring Training.
Dropped oldest daughter back at school and youngest comes along … extra Father daughter get away. Proud girl dad !
Daughter wanted pasta last year and we found Luna Grill. LOVED it so much that we had to come back. This time I think we loved it better than the first time.
Ambiance is nice. Dressy casual works fine.
Enjoyed an awesome dinner.
Service was great 👍🏼
Oh yeah the Lemon pasta is a good choice.
Everything we have tried has been great.
reviews.author: Gerardo

reviews.text:
Arrived to be greeted by smiling and faces who quickly sat us for a wonderful evening of dining. Server assistant quickly introduced himself and asked us which water we preferred.  Our server arrived tableside welcoming us and explaining the menu, wine list, and the specials offered by the Chef.
Starters, entrees, and dessert were nicely spaced out allowing time for enjoyment and conversation. At no time did we feel rushed or that they were in a hurry to flip the table.
We have visited Giada's Las Vegas location twice and was pleased to see different offerings along with some of our favorites.
Wonderful evening was had by all in our party and would highly recommend a visit.
reviews.author: Matthew

reviews.text: One of the best dining experiences we’ve had.  Giada didn’t disappoint.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: Great food and great service! Would highly recommend dining here for dinner for any occasion.
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.text:
The filet mignon was of good quality and the wine was excellent! 
Nice location, staff was great, our server was knowledgeable, honest, and excellent. 
A nice dining experience!
reviews.author: Jason

reviews.text: Outstanding all around! Great atmosphere and excellent food!
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.text: Food was excellent and something for everyone - meat eaters, vegetation and gluten free - everything was fantastic. Server was personable and enthusiastic. Cocktails were phenomenal. Will definitely return!
reviews.author: Adam

reviews.text: Wonderful!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food was very good. LOVED the focaccia. Service was excellent. Will return…
reviews.author: Aashish

reviews.text: Amazing 12/10! Even my dad who owned the onion in its glory days said this was one of the best meals that he's had in his entire life. The steak and lobster combo is a must get!
reviews.author: Jordan

reviews.text: We got to meet Giada!!!! We had a wonderful experience!￼
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: Luna's is excellent and you won't be disappointed.   The atmosphere is beautiful, the food is wonderful and the staff, is very friendly!
reviews.author: Janet

reviews.text: Best atmosphere by far.  Attentive staff, amazing food, beautiful scenery, the people who work here care about you and your experience.  The Giada brand is the best!
reviews.author: Jake

reviews.text: Brandi our waitress was the best! She was so informative and made our experience amazing!
reviews.author: Kathy

reviews.text: We took family that was in town to dinner at Luna. Everyone loved it. We ordered 3 appetizers (all delicious) and 4 different entrees (also all delicious ) and 2 desserts. We will definitely return.
reviews.author: Tina

reviews.text: Took my wife for a date night to decompress because of life. I am so impressed with how it went. She could not stop saying wow and that she felt so relaxed. Our hostess was very informative and polite telling us facts about the restaurant as we were taken to the table. The look of the restaurant - elegant, luxurious, comforting. Our server, Patricia, was top of the line. Her care and attentiveness were incomparable. Her timing was efficient, she was always checking in without hovering. Talking it through with us to choose a wine and answering any questions about the menu, even talking through our thoughts on the dishes we chose. She was AMAZING! The dishes- perfection, balanced, beautiful. The food was heavenly. The plates weren’t tiny portions, they were clean and hearty and most of all flavorful. My wife had the best time and she felt like she could just be. Which doing while eating a meal says a lot. Absolutely will be back because Luna by Giada is not something you can experience once and only once.
reviews.author: Michel

reviews.text: All was good with food and service. The scantily clad hostesses were an off putting surprise that took away from the experience. Would not return because of it.
reviews.author: elena

reviews.text: Wonderful dinner and service.  Some of the best food in Scottsdale. Service was wonderful.
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.text: Really good food. The open dining area makes for a lot of noise, so conversation can be difficult to hear. The outdoor dining patio would be a better choice if you would like to converse at a normal level.
reviews.author: Randy

reviews.text: The chicken dish was very disappointing. It was a very very small 1/2 chicken that was over cooked. The lobster was not worth the extra charge as you barely had 2 bits from the lobster tail. Don’t like that you have to give them your entire order all at one time.
reviews.author: valerie

reviews.text: I go to Luna’s and Giada’s in vegas and pronto; thou our waiter was great we arrived at 5pm party of 2 they sat us was in the back and restaurant not crowded; ordered cocktails appetizer and salad entree was not made chef failed forgot to make order by 625pm we received both entrees which were missing ingredients and was bland not made proper. We ate the dinner and left in 20 minutes I shared with waiter when we arrived we had an engagement close by at 7pm. The chef failed on every level not the meal or ambience I expected. The manager came by to recap chef didn’t make order and comped appetizer. Sorry it doesn’t make up for our time or $200 spent on a nediocre dinner for two.
reviews.author: Kim

reviews.text: Exceeded my expectations. The homemade gluten free pasta was phenomenal. Our table loved all the food and the service was great!
reviews.author: Miranda

reviews.text: Everything was great. Really good food. Would definitely come back
reviews.author: Jihad

reviews.text: Wonderful staff and food is fabulous!  Wish the server would have acknowledged my friend’s birthday but overall great dining experience.
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.text: Sharice was absolutely amazing. She was very attentive to our big party, went above and beyond to ensure everyone’s needs were satisfied. She gave great recommendations and her personality made our experience even better. Also, the manager came by and spoke to us to ensure everything was okay and to make sure we were enjoying ourselves at Luna and made small talk which you normally do not see inside restaurants. The only downfall was the chefs special dinner with the lobster tail add is that the lobster tail was smaller than the shrimp. The service, food and drinks was overall delicious!
reviews.author: sarissa

reviews.text: Came here on the fly. We are visiting Arizona for spring training. My wife and I usually pick a place to have dinner before or after a baseball game. Well, my intuition was correct, as this place has an amazing atmosphere and the food was delicious! We will definitely be back here once we come back. Thank you to all the staff for making us feel welcome! This truly is a great restaurant.
reviews.author: Alejandro

reviews.text: It was great!  We took out of town visitors and they loved it.
reviews.author: BarbaraJ

reviews.text: Great food and great service in a beautiful setting
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text: We waited 15 min to be seated. The round table was very nice for group of 9.  Our server was very pleasant but it took a long time to be served.
reviews.author: Myrna

reviews.text:
This was the first time dining at Luna, and it was fantastic!  From the first moment of checking in at our reservation time through our entire experience - everyone involved in our service/meal was exceptional and very professional and super friendly.  We loved it!!  Definitely a 5-star destination and we will definitely be returning in the future!!

Well done Giada and staff - you have a winner here!

FYI - the gentleman who is the Maître d' and our server, Jay - they were incredible
reviews.author: Kate

reviews.text:
So….first time here, we had high expectations. First, the place is beautiful. Upon arrival we were welcomed by the hostess and on the way to the table we had a brief tour of the restaurant which was really cool. Front of house staff to this point was awesome. We then sat and ordered drinks and wine. Server gave an awesome overview of the menu. Guy was great. Ordered 3 apps which came out fast and they were great. Then… server disappeared. We finally ordered mains, which again came out fast, then…no server. Empty plates sat on table for about 40 mins. Finally a manager came over and cleared for us and offered desert menus, which we wanted.  But, they didn’t come. I got up and found them myself. Server came back after a long wait (and never brought next round of drinks) with dessert menus which already had, so we ordered. Again, came out quickly and like all the food, it was awesome. Then, waited quite a bit for the check.
Overall, this place is good, but I’m guessing our section got jammed and the server - who we liked - was just overloaded. 
This, in addition to the 3.5% surcharge on the bill and the very chaotic valet parking (and cost) has us deciding to wait to return until they get their act together. I’m guessing non-local customers will be fine with this sort of experience. If you’re visiting Scottsdale please check this place out, but for us…we will be waiting to return.  3+ hours was just too long for a dinner for 3. Food was great though!
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.text: Our server was absolutely amazing.  She was super friendly with a great personality.  Keep doing what yall are doing.  Everthing  was Amazing !
reviews.author: Candice

reviews.text: Great service in a lovely restaurant. Food was overpriced and just okay.
reviews.author: Bruce and Lyn

reviews.text: Enjoyed a pleasant evening on the patio sharing plates with my wife and son. The service was outstanding and timely. The food was what I expected - excellent. The outdoor seating was private and very relaxing.
reviews.author: Jerald

reviews.text: What an incredible evening. It greatly exceeds expectations. Cannot wait to go back. Kaitlin was awesome. Wonderful
reviews.author: Teresa

reviews.text: I’ve eaten at Luna several times and it’s been very good.  However this time it was a disappointment.  We took friends and I had really talked it up.  The Lemon Pasta - a featured dish - was dry and all stuck together.  Very disappointed.  Service was excellent but I’m not sure we’ll go back given the cost, I’m sorry to say.
reviews.author: Mauri

reviews.text: This honestly was one of my favorite dining experiences ever. The food was exquisite, the desserts were phenomenal, unique and the presentation was incredible! Chefs Jennie and Reagan are top notch. Service was outstanding and truly made us feel welcomed. We will definitely be back!!! Gorgeous restaurant without feeling stuffy too.
reviews.author: Kathleen

reviews.text: Very overpriced paid $60 for a pizza will not be coming back
reviews.author: gregg

reviews.text:
I absolutely loved my dining experience at Luna's!
Our server, Kaitlyn, was attentive knowledgeable and, most importantly, I could tell she really really loved the food she served. It was obvious to our table that she truly enjoys where she works and admires Giada de Laurentis.
The decor was stunning and comfortable at the same time, great vibe. We were treated to a tour of the entire restaurant and shown the kitchen and once again Kaitlyn was very knowledgeable with what she shared.
We enjoyed the lemon homemade pasta with shrimp, Caesar salad, arugula salad and a most deliciously decadent tiramisu at the end of our meal.
I wish this business much much success as it truly a dining "experience", and not just another place to go for dinner. Do not hesitate make reservations immediately!
reviews.author: Tracy

reviews.text: Outstanding is the one word I would use! The food was awesome. We had the Lemon Spaghetti with shrimp, which now I see why it’s one of their favorite dishes! We also had the ribeye steak which was super flavorful and moist. As an appetizer we had the calamari and shrimp which was outstanding. Oh …..and the staff could not have been anymore attentive! Many asking if you needed anything else, and the management staff coming by thanking us for coming to dinner there! All-in-all …..will definitely be back!!!!❤️
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: The food was excellent, ambiance was lovely, and very good service
reviews.author: Kathleen

reviews.text: The food was outstanding but our entrees were over an hour late. They did comp some of our costs. Beautiful and great food. Service needs improvement.
reviews.author: Lynn

reviews.text: The Staff and food were outstanding!  The perfect place for a special night.
reviews.author: FRED

reviews.text: Great food!  Very friendly server and excellent suggestions for food and wine!! Definitely recommend for just a date night or a special occasion.
reviews.author: Monica

reviews.text:
In February and many before we had so many great experiences with Kenny as the manager at Luna.  Tonight 3/11 we returned for what we have experienced in the past only for a major disappointment.  We waited 45 minutes for our table.  The hostess were completely confused.  New management came up to explain to us why we didn’t have a table, then all of a sudden we had three choices of tables.  We ordered our normal dish, lemon spaghetti but this time they had it with Shrimp and a special with crab as a side.  It may have been the smallest crab I’ve ever been served with a shocking price of $140 when the bill came.

I asked to speak with management to suggest that they announce the price of the side versus sticker price shock when the check came.  Needless to say, managements response was very unprofessional and surprising.

Remember who will keep you in business when summer hits, us the locals.
reviews.author: Joella

reviews.text: We were in town (Phoenix) for Mardi Gras week that also coincided with Valentine's Day, and our reservation was for a somewhat later-than-usual dinner time (20:15) on Valentine's Day.  Valet parking was extremely chaotic/disorganized, and once inside we still had to wait ~35 minutes to be seated (beyond our on-time arrival).  The Host was kind enough to provide a glass of sparkling wine for us while we waited, which was a nice touch.  The surroundings were extremely swanky (VERY satisfied with the ambiance), but the menu was extremely uninspired - very basic, predictable fare.  Service was rather poor (our server was very inattentive), and the food was decent but again, very basic and a bit insipid actually.  The cocktail menu was equally uninspired, and despite the ho-hum options (which you'd think ANY bartender on the planet could easily make), our cocktails were rather poor quality; in fact, neither my wife nor I finished either of our cocktails, switching swiftly to wine instead.  Had this been any other restaurant, I would have given it at least 3-stars, but my expectations for Luna FAR exceeded what was ultimately delivered, and so I feel I must rate our experience a bit more harshly.  Very disappointed...
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: My husband and I went for Valentine's dinner.  Despite being on time for our reservation, the front desk seemed frazzled with the amount of people there and it wasn't well organized.  We were told they were "just clearing off tables" and we'd be texted when ours was ready.  It was almost 45 minutes later when we actually got a text.  We were seated but then it took forever for a server to actually come to the table.  The food itself was delicious and the pacing of the meal (time between apps and entrees) was fine- but then we waited forever to get our check.  And the server brought us the wrong check.  And then took forever to bring us the correct check.  It was painfully apparent that this is a new restaurant and wasn't prepared for the volume of guests on a special occasion.  I'd be willing to try it again, but not on a high volume day.  Hopefully, they can iron out their wrinkles and improve service.
reviews.author: Emily

reviews.text: Had a 7:15 reservation on Valentines Day but was not seated until 8:15. No servicer at the table for almost 15 mins. Arancini‘s were undercooked, and the food quality was equivalent to Olive Garden if not worse. Very expensive restaurant for pasta and average wine.  ￼￼
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: Had 7pm reservation for 2 and didn't get seated until 730, Hostess staff seemed very overwhelmed and chaotic. Our server was not attentive and disappeared for a long time. We didn't have our dessert brought to us timely and decided to take it to go. The overall experience was poor service, but food was good.
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Took us an hr to get seated even tho I booked the reservation over a month in advance just not a good experience
reviews.author: Bobby

reviews.text: We won’t be dining here again. We had 630pm reservations on Valentines day. Even after waiting 5 minutes for valet ($12) to take care of the car. We checked in with the hostess at 620pm. They do not have a notification system once you check in for your reservations, so we just stood in the sea of people in the check-in area for them to come get us when our table was ready. I had to go back up to the hostess stand at 655pm and ask where we were in getting seated for our 630pm reservation. All we got was a “sorry” and we’re finally seated at 7pm, 30 minutes after our scheduled reservation time. The food was okay, my wife had the Branzino and I had the petite filet. We skipped dessert because we were already running late for the show. The ambiance is very loud and the service was okay. No one from the management team ever approached our table to apologize for being seated 30 minutes late and offering a way to make things right.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.text: I tend not to leave bad reviews but I will never recommend this place to anyone. Reservation was at ￼6:15 PM and were seated at 7:00 PM. Waitress was moody, drinks took forever and were all bland when they got to the table. Food was tasteless. Overall a bad and expensive experience.
reviews.author: sam

reviews.text: Absolutely flawless experience. Food was incredible. Service was perfect. A top 5 dining experience!
reviews.author: Todd

reviews.text: This was our first visit to this restaurant. We absolutely loved everything. From the bread with dipping sauces, calamari that was cooked perfectly to our delicious entree of scallops and risotto. Quite expensive but was worth it for a special occasion.
reviews.author: Grace

reviews.text: Went Valentine Friday. Restaurant was hectic and staff appeared overwhelmed. After a questionable start got better
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: Everything was fabulous…Amanda was a fantastic server, we will request her again!  We will definitely be back with friends!￼
reviews.author: Lyle

reviews.text: Love Giadas in Vegas but this one fell short. Appies arrived before cocktails, food was very good but hubs main course was lukewarm at best, never saw the server once the meals were dropped. Expensive and expected more. Wanted to love it but didn’t.
reviews.author: Marci

reviews.text:
This was our first trip to Luna after wanting to try it for a while. It did NOT disappoint! We consider ourselves Cesar Salad aficionados and Giada's is the best in town. The Signature Lemon Spaghetti is just so delicious and we also had the Pistachio Pesto. Magnifico!
Most of these high end places do have quality food but I never get enough. NOT HERE! We have enough left for a full dinner tonight. Abbondanza!
Can't wait to go back.
reviews.author: mike

reviews.text:
Luna by Giada delivers a refined, cohesive experience.

The Signature Lemon Spaghetti shows clear culinary direction — acidity and richness well balanced, shrimp quality strong, finished tableside with fresh pepper. Confident execution.

Crab Arancini were evenly crisp with clean seasoning.

The Rosé of Falanghina DOCG (Fontanavecchia, Campania) paired appropriately with the citrus profile.

Dessert — pistachio cream pastry with caramel components — offered well-structured sweetness and contrast.

Service maintained professional rhythm throughout: attentive yet unobtrusive. Hospitality felt natural rather than transactional.

A restaurant with both culinary identity and service discipline.
reviews.author: Yan

reviews.text: Met 3 friends for dinner at Luna. First time visiting for all of us. Service was great, food was AMAZING, and the restaurant is beautiful. Prices were on the higher side but truly, the food was amazing. All of us will be back!
reviews.author: Kristien

reviews.text: We have been there three times and the service, food and overall experience was amazing. The add on lobster is a must. Best lobster I ever had.  The managers are very people friendly and professional.
reviews.author: Jabby

reviews.text: Unfortunately we did not have a good experience at Luna. We did not recieve our entrees until two hours after our reservation time. Food came out wrong several times and the seafood was extremely undercooked and completely inedible. Bottled beers and glasses of wine took an inappropriate amount of time to come out. We completely understand this is one of the busiest weekends in Scottsdale but the entire experience start to finish was inexcusable. We will not be returning.
reviews.author: Margot

reviews.text: Overall for the buildup and the price, I found the experience mediocre.  The signature lemon pasta dish was fine, the butternut squash ravioli was dry (filling).  Our wine order was delivered after we finished our main.  (It was ordered well in advance).  There were some nice touches from the staff…but it felt a bit forced.  If you are looking for high end Italian I probably wouldn’t start here.
reviews.author: Curt

reviews.text:
Best Branzino ever!
My husband has to have gluten free, and Luna had some delicious GF dishes
reviews.author: cathe

reviews.text: Food, service and ambience were all amazing! Kudos to our server for great recommendations!
reviews.author: Bob

reviews.text: Terrible service from the start!!! And they knew things were going poorly but they could not turn things around the entire night. The food was OK, but not very hot and nothing worth raving about. We would never go back. There are too many other great options to enjoy.
reviews.author: Kathy

reviews.text: Food and service was bad. Pasta was super salty and my filet  tasted like rubber. It was the eight of us , and did not get our drinks at the same time . Server seemed distracted. I think It was our last time to Luna. We definitely not going back. I was very disappointed bcuz this restaurant was my recommendation but it didn’t meet anyone’s expectations. We all ended up with a hefty check which was not worth it at all.
reviews.author: Soheila

reviews.text: Food and service were great!  Ask for Amanda- she is amazing!!
reviews.author: Stephen

reviews.text: The food looked appealing but lacked flavor. Drinks were delicious. Appetizer lacked flavor. I ordered a tiramisu to go and it was deconstructed and placed in a plastic cup. For 20 dollars I would like it sliced and placed in a container not it looking like a cake in a jar. For me it’s the small things. I was refunded for the desert and they took care of the appetizer. Overall it’s a nice place just not for me a second trip.
reviews.author: Tamara

reviews.text: Outstanding!  Food was delicious and our server, Patricia was just wonderful!  Great atmosphere!!!  I highly recommend
reviews.author: Deborah

reviews.text: Having dinner at Luna is not only a great place to go, it's an experience youll never forget. This restaurant is over an hour away but I would travel 2 hours for it.  The food is the best dishes I've ever eaten but that is constant every time we go here. The staff is unbelievable! This is what makes the experience so good and special.
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.text: Excellent meal. Luna is a terrific option when dining in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Christina

reviews.text: Food was very good. The service was excellent. Our party would come back for sure!
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text: One of my favorite chefs and love all of her food. Everything I’ve had in the menu is outstanding but many of the dishes are overpriced. Otherwise, 5 stars.
reviews.author: Gina

reviews.text: Food and service was excellent. It was our first visit.  We will not return as we had expected a quiet, relaxing meal.  It was the noisiest restaurant of this quality and price we have ever eaten at.
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.text:
Such an incredible experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious — we had the branzino, pizza, and Caesar salad, and every dish was perfectly executed and full of flavor. You can truly taste the quality and care in each bite.

The vibe is warm, stylish, and inviting — the kind of place where you want to linger a little longer. The staff were amazing: attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely welcoming, which made the entire experience even better.

They also have a really cool wine collection, and a special shoutout to the giant pepper grinder 😂 When they pulled it out and asked if we wanted pepper, it had us cracking up and instantly added to the charm of the night.

Great food, great energy, and thoughtful little touches that make it memorable. Can’t wait to go back. 🍷✨
reviews.author: Marta

reviews.text: We had a wonderful time celebrating our anniversary at Luna. The entire staff was wonderful, kind, and attentive. The food was phenomenal - can’t wait to go back!
reviews.author: Megan

reviews.text: We have been there several times and each time we were impressed with the food and the service.  We highly recommend it.
reviews.author: Tony

reviews.text: It’s always a good experience here. We haven’t been here since the new executive chef arrived. My only criticism is the “half-chicken” listed on the menu isn’t really a half at all. It’s a quarter of a Cornish hen, probably. The polenta & chicken were swimming in the sauce. Tasty, but a too much.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.text: We've eaten at Luna a few times and while I like the initial vibe of the restaurant, I have to say, this time was a little disappointing. We had a reservation, but when we arrived, we were told we had to wait as "our section was understaffed". We were finally seated in the corner of the dining room at a table that was not very desirable and there were several open booths, and better tables open in "our section". Our servers were lovely, but it took a long time to get our drinks. Appetizers were great and my risotto was delicious. Food presentation was excellent but the men in our group ordered the specials and they were just OK...the lobsters were a little less than stellar. Meal for 4 with only 1 bottle of wine was close to $800 which I felt was pricey all things considered.
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text: Lovely service, great food.  It’s expensive the only possible reason it was not packed.
reviews.author: Russell

reviews.text: The ambiance, food and service were amazing!  I can’t wait to return to Scottsdale so I can come back again!
reviews.author: Kimberly

reviews.text: One of the best options for big-time food lovers. Do not skip getting a cocktail! Strongly recommend for date night with spouse, double dates, and other small group gatherings.
reviews.author: Haley

reviews.text: Felt like we were sitting in a cafeteria. The food also was not good.
reviews.author: Roger

reviews.text: Great dinner !!  Food was excellent highly recommend the rib eye
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text:
Our evening at Luna by Giada was absolutely amazing! With impressive manager Kenny G at the helm, service is presented as a well orchestrated symphony. Service is ever present, without being intrusive. Difficult to accomplish however with Kenny G overlooking the staff ensuring diners are well taken care of, all is executed in a magnificent order created with an elegant simplicity. We were a party of 6 with great food, excellent service, and perfect drinks presented in a seamless wonderful manner. Must make mention of Patricia who was our terrific server this evening, with José as her support staff.
Having been to Luna by Giada several times, can attest to its ever-extraordinary scene.
reviews.author: John and Susan

reviews.text: Food and service was horrible. Will never go back. Garbage food thats over priced.
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant! Great service and great food!!
reviews.author: Devon

reviews.text:
The food was incredible. We started with focaccia, meatballs and the frito misto. All delicious. Several of us got the Lemon Spaghetti with shrimp. Absolutely delicious!  The shrimp were enormous and the pasta was cooked perfectly. Others got the Buccatini Pomodoro, salmon, petite filet and lobster. Everyone raved about their dinners. Steaks were tender, perfectly cooked and delicious. Salmon was cooked perfectly and the sides were yummy.

We were celebrating a birthday with a large group and the service was incredible. The staff was very attentive.

I have nothing negative to say about Luna. Can’t wait to go back.
reviews.author: Kim

reviews.text: Had a wonderful dinning experience! The food was delicious, compliments to the chef for such flavorful, well-prepared dishes. Big thanks to Kendal and Kaylin for their warm and attentive service as they made the experience even better. Can’t wait to come back!
reviews.author: Kate

reviews.text: Amazing experience overall from the service, to the food, to the ambiance.
reviews.author: Trisha

reviews.text: Food was not good. Cold, over priced. Extremely disappointing
reviews.author: lance

reviews.text: We dined at Luna for my wife's birthday, and the experience was not disappointing. Everything exceeded our expectations. Our wait staff Kaitlyn was a delight and offered some excellent suggestions i.e. the brussel sprouts with a side of the chile oil A+ and the Arizona benefit of being able to cork and take any remaining wine in the bottle. This was great advice. We will add Luna to our rotating schedule for dinner options.
reviews.author: Barton

reviews.text: Great menu and the food was delicious. It was NYE so it was a busy night and they were a bit understaffed. We were understanding of this yet a bit put off when the server complained  about not having enough help and then referred to the bar staff as "not great" when he saw that our wine had not yet been delivered.  Put a bit of a negative spin on things but besides that the food was fantastic and the service was good considering the busy night. Will definitely go again.
reviews.author: Beth

reviews.text: We had an enjoyable New Year’s Eve dinner at Luna. Three of our party are gluten-free eaters, and our waitress Amanda was very accommodating, knowledgeable, and had many options. We loved the lemon pasta, the butternut squash ravioli, the two wash chicken and à la vodka pasta. Luna offers a gluten free pasta that is tasty.
reviews.author: Orion

reviews.text: Service was slow in beginning as we waited a while for water and a waiter. It was New Years eve so very busy. Food was good, ambience beautiful. In my opinion over priced for Italian food.
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text: We had an awesome experience, the service and staff was excellent and the food was amazing!
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Great food, service, and atmosphere!  Lots of positive energy on New Year's Eve!
reviews.author: Charles

reviews.text: Sent the restaurant a private note. Hopefully it was just an off night at what is usually a favorite of mine.
reviews.author: NIKI

reviews.text: Delicious food, outstanding service, loved the ambiance.
reviews.author: Diana

reviews.text: Unfortunately this place was disappointing. We were excited to try a Giada restaurant while in Scottsdale but this one left us wanting more. The real issue was the service. We were sat in the back corner of the restaurant. Took 15 minutes to be acknowledged. We ordered drinks, another 10+ minutes for those and then we ordered dinner. A sausage pizza and a bowl of Buccatini. I will say the food itself actually came out in a rather speedy way. When the server came back to check on us my husband ordered another cocktail. This one took 30 minutes! At this point we were over it. For the price Luna is overrated. Drinks too expensive. Food average. Go elsewhere.
reviews.author: Lindsey

reviews.text:
Beautiful setting. Kitchen set up so you can see it without the noise.
Service was great.
Food was ok. The price would indicate a better culinary experience.
The restaurant adds a 3.5% venue/ admin fee. Our server said it goes to the hotel (landlord).
Not sure if this is a way of pushing the % rent to the customer.
I was hoping it was going to support the kitchen staff.
Our server offered to ask management to take off the fee. I passed.
reviews.author: Max

reviews.text:
We are constantly amazed at the quality and value of the seafood tower. If you want seafood, this should be your go to location.
I always hammer the ribeye and have not been disappointed.
We splurged and ordered tiramisu, pumpkin soufflé, and the cookie platter. All were exceptional.
reviews.author: jack

reviews.text: Amazing food with even better service. Loved this restaurant and will be back!
reviews.author: Regina

reviews.text: Outstanding experience! Took the family(7 people) for a holiday meal. Everyone raved about the food. The specialty lemon spaghetti with a lobster tail was melt in your mouth delicious. Arranci and bacon wrapped dates were wonderful appetizers. Our server, Amanda, was very knowledgeable and gracious. Highest recommendation.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: The night started off wonderfully with outstanding service! From the warm greetings by the hostesses to our fantastic server and the truly delicious food, we really had a wonderful time! Handling a large, lively group isn't always easy, but our kind and attentive server was absolutely superb throughout.
reviews.author: Allen
