reviews.text: The hostess was extremely rude and dismissive when we asked her to take a photo of our family. We asked to be seated inside and were sat halfway on the patio. It took forever to get our food. The entires were not good at all. We will never go back. It was a horrible experience.
reviews.author: Erika

reviews.text: Service was very attentive and the ambiance was great, but everything was overpriced and we had to get our food remade four times until it came correctly.
reviews.author: Zachary

reviews.text: Went for Christmas dinner and had a lovely time. We ordered the dates on recommendation from our hostess and also the lemon spaghetti and branzino. Everything was delicious! Service was very good accounting for how busy it was.
reviews.author: Juli

reviews.text: ABSOLUTELY PHENOMENAL EXPERIENCE!! THE STAFF IS TOP NOTCH! PROVIDED US WITH AN AMZING EXPERIENCE! WE ARE DEFINITELY COMING BACK!! BEST IN PHOENIX !
reviews.author: Noel

reviews.text: Service was GREAT! Food was AMAZING! Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Conni

reviews.text: Fabulous food and service. Meals included salmon, chicken & rib eye steak. All cooked to perfection. Lovely restaurant. Will definitely return in the future.
reviews.author: Cheryl

reviews.text: I sat at the bar and the food, drinks, and service were all amazing! I highly recommend the signature lemon spaghetti. Definitely will be back!
reviews.author: Alix

reviews.text: What Italian food is supposed to taste like. Great service on a Christmas Eve night. Don’t skip out n dessert!
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.text:
One diner enjoyed Seven Fishes menu while others ordered ala carte.  All were excellently prepared with wonderful sauces and beautifully presented and carefully served.  Tiramisu dessert was shared by all.  Will definitely attend next year's Seven Fishes if it is available, and make it an
annual family tradition.
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Christmas eve very busy but it was awesome. Emma our server was exceptional, so friendly very knowledgeable and fast. Our grandaughter brought her elf on the shelf and she brought out chocolate syrup and honey for her. My Grandaughter wad smiling from ear to ear. All the food was really good, drinks and dessert dead on. Thank you Emma for making our night perfect you are one of the best. Will be back.
reviews.author: Bill

reviews.text:
Absolutely the best dining experience one could have. The staff was outstanding,  the food has to be the best I've ever had. I travel about a hour, one way for this restaurant and its worth it. 
I would travel 2 hours. Luna is not only a great restaurant but an evening of experiences. A memorable evening.
Thank you Luna for a wonderful night!
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.text: Ate at bartop. Bar service was excellent. Had dates as a starter, above average and great portion size. 1/2 chicken for entree. Decent portion size, chicken cooked nicely not perfectly. Sauce was an interesting and delightful marsala that tasted like marsala with just a hint of piccata sauce or fresh acid that paired great. Bar cocktails were solid as well.
reviews.author: Dennis

reviews.text: Service and food was excellent! Everyone was happy and on top of everything
reviews.author: Avery

reviews.text: Outstanding service, food, and vibe. Will return again
reviews.author: gil

reviews.text: As has been the case on every visit, the atmosphere and noise level are fantastic. The bread service is great, fluffy and crispy edges with great accompaniments. Salads, Caesar, Caesar with lemon vinaigrette, and caprese were fabulous. The other members of my party loved their entrees. While the lemon spaghetti was fabulous, the chicken that was hammered (grossly overcooked, tough and dried out). It was also disappointing that, unlike previous visits, no one came to ask how the food was.
reviews.author: Terri

reviews.text: Food was delicious, service was so so. Overall good evening with good food.  Waitress was very delightful and friendly.
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.text:
Getting right to the point - the food is AWFUL~!  We ordered 2 appetizers, the crab and the meatballs.  Both were mainly filler and very little meat.  We could not taste crab in the crab appetizer AT ALL, and it had a rice filler - essentially they were rice balls in a tasteless red sauce. and the meatballs essentially were a ball of breadcrumbs and it seemed to be served with the same tasteless red sauce.  SO DISAPPOINTING~!  We both had salads, mine was fine (a caesar salad) and my friend's caprese salad came with near hard tomatoes, way under ripe and woody).
We split the lemon shrimp pasta entree which was fairly good, the sauce was goopy with not much lemon flavor and the shrimp a bit overdone but tolerable - and without salt being on the table for diners to use (MUCH NEEDED) our main entree, which mind you we split, was also not finished due to blandness. Nothing we ordered was finished, We both ordered Tanqueray martinis, which was upcharged by $8.00 for the Tanqueray over/above the price of the martini.  
The manager did stop by our table to inquire about how everything was, and at first we were not going to say anything - just dine and bear it - but I did speak up and at that point and as our main entree and salads had not arrived, but was only able to tell him about the tasteless appetizers.  He seemed shocked. He did end up taking both appetizers off our bill, but should have offered up a free dessert or a drink or to just check back again?? At the point where the manager spoke to us early in the meal our server started to ghost us, our plates sat in front of us until the next course came - which was not speedy.  
SO.....the food is both very over priced & tasteless/unimaginative. Don't bother going, you'll be disappointed too.  Oh, one last thing, the restaurant should give free valet parking to their diners, as you're essentially forced to use the valet due to the proximity to the mall - so parking cost us both $12.00.  This place will be gone soon.
reviews.author: Libby

reviews.text: Wonderful Italian meal! Highly recommend and will be going back soon!
reviews.author: Karl

reviews.text: We celebrated our anniversary and they made the meal and experience memorable.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text: Our date night was perfect and our server had a nice presentation all set up for us before we arrived. Bottle of wine chilled and ready to serve us and the food was amazing! Definitely a great experience and service from our server, management etc was Top Tier! Thank you Brandi for your stellar representation of Service above and beyond. Also shout out to Kenny for his professionalism and commitment to excellence! Cheers!
reviews.author: Mikyl

reviews.text: Was expecting a more unique menu, especially from Giada.  My husband enjoyed the branzino.  It was cooked well and had nice flavors.  The petite filet mignon was subpar.  Was cooked much less than medium as requested which was disappointing.  We were seated at a table in close proximity to the bar which meant the quiet, upscale dinner we were expecting to experience didn't happen.  The wait staff was very good though.  It was worth trying but, unfortunately, we won't be back.
reviews.author: Angie

reviews.text: By Very beautiful dining room however staff was a little on the slow side and wasn’t paying much attention to us in that they served our main course while we were still eating our salads. I hate when that happens  and you would think they would not do this in a high end restaurant. The caprese salad was so-so. They used a foam instead of mozzarella.  We weren’t impressed. The branzino was pretty bland. Everything else was good. Not sure I will return.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: Inventive menu- try the lemon pizza - great service and wonderful outdoor patio.
reviews.author: Donald

reviews.text: Super impressed with Jay and a young lady named McKenzie ( from Shakopee, MN) love the energy, positivity and awesome vibe!
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: Another wonderful evening with delicious food at Luna. Melanie was our server as has been in the past and was phenomenal. What a beautiful dining experience with quality food. A real treat for someone who loves to cook and dine out. Will come back next time in town. ￼
reviews.author: Liz

reviews.text: The food was not good! The service was great though. It was super expensive for what we got!
reviews.author: Mimi

reviews.text: Always love coming here.  Food is consistently excellent.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: We loved it!  The service was perfect from start to finish!  The food was amazing!  We will be back!  Would highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: We enjoyed a wonderful dinner at Luna. Our service was outstanding!  Our appetizers and entrees were delicious.
reviews.author: Laurie

reviews.text: The lemon shrimp pasta was amazing! My husband got the half chicken entree and sent it back. It was a small chicken breast swimming in sauce. They were great about it and brought him the lemon pasta dish in place at his request.
reviews.author: Carol

reviews.text: We enjoyed the great atmosphere and service. Our server was knowledgeable about the menu and offered good recommendations for food and wine. We enjoyed the food and would go back.
reviews.author: Christopher

reviews.text: The food is amazing. We ordered the seafood tower and could have used two more as it is the best value.
reviews.author: jack

reviews.text: The food was absolutely amazing. Everything fresh, carefully selected and delicious.
reviews.author: troy

reviews.text: Always an amazing experience at Luna, food and service were outstanding.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: The food is absolutely amazing.  The staff went above and beyond in all aspects! The ambiance was very festive - the Christmas decorations outstanding! Had a fabulous time! Ask for Cherise! She was awesome!
reviews.author: Jolie

reviews.text: We enjoyed a delicious meal, professionally served by Melanie & her helper. My husband ordered a special and it would have been nice if we were apprised of the price of the special .
reviews.author: Gary Skeeter

reviews.text: Luna is a good restaurant, but not at the level of the great restaurants in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Carl  M .

reviews.text: Pricilla who escorted us to our table was an absolute delight!
reviews.author: Kathy

reviews.text: Amazing food and atmosphere. Staff was friendly and attentive
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text: Overall, we enjoy coming back here. This is probably our 4th and we’ve tried a lot of different things. They change the menu up and the new tuna appetizer is amazing. We also loved the salmon and got 2 pastas. The bucatini sauce is a little lackluster but the nodi is really flavorful. Service is amazing here too, the dining room is nice and spacious.
reviews.author: Colleen

reviews.text:
Luna is amazing! The food and staff are exceptional, especially Kendall and Paul!
Thank you for a wonderful experience!
reviews.author: Emily

reviews.text: Kendall was a terrific server! I highly recommend the restaurant.
reviews.author: Ted

reviews.text:
The food at Luna was delicious and artfully displayed.  The atmosphere was fun and festive but still elegant.  Loved the giant pepper grinder!  Our server Kendall was very attentive, but not intrusive.  She was very helpful when we had wine issues.  

The downsides were the food was quite pricey (only 2 scallops in the dinner entre for $49) and we had issues getting the correct wine. I ordered a red Bordeaux blend and the wine that was brought out was not the right one.  My server actually pointed it out initially. The bar manager came out and said that it was the correct wine but didn’t give me the bottle.  Since he insisted it was correct, I accepted it and he opened it.  Once I was able to look at the bottle, it was clearly not the right bottle.  It was the correct winery but chianti and not a Bordeaux blend with a significant difference in price.  The server agreed and sent the wine bottle back. The beverage manager came out again and said he had something similar he would offer. He said it was a similar blend and again did not let me look at the bottle.  Once able to see the bottle, it was not a Bordeaux blend or even a blend at all!  It was old vines zin. It wasn’t anything close to a red Bordeaux blend although there were several Bordeaux blends on their list at a similar price point.  I talked to our server again, and she agreed that it was nowhere close to what I had ordered and suggested that I pick something else off the list which is what should’ve happened in the first place.  Thus, on the third try and after all the food was eaten, finally got an appropriate bottle of wine.  Kendall our server was great through all of this and discounted our meal 10% due to all of the craziness, I would say the beverage manager needs some additional training. He knew wine words and acted like he knew what he was talking about, but he clearly did not know wine.  Big fail.
reviews.author: Kendra

reviews.text: The BV wine dinner was delicious. Excellent staff at all levels. Food items came out at proper temps which is difficult when there are 75 guests! All in all, one of the best wine events we’ve ever attended - and we go to many!
reviews.author: Debra

reviews.text: There was a table across from us who were associated with the vineyard.  Felt that we did not get the service for what we paid.  The servers seemed to be more concerned with that table instead of the customers who paid for the experience.  The two first courses were great.  The main course was okay.  Not impressed with the pasta.  The dessert felt like I was eating pudding not tiramisu. I doubt I would ￼pay for this experience again.
reviews.author: Colette

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our dinner at Luna very much.  It was a bit noisier this time, but nice seated with a view of the kitchen.

The caprese and arugula salads were very fresh and bright.  The 6 oz filet was cooked perfectly, and we had plenty of horseradish as requested.

The spicy sausage pizza was also excellent.  Would not have minded more spice, however.

The crowning achievement, though, was the white negroni.  Last time, we had this same cocktail with a malfi limone gin.  It was mild -- could not taste the juniper.  This time, we asked for a gin mare instead, and this significantly improved the taste.  It was spectacular.  Perhaps the bar could consider making this change down the line and take the white negroni to a new level.
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: Staff was amazing and attentative and food was amazing. 10 out of 10
reviews.author: Iana

reviews.text: The dining experience was very good, I would suggest that people avoid sitting outside bc the tables are very close to the road, and we had sports cars going by with what I believe is loud aftermarket exhaust on them. Drowning us out. I understand that’s outside the control of the restaurant, but even with the great weather sitting inside would’ve been a better choice
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.text: The Thanksgiving buffet was terrible. Quality was extremely low. The price at $140 per person was ridiculous.  I have enjoyed my previous experiences at Giada in Scottsdale and Las Vegas. However, this was an embarrassment for an otherwise very good restaurant.  This should have been no more than $70 a person and at that price it still wasn’t worth it.
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text: Love it love it love it. Never disappointed to come back. Consistency, quality and excellence is their game here.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Excellent meal. Good service. Appreciated not being rushed and allowed to enjoy our meal.
reviews.author: Angela

reviews.text: We visited for my mom’s birthday who’s a big fan Giada, and she loved the good and ambience. We’ll be back!
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: Jay was amazing and provided excellent service.  The food was on point and decore was nice.  I highly recommend this place.
reviews.author: Caesar

reviews.text: Food was fair, the service and ambiance were nice. Not what I'd call a "value." More of a brand spot than a foodie spot.
reviews.author: Dwayne

reviews.text:
We got the crab arancini as an appetizer!! They were amazing.  The caprese salad was divine…. So fresh & quality ingredients.  We also got the famous lemon pasta which was delicious.  The bucatini with italian sausage added was also great.  Our server , Sarah was fantastic. The only complaint would be it took awhile for our main entrees to come out.  
The only other  negative is it is s extremely loud and the prices are way too  high.  We ordered 2 extra shrimp for our pasta dish & they were $10 each!!😳 They were big but $10?? 
The sausafe we ordered for our bucatini was also an extra charge.  All in all I’d say it’s a great place for a special occasion but be prepared to spend $$$.
reviews.author: Sue

reviews.text: They didn’t cook either of our chicken dishes fully. The waiters and manager handled it well by apologizing but it was not the best. We will still try back. We like their spaghetti.
reviews.author: Jenna

reviews.text: Great food as always and great service. Loved the steak
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Eating dinner at Luna was not just about the food, it's about the dinner experience.  And what an experience it was! I travel a little over an hour to dine here and it was well worth the trip. 
The food was outstanding,  as was the service, hospitality, and overall experience.  
Would recommend 100%!
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.text: Great food and service in a lively upscale setting!
reviews.author: Frank

reviews.text: Delicious food  Great service. Friendly staff. Don’t forget dessert
reviews.author: Ed

reviews.text: Excellent service n great food challenges rooftop parking but the restaurant is well worth it
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Nice place.  Service was outstanding.  Value for food was ok.  Portions were small for the price.  I ordered scallops risotto and it only had 2 scallops for a dinner entree with a small portion of risotto.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text: Everything was fabulous, the steak, the pizza, the lemon pasta, the bacon wrapped dates!  We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Brenda

reviews.text: Super fun experience and the food was great. So was the service! ￼
reviews.author: Tatum

reviews.text: We had a reservation for 7:30 but we had to wait over 30 minutes for our table. Seemed very unorganized.
reviews.author: Audrey

reviews.text: Dinner on the patio was most likely more peaceful than inside.  Brandy was an OUTSTANDING server with exceptional knowledge of the menu!  She made wonderful recommendations.  Homemade pastas, even a wonderful gluten free pasta available.  Everything down to the cocktails, wine and bread were a fabulous culinary experience.
reviews.author: Suzanne

reviews.text: The Branzino was raw, the Porter house steak was overcooked. The Sicilian bread was very good as was the pizza. The fried shrimp and calamari were also good. The deserts were OK.
reviews.author: Rose

reviews.text: The service was top notch and the food was great. The holiday decorations were up and the tree was lit while we were there. Very festive.
reviews.author: Gail

reviews.text: The food was not very good. The scallops were so fishy smelling I couldn't even get them to my mouth. I eat out a lot and enjoy good food. The food here sucks
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text:
The restaurant is presently beautifully decorated for the holidays, and we sat outside on the patio with a space heater and were very comfortable.
The orzo meatballs, lemon spaghetti, mezza rigatoni and pumpkin soufflé dessert were all top tier.  Our server Kaitlyn was very attentive and friendly, as were the entire wait staff.  Will definitely be returning for more Italian delights!
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Fun and great location. Food was good. Server was a little uppity and felt like we didn’t matter.
reviews.author: Martha

reviews.text:
Our dinner and time at Luna was wonderful.  The food was tasty and flavorful.
The restaurant was very busy so it took awhile for our drinks and food to arrive.  We were originally seated inside but the noise level was incredibly high.  They found us a high top table outside for our party of 10.  It was a perfect evening to sit outside and we could hear each other talk.  
Perfect location for our dinner.  Thank you!
reviews.author: Hants

reviews.text: Good vibe at the bar and food was great. Service was on point.
reviews.author: Juan

reviews.text: Just about everything was bad. The server entered in an incorrect starter, then looked at me like I was lying when I said I didn’t order it. Drinks were incorrect and essentially double charged. The sides arrived 10 minutes before entrees. Then one entree arrived, while we waited another 5 minutes for the next three. The shrimp on the signature lemon pasta was very bad. The pizza was just okay. The meatballs were too firm and too sweet. The focaccia and arancini (which we didn’t order) were good. Our server rarely checked in. A buster left our left over pizza in a box on the seat of a table next to ours. Multiple times drinks, food, and even a wine chiller were brought to our table that we didn’t order. To top it off, the chocolate chunk cookies, had one (yes 1) single piece of chocolate in them. We really wanted to like this place, but they operated like a new restaurant on opening night. Everyone we interacted with seemed completely lost and not properly trained.
reviews.author: Jared

reviews.text: we had to wait 45 mins on the table to receive food that totally disappointed us in taste.
reviews.author: Kiran

reviews.text: Service was excellent. Food was great and the ambiance perfect.
reviews.author: Oquendo

reviews.text:
Incredible customer service, food, and ambiance.
Loved it
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.text: First, very cold inside, didn't think the employees would be wearing jeans. Our appy was great, calamari! Dinner dishes, not so much, my pasta was overcooked, mushy..the server kepted trying to upcharge us on everything, would you like shrimp added, would you like lobster added? Expected a nicer interior...
reviews.author: leigh

reviews.text: Love it love it love it. Never disappointed to come back. Consistency, quality and excellence is their game here.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Outstanding service, beautiful locations and environment, original and creative menu, fantastic food from appetizers to entrees.  This place kicks Italian food up another notch.  Cannot recommend it enough.
reviews.author: Edgar

reviews.text: Food is outstanding.  Our server was great but forgot numerous things we asked for.
reviews.author: Lynn

reviews.text: I have never had lobster so light, soft and airy and the gluten free pasta was dare I say perfect. I will absolutely be back for more!
reviews.author: Taylor

reviews.text: Food was excellent especially the Signature Lemon Spaghetti and the Wild Isles Salmon. The ambiance was amazing. Thank you for a great experience.
reviews.author: Steven

reviews.text: Service was very nice. Ambiance was great. Food was meh. I was so disappointed as I’ve been a big fan of Giada for years and finally got to taste her food and didn’t care much for any of it. The food had a lot of lemon flavor or no flavor. After the lemon flavored Caesar salad, and the lemon marscapone butter, I changed my order from the lemon spaghetti to a tomato pasta. The lemon flavor was over powering and tasted artificial. The food was missing some salt and pepper and garlic and spices. The prices were quite expensive for portion size. You had to pay $15 for bread. We tried the peach cheesecake for dessert and it tasted like nothing. The peaches were not sweet. The cheesecake texture was light but had was not sweet and had absolutely no flavor either. There are many better Italian restaurants in town.
reviews.author: Elissa

reviews.text: This was one of the best restaurant experiences, especially in Scottsdale. Food was amazing, fresh scratch kitchen, every ingredient had a place - local or original sourcing. Service was outstanding - Jay was awesome and treated us like royalty :) !!
reviews.author: Marco

reviews.text: Everything about this place was great.   The food was perfect, service was flawless, & the manager touched the table.  This is how a restaurant should be.  Sarah, our server, was great.  Nice, friendly, checked on us, explained the menu, water was always refilled by assistants, etc.  All around great experience and we will definitely return.
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.text: Really fun time celebrating our anniversary 10/10 would reccommend!!!
reviews.author: Collin

reviews.text: This is a standard hotel restaurant. No complaints with the service the food is just okay and the price point is high. Had the ribeye, recommended by the server; it was really fatty. Wouldn’t recommend or return.
reviews.author: Jenny

reviews.text: The menu and food quality is superb. Especially the Lemon Spaghetti! The server was very personable; however, the wait for our food seemed longer than normal. It was extremely loud during prime time dinner hour. Others may find the noise energizing, but for me, it was unfortunately excessive.
reviews.author: Belinda

reviews.text:
In an area where there are many great restaurants, Luna really stands out from the rest. Despite the huge crowd that was at the hotel for a charity event, the restaurant manager, Kenny, treated us like VIPs from the moment we arrived till our departure. We had arrived a little early so chose to enjoy a drink at the bar and watch the start of the World Series game. Kenny kept circling back to check on us, each time to see if we were ready to move to our table. He personally ensured that we got the best table on Luna’s beautiful patio.

Service at Luna is truly impeccable, and extremely attentive. It’s clear that the entire staff is focused on creating a memorable dining experience for their guests.

The real test of any restaurant is of course the food, and each of us loved everything we tasted. Dishes are beautifully plated, incredibly tasty, and perfectly portioned to leave room for desserts.

Luna is now our favorite Arizona restaurant, and we’ll definitely be back.
reviews.author: Mickey

reviews.text: Luna by Giada is an absolute gem! The food was incredible—from the fresh ingredients to the thoughtful presentation, every dish was bursting with flavor. The outdoor seating made the evening especially memorable, with beautiful ambiance and a relaxed, elegant feel. The staff were friendly, attentive, and clearly take pride in making the experience exceptional. Whether you’re celebrating something special or just want a perfect night out, Luna by Giada is a must-visit.
reviews.author: VICKIE

reviews.text: Excellent service with the food to match. Compliments to Chef Mathew
reviews.author: Rick

reviews.text: Excellent dinner in very pleasant atmosphere, extremely attentive staff, including our server, Natalie.
reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.text: We were excited to visit this new Giada restaurant since we have been to the one in Vegas. It was quiet, and just what we needed to celebrate a birthday. The food was excellent, except for the peach cheesecake, where the peaches were hard and there was no peach flavor. However, the cheesecake itself was light and fluffy and airy. The ravioli were the same, pillows of cheese smothered in pepper cheese sauce. Out entrees were flavorful and everything we expected of fresh scallops and homemade fennel sausage. The cloud dessert was delicious and we wanted to take home the crunchy chocolate candy on it.  Service was outstanding, as our server was personable and explained how they are looking to move the menu to more local ingredients and considering sustainable practices.
reviews.author: Brent

reviews.text: Luna does not disappoint. Service was excellent and guided us to great dishes. We will go again and again.
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.text:
We have been to Luna a few times for dinner,the service and ambience on all occasions were excellent.
Thank you Melonie for making our dinner so special.
You were very informative and attentive.
The food as always was delicious.
reviews.author: Kate

reviews.text:
Luna has surprised me.   I’m not sure what to expect from pasta at restaurants because it is usually undercooked (not al dente) but luna by giada has a nice menu, decent pasta and pizza, and a lovely atmosphere.
The service at this place is outstanding. Friendly knowledgeable staff that really go out do their way to give you a good time.
reviews.author: kevin

reviews.text: The food, service, and atmosphere were fabulous as usual.
reviews.author: Andy

reviews.text:
A great vibe on saturday night especially now that evenings are cooler in aZ. That patio is well worth it.
Always awesome service by amanda; the welcome is always appreciated by Paul and Melissa.
See you in 2 weeks!
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: The service was unbelievable and above and beyond. Kendall was amazing and should get a raise! I was disappointed by their signature dish lemon spaghetti. It had too much cream and needed more flavor. Their lemon gelato was too tart. The focaccia was to die for! I would absolutely order that! The salmon was perfectly cooked but the peas that went with it were plain. I love Giada’s recipes and make them all the time but have been underwhelmed by her restaurants. I bet the recipes are great but the execution of the chefs is not great. I hope they can change this.
reviews.author: Catherine

reviews.text: This was our first time at Luna and it did not disappoint.  The service was very good.  The food was amazing.  We mentioned to our server that had a play and so we wanted to be sure the timing for us to get there was ok.  Our food came out VERY fast and they had us on our way so we had no issue getting out of there on time.  I will for sure be coming back.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: IF you love the combination of great food, a first-class atmosphere, and excellent service, you'll love Luna by Giada!
reviews.author: Charles

reviews.text: The view from the patio seating was lovely and the restaurant was beautiful.  The food was good but didn't blow me away, especially having eaten at many competing Italian restaurants the area. While our server was absolutely lovely and very attentive, it's clear they are trained to attempt an upsell with every single item ordered and it became a little agitating as the evening progressed.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.text:
Wife and I had a fabulous time.
Food was great 
Service was Great 
Cherise was FANTASTIC , she had ideas and offered options. Left us alone in-between courses so we could talk and enjoy each other's company on our date night.
We are actually going back tonight for another family celebration with the kiddos.
You will miss out if you don't try it.
Just saying!
reviews.author: Wayne

reviews.text: We had a fabulous time at this restaurant. From the bartenders at the bar before we were seated to dinner, to the front desk, and our wonderful server Brandi, and to her assistants and everyone around the restaurant, a big thank you! Brandi was so nice, attentive, warm and excellent at her craft.  The food was delicious. Thanks to the chef! The crab arancini was the best. So glad Brandi recommended it. We’ll definitely be back to enjoy dining at Luna by Giada.
reviews.author: Ana

reviews.text: Dara was awesome!  Great pizza.  Loved the whole experience.
reviews.author: Sachin

reviews.text: Great service by the host,waitress,and assistants. The food and ambiance was amazing.
reviews.author: Diana

reviews.text:
great food
$500 for two people
If you want a special meal this is the place
Located inside a hotel so it lacks some ambience
reviews.author: Wally

reviews.text:
Great atmosphere and unique menu. Fantastic wine list and knowledgeable, attentive sever. The cocktails and bread….amazing.
Go early for a drink the bar.
reviews.author: K

reviews.text: Outstanding customer service and wonderful offerings ￼
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text: Amazing! Amazing place to celebrate a birthday and engagement
reviews.author: Naomie

reviews.text: Very good food and experience they had some amazing calamari and the margarita to die for
reviews.author: Nailah

reviews.text: Food is always outstanding .  The waitress was great, however clearly under staffed.  A large event was taking priority over dining room customers.  Ordered a drink early in thr dinner and didn't get  until after the dinner .
reviews.author: Todd

reviews.text: Don’t order the $66 pork chop saltimboca. Awful and tasteless. Stick with the lemon pasta with shrimp.
reviews.author: ED

reviews.text: Took my wife here for an anniversary dinner. If you are looking to spend some money on a nice meal but want to make sure you get your moneys worth, I highly recommend. Amazing food and exceptional service!
reviews.author: Jacob

reviews.text: We had a wonderful time at Luna! We tried one of Giada’s places in Vegas, so we had to give this one a shot. The crab appetizer was incredible. We also loved the surf and turf special and the spicy sausage pizza. Service was also excellent!
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.text: Luna has exceptional service and uniquely crafted entrees
reviews.author: Deborah

reviews.text: Had an amazing salad and pasta meal.  Can't wait to go back!
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text: We went for restaurant week.  It was very busy but, we got there early 6:15p and thought we would be done around 8:00p.  We didn't leave until 9:30p the first course was timely and the others seemed slow to arrive.  Our waitress was very nice but, not very attentive.   We asked for a straw and it took 10 minutes before it arrived and that was only because we asked someone else to get it for us.   Same with ice for an iced tea... it took a long time too.  Two of us ordered off the Summer menu $75 , one of us ordered off the AZ restaurant week and one ordered off the main menu.  When the first course was delivered two people got salads and one of us never got their salad we had to ask for it and it took a while to arrive.  Food was just okay, My friend ordered salmon, she didn't want the pea puree so they brought out an simple meal of a small piece of salmon and a few gnocchi... very bland looking... I think they should have replaced the pea puree with something a little more appealing.  I ordered the chicken piccata.  It was warm, not hot and I have never had chicken piccata with bones in it.  It was just okay.  We ordered dessert.  My friend ordered Chocolate gelato when it was delivered the waitress said we don't have chocolate so we brought you vanilla.  My friend is a very much a chocolate person and would liked to have had a different option.  She ended up ordering Tiramisu which was incredible (best part of the whole meal) and the chocolate chip cookies were amazing too.  All in all we had a nice night with great friends but, we were very disappointed in our meal and the service.
reviews.author: DONNA

reviews.text: We'd been talking about going to Luna for a while, and Restaurant Week provided a good reason--and we're glad we did! To get as much variety as possible, we shared salads (arugula and citrus Caesar), entrees (tripolini pasta and lemon pizza, with prosciutto added), and the cookie plate and vanilla gelato. It was a fun mix of flavors and showed off the range & talent of the folks in the kitchen. The service was excellent as well, and our server Amanda struck the perfect balance between attentiveness and letting us enjoy each course. Her recommendation on the wine was spot-on as well.
reviews.author: Jake

reviews.text:
We had a great dinner and dessert. Our waitress was excellent, her name was Katelin and she saw to our everyneed. She was personable and answered every question.  The Scallop risotto was cooked just right as was my wife's Lemon Spaghetti and Shrimp. We had the Cheesecake for Dessert, it was creamy and a great choice with the strawberries.
All in all, a great anniversary dinner! We celebrated our 54th and Katelyn joked that we need to share 54 kisses!! 
We will definitely be going back!!!
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: Was excited to visit Luna for the first time. We were seated easily with reservations. Our waiter Jay greeted us, asked if we would be using the restaurant week menu or regular menu.  We said one of each. He then said we don’t do that. I almost left but my partner really wanted to eat here. If you can’t choose from both menus don’t offer them. Jose the staff help was was and welcoming. Jay was efficient and interesting. Glad we stayed the food was phenomenal.
reviews.author: Kim

reviews.text: Outstanding Lemon Pasta. Loved the arugula salad and had great cocktails! Definitely would go back.
reviews.author: Denise

reviews.text: Overall it was a good place to go on a Saturday night while visiting Scottsdale with family
reviews.author: Alessia

reviews.text:
Amazing night of drinks, ambiance and amazing tasting food. Most importantly the team was on their game and provided great service! We watched as Kenny  orchestrated the team to a busy night, he was on us from the moment we stepped in, and curated an evening that was memorable!
When the area we dined in was exploding with large groups and eclipsed our date night vibe,  he moved us to perhaps the best spot in the house.  We did not ask for it, he took it upon himself! That is attentive!
Daria read our minds and hovered over us and guided our choices as we enjoyed food not found on this side of the Atlantic. Thank you!
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.text: Delicious food, great options. My only complaint is how the special was explained. The lobster add-on was explained as if it was included with the dish, not charged separately.
reviews.author: Maggie

reviews.text: The food and service are good. The restaurant is nice, but the noise level in the main dining room is very high.
reviews.author: Angela

reviews.text: Food was fabulous. Did the summer tasting menu and it was of great value. Kendall was our server and she was fantastic.
reviews.author: Diane

reviews.text: Food was okay, service was initially great before ordering our food but the waitress did not come back to check on us until I got another waiter to order my dessert and I feel like I had to waive her down to get my check. Maybe she was over seated or she thought someone else would tip better but I have had better service and food other places.
reviews.author: Jalicia

reviews.text: Absolutely an amazing dining experience!! Definitely coming back again and again! Service and food as well as ambience was so exceptional!!
reviews.author: Nikki

reviews.text: It’s always an amazing experience to sample Giada’s menu. She is an amazing chef.
reviews.author: Rebecca

reviews.text: This is a review for the Meet and Greet Event with Giada held on 9/11/25. Overall this was a very fun experience and the food was unbelievable. Our only quibbles were that we would much rather prefer a pre-fixed menu with a smaller crowd than getting up and walking around to get our food at the different stations. We also expected Giada to talk a little more on the microphone about how the evening was going to go, and a little background on the restaurant etc.. Her bodyguard was also being pushy to keep her moving throughout the restaurant which is understandable but we felt the meet and greet was a little rushed. This was a lovely experience but for that price point I would not do it again.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.text: We did the wine pairing dinner with Giada. It was awesome. My wife loves Giada and she was able to meet with her discuss favorite recipes and have her book signed. It was an awesome evening and one my wife will remember forever.
reviews.author: Travis

reviews.text:
Last night we attended a special tasting event at Luna and it was a night to remember! 
Every employee we interacted with was so friendly, provided good conversation, and had big smiles. You could tell they actually wanted to be there which made the experience even better. Now the food options available were killer. Salad in a cheese wheel along with pasta was the highlight, especially the freshly made ricotta. White lemon pizza melted in your mouth and lemon was a perfect hint of citrus. I also enjoyed the dessert bites as well. 
Kendall (waitress) and Elisa (helper) deserve a shout out because they were so kind and just on top of everything! Can't wait to go back and sit in Kendall's section :)
reviews.author: Lauren

reviews.text: Awesome experience! Highly recommended it was a great evening
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: We had a wonderful gustatory experience. Service is impeccable, gave 4 stars because the vegetarian bolognese wasn’t that great, however, the brancino and the bucatini were delicious. There’s a lot of echo mainly because of the metal and tile which makes it hard to hear other people . The price is high but nothing that wouldn’t be expected for the location and service. All in all a great experience.
reviews.author: Cristina

reviews.text: WOW!!!!!  Luna by Giada is fabulous.  The restaurant is nestled inside the Caesars Republic Scottsdale Hotel, and the ambiance is very pleasing to the eyes.  We were drawn to Luna by Giada as Giada is one of my favorite chefs I used to watch on the Food Network.  The staff were very welcoming, and we appreciated their attire for this upscale establishment.  Every staff person we encountered wished us a Happy Anniversary (I put a note in when I made the reservation).  Our server, Dara, WAS PHENOMENAL.  Every drink, dish and dessert she recommended was a winner.  I had a Giada inspired martini that was infused with Giada EVOO.  It was nice and smooth.  We started with the bacon wrapped dates.  Hubby and I both gave this recommendation by Dara the SIDE EYE, yet it was DELICIOUS.  Perfect combination of sweetness with the dates, savory/salty with the bacon and a little spice from the sauce on the plate.  The stars of the night were the entrees.  We chose the signature lemon spaghetti which was paired with grilled lobster (featured menu item) and Giada's trio (also featured menu item) which was Giada's take on surf n turf n pasta.  The trio included a petit filet cooked to perfection, topped with a round cheese filled ravioli and paired with seared scallops.  Initially looking at the meals before us, I didn't think we would have room for dessert.  Surprisingly we had room to share their signature dessert of lemon souffle with a raspberry sauce and paired with their homemade lemon biscotti.  The chef also sent us a c dessert for our anniversary. We walked away from this experience feeling extremely satisfied from our meal yet not stuffed as if we had overeaten.  Definitely a place we would go back to for special occasions.  This is a place we feel that anyone needs to experience at least once in their lifetime.  You won't be disappointed.  The staff stayed on point, and we loved they sat us near the kitchen that customers can see through the floor to ceiling glass.
reviews.author: Monica

reviews.text: Everything was lovely and delicious! Truly an amazing food experience and looking forward to my next visit!
reviews.author: Linda

reviews.text:
We enjoyed the Lobster ravioli and Scallop Risotto, amazing dishes along with delicious Ceasar salad and Foccaccia bread.

Mia at the bar was great!
Christian our server was fantastic too.
Even Amanda the manager greeted us at our table very nice.

All in all great food, drinks, service, ambiance and a well orchestrated team throughout Luna by Giada.

Loved it all so much we are returning next week.

Thanks!
Jim and Lisa
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.text: Great food, ambience and service. However I think the price point is a little out of pocket for what it is. You are paying for the Giada name.
reviews.author: tara

reviews.text: Food was delicious, pizza was superb and sauce was seasoned to perfection. The desserts are amazing and the service is on point. Great dining experience.
reviews.author: Steven

reviews.text:
5 Star Prices for 2 Star Quality.
Despite special instructions the $66 pork chop ( with no side) was over done. Pasta was good, but not worth $38. Service was attentive, but the wait between courses was excessive. Cheesecake tasted more like whipped cream on a crust you could not cut with a fork. Fairly loud. Charged an additional service fee, and no validation for the $12 valet.
reviews.author: Debbie

reviews.text: Server and busser were professional and very attentive. The bartender knew his stuff! Food was amazing as usual!
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: I enjoyed everything about my Luna dining experience.  Reservations were easy to make, the hostess staff was friendly and welcoming, as was the restaurant manager.  My waiter explained menu items very clearly.  We started with the arancini and the focaccia, which were delightful.  I had the signature lemon spaghetti, which was absolutely delicious.  My husband had the bucatini pomodoro.  The pastas were delightfully homemade.  I loved the ambiance of the restaurant.  We ate in the Jade Room, which was a little quieter than the other dining room.  We will definitely dine here again, and recommend it highly to friends.
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.text: Great first time experience at Luna Giada! Started with fun cocktails, moved to apps- calamari/shrimp, fungi pizza, then entrees. Two of us ordered the signature lemon spaghetti with two shrimp, other two ordered the vegetable bolognese. Lemon spaghetti was very rich and very lemony! I could have split that with someone. A little too much lemon for my liking, but good nonetheless! The vegetable bolognese was incredibly flavorful! So good!  They treated us to a Cannoli dessert for my bday! Very yummy! Christian was an attentive server. The team there was on point!
reviews.author: barb

reviews.text: Our waitress Shereice was outstanding! She just radiates a positive attitude and set the tone for our evening. She knew the menu like the back of her hand and suggested great wine pairings with each meal. Its like we had our very own sommelier. The lemon spaghetti and branzino were cooked to perfection and bursting with flavors. I cant wait to go back. Great ambiance and collectively the entire staff were amazing.
reviews.author: Surin

reviews.text: This was my second time dining at Luna by Giada and was just as excellent! Everyone is just so welcoming, friendly and helpful. I love staying at Caesar’s Republic and you can bet I’ll always make a reservation at Luna every time! Thank you so much!
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: The food was wonderful and our server was excellent. It was all so good. Will definitely return.
reviews.author: Lino

reviews.text: Enjoyed a great dinner at Luna celebrating my wife's birthday. From the moment we arrived we were welcomed and the positive impression presented by every one of the staff set the tone for the evening. We ordered from the fixed price menu, which is only available in the summer, and it was a tremendous value. Salad, pasta, entree and gelato. Everything was excellent, portions were ample and service was unhurried. We plan to hit the bar at happy hour next week!
reviews.author: Ric

reviews.text: Great as always. The warmth of the service and quality of the food always make it a great experience!
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: This is the best dinner we’ve had in Scottsdale.  Everything was amazing and so much better than Maple and Ash or even the nicest Italian spots in the valley.
reviews.author: Charles

reviews.text: Food was good, ambiance decent. Dining area almost had a cafeteria feel and certainly did not match the menu or prices. Beautiful high-end kitchen. Service was up to par. Value not good. Likely first and last visit.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: Excellent food and drinks menu. Stunning restaurant down to the small details. Don’t miss this place!
reviews.author: Sadhana

reviews.text: The best italian in all of arizona! Authentic quality ingredients, super accomodating chefs, amazing dishes, and awesome service! From Paul the GM, to our favorite servers, we love this family, chic atmosphere.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: The food is exceptional, memorable and cravable. The service was even better. I will absolutely go back again and highly recommend.
reviews.author: Aubrey

reviews.text: Excellent food and drinks in a beautiful space.  Superior  prepared food from a well designed menue.
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.text: Enjoyed our experience at Luna I’m a local and my first visit it was Fabulous nice place to bring friends and family. One key point at the bar area and main entrance there is not a lot of room for people that don’t want to do the simple 2 steps to restrooms, I’m handicap and my experience with trying to around navigate around the bar area, The Most Rudest group of patrons I’d ever come across with using a 2 word comment of Excuse Me. Just a thought.

reviews.text: Great food and great service! A little pricey, but great experience.
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.text: We had the summer tasting menu and it was excellent - and something special, not the usual menu. We also got our favorite table next to the kitchen (to watch all the other food, not just ours). The service - as always - was excellent.

reviews.text: Wonderful as always! We love Giada’s restaurants. Everything on the menu is fantastic.
reviews.author: charles

reviews.text: Overall my gluten free rice pasta a la vodka was excellent. The calamari, pizzas, risotto, crab arancini were outstanding. The lemon soufflé and tiramisu out of this world! Keep up the great work Luna team.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: My wife and I are fans of Giada’s so we were excited to try Luna but was pricey and I was very disappointed with the food.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text: Great service and excellent food. Thanks again love the atmosphere
reviews.author: Steven

reviews.text: Great food experience! Dined in the summer so there were  wry few people dining which made for a great time!
reviews.author: Maria

reviews.text:
Really, a nice experience. From hostess to wait staff, to support staff, service was friendly and genuine, with the degree of professionalism you’d expect from an upscale night out kind of place (although the jumbo red pepper mill seemed like a clownish prank management might be playing on the waitstaff). Cocktails were spectacular; I had the Moderno…lovely, balanced, and refreshing for this non-bourbon drinker. My daughter had the Fico Prugna, a fantastic feature of fig vodka (and if you haven’t tried that yet, what’s the matter with you?). Oysters are always a gamble in the desert; not here…the West Coast oysters were fresh, sweet, and beautiful with traditional vinaigrette and lemon (don’t drown such a beautiful thing in cocktail sauce, but it’s there if you must). My daughter had the pistachio pesto and sausage pasta; you could taste every ingredient…lovely, but do yourself a favor and try the signature lemon spaghetti…I have celiac disease, and took a chance on the gluten-free substitute: a short noodle that I really can’t recall…Penne?…I was too floored by the exquisiteness of it to try and pin it down…just amazing. Served with two large, sweet, perfectly cooked shrimp. If giving up gluten kills you, Luna will send you right to heaven.

Dessert was a bit of a bummer. Decaf was tepid (cold…had to send it back); the replacement wasn’t much hotter, and the lemon souffle was bland and under cooked. I know it’s tricky, but 2 more minutes would’ve been probably perfect, like the light, tart, blueberry coulis served with it. We did not complain…sending the coffee back was hard enough for me; I don’t wanna be that girl.

Ambience is soft and pretty, too nice for the volume blasting from table of 8 next to us who got really load after their meal (lots of shouting), but it was somebody’s birthday, and I can see how that lemon pasta might do that to some people.

All of n all, I can’t wait to go back.
I’ll try and be quiet.
reviews.author: heather

reviews.text: Really nice restaurant, great menu.  Pizza for an appetizer was fantastic!  The famous lemon pasta was very good, it was a bit too tart for me but I will definitely go back and ask for it with less lemon.  The rest of our party loved everything and the service was impeccable.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: Food was great and the service was even better! We’ve been to Giada’s restaurant in Vegas numerous times and would definitely recommend Luna over it! Every employee we interacted with was extremely friendly and made us feel so welcome and cared for. The tiramisu was also fantastic!! We’ll definitely be back.
reviews.author: Jordan

reviews.text: Excellent Service with Sarah at the helm!  The food was fabulous and we look forward to returning!
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text: Outstanding food and service! We get let down so often when we go out to eat and want to treat ourselves to a great meal and 95% of the time is been disappointing, especially at more high end restaurants. This was a great experience from start to finish and the food was outstanding!! The best scallops I have ever had. Our server Sarah was also a great addition to our meal. Very helpful, friendly and just fantastic!
reviews.author: Tammy

reviews.text: Our server was great and attentive.  Food was good as well
reviews.author: John

reviews.text:
Amazing food, excellent service, and great ambience!!!
Make sure you get the Soufflé for desert!
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.text:
Our server Jay did an excellent job.  Overall service was superior to other restaurants.

Lemon spaghetti was very nice.
reviews.author: Troy

reviews.text:
Caymus wine event was great, well done .
Food was amazing and paired well.
reviews.author: Curt

reviews.text: Attended a 5 course wine dinner. The menu sounded amazing but failed to deliver on taste. It felt like everything was prepared ahead of time and sat under a heat lamp. I will say the service was outstanding.
reviews.author: Elizabeth

reviews.text: Absolutely outstanding service and food. We came for the dinner and wine pairing and can’t wait to go back. Stunning food and wine
reviews.author: Sarah

reviews.text:
Servers and other staff were very friendly and helpful. We were celebrating an anniversary, which was acknowledged by many. 
It was a busy night, and noisy. We liked that. They like to call it "lively." It was also cool too look through the windows into the active kitchen. 
I was able to get a gluten free pasta dish that wasn't on the menu. There are only a few gluten free items on the menu, though those items on the menu looked great! 
My wife had a chef special and it was awesome. 
My pasta dish was good, but too salty for my taste. 
The wine was good!
There's a 3.5% fee added to the bill, for no particular reason.
reviews.author: Rchard

reviews.text: It was a wonderful nite out! We loved everything!!
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.text: Food was delicious. We love Giata and her shows. My one year old grandson loved the meatballs. Service was ok. Waiter was nice but busy. Didn’t ask us if we wanted another drink from the bar. Also took a really long time to have our plates removed after dinner. Also waited a long time to get bill after our coffees.
reviews.author: Angela

reviews.text: Let’s start off by saying the food was pretty good but definitely not worth the price. Any decent Italian restaurant could have made the same quality of food. The place had club music that gets cranked up insanely loud at a certain time. The service was the worst part, with the server being condescending and having micro-aggressions. The food and overall experience definitely does not justify the extremely inflated price. It seems that the fact that they are in a nice hotel and affluent area they can charge a lot more. I had very high hopes but I just can’t recommend it. I’d go anywhere else next time.

reviews.text: Excellent atmosphere, beverages, and food!!! We loved everything and will be back⭐️🤗❤️👏
reviews.author: Aimee

reviews.text: Excellent food, outstanding service, and a great fun atmosphere.
reviews.author: Dino

reviews.text: Great staff, the atmosphere is very nice and the food was wonderful.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: The food is creative and delicious. Our server, Kendall was fun and knowledgable. Definitely get in her section!
reviews.author: Steffani

reviews.text: Thank you for taking care of us during my bff’s birthday celebration. We appreciate you all.

reviews.text: Food was amazing and the service was amazing also Brandy was the best waitress we had! She was very good at what she does. She is awesome will always be requesting her when we dine here.

reviews.text: Tried when originally opened and there were issues. Happy to say a year later the food tastes even better
