reviews.text: Appetizer was good, pasta was very disappointing no flavour too heavy not Italian at all
reviews.author: Manfred

reviews.text: Amazing!!! Everything as amazing. Can’t recommend it enough
reviews.author: Chantel

reviews.text: Ambiance was good. Service staff was on point with knowledge of food and cocktail menus and provided a great service. Chef perfectly prepared our Porter House which was juicy and so tender. Topped with a ravioli that you must try. Paired nicely with a red wine and a super cold IPA. The General Manager made it to our table to seal our experience. We highly recommend this restaurant in Scottsdale, Arizona.
reviews.author: Yolanda

reviews.text: They had a person playing music in the bar area and also had different music playing over speakers throughout the restaurant so it was kinda of annoying to hear both playing at the same time since it’s an open concept restaurant.  Also, the server suggested that I get the special which added lobster to my meal.  When I got the bill I was a bit surprised that it increased the cost of my meal by $65 (original meal was $39 and new total was $104) and the lobster was tiny and the shrimp were bigger than the lobster tail.
reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.text: Best focaccia bread I’ve had at a restaurant in Az. Compares to Felix in Venice Beach. Amazing. The two pastas we got were fantastic. Cooked perfectly and tasted great. It’s an expensive place like so many nowadays, but when you pay a lot of money you at least want to be amazed at the food. This definitely gave you that. Also, the service was awesome. Our waitress was fantastic.
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.text:
The restaurant itself was very elegant—beautiful decor, lighting, and furnishings that set high expectations.

The service was friendly and pleasant, but I felt the attire of the waitress didn’t match the upscale setting. It was a bit too revealing for the type of atmosphere they seemed to be going for.

The music was another mismatch. They were playing loud pop-rap, which felt completely out of place for a refined dining experience.

For food, I ordered the crab arancini, scallops risotto, and lemon soufflé. The arancini was the highlight—absolutely delicious. The risotto was far too salty, and the soufflé was very eggy, bland, and honestly quite off-putting.

There were 7 of us in total. We all ordered entrees, some shared appetizers, and some had dessert. We didn’t order any alcohol—just bottled water. The total came to \$592 before tip. For that price point, I would have expected a much better overall experience.

If I’m spending that kind of money, I’d much rather go somewhere like Café Monarch, where the ambiance matches the pricing. And for quality Italian food, North Italia would’ve been a better bet.

All in all, the night was fun because of the company, but the restaurant itself was a letdown.
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text: Very loud!  Everything on the menu has lemon flavor. Not our best 1000.00 dinner! Expensive
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Nice wine, ambiance and several interesting menu items, especially those being lemon-forward. However, execution of the dishes wasn't good as all four entrées were overly salted hiding the favor of the each dish.
reviews.author: Scarlett

reviews.text: Food was very underwhelming and lacked seasoning. Bacon wrapped dates, bacon too thick and whole date was roo much, sauce was bland. Salmon Crudo, was too thick and had far too much going on l, salmon was completely lost. Pork chop was basically a shake and bake that was still wet, also bland. The filet special, was insanely priced for mediocre food. Steak was good but lacked ANY sort of char or seasoning. Shrimp also very bland and seemed boiled then warmed, no sear or black whatsoever. Raviollo was good but again filling was just bland. The scallops were cooked well amd had a good sear seasond well, best bite of the evening. I will say drink were on point, highly recommend the White Negroni! Hostess was fantastic as well as several busses. Our server was okay but sitting outside when it was 107° we had to constantly ask for water instead of having our glasses filled. We will not be back nor would we recommend this place to anyone. FAR too expensive for quality of food and being lackluster. For a bill to be $400 for 2 apps, 1 dessert, 4 drinks and an espresso is completely unreasonable. I even asked for a biscotti to have with my espresso and was told that only is served with a dish and could have one if I but the dish, again this is after a supposed $400 meal. The fact I couldn't get a small $2 dollar cookie after that meal was the topper. Many other places that are much better for half the price here in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Travis

reviews.text: Outstanding dishes, amazing service by Amanda and Kendall (2x), and excellent oversight by GM Paul. This was our 4th time, and it has been consistent every time; even hosting a corporate function here in a couple of weeks because of quality and service. KUTGW team Luna!
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: So amazing ziggy and Isaiah were great! The food was amazing and service was fantastic! Great place ￼
reviews.author: Addison

reviews.text: My lemon shrimp spaghetti (which is always my “go to”) was so salty I couldn’t even eat it. I’ve eaten there many times before and never had a problem with this entree. When our server delivered our food he apologized for the wait  and said the chef wasn’t pleased with the first one he made so he had to remake it. It’s odd that Chef thought this one was any better.
reviews.author: Donna

reviews.text: My first visit. Excellent service and ambience. Beautifully designed establishment. I was disappointed with the Lemon Spaghetti. As a signature dish, it did not meet expectations. Too much sauce and cheese overpowering. Could not taste any lemon. I order this every time I go to Giada Vegas and this one was definitely not up to par.
reviews.author: Vince

reviews.text:
Great Meal
Great Service
Great cocktails and wine service.
Managers were visible and checking with each table to make sure everything was on point. Yes, it was all correct the first time.
Our Server did an amazing job with our group of 7 from start to finish.  The bartender delivered the beverages that were made perfectly.
Luna is a must dine location if you are in the Phoenix / Scottsdale area.
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.text: The service and ambience was good but the food was unimpressive.
reviews.author: JD

reviews.text: This restaurant even exceeded our expectations!  From the impeccable service to the incredible food, it was amazing!!!   Can’t wait to go back!!!
reviews.author: Teresa

reviews.text: One of the best meals I’ve had in a while and the service was amazing.  Thank you Brandy for taking care of myself and my work colleagues.  Will be back very soon.
reviews.author: Dane

reviews.text: Excellent and attentive service.  Delicious Caprese salad and seafood risotto.  Server was very patient, friendly and helpful.  ￼
reviews.author: Genie

reviews.text: We went here after having an issue with a reservation at another restaurant, and we couldn’t have had a better evening! Thank you so much!!
reviews.author: Austin

reviews.text:
I don’t usually critique where I eat but for the price we paid for our meal for 4 I felt compelled.
I love Giada have been a fan for years.  I have many of her cook books.  I think the recipes were probably very good but the quantity of salt  in the dishes my husband and I shared were so over the top I couldn’t believe it.  I actually add Maldon finishing salt to almost everything I cook do I understand how salt enhances food.  That said the lemon pasta and the scallop risotto were close to inedible due to salt content. The lemon pasta was stone cold .
The pancetta in the arugula salad was so over fried??? Maybe sauté??? To being like consistency of jerky.
Sorry to be so frank but I am just being honest.
The servers were attentive but lead conversation with the food is so good I didn’t know what to say without causing alarm. Didn’t seem approachable and very busy dropped things very quickly at the table.
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: Great experience loved the food. Can’t wait to return and try more items in the menu.
reviews.author: Kris

reviews.text: Absolutely delicious! Service was excellent! A perfect spot for an Italian meal. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: shannon

reviews.text: Excellence in food and service. All courses were spectacular and a complimentary new dessert tasting at the end capped it off. Oh yah - and then the manager introduced us to the chef and we had a group photo. Memorable in all ways n
reviews.author: craig

reviews.text:
We had a slow start and for a bit
Felt ignored. We were heee celebrating our 54th anniversary and we were greeted quite graciously but i ordered a bottle of wine and everyone disappeared for quite a long time.  Eventually they came to tell me they did not have that wine and would i pick something else. I did and that took time as well.  But once that was all straightened out this place was wonderful. Great food. Great service and they went way overboard to make up for the slow start. Even with a rocky beginning i give this place. A great review
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: Excellent food and service.  Will definitely go back!    We had the Lemon Spaghetti, bacon wrapped dates, arugula salad and to top it off we had Tiramisu.  All of it was incredible!
reviews.author: Rhonda

reviews.text: I booked dinner for two, as a gift, for my mom and her husband for her 80th birthday. They had the most lovely dinner. My mom and Geoff said the food & service were both exceptional. They had lemon cream spaghetti with prawns & chicken piccata. Delicious! They shared the best lemon Caesar’s salad ever & chocolate carmel  chip & lemon cookies. The servers and team treated them so well! They felt like they were truly waiting to make their evening simply the best in every way. And what an evening it was! A BIG thanks to the team there. We highly recommend Luna by Giada.
reviews.author: Meghan

reviews.text: This is my second time dining here. The first time my food was a 7/10 but the service was amazing. Again this time the service was 10/10. The food however was 3/10 at best. My caprese salad was amazing and one of the best I have had. The fritto misto was dry and very over cooked along with the lobster I added to my pasta. I did order a side of lemon smashed potatoes, and I did not care for them, nor my guest; however, my did. They had a very strong lemon and salt flavor, so I recommend them if you really like lemon on your potatoes. Overall I was disappointed in the food because my entree and appetizer were both over cooked and the food is not cheap. The ambiance and service is nice.
reviews.author: Natasha

reviews.text:
I get that Giada always talks about liking Lemon and parm as ingredients but it was taken to annoying level on several of the dishes we had. First off, the Cesar Salad had parm clumped up on the lettuce throughout. The signature dish spaghetti was over powering with lemon flavor towards the end.

An issue with service is the waitress casually asked if we wanted a few more shrimp and scallops on our main dishes and that ended up being $40 extra! She needed to make sure we understood it almost doubled the price of the spaghetti. Seems like the restaurant pushes their staff to upcharge.

The focaccia bread was fantastic. The rissoto was outstanding. The price paid ($250 before tip) was thoroughly disappointing for only half of the meal being tasty.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text: Very trendy and service was outstanding. Expensive for what you get, but knew that going in. Food was fantastic!
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.text:
Having been to Giada Vegas, I wanted to try her new concept in Scottsdale. The entire evening was exceptional. Great food, great team from front desk to bar to table. Menu was excellent and my brothers and I loved the Lemon Spaghetti, pasta ala vodka and even the cowboy style steak. Meatballs and focaccia starters were both exceptional, the pesto was one of the best I've ever had. Don't get us started on the tiramisu. Fantastic.
Our server Bailey was superb.
We'll be back.
reviews.author: George

reviews.text: Best service I have had in Arizona. Beautiful restaurant, very attentive staff, food was great. Cocktails were the best part, I had Message in a bottle, which is poured table side. Ambiance is very nice.
reviews.author: Joseph

reviews.text: Marvelous! Everything we ordered came out beautiful and equally tasted divine! Thrilled to return.
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.text: Absolutely the best meal … amazing service. Fast food delivery of the best . Great experience … I will definitely be back
reviews.author: Leslie

reviews.text: We had amazing service and the food was AMAZING! Great flavor without the heaviness of your typical Italian fare!
reviews.author: Angie

reviews.text: Consistently very good here. Service was a little spotty last night. Other than that great experience.
reviews.author: Rochelle

reviews.text: Excellent from start to finish. Lemon 🍋 Pasta is delicious.
reviews.author: Christina

reviews.text:
We always enjoy ourselves at Luna. Kendall and her teammates provided outstanding service. Every dish was excellent. We even doubled down by ordering “seconds to go.”
First time sitting in the booth in the second dining room. We enjoyed the lower noise level there.
We’ll see you next time.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Flew from Chicago twice this month and loved the restaurant so much that I visited it twice this month. Great food and service.
reviews.author: aleksandra

reviews.text: We were a little underwhelmed by the experience. The food was very tasty, but the service while attentive was overly fussy. The overall atmosphere is also a bit cold and sterile.
reviews.author: Kim

reviews.text: The service was great, but the food was not worth the hype. It was underwhelming unfortunately.
reviews.author: Tanner

reviews.text: We continue to have some frustrations with this restaurant as the timing of drink/food delivery is often mismanaged. The food is always excellent, which is why we keep coming back. The staging of beverages, apps, mains etc is an ongoing struggle, it seems. The acoustics are also not the best. The space must need more buffering with added textures to reduce noise.
reviews.author: Kristen

reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our first time here. The manager who greeted us suggested we head to the 8th floor patio following dinner to watch the sunset. We took that suggestion. Lovely! Sharisse took great care of us by explaining the menu and offering suggestions. We even received a birthday treat in honor of my upcoming birthday (May 28th). Thank you, Sharisse! We will be back.
reviews.author: Cheryl

reviews.text: Wonderful restaurant a must visit everything is phenomenal. If you love lemon a lot of the dishes have a hint of lemon what makes it so tasty  Crushed Lemon potatoes , branizo , tiramisu , Barata salad ￼
reviews.author: Muna

reviews.text:
Atmosphere felt a bit sterile and not intimate. 
Waiter was a bit overzealous, needs to leave time for us to enjoy our company..stopped by way too much, felt like table turning and we were there for 40 mins with 6 of us. 
Food was solid with bread being the favorite and drinks awesome.
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text: This was a FANTASTIC experience. Food was outstanding and Giada was the perfect host, she was accessible and very outgoing. Saw her serving the pasta and she seemed to have a great time. Worth the cost and Luna is an excellent restaurant.
reviews.author: Hugh

reviews.text: Went for a Giada event that was exceptionally poorly executed. Underwhelming in more ways that I can type. Pretty obvious the food and beverage team at Caesars Scottsdale needs new management. Probably the whole hotels does.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text: Absolutely love this place! Sat outside and watched sunset over Camelback and the food is amazing!!!! Drinks were beautiful and so refreshing
reviews.author: Mmadison

reviews.text: It’s a little tough for me to give a stellar review of a place like this, but it was good, not great, but good. We had no alcoholic beverages  and two entres, one appetizer, one desert and three NA glasses of $14 each wine came to over $180.  For that money, there are several other places I’d prefer that we can get out of for less.  We may be back, but not sure at this point.
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.text: Luna by Giada delivers a dynamite dining experience—where every detail, from the first pour to the final bite, is elevated by world-class service. The food was exceptional, and the wine selection hit every note, but what truly set the evening apart was the seamless, thoughtful service from start to finish. From the host who seated us to the server, food runner, and even the water attendant—every team member was trained to anticipate and enhance the guest experience. It was polished without being pretentious, and it made an already great meal unforgettable. If you’re wondering how good food becomes extraordinary—this is how.
reviews.author: Ray

reviews.text:
Ciao Giada, this property is not up to your usual standards and was lacking in service and food quality. This was my second poor experience. The manager was attentive but in the end I am afraid I will not be returning. Scottsdale has many fine Italian restaurants that are nearby that offer spectacular service and dishes.
Arrevaderci Giada!
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text:
We. Will. Never. Return!  The disappointment started from being seated.  Our reservation was for six and we were led to a table for four with two appetizer plates quickly placed at the ends of the table.  When we asked for a nearby booth for six, we were told that the manger would have to be consulted.  Ultimately we were seated at a table designed for six.  The problem with the food was primarily how it suffered in comparison to the previous night's dinner.  We went to a different celebrity chef-owned restaurant and were treated like royalty and served fantastic dinners.  Here the food was hit or miss-good focaccia, good filet, poor lemon spaghetti, average lobster, good scallops, okay shrimp.  Our server mentioned the evening's specials but not the prices.  This led to our party of six generating a tab over $1000 before the gratuity was automatically added.  Yes there was wine but only two inexpensive ($65) bottles.  Also need to mention that one couple ordered a chocolate torte/cake for dessert which was never served but they were charged for.  They were given a slice of carrot cake to acknowledge their anniversay celebration however.
UPDATED 5/20/2025: PAUL, THE GENERAL MANAGER, CALLED ME AT HOME TO APOLOGIZE FOR OUR EXPERIENCE AND TO LEARN THE DETAILS.  HE WAS SINCERE AND PROFOUNDLY GENEROUS IN HIS RESPONSE.  WE WILL ABSOLUTELY RETURN TO GIVE THEM A SECOND CHANCE.  FIRST CLASS RESPONSE ALL THE WAY! I ANTICIPATE GIVING FIVE STARS NEXT TIME.
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.text: Beautiful venue with eye catching glassed in kitchen. Service was superb, especially Kendall our server.  The Caesar salad was very good, mushroom risotto with scallops was our favorite, and house special of filet mignon, scallops with ravioli was good but not great. Filet needed seasoning and for a $97 dish, you expected a better filet. Tiramisu was amazing as well.  Great bar menu.  We will be back to Luna and go to Ruth Chris or another top quality steakhouse for steak.
reviews.author: robyn

reviews.text: Awesome experience and Kendall was awesome really enjoyed it all
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: Servicio fuera de tiempos, lleno la comida antes que el vino que habías pedido an cuanto llegamos, pedimos agua y nos sirvieron el vaso hasta el tope no se podía mover porque se caía el agua, no nos ofrecieron pan tuvimos que pedirlo, no había música o estana tan despacio que no se escuchaba. En cuanto a la comida bien, nada extraordinario, no acorde al valor
reviews.author: laura

reviews.text: Great Italian restaurant .. classy and new same time
reviews.author: Gabe

reviews.text:
Food was good but service was a bit inattentive.
Not seeing the experience live up to the hype.
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: Food was very good.  Steak Florentine was delicious as the pasta
reviews.author: Christine

reviews.text: The food was good, no complaints, but it seemed a little pricey for what you get. Started with the Focaccia bread and the Caprese Salad both good. Split entrées of the Signature Lemon Spaghetti (very rich, a great dish to split or to take home as left overs￼)￼ and the Branzino (nice and lite) with a side of Broccolini. Again, everything was good but not wow. I also felt a disconnect with the vibe they’re trying to portray. The check-in ladies at the front are all in black slinky dresses and heels, but then the servers are in jeans, tennis shoes, a T-shirt and a tight navy vest. I feel you could elevate the experience with a better outfit for the servers. I felt the bar area looked really cool and chic and then again you walk into the restaurant area and it’s so-so. ￼￼ Also a shout out to Melanie. She was an amazing server. ￼
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text: I'm not sure if Luna does the buffet for any other occasion than Mothers Day, but we are so happy it was done this year, it was the perfect way to celebrate myself and my Mom, top notch service and top tier food from the starters to dessert. Thank you Luna for an amazing Mothers Day buffet
reviews.author: Belle

reviews.text: Mother’s Day Brunch was AMAZING! Can’t wait for the next brunch. Service was on point! Food was SO GOOD!
reviews.author: Lanna

reviews.text: The food was amazing as always going to eat at the Las Vegas location Friday night can wait !
reviews.author: eric

reviews.text: Mother’s Day brunch was lacking. Bagels were stale. Eggs were average at best. Pasta dishes were good and the prime rib was excellent but the breakfast fare was subpar. Service was adequate but both the hostess and waitress seemed overwhelmed
reviews.author: Gregory

reviews.text: Best brunch I can remember. Rare and wonderful to have English muffins crispy and brown on Eggs Benedict in a buffet. Lobster, oysters and shrimp seafood tower was delicious too. Tons of options, all very well executed and fabulous service!
reviews.author: Thomas

reviews.text: Unexpected disappointment.  Was really looking forward to a delicious meal but unfortunately experienced the complete opposite.  Some things were completely over salted, and some had no flavor at all.  Everyone in our party agreed too.  Crab arancini was good, but the sauce with it had so much salt you couldn’t even eat it.  The lemon spaghetti which was a take on fettuccini Alfredo- also had no flavor and was dry.  The filet was overcooked and no flavor at all, including the puree it was over.  Our appetizers came out literally not even 5 minutes after ordering it, yet waited forever for our meal. Waiter was great though and acknowledged the long wait.  Beautiful restaurant and cool vibe.  But not worth the value, and it’s expensive.  I never have a problem paying for a good meal, but I most likely won’t go back.
reviews.author: Lori

reviews.text: Service was not good. The server seemed like he didn’t want to be there or serve us. Food was not good either. I’ve dined in Vegas at Giada several times and it was amazing. This location the food was not good at all and over priced.
reviews.author: Karin

reviews.text: Luna was amazing, our waitress Natalie was very friendly and the food was delicious!
reviews.author: Levi

reviews.text:
Our waiter, Jay, was fantastic
Food was great
I was surprised and happy that they now have meatballs .. they were wonderful
Atmosphere was perfect
We've been to the location in Vegas as well, and the food is excellent
One of our favorite restaurants and we will be back
reviews.author: james

reviews.text: Everything about the experience was great. Food was wonderful and service is outstanding.
reviews.author: LARRY

reviews.text: Our party of 4 was celebrating a birthday. Our server, Caitlin, was attentive, professional and welcoming. We followed many of her suggestions and were rewarded with wonderful meals. Everyone in our party was ts to return!
reviews.author: Kathleen

reviews.text: Shereese was absolutely phenomenal, helpful and informative. Brought my grandparents and their close friends in for dinner from Montana. They were so impressed with her, said its was one of the greatest dining experiences they ever had.
reviews.author: Gavin

reviews.text: We went for a birthday dinner. Nice ambiance and attentive service, but felt way overpriced for the quality of the food. Food was mediocre and everything was overly drenched in lemon.
reviews.author: Elise

reviews.text: Honestly, everything was wonderful but our server Amanda went above and beyond and made out night PERFECT!  She truly wanted us to have a lovely experience and delivered on perfection!!!
reviews.author: Erin Jane

reviews.text: I went to Giada's for a small birthday dinner and it was phenomenal as usual.  It's semi casual and fun but the food is top notch.   Drinks and desserts are so good too.  It's kind of feminine in there which is a nice mix up from the typical steakhouse setting.
reviews.author: Risa

reviews.text:
Review:

The food here is genuinely excellent—well-prepared, flavorful, and worth the visit. However, the dining experience is hampered by the layout: the tables are crammed so tightly together that even the servers had a difficult time maneuvering. The bathroom setup is downright absurd and inconvenient, two bathrooms for a big restaurant and you have to wait in the hall. Great food, but a few hiccups.
reviews.author: karen

reviews.text: We had the most wonderful evening.  Service from Melanie and Blake was top notch, and the food was divine.  HIGHLY recommend the lemon pizza.  So unique and a must try.
reviews.author: Kelly

reviews.text: It’s been a while since our last visit to Luna. The atmosphere and ambiance is undeniably enchanting paired with top notch service makes for a welcoming date night. The pizza and frito miso were a bit overcooked this time but delivered quickly to the table.  It may have been an off night but didn’t quite meet the mark. We’ll have to revisit before the final grade ✅
reviews.author: Milton

reviews.text: Overpriced. Pretty decor but for the description you would think it would have been dressier. People came in shorts even though the restaurant specifically said no shorts! Portions are not shareable.
reviews.author: randey

reviews.text: Melody was the best waitress ever!  Responded to my questions before I even ask them. It was very prompt with service and super nice!  Made my experience pleasurable!
reviews.author: Kay

reviews.text:
The host would not honor our outdoor reservation, but did not give an explanation (there was plenty of room). Our waitress was probably the worst I have ever had. She was curt and even made a face at my husband when he asked for a tall glass of ice water instead of the baby cups with room temperature water...she also never brought the water. We tracked down a busboy who brought it to my husband. 

The food was incredibly overpriced and not good.  I had the lemon spaghetti with shrimp and lobster.  The lobster and shrimp were chewy.  The pasta had a good flavor, but this dish was way overpriced.  

All in all, the only thing I was the least bit impressed by was the bussboy.  Other waitstaff were mostly seen standing around talking since it was not busy.  Our waitress seldom came by to check on us. 

The final thing I will say is that I was incredibly disappointed in this restaurant.  Save your money and go somewhere that you can get better service.
reviews.author: Stephanie

reviews.text: Food very good to excellent!  Not too noisy so one can can  easily have a conversation.
reviews.author: Sheilaq

reviews.text: Jay our waiter was amazing ..perfect night, great service, great food.!
reviews.author: Violet

reviews.text: Kaitlin ad Sarah were amazing servers.  Food was excellent.
reviews.author: Cody

reviews.text: Excellent food, excellent service!  It was a bit noisy and loud but we also went on a Saturday night...  Would definitely recommend the homemade pasta dishes and can't wait to go back to try some more!
reviews.author: Monica

reviews.text: Super disappointed with Luna. I was looking forward to the dinner as I have enjoyed watching Giada cooking shows. The noise level was ridiculous. Tables so close to each other that I couldn’t even hear my spouse during dinner. I also had people bumping into my chair when they walked by. They charge a service fee for the ambiance, which there is no ambiance. The food did not meet my expectations at all especially for the cost. Definitely do not recommend this place!
reviews.author: Sandra

reviews.text: Everything from the appetizers to the dessert was amazing! Amazing service and amazing food! Thank you to all the staff!
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text:
Melanie our server was absolutely amazing!  Fast, attentive, and efficient with our order.  Thanks so much!! You were GREAT!! 😍

Friday night - Table of four to celebrate my Birthday!

Starters: We ordered 2 Caesar salads (very good but could have had a bit more parm ch and the freeze dried capers were a great touch!), Arancini (light and delicious - a must!).

Meals: Signature Lemon Spaghetti (was okay, but barely warm but the shrimp were tasty), Margarita Pizza (delicious as well), 2 steaks (underwhelming unfortunately and dry for medium temp - but you don’t order steak when you go to an Italian restaurant, duh).

Dessert: cheesecake with raspberries was AMAZING! ORDER IT!!

Bonus: They also brought a gelato and cookie with a candle to celebrate my birthday which was unexpected.

Overall, mixed with my review (maybe 4 out of 5 stars) as it was a good experience and glad we tried it, but felt a bit overpriced, especially with $20-$25/drink…

Thank you!
reviews.author: Tara

reviews.text: THIS IS NOT A $$ RESTAURANT!! It is easily a $$$, maybe $$$$. The appetizers were all over $20. Apps should not be the same as an entree!! Do you remember when Italian restaurants use to just bring out bread when you sat down??  Not this place. $15 for a small focaccia with lemon butter and oil. My fiancé had the signature lemon pasta with shrimp (and the waitress of course tried to upsell by offering lobster instead of shrimp) and I had the branzino. 2 jumbo shrimp and lemon sauce poured over a spaghetti tower. The branzino was cooked really well, which was the only saving grace for the evening, but had NO seasoning. Even a little finishing salt could have saved it. It was sprinkled with pomegranate seeds which added a little something, but overall the food was just ok. I would have liked to order more so that we could have a good sampling of dishes, but at the prices, that was not going to happen. The pastas were all over $30 and then if you wanted to add a protein like chicken, shrimp, scallops or sausage, it would be an extra $20. And not to mention, 3.5% resort admin fee added to every bill. I have no problem paying for good food, but expensive and bland is not a good combo. Desserts were $20!!!  With all the amazing restaurants in Scottsdale/Phoenix, Luna by Giada falls way short of what it should be.
reviews.author: Mitch

reviews.text:
We dined here last night with a group of four. The staff, service, and overall atmosphere were exactly what we expected — warm, attentive, and very good. Unfortunately, the food itself didn’t quite live up to expectations, especially considering the reputation attached to Giada’s name and the number of exceptional restaurants nearby.

Out of the four meals, only one truly impressed. The pork chop saltimbocca had to be sent back for being overcooked and very dry; the replacement was slightly better but still disappointingly dry and unpleasant. The steak was not grilled to the requested doneness, and the overall flavor profile fell flat. The pasta was fine but forgettable — nothing special.

On a positive note, the branzino was excellent, as were the crab arancini and the arugula salad, which stood out among the dishes we tried. Dessert is a must try. 

To their credit, the staff was incredibly accommodating and did everything they could to make the experience right. It’s just unfortunate that the food didn’t meet the high expectations we had coming in.

We might return for cocktails or a glass of wine, but likely not for a full meal.
reviews.author: joe

reviews.text: Both the food and the service were stellar! Absolutely fabulous! The chicken piccata was the best I ever had! The staff, all of them were so professional and friendly. Thank you!
reviews.author: Carla

reviews.text:
I rarely write reviews, but our experience at Luna by Giada was such a letdown, I felt compelled to share. From beginning to end, it just missed the mark. I ordered the signature lemon pasta, expecting something special, but could barely take a few bites. It was runny, the pasta was undercooked—well beyond “al dente”—and the flavor was just off. To make it worse, the table next to us ordered the same dish, and neither of the women could finish theirs either. That told me it wasn’t just me.

We also tried the crab arancini, which strangely had no crab in them. It felt misleading and underwhelming.

The atmosphere was elegant and beautifully designed, which I appreciated. But it felt mismatched when the staff showed up in jeans—it didn’t fit the upscale vibe at all.

Overall, this just wasn’t the experience I expected from a Giada-owned restaurant. It looked the part, but the food and execution fell way short.
reviews.author: Leslie

reviews.text: I’m sorry to say the Sunday brunch experience was a big disappointment. While the service staff was excellent and attentive the food selection was limited -cold pasta, pizza, over seasoned meat, shellfish stuck in shells. There were no shrimp or tiramisu by the time we arrived at 130 seating. Zero gluten free options-my meal was cheese, olives, salami and over-salted fatty steak $150.  They kindly brought a gluten-free dessert from their dinner menu after I mentioned issues. It’s a beautiful hotel but we won’t be back.
reviews.author: Pamela

reviews.text: Everything was excellent!! We loved the food, the decor (especially the ice sculptures!!), and the very friendly & accommodating staff! We can't wait to go back!
reviews.author: Kristin

reviews.text: I was a fantastic Easter Sunday with plenty of great food and atmosphere.  Next time I think I want to sit by the live music.
reviews.author: Jamien

reviews.text: We went to their very overpriced brunch. I was very excited to try this place but was underwhelmed by the food. Of course, it had a ton of food choices but none were worth the price they were charging. $150/person plus tip. Disappointing!
reviews.author: Lori

reviews.text:
Luna is now my favorite restaurant.  From how your greated when you enter, to being seated as you get information on the restaurant. The Servers are extreamly knowledgeable,  professional and attentive.  Now the food; prepared to best I've ever eaten. The only issue is to what to order! We travel better then an hour to get to Luna but have never complained about the drive. 
It's just that good!
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.text:
First time in. What a beautiful restaurant! Tucked into the Caesars Republic Hotel. Waited in the beautiful bar area til out table was ready. Service was a tad bit behind. Finally got out drinks as we were gonna be seated. But the bartender was friendly. 
Walking into an amazing atmosphere through the restaurant. We had reserved a table outside, and the hostess asked us if we were still interested in being seated out there. We decided to come inside and she accommodated us perfectly. 
Server and assistant we're on point. Server gave us some great recommendations for appetizers. We had the caprese salad and the focchaccia. Great communication.
Had a nice bottle of wine. And ordered the bistecca(?) for 2.
There were some fatty parts to it but still very tender, cooked at our requested temp, just delicious. 
There was a ravioli topped on the steak which was great! Just wish we could have gotten a couple more with it. Or another pasta option. More pasta would have been amazing! 
Fun time for my girlfriend and I. 
We will be returning to try more dishes. 
Thank you again for a wonderful night!!
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.text: Service was great. Food was delicious. The brussels sprouts are a must.
reviews.author: Vicky

reviews.text: Atmosphere was more casual than expected of a high end and priced celebrity restaurant. Food was very good! Service started out strong and slowed towards end of meal. Overall a good not a great experience.
reviews.author: Dale

reviews.text: Great place! Great location, I was there by myself and saw lots of couples in the romantic patio area the bar looked great as well. The waiter that helped me was amazing suggested a few plates from the menu which I tried and he wasn’t wrong. Love the food defínetly will go back.
reviews.author: Nora

reviews.text: Extremely good food great drinks with beautiful tables in a flashy room. Friendly professional greeting. Third time and I’ve grown increasingly unimpressed with the time taken at the table by wait staff talking endlessly about the menu the food the specials literally as if people haven’t been to a restaurant or can’t read. A quick recitation of the specials with staff quietly retreating is what a fine restaurant does. A Ted talk and a lecture is both unwelcome and overly intrusive.

reviews.text: Had an amazing time at Luna! The ambiance was inviting and warm. Hostess were knowledgeable and patience. It is fancy $$$ restaurant but totally worth it.
reviews.author: Olivia

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant with amazing pastas and service! We had a great time! It is pricey for italian because of Giada but do think it’s worth it.
reviews.author: Iliana

reviews.text:
First time and came with friends who are very particular re food and quality.
Very pleased with what we ordered. Very accommodating with excellent service and attention.
reviews.author: okky

reviews.text:
First time visit.
We had focaccia bread as an app, pizza, lemon spaghetti and chicken piccata.
Everything was AMAZING. Table Service was friendly and hostesses were the BEST.
Would definitely come in again when in town !
reviews.author: Candace

reviews.text: Had the best experience with the staff SO knowledgeable and kind and fun! Shout out to Kaitlyn - best server made our night as out of towners.
reviews.author: Mia

reviews.text: It’s been a year since I’ve been here and it really frustrates me how slow their service is. It’s beautiful and the food/drinks are wonderful but we sat for 30-40 minutes before getting our drinks, the server had to have won something for selling the steak cause she recommended it minimum 5 times despite being told we didn’t really like steak. It’s a competitive restaurant town and height of busy tourism yet the dining room was fairly empty by 8pm which also confused me about the slow bar service. Get it together and you’ll succeed more off word of mouth in Scottsdale
reviews.author: Colleen

reviews.text: The entire experience was amazing! I had mentioned how beautiful the restaurant was so as we were being seated, the hostess took time to explain some of the personal touches brought in with the tiles and ceiling. The incredible service didn't end there though. Our waitress and a trainee were so welcoming and friendly. She took time to go over the menu and specials along with answering our questions. We settled on two of their specials, one with steak and shrimp and another with lemon pasta with lobster and shrimp They had just ran out of lobster but  kindly substituted with Alaskan King Crab which made my day! Both meals were cooked to perfection and delicious! We followed with their soufflé for dessert which was amazing! I would absolutely recommend Luna and can't wait to go back and try other items on their menu.
reviews.author: Kristina

reviews.text: Third time here.  Food is fantastic.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: Food great.  Service great.  A little noisy, though.
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: First time dining and it was excellent. Highly recommend the crab arrancini,   margarita pizza, and the mushroom and scallop risotto.
reviews.author: Shirley

reviews.text: First time eating here and it was AMAZING. From the food, the ambiance, the service!!! Everyone was nice from start to finish, best service I’ve received ever. Will be back again and again!

reviews.text: We went to celebrate a birthday and the restaurant is beautiful with good food.

reviews.text: The service was top notch. The fritto misto was delicious. We shared the agnolotti & the chicken piccata- both were great. The chicken was late coming out and the manager came by to apologize and checked on us again after it arrived. Thank you for making my mom’s birthday so special !

reviews.text: This was our first visit to Luna’s. The waitress was very helpful with explaining the menu and specials.  The food was so yummy! We will be back.
reviews.author: Todd

reviews.text:
Outstanding experience! Food, Service, Drinks,  Location, everything could not have been better.  I travel 70 minutes to get to this restaurant and it is so worth it every time.   
Going here is not just a good eating establishment.  It's a dinning experience! 
Wish I could give it more then 5 stars.
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.text: Another extraordinary experience at Luna. The food was out of this world in every way. Our server Kendall was fantastic. We left a credit card and she called us directly to let us know and take care of it, which was so appreciated as we were leaving the next day. Will be back to Luna Every chance we can get. Absolutely delightful!

reviews.text: Mediocre at best. Hostesses great, service slow, pasta swimming in sauce.
reviews.author: Roger

reviews.text: The setting and decor are beautiful! Very lovely atmosphere! Service was great initially... But follow up on a couple of items ordered was not... Food presentation superb! From just the right plates... to the garnishes. Food taste was good.... But not amazing! Worth giving it a try....

reviews.text:
First time at Luna. We were very impressed. Warm and friendly staff from server to secondary staff to management.
A unique menu that highlights use of lemon in a variety of food choices.
Highly recommend the arancini appertizer and foccasia bread, the angnotti entre, and Giadi's signature lemon spaghetti.
Pricing is at the higher end.
Definitely will return..

reviews.text:
My husband and I have dined here many times.
The food and service are impeccable. The servic is absolutely phenomenal 
A truly great experience. 
We highly recommend this restaurant. 
The Crab Arancini and sea Scallops with risotto are an absolute must!
Great environment 
A+++++
reviews.author: Sophia

reviews.text: A true WOW restaurant. Two seafood towers to start. Everything was fresh clean with great selection of sauces. Lemon pasta is a must. Our server did an amazing job keeping up with 12 people all talking at once.
reviews.author: Warren

reviews.text: Food was very good. Lemon pasta was my favorite with the sausage. The Focaccia bread was next level. Big fan!! Wasn’t too pumped about them seating us in the very back by the bathroom. Especially since walked past open tables. Overall a good experience and I would go back!!

reviews.text: Amazing service and the food was so delicious too
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text: Me and my friends went here for prom, it was so nice! Service was great everyone was so nice and food was amazing. Would 100% recommend😊

reviews.text: We loved the dishes we chose-we thought our server Melanie was excellent and the service very efficient but we thought the noise level was very distracting. Our intention in visiting an elegant restaurant is to relax and not have to speak above the crowd.
reviews.author: Andrea

reviews.text: Not what we expected from Giada.  Signature Lemon Pasta was bland, lukewarm and all stuck together.  Sauce was watery and barely warm.  Shrimp was overcooked.  So noisy we could not not carry on a conversation at our table.  Hostess was very good.  Apps were fine.  Desert was fine as well.  Server was very pleasant but mostly absent.
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.text: We had the best personal service ever! Kudos to the general manager and staff. Wonderful food and great ambience. So fun to take out-of-town guests to Luna to enjoy Scottsdale and great food.
reviews.author: AUDREY

reviews.text: Our server Kaitlyn was spectacular!  Her knowledge of the menu was spot on. The timing of serving our appetizers and dinner was perfect! The food was delicious! We will definitely return. This is our new favorite restaurant!!
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.text: i have to say I love this restaurant more so then the vegas location . much more friendly & a better vibe .z service was excellent & went out of there way for us !!
reviews.author: Jojo

reviews.text: We went there to celebrate our anniversary and had decidedly mixed experiences. The place is lovely. The service was excellent. The staff, in its entirety, was extremely pleasant, accommodating, and clearly well trained. However, the food varied dramatically. For an appetizer, we split the crab arancini and while I thought that it was ok, my wife felt that it lacked any actual crab flavor. I had the pork chop which tasted really good but was a bit overcooked and dry. My wife had the pasta with arrabbiata sauce and added scallops. Unlike all of the other dishes, this one arrived at barely room temperature. When she mentioned this to our server it was quickly removed and remade. She liked the scallops but felt that the sauce was light in flavor with none of the heat that typically comes with that sauce. For my side, I ordered the corn with spicy sausage. This was absolutely the hit of the night! It might well be the best dish I've tasted this year, seriously. It is almost a riff on Mexican elote but much much better. Her side was the smashed potatoes, which were neither smashed (how did they choose that name?) nor tasty. She started to dip it in my corn and was much happier with it that way. The evening was pleasant but overall disappointing. And at their price point that should never be the case.
reviews.author: Larry

reviews.text: Was surprised to see that Giada has a restaurant in Scottsdale! Had to try Luna to celebrate my birthday…the fritto misto was so tasty, lightly battered with dried flowers and a nice lemon sauce, Caesar citrus salad was so yummy, the signature lemon spaghetti was beautifully twirled and sauce was so tasty. Tiramisu was so cool with the layers in the mug and got a surprise stracciatella gelato with cookie birthday dessert!  ;)
reviews.author: Christine

reviews.text: We were seated at our requested table area and Kaitlyn our server was so knowledgeable and accommodating, our “pop out for dinner on a Thursday night” turned into a dining indulgence. The Bella Luna and Fico Prugna cocktails were a nice start with the carpaccio and large delicious arugula salad which lasted all through dinner for both of us. Kaitlyn also confirmed when I inquired, that lobster could be added to the signature lemon pasta and shared her love for the agnolotti pasta which was my husband’s choice. We almost shied away from the lobster upgrade price but it ended up being a generous full split tail with shelled whole claws and was the most succulent, sweetest lobster I’ve ever had in Arizona! A glass of wine each and a tiramisu finished the almost perfect night. Why almost?, they don’t have the lemon soufflé on the menu which was my favorite! Chocolate hazelnut soufflé will make others happy though. Finally, though it can be pricey, the value is excellent because the food is fresh, innovative, can be light or hearty and most of all different than the same old options everywhere else. Grab wine and a pizza or splurge like we did!
reviews.author: Lesley

reviews.text: Absolutely loved the ambiance, food and service. We’re huge fans of Giada’s shows and it was so fun to try some dishes that we’ve seen her make. Great experience and can’t wait to go back again.
reviews.author: Brigette

reviews.text: Excellent food and service but the ambiance is like eating in the hotel lobby. Modern chic, yet casual. I’d expect a little more character considering the prices.
reviews.author: Dominic

reviews.text:
Good experience. The calamari was overcooked; inedible. The dates were very good, the pasta Ala vodka was amazing, and the mezzi rigatoni with sausage (gluten free) was quite delicious!
It was lovely sitting on the patio, watching the sunset over Camelback Mtn. Dara was a very good waitress. Will return.
reviews.author: Melody

reviews.text: The service here was so good. Our waiters were great and kept us informed through out the entire night. The food is really good. I felt the ambience was good too but unfortunately we were sat in a busy area so that wasn't too much fun.  But we would totally go back because it was a good experience and the food was good.
reviews.author: Paulo

reviews.text: Food was excellent but very overpriced. Pastas over $40?! Ambience felt very hotel lunch and breakfasty
reviews.author: Carol

reviews.text: Amazing food & great service. This was our first time at Luna and we will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Aillene

reviews.text:
I have dined with you since you opened.
The Management, team , food, atmosphere is excellent.

reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.text: Stunning interior, professional and attentative staff, delicious food!  Enjoyed the whole experience and will come back again when we are in town.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: Food was delicious - get the lemon spaghetti and the bread patter, the lemon pizza and the lemon cheesecake!! Everything was so so good. The staff was amazing - just go and enjoy!!
reviews.author: MIchelle

reviews.text: We had an amazing experience!!!! Our server Sarah was superb and Paul (Gen Manager) was very attentive and accommodating. Definitely made our experience delightful and memorable!
reviews.author: Lili

reviews.text: We ate at the bar.  Appetizer were great!  Lovely view of Camelback mountain.  Very open feeling.
reviews.author: Tanya

reviews.text: Great food as usual.  The Lemon spaghetti is fabulous.
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text: Great ambiance! Service was exceptional and food was exquisite!
reviews.author: Linda

reviews.text: We had great service and the food was very good!  Ambience exceptional.  Wine a little over priced, but worth it in other ways!
reviews.author: Marcia

reviews.text: Loved the vibe and food. Parking was not easy ended up using the $12 valet
reviews.author: Diana

reviews.text: Everything was very good.  Pizza, pasta and salad.  Not cheap but nothing is anymore.  Really enjoyed.  The mushroom pizza was outstanding!
reviews.author: josh

reviews.text: We had dined att Luna last year during the opening month and enjoyed it immensely for a friend’s birthday so returned again. The service with our waitress Kendall was Awesome and Jose was Outstanding! The Lemon Pizza didn’t seem to give the same Lemon punch as previous tasting but still good. The focaccia bread appetizer was a much better option with the caprese. The special, Filet with scallops on potatoes with a huge ravioli on top was one guest meal which was delicious and the other two split the lemon spaghetti with shrimp (one doesn’t eat meat or fish). Shrimp was a little spongy but pasta was delicious. Dessert was shared Tiramisu. It was more chocolate than lady fingers. Coffee was lukewarm at best unfortunately. Not sure if we would return again for the price but service and ambiance was great and I would still recommend Luna for a try.
reviews.author: Ann

reviews.text:
Loved the espresso martini! And the tall glass.
Lemon pizza was amazing.
I don’t love the booths for seating. I felt like I was sinking.
reviews.author: Terri

reviews.text:
Do not recommend. Over priced food. $30 for salami $25 drinks.

Poor service and it feels like you are eating in a hotel lobby. $221 for a meal that was worth $80 with tip included
reviews.author: mentiradeborrego

reviews.text:
Interesting experience. My wife has been to the restaurant in Vegas and loved it. The decor and ambience is fun. We had to wait with a large group of people for our table. This was exactly 30 minutes after our reservation time. During the wait - some people were offered champagne. We were not. A man who I assume was the manager finally brought us to our table and gave us a quick tour. He apologized for the wait and told us he’d do something nice for us. Nothing ever materialized from that promise.

The food was ok. It wasn’t $40 pasta good. We enjoyed the arincini and a split salad. The drinks were good. The lemon pasta was underwhelming. The sauce is on the bottom of the plate. You have to cut through the tangled pasta to then run it through the sauce. The sauce is fine. It’s not this amazing dish that it’s made out to be. While presentation was great and the servers did their best to keep up with a busy restaurant, this seems more like a place to get a drink or to go if you want to say you ate at a goads restaurant. We’ve had much better Italian food and the wait and false promise from the manager made us feel as though this probably happens often.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text:
Excellent food, great service, pretty restaurant
But was incredibly loud making it nearly impossible for conversation
reviews.author: MarthaH

reviews.text: Good food! Okay service. It's my 2nd time here and it's fun! Good people watching.

reviews.text:
As admirers of Giada’s culinary expertise and having enjoyed a previous visit when she was present, we had high expectations for our dining experience. Unfortunately, last night’s meal fell significantly short of what one would anticipate from a restaurant bearing her name.

The Spaghetti alla Nerano was particularly disappointing. Traditionally, this iconic dish from the Amalfi Coast features thinly sliced fried zucchini, imparting a rich, slightly crisp texture that harmonizes with the pasta. However, what we received was a puree-like zucchini sauce, which altered the consistency, texture, and depth of flavor entirely. At a price point of $39, the dish should adhere to its authentic preparation, especially in a restaurant representing “una vera Napoletana.”

The Spaghetti al Limone, while cooked to the proper al dente texture, suffered from a dry consistency and was served in a broth that oddly resembled milk. This was a stark contrast to the version we had previously enjoyed, which was beautifully coated in a light, velvety sauce infused with lemon and a touch of olive oil—a balance of acidity and richness that defines the dish.

Additionally, we had specifically returned for the Limoncello soufflé, a signature dessert we had looked forward to, only to be informed that it was no longer available. The absence of such a highlight only compounded our overall disappointment.

A name like Giada’s carries weight in the culinary world, and with it, the responsibility to uphold the integrity of the dishes it represents. Consistency is key in fine dining, and maintaining the essence of these iconic Italian flavors is essential to preserving the trust of discerning guests.

I have been to dozens of elite establishments, this one is now easily in the top three. The other really cool thing about this restaurant is that it is still very Arizona, and what I mean by that is even though it is high end, many patrons are there in shorts, jeans, and cowboy hats. The staff themselves (with the exception of the hostesses) wear blue jeans. A relaxed atmosphere indeed. We went for a very special event and this place amplified the experience. It was truly enhanced by our server, Teresa.

reviews.text: the focaccia and risotto are a MUST. The service was FANTASTIC!
reviews.author: Jenna

reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff and delicious food.
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.text: Excellent food, nice & knowledgeable staff & great ambience.
reviews.author: Erin

reviews.text: top shelf food, service and facility.  only item to watch out for is the 3.5% venue admin fee added to the total bill, which is on the menu at the bottom in small  print.
reviews.author: Myron

reviews.text: Weirdest dining experience of our lives!  From the hostess who walked like a sloth...giving us a tour of the wine wall and pizza oven as if it was our first time in a restaurant.  To the waiter who explained that starters are appetizers...and a full description of Arancini, in case we weren't familiar.  To the margarita that arrived spilling over the top, making a sticky mess of our table...we politely sent it back...only to have them deliver the same sticky mess back to us.  Each dish was delivered with a FULL explanation of every ingredient...as if we completely forgot what we ordered.  The salads and focaccia were fine.  The signature lemon pasta was almost inedible...we each ate 1/3 of it.  The manager approached us to ask "Is your food hot?"...strange question in an upscale restaurant.  We were given a dessert menu...but never asked if we'd like to order dessert. Instead, they suddenly delivered three scoops of ice cream with mediocre cookies...and lit candles for all of us...celebrating our birthdays.  None of us were celebrating birthdays.  They delivered a purse hook AFTER our ice cream so that my daughter's purse didn't sit on the floor...but he couldn't get the hook extended enough to elevate her purse.  When we were finally finished, we were told to walk around the back of the bar because the wine wall was open.  We just paid over $300 for dinner...but are suddenly a security risk around their wine wall??  When we got in the car, my husband declared..."we are NEVER GOING BACK".  We are Scottsdale locals...took us 11 months to finally go...for our one and only experience at Luna.  There are so many wonderful restaurants in Scottsdale...with amazing food and service.  Luna is not one of them.
reviews.author: Dana

reviews.text:
We were very lucky to share an evening with the famous Wagner
family famous for their Caymus
Wines and coupled with Giata
paired food courses! What a spectacular evening! The guests at our table were amazing and the 3 hours spent went by in a flash!!
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text: Phenomenal wine event. One of the best I have been. We were seated with other couples which made an event amazing. Met wonderful people, laughed hard, met Chuck Wagner and enjoyed the story behind Caymus! Food was delicious and very unique menu. The night started quiet and got loud very fast. Food was amazing!
reviews.author: Nina

reviews.text: Little too much noise. But, it WAS sold out!!! So, kind of expected a bit more noise than we wanted. Otherwise, a truly GREAT experience!!!
reviews.author: Tony

reviews.text:
Ambience and food presentation was good. Food was barely average. Crab Arancini had no crab flavor. Lemon Spaghetti was really good, except the shrimp was tough and rubbery, and we paid and extra $40 for 4 extra shrimp. At $10 a shrimp, it better be really good, it wasn’t. $15 (almost $20 with tax, tip, and fees) for bread, when spending $580 on dinner, really? It also wasn’t that good.  Tripolini had almost no sign of the Tuscan Short Rib and tasted unremarkable. 

Attention to detail by the staff is really lacking.  Made a reservation for 6. Greeted by the hostess by name, which is a nice touch, but then we were taken to a small table set for 4. Two of us were handed a plate, napkin, silverware and drink ware and we actually set our own place settings. Then, 3 of the 6 entrees were delivered incorrectly. Not worth the 21% tip automatically added to the bill. I expect more when coming to a restaurant of the caliber that Luna thinks it is.
reviews.author: Dudley

reviews.text: Nice atmosphere, good service. The food was good. Thought it was over priced
reviews.author: Bryan

reviews.text: We were for my father-in-law’s birthday and were a party of 8. We had great service and a beautiful evening.
reviews.author: Kyla

reviews.text:
Luna redeemed itself this time. The food was outstanding and came at a good pace.  So the kitchen worked out its kinks since our previous visit.

Brandi also did a fine job helping us with the menu.  She was knowledgeable and on point with suggestions.  We were seated in the Jade room, which was quiet, compared to near the bar and the kitchen.  So we appreciated that.

Both the arugula salad and the caprese salad were very refreshing.  Especially loved the heirloom tomatoes, perfectly paired with stracciatella and balsamic pearls.

The tripolini was mild, not as bold as one might consider eg. a hearty bolognese, but we enjoyed the Tuscan short rib ragu that was used for it.  The parmesan tuile was a plus.

The spicy sausage pizza was a winner.  Perfectly thin crust and a perfect dough, roasted peppers and scamorza.  Would not have minded it to be more spicy, but good as it is.  Each bite was memorable.

We ended with an excellent affogato.  The kitchen did not skimp on the vanilla bean gelato and just the right amount of double espresso.

This was a great meal with excellent attentive service.  We'll be looking for a repeat performance.
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: We are so happy that we found Luna!  The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was excellent.  The lemon spaghetti with lobster was amazing.  We have eaten all over Scottsdale and this is our new favorite place.  Best 50th Birthday dinner!  We will definitely be going back.
reviews.author: Tiffany

reviews.text: Very attentive and friendly service. Our server  Melanie had excellent insight into the menu. Her recommendations were spot on!
reviews.author: Leslie

reviews.text:
Usually, every thing is great!
It took 15 minutes for us to get service! I did complain several times, but to no avail!
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text: Our reserved table was not ready when we arrived; however, Luna’s Staff went the extra mile to make up for that, checking in with us frequently, they even offered us courtesy champagne.
reviews.author: Adalberto

reviews.text: The place is nice and cozy but the check-in assistance is very bad. Even if you have a reservation, they make you wait a long time and they don't give you any explanations and when you ask, they just say they don't know how much longer you have to wait. The food is good and the assistance at the table and the bar is better.
reviews.author: Javier

reviews.text: The location, ambience and company was amazing!!! The food was ok I liked it but not worth the price. Our server was really funny and nice but once we got our food he never came back. I waited forever to get a refill. They said they would comp our drinks since we had to wait so long and our server never came back. Once we got our refill the server disappeared again and our drinks were never comped. It’s the principle of the matter and and following through with your word. Otherwise we had fun and the rest of the service was great!
reviews.author: vanessa

reviews.text: Such a wonderful experience. Delicious food, outstanding service and a fantastic vibe.   Brandi is a true asset to the restaurant - make sure you try to request her as a server. We’ll definitely be back.
reviews.author: Jennie

reviews.text:
We have dined at Giada in Las Vegas and found Luna not meeting our expectations. The service was fantastic.
The food overall was wonderful however the lemon spaghetti was too lemony for our taste.
D
The noise level was challenging even though dined in the Jade room (quieter location). It was very loud, difficult to hear others.
Overall, we are very happy for the experience however, unsure if we would return.
reviews.author: Nancy

reviews.text: I’ll separate service and food reviews. Food was ok. The Cesar salad was very good. The focaccia was also good. We had the chicken piccata and the lemon spaghetti. Both were ok. I’ve had way better piccata. The spaghetti noodles were good, but the lemon sauce was not as good as I was hoping. For the prices, the food was only average. The service was disappointing. Our server left us when we weren’t quite ready to order. It was probably 15 minutes or so before she came back. I watched her on her phone for awhile. Also, individuals would walk by our table several times, looks at dirty plates and the wine menu, after we had wine, and then keep walking. More then once I had to ask people to take things. Finally, in very small print on the bottom of the menu, which is inline with other items so it blends in, is a notation of a 3.5% ‘entrance to venue’ fee. Beware of the charge. This is not Caesar’s Casino Vegas, it’s a hotel in Scottsdale. I had high hopes, I walked away very disappointed and over charged for the quality. I won’t go back and I would not recommend it.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: We were so delighted and impressed to find this restaurant! It’s stunning and stylish, yet everyone who works there is very friendly and un-pretentious. Customers were dressed in somewhat nice-casual to very stylish-gorgeous. I highly recommend it for the food, the prices, the wonderful atmosphere and great service.
reviews.author: Solveig

reviews.text: Food was okay, staff was untrained and intrusive.
reviews.author: Ramras

reviews.text: The food wasn’t at all as good as the price point, nor did it meet the expectations of a high end restaurant. The service was terrible; and apparently there was a reservation that needed our table so we were told we should take our conversation to the bar as soon as they picked up our desserts which we had not yet finished. It was humiliating and after spending near $700 I wasn’t impressed. Very poor service.
reviews.author: Julia

reviews.text: The lemon pasta dish, which is supposed to be a signature dish for this restaurant was a big disappointment for several of our dining guests. Overall, I did not see anything that made me think that this was fine, upscale dining.
reviews.author: Anthony

reviews.text:
Luna is nothing short of spectacular. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warm hospitality and an elegant yet inviting atmosphere. The service was impeccable, attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely welcoming.

The food? Simply outstanding. Every dish was crafted with precision and bursting with flavor. The ingredients were fresh, the presentation was stunning, and the flavors were perfectly balanced. From the appetizers to dessert, every bite was a delight. The Fritto Misto and the Signature Lemon Spaghetti with a side of Lobster were absolutely the highlight.

The ambiance added to the experience, offering a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. Whether for a romantic evening or a special celebration, Luna by Giada exceeds all expectations.

A flawless dining experience from start to finish. We will absolutely be back!
reviews.author: Mufeed

reviews.text: Menu selections creative, food preparation and presentation excellent and attractive, and service staff attentive with personable professionalism.  Luna is a relaxing and modern atmosphere with comfortable furniture.
reviews.author: Dennis

reviews.text: Food was outstanding and the service was wonderful.
reviews.author: Celina

reviews.text:
Service was marginal at best.   Received appetizers well before drinks.  They took care of the initial drinks but really?
Very loud atmosphere.
Caprese salad was excellent.  Oysters crudo was very good.
Pork chop saltimbocca was delicious.  Tasty.  Perfectly prepared.
