reviews.text:
Food was outstanding!
Service was in/out

Weird 3% fee via the Hilton that was waived

A cool vibe with impressive ambiance...needs to work on service that matches the quality of the food
reviews.author: Angela

reviews.text: Outstanding atmosphere, food and service.  The grilled pork chop, chicken piccata, and lemon pizza are excellent.   Incredible wine selection.  We will certainly return.
reviews.author: JP

reviews.text:
Good not Great - We are local and visit many restaurants in the area. We were excited to experience Giada's food after watching her on TV. I think the expectation was to experience something great, but the food and ambience just fell flat. 

- Food: The drinks were nice, but the food just wasn't anything special. We had a couple apps, a pasta course (famous lemon spaghetti), and a main course (Bronzino). It's odd with the kitchen being wide open (big windows) and you see the famous lemon spaghetti has the sauce just poured out of a pitcher onto the noodles. There are so many great restaurants in the areas with better quality. 

- Servers Junior: Our servers were nice, but you could tell they were more junior and not accustom to a nicer dinning experience. We kept on getting asked questions at awkward times. Didn't clean plates when they were empty and asked when they were half full if we were finished. It just didn't feel orchestrated well. Manager even stood by our table and smiled at us, but never attempted to make an introduction.

- Ambience: It is a beautiful location. The feel is very upscaled. I actually like the open kitchen. The only thing funny was the large red pepper grinder. It just feels gimmicky. 

- Price: I think this was the biggest shocker. Honestly for the price I would think I am in a very fine dining restaurant. If it was more aligned to the quality, I probably wouldn't have done this review. 
---- Example: We like to start the evening with one tequila shot, usually Don Julio 1942. Many well known high-end restaurant in the area are $40 to $50. Yes, it's silly, but we are out for a fun night. Luna wanted $80. We didn't order them. The food seemed to have a similar disparity in the price. 

I doubt we will ever come back unless someone else is paying. I wouldn't even consider this place if it was a special birthday or anniversary night.
reviews.author: Wes

reviews.text: Service was great but value of what you pay for is not there. Definitely seen and be seen crowd catering to the tourists who visit Scottsdale. They also include a service fee on your bill.
reviews.author: Lauren

reviews.text: The food was great. The customer service was amazing! The ambience was so fun and casual! U cannot wait to go again!
reviews.author: Natasha

reviews.text: What a perfect dining experience!!! I will return again and I always let friends and associates how great the restaurant is and a true asset to Scottsdale!!!
reviews.author: Marcie

reviews.text:
My love for Luna by Guida In Scottsdale has been building up over the past few weeks.

It all started with just a flicker and an and then a small spark. First, I went to the bar had a tasty cocktail and tried their bacon wrapped dates.￼

It was love at first bite and literally quite a tasty date.￼

It is a restaurant in a hotel in fact, a well-known brand, Caesars Republic Scottsdale.  Not the normal spot you expect to find some first class Italian food with the tasty Giada twist.￼

Obviously, a lot of passion went into development of this menu.￼ 🙏. I don’t want to ruin all the menu surprises as I hope you’ll visit soon but but one of my favorites and something I now dream about is the Signature Lemon Spaghetti.￼. It is served with two sautéed shrimp that honestly I don’t even eat and it’s still an amazing dish.

There are some excellent surf and turf entrees  and honestly I have hardly got to them as so many good starters, pastas and unique pizzas.

Seems weird to recommend that Caesar salad as most can be run of the mill but try this one. You won’t be disappointed as the croutons are amazing and crispy capers really take Caesar to a new level (at Caesars).

Save a little room for some of the taste of desserts.

I stayed here two different weekends￼ while working as special events in the area.

Service is amazing as well, try and catch Mia or Ziggy at the bar and managers. Amanda and tall gentleman were amazing and attentive as well. ￼

So here we go, a love can grow… we went from a spark to a small flame and two of burning fire of passion all in a few weeks.￼

Visit soon and fall in love too.
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.text:
Natalie the food server is likely the best in the Phoenix metro area. She is the model of what a perfect server is.  The food was outstanding as well. The ambiance (design and decor) is exceptional. And Paul the GM stopped by and was extremely warm, friendly and accommodating. Great experience for our wedding anniversary dinner. Thanks to the chefs, Paul, the terrific busser and to Natalie for putting on a perfect show of how to deliver a great dining experience.

Sean and Tina.
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.text: Excellent service, and great food. Be prepared, it is expensive.
reviews.author: Louise

reviews.text: What a great brunch menu. Food, staff ambiance met my expectations!!
reviews.author: ANNETTE

reviews.text: Ok experience overall. Food was bland, very over priced. Service was great once we were seated, as the 2 young girls at check in proceeded to have their own conversation while we stood there waiting to be greeted. Ambience was nice, but very loud. Wouldn’t most likely return.
reviews.author: Bill

reviews.text:
Let's start with the service, Amanda was super attentive, she is by far one of the best servers I have had the chance to interact with. Giada is very fortunate to have this young woman on her team.

The Lemmon spaghetti was great, tangy and creamy. We had this dish as the chef's special with Lobster, the butter sauce was amazing according to my party!  Luna ribeye was cooked to perfection, my husband was gloating about it. We had it as a special as well, the giant ravioli was good but the potatoes were great. Crab arancini was tasty and crunchy- sauce gave it the perfect balance. Fritto mixto was my favorite, again the sauce was perfect pairing. Now for the Desserts... chocolate soufflé- presentation was great, taste was yummy and warm. We added some gelato to it and that made it great! Ricotta cheesecake- the cookie on this was amazing, the texture was crunchy like it should be and the cheese has the perfect amount of ricotta so the texture of the cake isn't compromised. And lastly we also had the tiramisu- OMG the best we have had, perfect texture on all levels, perfect punches of flavors.

Drinks were delicious, on the pricey side but expected in Scottsdale. We had the Isabella- was good amount of tequila, tart and semisweet and fico prugna - was on the sweeter side but didn't disappoint with its fig and thyme.

The setting was warm, although it was an open concept you felt one with your party. The huge pepper shakers were a fun addition!

Only gripe was the venue admin fee, what was that about?
reviews.author: Edith

reviews.text: Loved it all, food, staff and setting was great.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jayson

reviews.text: My lemon sauce pasta was average. Drinks and bread was great and excellent service
reviews.author: Alejandra

reviews.text: Service was exceptional. Our waitress Melanie was awesome and when asking about 2 different dishes she explained each dish to help make our choice and it did not disappoint. Food was phenomenal I have not one bad thing to say. Each dish was so delicious, hot, seasoned just right. The signature lemon spaghetti is a must try.
reviews.author: TANYA

reviews.text: Overpriced for average food. Table wasn’t ready when we arrived even though we made reservations on Open Table. Had to wait 30 mins to be seated.
reviews.author: Mitali

reviews.text: We had a great experience - service was absolutely fantastic. Food was delicious. Branzino was one of the better cooked fish I had in a while. With that said, the place is terribly overpriced. I also had a high hopes for tiramisu being an Italian restaurant, but it was very disappointing - very sweet and very heavy.
reviews.author: Elena

reviews.text: Overpriced mediocre food, paying more for her name but not the quality I expected.
reviews.author: Kip

reviews.text: Excellent service very attentive staff food absolutely amazing
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: We ate at Luna a month ago, and enjoyed the restaurant. This time we found the food very disappointing.
reviews.author: raymond

reviews.text: Food presentation was beautiful.  Our server, Brandy, was excellent.
reviews.author: tom

reviews.text:
Good staff and kind and responsive manager. Unfortunately food was exceedingly average. Entire meal was returned because it was at best lukewarm. Spaghetti Lemon was good not great and Bugatti was bitter. Extra Sausage was a tiny bowl of crumbled sausage with NO FLAVOR.

We were so hopeful of a great experience particularly since it was an our anniversary celebration. Yet it wasn’t. So sorry Gidzy, I  was looking forward to the experience since I heard of the restaurant last year and booked this as our first dinner for our return trip back to Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.text:
All aspects were excellent

Service was attentive and knowledgeable

A great time
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Redemption. A return to Luna proved to be the experience I expected. Attention to detail, service from the staff, and an extraordinary culinary journey. Bravo
reviews.author: M

reviews.text: Had a wonderful date night at Luna! Our server was very knowledgeable about the menu and we loved how all of the ingredients were authentic and fresh. Also there were great mocktail choices and I am currently pregnant. The food presentation was a 10/10 and the ambience was also a great vibe. Highly recommend
reviews.author: Emily

reviews.text: The service and food were great would eat there again ￼￼
reviews.author: Billy

reviews.text: This was our first time here and we were super excited to eat at chef Giada’s restaurant. ￼ The ambience was very nice and the service was excellent, but the items are way overpriced for what we ordered.. $21 drink?  $32 pizza? ￼ Also my fiancé got extremely sick from the crab pasta dish.￼..bad batch perhaps. Way too much lemon in everything!…even the cheesecake. The graham cracker crust tasted stale and lemony.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: Food and service was exceptional! Definitely recommend
reviews.author: Ilea

reviews.text: Luna by Giada was absolutely great and delicious. The food was exactly what we imagined. Service by Teresa was awesome. She was helpful and knowledgeable about the menu and our preferences. Only complaint would be that the cost for a Moscato bottle was very expensive for the alcohol percentage of 5%. We felt like it was juice for $55. Other than that, 9 out of 10!
reviews.author: Salina

reviews.text: Our friend flew in from Austin to try this restaurant because she is a huge fan of Giada's and our first time trying this place was fabulous. From the friendly and knowledgeable staff to the ability to change dishes up to suit tastes, to the awesome recommendations from our waitress, the service is top-notch!  Most of our food was delicious, however, a few of our dishes lacked enough sauce which made the al dente pasta difficult to enjoy. The seafood was perfectly good. We also thought the focaccia and pizza were a little too salty on the outside. The Caesar was also a little bit of a letdown as the dressing doesn't include the traditional egg yolk, so it tasted too cheesy for me. What stood out the most here was the service. We would go back and try more dishes, I'm thinking of the filet or the Florentine next time and of course some delicious prosecco! Giada's should be on your list to try sooner rather than later!
reviews.author: Jenifer

reviews.text: We truly enjoyed this restaurant. The food was delicious and the service was excellent. Kaitlyn was an excellent server - so personable, genuine and truly loves Luna. We will be back!
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: Luna is amazing and never disappoints. We will be back!
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.text: Great service from Melanie. Had a lovely experience.
reviews.author: BECKY

reviews.text:
Our server Sarah was very attentive and helped us to select the meals we wanted
Food was just fantastic, flavorful and craveable and we will recommend and come back and back with family and friends
We loved it
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.text: Service was impeccable. Food was warm but not hot when it was served. Will go back again because everyone has an off night.
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.text: You can really tell when you have professional servers like Luna does.  They know the food, they know the wine. Really great service.  The food was spectacular! Every bite worth savoring. My favorite was the braised short ribs.  Melt in your mouth delicious.
reviews.author: Jeffrey

reviews.text:
Our server Melanie made it perfect. She was very pleasant, patient, very knowledgeable on the menu and a pure delight. Great hire.
As we waited for our table and sat at the bar- our bartenders were fun and energetic and helpful on drink decisions.
Great place and looking forward for a return visit.

reviews.text: Location is great food was just ok. For the price I was expecting an incredible meal, but it was just ‘ok’.

reviews.text: Everything was exceptional; service, food and drinks.  Best experience we have had; will be a regular!

reviews.text: Simply sensational , booking again for tonight and taking more people to experience this incredible restaurant

reviews.text:
Our server was the absolute best ...
thank you Shereese !!

All of our meals were wonderful .
We will be back

reviews.text: Service was outstanding. The front ladies not very friendly or welcoming. They seemed annoyed. The servers and other staff were excellent and the reason I would give it a second chance. I have been to Giada’s restaurant in Las Vegas, and the Vegas restaurant is better. The lemon pasta is different and not as good here. Pasta also seemed sticky. Caesar salad was over dressed. Lobster was cooked well. Drinks were good.
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text:
Food is meh.  So was pizza.  Based off tik tok vids I was expecting authentic Italian.  Was not.  Waitress recommendations were all of the most expensive items on menu.  For 2 people she said we should get the deli tray, the  seafood tower, the tomahawk and save room for desert.  I asked if I could get noodles with my chicken piccata and she told me I could absolutely order a pasta entree in addition and both would come out together.
The restaurant itself is nice.  Very Vegas feel.  If you like wine you will love it.
reviews.author: Lionel

reviews.text: We went to celebrate our daughter’s 23rd birthday with family. The whole experience was 5 star. Can’t wait to go back and try some of the other menu items.
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.text:
Everything was special at Luna Restaurant.  The service was friendly and attentive.  The food was superb from the Caprese Salad with heirloom tomatoes and amazing little balsamic pearls to the Shrimp Risotto with mushrooms.  My partner had the hand tossed Mushroom Pizza, which he said was outstanding.  The star of the show was the Chocolate Hazelnut Souffle.  Our waitress, Baylie, was so helpful with the menu choices and had such enthusiasm which was contagious.
We will definitely go again.
reviews.author: JamesB

reviews.text: Hermosa experiencia, excelente atención, la chef y el personal y todos son geniales 😍🫶
reviews.author: Yohan

reviews.text: This was our second visit. We had the crab arancini appetizer, lemon spaghetti with shrimp and added lobster, and a couple of gin-based cocktails. It was one of the best meals I've ever had. The lobster was sweet and tender. The lemon pasta was creamy and delightful! Wonderful ambiance! Our server, Sarah K, was so sweet, and she described in great detail the popular menu items.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: Came here with my girlfriend for a nice dinner out after hearing about this restaurant. I got the lemon pasta with added shrimp, and it was delightful. We shared a tiramisu for dessert and that was amazing as well and the only downside is that it took 15 minutes to come out other than that service and atmosphere was amazing.
reviews.author: Antonio

reviews.text: Everything was perfect! Even the kids loved the pasta and pizza. Dessert was amazing.
reviews.author: Chrissy

reviews.text: Deva, Sara, Kenny and Blake were fantastic.  What a great experience.  Love the brunch!  Thanks again for making it a great day.
reviews.author: Jimmy

reviews.text: Absolute wonderful Sunday Brunch! Wait staff was phenomenal and the food was fantastic! It was a true experience to enjoy.
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text: This was our first time at Luna.  Great location with an incredible decor.  Every detail from the red L on the plates to the red pizza oven, to the unique red water glasses and the red pepper mill was well orchestrated. Good wine selection and food offerings.  The staff was efficient, pleasant and knowledgeable.  The only disappointments - the food was not hot, the lemon spaghetti with shrimp had a total of two shrimp and the risotto with scallops was served with only two scallops.  The expectation would be to have at least three or four of the protein for the price.  The Nodi Marini Ala Vodka with spicy sausage on the side was delicious, but again not hot.

reviews.text: Did not clear the table of finished starter dishes and unused wine glasses. Starters shined, entrees were average, desserts very good.

reviews.text: Luna, my experience was outstanding! This is the best value for your dollar. It is by far, the best food I've ever eaten. From the ambience to the servers to the freshness of the food. I drive an hour for this experience and it is worth it!
