reviews.text: The vibe was mellow, our server was fantastic! Our food had great flavor, my husband and I both felt it should’ve come out warmer it was more room temp and possibly a little cooler.
reviews.author: Tara

reviews.text: Amazing service! Bailey was excellent. The food was exceptional. My wife and I have already decided that we will be back again many times.
reviews.author: Joseph

reviews.text: Very nice place, views were great and atmosphere was good. Food was questionable for this much ballyhooed restaurant. The bacon wrapped dates were exceptional, but the signature lemon pasta had way to much lemon and was not very good, and the margherita pizza crust was soggy.  The Lemon Drop Martini's were far from special. We will not be in a hurry to visit Luna's again.
reviews.author: RUSS

reviews.text: Great experience and a charming service staff. Will highly recommend for anyone.
reviews.author: Shingi

reviews.text: Our reservation was 9PM but they did not provide us the table even on 9:15 PM and I had to talk to the hotel front manager to get the table. Finally we got it on 9:40PM. It was embarrassing. The signature lemon pasta was too sour. I don’t know how many people appreciate such a sourness. The list of Italian wine list is very limited and no good selection.  Overall experience wasn’t good at all.
reviews.author: Ryuji

reviews.text: Steak was delicious but then the mashed sweet potatoes that came with it was wildly salty…
reviews.author: Ally

reviews.text: Been here about three times, trying to give it a chance, but the food is still meh. With Giada’s name tied to it, expectations are high, but they fall short. Ambience is great! Service and definitely the food & beverage needs to up their game. Very underwhelming considering the hype Giada’s name has, but she needs to revamp menu and add more flavorful, tasty dishes.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: The food was very tasty.  We had a reservation for 730 but we didn’t get our table until 8.00.  I think it was pricey.
reviews.author: Lilly

reviews.text: The food was wonderful but unfortunately our evening just got off to an extremely slow start that kinda set a sour tone. We had booked a new years eve package that started at the hotel at 9.  So I booked a rsvp for 7:30.  It took until 8:27 to actually be seated and receive our first drink.  I'm not sure if the restaurant was just understaffed or if perhaps our server had too many tables. But the dinner lasted way longer than anticipated.  Food was good and our server was nice, that wasn't an issue. But to be seated 30 min after our rsvp and then take another 30 min to receive a drink just wasnt great.
reviews.author: Melissa

reviews.text: We dined at Luna on NYE.  First time, four of us.  One of the best dining experiences we’ve ever had, on all levels.  The service is outstanding ~ professional, not stiff.  The food, from start to finish, was exceptional.  The menu options are terrific and the pricing is fair for such a first-rate experience.  And the room / ambiance is perfect.  Upscale, but casual.  Great, convenient location, too.
reviews.author: Larry

reviews.text: Love this place.  Great food, great service, great wine selection, patio is awesome in the cooler months with plenty of heaters and warmth to add ambiance, just overall an amazing time is always had here.
reviews.author: Cherie

reviews.text: Lemon pasta was very “lemony” so most of the group didn’t enjoy it, I thought it was ok. The seafood was tough and lobster was chewy. Thr potatoes were the best part. Broccolini didn’t have much taste, branzino was a good amount for the price but this fishy fishy didn’t have much seasoning. Drinks were decent we tried a variety, water was bad but I think it was tap, just tasted weird at a high end restaurant. It was decent, for the price I’m not sure. Beautiful restaurant though.
reviews.author: Kaaydah

reviews.text: Loved the food! Served was very knowledgeable. Loved the mocktails
reviews.author: Victoria

reviews.text: I dined here with a couple of girlfriends for the first time and we ultimately had a great time. Our service was exceptional. We loved our waitress. The food was very good. Our food was good and we had a fun time trying out a few appetizers and entrées and dessert to share among the table. My only complaint is that it was very overpriced. But still likely to return for special occasions. ￼
reviews.author: Lara

reviews.text: Food and ambience were perfect. Wait staff was perfect!
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.text:
Amazing!!
The best brunch EVER!
Thank you Christian for a beautiful experience
reviews.author: Michele

reviews.text: It was an outstanding experience to celebrate a milestone birthday.  Our waiter, Christen gave us exceptional service also.
reviews.author: Patt

reviews.text: Great food but a bit expensive.  Service was excellent. Kendall was our server and was great!!
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.text: Excellent brunch!  Every choice is well chosen and the quality is amazing.   Wonderful personal service in a beautiful space.  Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.text: Our dinner was fabulous and the staff impeccable. ￼￼
reviews.author: Dianne

reviews.text: Excellent service and great communication from our waiter Jay the whole time. Would definitely return and the food was outstanding as well
reviews.author: Gina

reviews.text:
Beautiful restaurant and staff is exceptional. My 5th time dining here, love the choices, everything is delicious. My only disappointment is our food never comes out hot, it is always room temperature. And with the trio last night, my raviolo was cold and steak was warm.
Other than that it is a wonderful dining experience.
reviews.author: Jill

reviews.text: This was our first time visiting Luna. Service was mediocre at best. Restaurant was not that busy but the time that we had to wait for our water glasses to be refilled or are drinks to be refreshed was way too long. ￼ We sat at our table with dirty plates for over 15 minutes before they were finally cleared. We were planning on getting dessert, but to be honest service was so slow that we didn’t want to wait there any longer.  Food was good, but honestly the service was very disappointing for the price. ￼
reviews.author: Aimee

reviews.text: Wonderful food and service. Kudos to the manager who loaned my cold sister a hotel robe!
reviews.author: Debbie

reviews.text: The entire staff was well trained.  The food was great.  Our server Bailey was amazing.  Kenny is one of the best managers in the Valley.
reviews.author: Vernon

reviews.text: For my 65th birthday on Christmas Day, I decided to shake things up. After two years of excellent celebrations at Mastro's, I was excited to try Giada De Laurentiis's latest venture, Luna by Giada in Scottsdale. Unfortunately, the experience fell short of expectations in almost every way. Overpriced olive garden without the unlimited salad and breadsticks. Read my full review on Yelp, open table limits your response.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.text: Our server Gilbert was stellar! The entire meal was impeccable. The Bistecca alla Florentino cooked to perfection!
reviews.author: Kelly

reviews.text: The venue is beautiful- inside a gorgeous new hotel.  Right next to old Scottsdale.  Very friendly staff, beautiful decor.  The food was outstanding, quality .  We loved our food.  Lemon shrimp pasta, Meyer lemon pizza, Mazing Cesar salad, and the lemon cheesecake was fantastic.
reviews.author: eugene

reviews.text:
Not good and spent $400.
Aioli sauce for the calamari tasted like metal. It was actually horrible.
Ordered vegetarian risotto and was charged same amount as the scallop risotto on the menu, minus the scallop’s!
The sauce on the pasta was worse than Ragu!
The hostess employees were very very unprofessionally dressed.
The table we had was in the middle of nowhere and not private at all. Forced area to squeeze in four two tops.
Will not go back and will not recommend.
reviews.author: Kristen

reviews.text: Great food, a bit pricey but nice ambience. Outside patio is a nice area for apps and drinks.
reviews.author: Raquel

reviews.text: Jay our waiter is amazing.  Attentive, fun and truly cared about us.  Kenny the GM is sensational.  Everyone needs to go to Luna.  A real treat!
reviews.author: Linda

reviews.text: This was my first visit to Luna and not if I would  make the return visit. The staff were extremely friendly and the food was ok, but under seasoned and over priced for the portion sizes. The space itself is beautiful albeit a little boring and not sure what they are doing with music programming but it is disjointed from the concept. The kitchen is gorgeous but unfortunately they have a huge glass wall which keeps the energy, smell, and excitement from the dining room. Way too much literature at the table (large menu, drink menu, tasting menu, and wine book). Our apps hit the table before our drinks but they rallied and kept them flowing moving forward. I love Giada’s style of cooking but it might have been better with just drinks and apps at the bar.
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.text: Christmas dinner, fantastic food, excellent service
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text: Everything about this place was amazing. The hostess explained a lot about the restaurant. The server was super knowledgeable about the menu and helped choose dishes. The decor and comfort was outstanding.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: Classy atmosphere in Cesars Republic hotel, impeccable service with coordinated plate service by the staff. Three of us started with the arugula salad with crispy prancetta and candied lemons…yum, and the Lemon pizza…fantastic! For entrees the table had the Signature Lemon Spaghetti with shrimp…wow, the Nodi Marini Ala Vodka with a mild arrabbiatta sauce, and the Pan Seared Salmon on a bed of artichokes olives and capers…awesome!. Nice bar and outdoor seating area. Overall, a little pricey but service, food quality, and venue helped to build the value.
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.text: This was our second visit and it was fabulous dining experience from start to finish.  It was Christmas Eve and the restaurant was lively and decorated beautifully.  The staff was wonderful all the way around and the food could note have been better prepared or more delicious.  I am glad we tried this restaurant again as they have definitely worked out the kinks since the time of our first visit.  We will be back.
reviews.author: Trudi

reviews.text: This restaurant was first class all the way. We were greeted warmly upon checking in. Service was outstanding. The food was amazing. Try the Branzino or the lemon spaghetti! I can’t wait to go back.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: Superb!  Can’t wait to return and try another entree!
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: Great restaurant I highly recommended the lemon shrimp pasta and the focaccia bread is fantastic! ￼ The service was over the top ￼wonderful!!
reviews.author: melanie

reviews.text: $41 dollars for the worst risotto I have ever eaten! As the dish cooled down, I realized it was a giant over cheesy mess. The lemon spaghetti was tasty!
reviews.author: Bryan

reviews.text: Very good.  Very expensive.  Paying for 6 is pricey.  Service was 10/10.
reviews.author: Larry

reviews.text: Celebrated my wife's birthday at Luna with a party of 7 on December 22, 2024.  The beautiful ambience, attentive service and exquisite food was beyond expectation. The staff was by far the most professional and attentive that I have experienced in quite a while.  The manager stopped by several times to check on us and the waitress was friendly and gave great recommendations.  We dine out at minimum four times a week and entertain out of town guests often.  We will definitely be returning to our new favorite Scottsdale restaurant.  Thank you!
reviews.author: Tim

reviews.text: Luna was a wonderful experience! Everything was fantastic, from the patio views , to the service , to the food . Christian was our server,  and we can’t thank him enough for his kindness, expertise, and prompt service . The focaccia , arancini , lemon spaghetti, swordfish were all wonderful . We enjoyed the lemon and spicy sausage pizza as well to share . The tiramisu was the final great touch to the night . The menu is a bit pricey , but overall worth the experience.  Everyone seemed to go out of their way to make sure our evening was enjoyable. We would go back again.
reviews.author: Anna

reviews.text: The overall experience was okay not worth the money they are charging
reviews.author: Alix

reviews.text: Great place for brunch and loved the holiday decorations. Excellent service
reviews.author: Eva

reviews.text: Had to wait :15 past rez for our table. Slow service to start but got better as the evening and courses continued.
reviews.author: Gerald

reviews.text: Luna is an exquisite experience. The ambience and decor are contemporary and welcoming. The food and presentation is excellent. But beyond these qualities, the staff and management are what make Luna unique. They see warm, welcoming, knowledgeable, caring and take great pride in Luna and their responsibilities. We have only the highest praise for Luna.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: Booked the Jade room but seated elswhere. Food was ordinary, prices were not.
reviews.author: Denise

reviews.text:
Everything was fantastic! We are so glad we discovered it was here!
One thing I am puzzled by on open table, is why they ask about birthdays, anniversaries, etc, if most restaurants never do anything special for you. It was our 25th.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.text: It was my wife and I 19th anniversary. We sat outside. Melanie was our waitress. She was amazing. We had the lemon spaghetti and citrus. Ceasar both fantastic! The general manager came by and even checked on us to make sure everything was great. They really went above and beyond we love this place and will definitely be back! Giada give these two a raise !
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text: Great brunch buffet! Food needed a little salt, but was very good. Service was the best. Christian is an amazing waiter. Super attentive. Thank you CHRISTIAN! Will be back.
reviews.author: Vincent

reviews.text: Excellent Sunday brunch! We went for my birthday and was very pleased with the food and service!
reviews.author: Janet

reviews.text: It was a great experience! The food was phonominal. Great location and vibes! I would definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Sunshine

reviews.text:
Probably will never go back the last couple times I been they have been very late on seating us
No excuse just people are late but
Not me never any apologies or anything to make
Up don’t need anything but just the point
Also service was very slow and bad took
Forever to get a bottle of wine the. After we kept
Waiting for a waitress to take
Desert order the waitress wanted just to sell
Like I said will never go back and will let my friends know
reviews.author: GUSTAVO

reviews.text: Service is SLOW. And we can’t say it’s the holidays. My friend went a few months ago and said the same thing, but wanted to check it out. Waited 45 minutes for our two bottles of wine. ￼￼Food was fine yet overpriced, nothing to write home about. Beautiful space though.
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text:
Service was rushed.  Our dining experience only lasted 45 minutes.

The restaurant was very loud.  Accoustic modifications are needed
reviews.author: rick

reviews.text: Exemplary service from the moment we arrived. We dined in the Jade room. We ordered the Acorn Squash soup, the Citrus Caesar, Branzino and Pork Chop Saltimbocca. Great wine list. The meal was delicious and Teresa was an excellent server. We would definitely dine again when visiting Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Jacqueline

reviews.text: Always a delicious time and the service is impeccable.
reviews.author: Lainey

reviews.text: I love Luna by Giada! I love everything on the menu! When you go - make sure you get the Lemon pizza and the Lemon Spaghetti.
reviews.author: Lani

reviews.text: We did not realize it was a Brunch buffet only when we booked. Very few people were in attendance, which led to a poor turnover of the buffet items, and many of them that were supposed to be hot were cold. The English muffin on my eggs benedict was so hard that I could not cut it with a knife. We will not come back for Brunch, but we may try it another time as the service and atmosphere were nice.
reviews.author: Jim

reviews.text:
This was my first time at Luna. Let me say the hype is well-founded. From the lovely front of house staff, to our waitress, Shereese, this place is a finely tuned machine. Shereese was extremely attentive, and offered wonderful suggestions for our dinner. The focaccia bread with dipping sauces was out of this world! Our Caesar salad had a mild lemon flavor, which made the salad light and perfect for an appetizer. It is sharable! BTW, the dressing is eggless!!
We had the lemon spaghetti, Giada’s signature dish, and it was flavorful, with a lemony creamy parmigiana sauce along with shrimp. Definitely recommend. The ambience was beautiful with an energetic vibe, absolutely a place to see and be seen. I would highly recommend this place, and cannot wait to come back with my entire family!
reviews.author: Valerie

reviews.text:
The whole experience was wonderful from walking into hotel entrance and into Luna.
Our server Jay was so great. Being the owner of a restaurant in WA. I would hire him in a minute.
Food presentation, flavor profiles paired with excellent wine selection. I highly recommend, ask for Jay if you have the opportunity.
reviews.author: Rhonda

reviews.text:
Beautiful setting. Service started off excellent but deteriorated as the evening progressed, unfortunately. Everyone was very pleasant, but many details were overlooked. This was disappointing considering the price point and luxury position of the menu, prices, and overall vibe.

I absolutely don't mind paying ridiculous premiums for fine dining, but you better execute. Unfortunately, it just failed to deliver all the way through.

Will certainly be back, but maybe for lunch.
reviews.author: Matthew

reviews.text: Luna always exceeds our high expectations. The service, food, and ambience cannot be matched elsewhere.
reviews.author: Larry

reviews.text: The food was amazing service  and atmosphere was Fabulous ❤️🥂
reviews.author: Joyce

reviews.text:
What I expected from Giada
All top notch , the server Jay was polite and very informative of the menu and flavours
reviews.author: joe

reviews.text:
2nd time there and may never be a third.  The food arrived cold, undercooked and when a second attempt was made we had to wait 45 minutes and still the food was cold and undercooked.
Management offered to buy our dinner however, I will never be able to get that fine dinner experience back.
Perhaps some better oversight is needed by all the management staff.
reviews.author: Catherine

reviews.text: Service was incredibly slow! We waited 1 hr between appetizers and the entrees.  Dinner was 3.5 hours overall  Took 30 mins to get cocktails! Server continued to push high priced wines when we said no, food was delicious.  Server in attentive to our needs.  Beautiful restaurant but with the service on a Friday night and the clueless valet staff, we will not return.
reviews.author: Debbie

reviews.text:
The food was amazing and the server (Jay) made the night even more special. The ambience on outside patio viewing the Christmas tree and lights, incredible.
Ask for Jay on your visit!
reviews.author: Carol

reviews.text: Our server Bailey was very kind and extremely knowledgeable about the menu and wines! Her recommendation’s were greatly appreciated. Everyone we talked to was extremely professional and helpful! Gorgeous design as well! We sat next to the wall of windows that look into the kitchen and it was so fun! Definitely coming back with more company.
reviews.author: James

reviews.text: Our server Melanie was so wonderful, she went above and beyond to make the evening a great experience. The food was excellent, must try the lemon pasta they’re known for.
reviews.author: Allison

reviews.text: Very good food. All delicious. Server was attentive and nice atmosphere. Noise level super high. Server had to elevate her voice to a scream so we could hear her. The restaurant needs to do something with the ceilings to defuse the noise. I have seen it done in other restaurants.
reviews.author: Anna

reviews.text:
This was our first time to Luna and it exceeded expectations. We were greeted by lovely hostesses and had a great pre dinner cocktail at the bar-great drinks and bartenders!!
When we reached our table the great service continued with Natalie as our server. The food was excellent , service too, all of the staff is top notch!! Highly recommend Luna and December is a wonderful time to go!
reviews.author: Krista

reviews.text: Very good service but the food is not good, little salty and deserts are too sweet.
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.text: We had an incredible time! Food was delicious and service was outstanding! We were celebrating my moms birthday and they brought out not one but two complimentary desserts. It made her feel so special!
reviews.author: Andrea

reviews.text: Another excellent dining experience at Luna. We met up with four others who had not been here before and everyone raved about the food, drinks, service and atmosphere. Four of us had Giada’s signature Lemon Spaghetti and loved it. The others had a steak on a bed of potatoes, topped with ravioli and finished with a quail egg. Also rave reviews. We finished with the hazelnut  soufflé and chocolate almond cake. Again, both delicious , but the soufflé was everyone’s favorite. The service was top notch and made the evening so enjoyable. Well done!
reviews.author: Machele

reviews.text: Great experience for a special occasion. Good was great , I had the nodi marini and added the shrimp for an extra$20, but only got 2 shrimp, unsure that was of value, probably should have had at least 4. Everyone had great food, service was excellent...Melanie was friendly, professional and offered up great descriptions of the different dishes. Be ware there is an odd 3.5% venue fee that you aren't notified of ahead of time. Nvr heard of a venue fee, let alone a % of ur overall food and drink bill. That decreases the tip for us.
reviews.author: Tamara

reviews.text:
A great place to go for the holidays!
Very festive!
reviews.author: Marguerite

reviews.text: We’ve had dinner here before, & their food & service was excellent!
reviews.author: Judy

reviews.text: Luna by Giana turned out to be disappointing. The best part of the meal were the delicious Rose Negroni cocktails. We started out with the Fritto Misto. It was over fried and hard to cut through. The calamari was not tender. I had the star of the menu, the signature lemon spaghetti tower and it was quite flavorless with two not so large shrimp. My dining partner had the Mezzi Rigatoni with added sausage and it was nothing special. We will not return. Scottsdale has too many other options that are much better. It was not a good value and they added on what the server called a resort fee customary to Caesar’s.
reviews.author: Mary

reviews.text:
So enjoyable
Delicious food
Great Team
Brunch was varied, healthy and relaxing.
It’s a must experience.
reviews.author: Frances D

reviews.text: 4 of us dined.  The branzino was pitifully small, dry and not that flavorful.  Loud restaurant.
reviews.author: sharon

reviews.text: It was extremely expensive. Paying $40.00 for pasta was ridiculous. .  Food was good. Service great.
reviews.author: julie

reviews.text: Great dining experience. Loved the Lemon Spaghetti!
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.text:
A wonderful time at Luna!  We ate our four-course scrumptious Thanksgiving dinner at the Luna Bar the first night.  It was fun to do TG dinner at the bar with great people! The second night we started out with happy hour @  Luna Bar, then dinner in the Luna dining room.
Exceptional service by everyone especially at the Luna Bar with Deva, Ziggy & others.    Kenny, the manager, was thoughtful and helpful.  We will be back for sure!  Thank you for an awesome time!
reviews.author: Krista

reviews.text:
Our waitress was very knowledgeable but didn’t really give us enough time to chat
She needed to take it down a notch lots of energy
Food was ok not as good as last time
Branzino was dry
Risotto was excellent
Lemon spaghetti was ok
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing the food in the service was outstanding. Definitely will go back. ￼
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: Our server Brandy was awesome.  Food was really good.  Wish we had room for dessert
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.text: Overpriced, but delicious food and drinks. The Agnolotti and the pork chop were our favorites. Good sized portions on salads.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text: Great food amazing service will be back and definitely recommend to friends and family
reviews.author: Jeramiah

reviews.text: Excellent food and service. It’s a bit pricy, but you won’t find anything like it in the immediate area. The quality of the food and the unique flavor profiles are impeccable. We’ll definitely be back.
reviews.author: Jo

reviews.text: For the first part if the meal we thought it one of the best in Scottsdale. Then came the main course. Chicken piccata was not pounded and was too thick and tough. Ruined the capers by flash frying them. Specialty lemon pasta became cloying as it did not stay hot and lemon butter with lobster was too overpowering. Pizza was good. Disappointing food was somewhat set aside by excellent service and good ambiance. Definitely felt welcomed and valued
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: Food was amazing, Shereese my server, was outstanding !
reviews.author: Jean

reviews.text: I was shocked to look at my bill and see a 3.5% Venue Admin Fee. Called them and first they told me it was for their overhead and then she said no it was a credit card fee. Don’t recall ever being told there was a credit card fee when making reservation and the prices they charge ($21 for a drink) should cover their  overhead. Do they expect people to carry that much cash? Food was good but this leaves a real sour taste. Plenty of other places to go that don’t nickel and dime the customer. Adios!
reviews.author: w

reviews.text: Very expensive for the portion received. Service was so so and very stretched out in a non-paced way. It took too long to be initially greeted and too long to receive the initial cocktails. When I’m spending that much money I want to be attended to… cocktails were too sweet, wine never got delivered to one of us during dinner and even though I told three people on staff it was my husband‘s birthday they completely missed the candle and birthday. I don’t know that I would come back here and spend almost $800 again. Ambiance beautiful.
reviews.author: Ashleigh

reviews.text: I don’t like being this tough in a review but I have to be honest. The price point was $95 and it was a glorified breakfast buffet at any hotel. The one pasta option was overly salty and was not hot at all. The main problem with everything was the temperature. Everything was luke warm, including seafood and salads. I wasn’t thrilled with my experience at all and I love the Giada brand but this just wasn’t it. I don’t know if this brunch concept will continue as I did not see more than 2 other customers during our seating.
reviews.author: George

reviews.text: Wow!  I believe it’s Scottsdale’s BEST KEPT SECRET FOR SUNDAY BRUNCH!  We originally tried Luna for a Date-Night dinner & loved it so much wanted to see if Sunday Brunch is worth the $95 price/ if you love fresh quality seafood you will LOVE THIS RESTAURANT
reviews.author: Dina

reviews.text: I love Luna for dinner Not for brunch. I do not mind paying for the price if it’s worth it, it’s not! Quality is the same as Vegas Buffett at a cheaper price. You guys charge almost $100. So tax + gratuity now I’m looking at over $100 for a food that taste like days ago food. I do have pictures. So, tell me if that's worth $96!
reviews.author: Ces

reviews.text: Food was ample and tasted exquisite. The service, from the hostess', to the bartenders, and servers was outstanding. We were made to feel welcomed through out the meal.
reviews.author: Dino

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant, every bite was perfect! Loved the branzino and lemon pasta.
reviews.author: Lindsay

reviews.text: Waitress’s upsell was too much. She provided good service, but I don’t want to be upsold at every turn.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.text: Service and ambiance was fantastic. The Signature Lemon Pasta was fantastic! Our friend had the chicken piccata and he said it lacked flavor. The soup was good but not served hot and the portion was extremely small, probably less than 1/2 cup. The chocolate soufflé was fantastic and the focaccia was the best I have ever had. One warning - WHEN WE RECEIVED THE CHECK A 3.5% VENUE/ADMIN FEE WAS ADDED TO THE BILL. WHEN WE ASKED ABOUT IT WE WERE TOLD THE HOTEL CHARGES A RESORT FEE. I HAVE ONLY SEEN THIS IF YOU ACTUALLY STAY AT A RESORT AND ARE CHARGED THAT AT CHECK-IN. WE WERE THEN TOLD UPON REQUEST THEY WILL REMOVE IT AND THEY DID. I WONDER HOW MANY PEOPLE HAVE PAID THAT AND NEVER KNEW IT COULD BE REMOVED. I would definitely go back and try the other dishes.
reviews.author: Anne

reviews.text: Delicious! The food was so good! We had the focaccia, crisp and dips accompanied great pairing. Our server Jay super knowledgeable. Offered suggestions! The few things I would say that were little was the confusion at the hostess stand and not a lot of smiles.  Some of the uniforms seemed dingy and too small.  The decor was beautiful-tile-wine wall-separate party room! A must when in Arizona!
reviews.author: Deana

reviews.text: It was a great night of food and laughter! Thank you all for a great time!
reviews.author: Craig

reviews.text: It was a wonderful overall experience.  Great food and mood setting.  Waiter provided good selections from apps to drinks to entrees to dessert.  Definitely a do over! .
reviews.author: Debbie

reviews.text: Exceptional service, beautiful views and delicious food! Looking forward to Dinh h here again soon.
reviews.author: TAMARA

reviews.text: Jay and Brody provided phenomenal service. Beautiful restaurant to go along with an amazing meal.
reviews.author: Anthony

reviews.text: We had an amazing experience! Can’t wait to go back! 🤩🤩🤩
reviews.author: Jasmin

reviews.text: Amazing food and customer service. Great atmosphere.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: Luna has become a favorite for us and we enjoy sharing it with friends. Cocktails, food and service were top notch again. We loved the new menu options. Brandi was our server and I loved the options and suggestions she shared with us regarding the food and drinks. We had a wonderful evening and look forward to our next visit.
reviews.author: Machele

reviews.text:
The lemon pasta is good but overrated for a signature dish. I have made this recipe by Giada and it was better than her own presented to me with only two shrimp.
I was asked by waitress  if I wanted to pay more and have four shrimp.
Good shrimp are not that expensive …it good pasta lacking seafood flavors.   The restaurant is pricey so an attitude of counting shrimp is just cheap!
reviews.author: Pam

reviews.text: A top notch hotel eatery. Food was very tasty! Great wine selection.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: As always, Luna was excellent. The ambience, service, food, and management  were all exceptional.  Emma, Amanda, and Paul were very attentive to all our needs and provided  us with yet another wonderful dining experience.  Needless to say, we’ll be returning soon.  Thank you!
reviews.author: Christopher

reviews.text: Reservation was at 715 we didnt get seated untill 745. Waitress took forever to take our drink and food orders. Food was amazing however service was extremely slow which impacted our overall experience
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our entrée was coded with salt. It was served Cole did not cooked in the middle  the restaurant was very loud and did not represent the ambience that we expected the valet parking team did not complete their process of sending us a text message and then when we finally received our car, they took a payment for $20 even though the payment was supposed to be $12 and they did not give us back the change to decide how much or if we want to add a tip. When I asked about it, they were somewhat resentful that we were even asking ￼￼￼
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant, excellent service, outstanding food. We will go back soon!
reviews.author: Nancy

reviews.text:
Great food, our party of 6 was happy. Presentation, flavor and quality were spot on.

Our server, Brandy, was great but didn’t mention the gratuity was already added on our bill. The auto gratuity was not noted on the menu, only a note that they automatically would add a 3.5% for a Venue admin fee. I couldn’t see well in the dim light but added my $120.00 for a 20% tip and for some reason, grabbed the itemized receipt, which I normally don’t. I later looked at the receipt and saw they had charged me the 3.5% venue fee (?) of $16.00 plus $92.00 gratuity BEFORE presenting us the bill with the tip space blank. After a phone call, they agreed to remove the excess gratuity but really left me feeling like they are trying to get double tips.
reviews.author: Kiyoko

reviews.text: Sarah is one of the best servers I’ve met in years. She knew the menu extremely well she knew all about.Giada, and had some great stories about her. The food was excellent. We had the lemon spaghetti with shrimp which was outrageously good, the signature dish of the restaurant, the pork chop and the Bronzino, all delicious.!
reviews.author: Halle

reviews.text:
first time dining here and the place was absolutely beautiful. I loved the soft lighting and every piece of decor was spot on. Our server Sara was just awesome and even though she was busy with other tables she always made it seem like she was just catering to us and loved what she was doing. Her recommendations were spot on and everything we ordered was really good. 
If you like lemons in dishes then this is the place to go as many of them had lemons. 
We had the burrata and tomato salad and it couldn't have been better with the heirloom tomatoes so sweet and the burrata so creamy. We ordered their signature dish which was the spaghetti and shrimp which was in a creamy white sauce, very light, tangy. Also ordered the chicken milanese which was moist and tender with a crunchy crust and a sauce they poured over that was so delicious.  If you order dessert then you have to try the lemon cookie plate as I know it sounds kind of plain but once you try the cookie you'll know why. 
Lastly, one of the telltale signs that the food is good is looking at the other tables and seeing what they order, how it looks and then if the plates come back empty and sure enough they all did!
reviews.author: randy

reviews.text: This is the second time eating at this restaurant and it was superb!  From appetizers to dessert was all amazing and delicious!
reviews.author: Gray

reviews.text: Beautiful ristorante! The menu was not overwhelming, balanced, including both traditional and creative offerings. The preparation exceeded my expectations. The service was excellent! The prices were reasonable. Well put it on our list of fine dining spots.
reviews.author: raymond

reviews.text: Pasta was not that hot.  Flavor was good. A bit pricey.  Very rich … good but not great.
reviews.author: Elyse

reviews.text: Food was great, service was slow and we had a rude server
reviews.author: Eliane

reviews.text: The service with Theresa was wonderful! The food is very good, but this restaurant is pricey. The Caesar salad is terrific, and the bread is wonderful. My wife loved the Salmon, my pizza was good.
reviews.author: Denny

reviews.text: Food is excellent! Staff is top notch!! Fantastic dining experience!!!
reviews.author: THOMAS

reviews.text: Great place!  Terrific service and beautiful restaurant
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text: Front people need to wear skirts long enough that they do not have to keep pulling them down.  No spoon given at table, soup was cold by time was brought out.  Spaghetti was sticky, but fine tasting.  Ambiance was very good.  Bacon dates were very good as was pork chop.
reviews.author: Craig

reviews.text:
Underwhelmed
Food was basic, I likely could have made most of the dishes out of one of her cookbooks.  Lacked depth to be what the restaurant is trying to be.
Definitely not worth the cheque at the end.  Least favorite meal in quite awhile.  Many better spots in Scottsdale for a lower price point.
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: We went to dinner for our anniversary recently. The The restaurant ambience was beautiful and the food superb. The service was exceptional as well. Can’t wait to go back.
reviews.author: June

reviews.text: Really nice decor, food delicious  , Jay was our waiter and he was super helpful with the menu for our first visit . We plan on returning soon
reviews.author: Lorraine

reviews.text: This place can’t miss. Everything we had was amazing. Our Server was extremely knowledgeable and gave us great recommendations.
reviews.author: Travis

reviews.text: Amazing food & service. Beautiful place.
reviews.author: Lianna

reviews.text: Sarah, our waitress was absolutely phenomenal. Very knowledgeable and helpful with the menu. Very kind went above and beyond service we will be back.
reviews.author: Jackie

reviews.text:
Revised Fall menu had new options on old favorites, well explained by waiter.  Attention to salt-free requirement was respected, and entrees were well prepared and beautifully presented.
White wine originally served too warm, but quickly chilled in ice bucket.
reviews.author: David

reviews.text: Nice cocktail menu and overall very pleasant experience.  Arugula salad was really fresh, delicious and a very generous portion, as was the caprese.  Our entrees were also very good - lemon pasta for my husband and the branzino for me and our friend.  While the salads came out right away, it was a long wait for the entrees. Given the prices, we would usually expect over the top service so the delay was a bit disappointing.
reviews.author: Agnes

reviews.text: Overpriced restaurant with no atmosphere, average pasta and unimpressive servers.
reviews.author: Susan J.

reviews.text: Just an all around wonderful experience. Love the layout and decor. Everything we got was delicious. Lemon pasta, pork chop, Caesar salad, and the must have lemon cookies. We’ll definitely be back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We went to Luna by Giada for my husband’s birthday. The hotel was beautiful and already decorated for Christmas on November 2nd! Our reservation was for 7:30 but our table wasn’t ready so we sat in the charming bar before dinner and was told we would be texted momentarily. We were still waiting 45 minutes later and had to search for someone to assist us. It was extremely noisy in the restaurant . Our server was not overly knowledgeable about the menu and the sommelier was not extremely knowledgeable about the wine. We ordered a white lemon pizza to start which was good but took a long time to get to the table. We had the pasta and a branzibo dish . The fish was just ok and the pasta dish was not very good. They brought us a soufflé for dessert which tasted like overly scrambled eggs. Somewhat disappointing especially for a birthday.
reviews.author: Sara

reviews.text: Beautiful environment, the staff was super attentive and knowledgeable, and the food was amazing. A lovely evening. A special thanks to our server Jay for his attention.
reviews.author: Tisha

reviews.text: My boyfriend and I went on a Saturday night, but we did have to book on the Monday before because they book out so quick! And we quickly found out why! We had Sarah K. as our server and she was incredible. She was so knowledgeable and helped us pick out some of our choices. She recommended us drinks and even brought us a cute little anniversary dessert! The restaurant is beautiful. They have a ton of different types of seating with different areas you could choose from on the reservation. We were in the main dining room but we didn’t feel overcrowded at all. The kitchen is a super cool concept - it’s surrounded with glass so you can see the beautiful tile on the food line and the pizza oven. The food was absolutely incredible. My boyfriend got the Mediterranean branzino and I got the scallop risotto with 4 scallops. My boyfriend finished his meal within a couple of minutes because it was so delicious. My risotto was amazing. The rice was cooked perfectly and the scallops were huge and had a beautiful sear on both sides. The drinks were delicious and refreshing as well. I got the Fico Prugna which was a perfect, refreshing cocktail. My boyfriend got the Isabella. We both got 2 rounds of drinks because they were so good! The dessert, which was a simple cookie and ice cream, was delicious as well. We really enjoyed the salt on the cookie combined with the ice cream. Overall this restaurant is a 10/10 and a must try if you’re in Scottsdale. If it’s your first time, make sure you ask for Sarah K because she was super helpful and helped guide us a lot!
reviews.author: Kylie

reviews.text: Always an amazing evening at any of Giada’s restaurants!
reviews.author: gregory

reviews.text:
This experience was simply delicious!  The ambiance for our delayed Anniversary dinner was spectacular, we had a view of the kitchen, which was fun.  The staff worked like a well-oiled machine, ensuring the water was never empty, and the plates were cleared timely.  We got great recommendations for the bacon-wrapped dates, and the scallop and mushroom risotto was divine!!  To top off a spectacular meal, we had the chocolate-almond cake - OMG, swoon-worthy!

Absolutely a fantastic choice for a romantic meal!!
reviews.author: Karyn

reviews.text:
Great service ( besides our head server Sara, no less than 5 people took care of us).
Great dishes: appetizers, pasta, desserts! Coming back!
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text: Our server was wonderful, the food outstanding and the ambiance was amazing!
reviews.author: Denise

reviews.text: Very good service and the food was wonderful. 111111
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: We had a fantastic dinner last night.  Our waiter was terrific.  The food was fantastic.  And the ambience was wonderful.  Can't wait to go back.  Oh, and the cocktails are spectacular.
reviews.author: stephanie

reviews.text: Great find. Food was fantastic and all of Kendall’s recommendations were spot on! Enjoyed it all!
reviews.author: JulieB

reviews.text:
Shereese, our waitress was stellar !!  The restaurant is beautiful. Our salad was wonderful
We had the special lemon pasta with lobster and crab. Very different and delicious. The cheesecake was a breathe of fresh air. It lightly exploded in your mouth. The cookies, especially the lemon, were divine
reviews.author: Victoria

reviews.text: Superb service and attention -however the food was lackluster, tasteless and even poorly cooked (shrimp).  The ambience is lacking- and is more of a “cafeteria style” where we were seated. It was very clean and wait staff (Shereese) was amazingly attentive and knowledgeable and the manager even fixed the uncooked shrimp -right away by removing from tab. We had high hopes- a bit of a let down.  Note to management- we noted young “runners” bring food to tables holding plates well below their waists- and to the side not out in front and above the waist- this shows poor training.
reviews.author: Kimberley

reviews.text:
Food and service top notch.
It’s a definite to return.
reviews.author: Tony

reviews.text: We came here to celebrate my birthday. First time dining at Luna by Giada. The entire experience was first class all the way. We were greeted immediately by our host. She gave us a brief tour and description of the wine wall, the kitchen, and the pizza oven aka “The Ferrari”. Our server Kendall was the best. We ordered the Caprese salad, lemon spaghetti, and tripolini. And for dessert we ordered the citrus ricotta cheesecake. My gf and I loved every bite. Phenomenal dinner and service! Thank you Luna by Giada
reviews.author: Anthony

reviews.text: It was the best overall experience! Food, service, ambiance. Definitely can tell when the creator has such profound influence!
reviews.author: Dorina

reviews.text: I wanted to like this place because I love Giada. The wait staff was very knowledgeable and attentive. The focaccia appetizer was great. The wine list impressive, but the 17.00 cost for one rose’ was high. We both ordered the lemon spaghetti. The flavor was good, however, the sauce was super runny and the spaghetti itself was not al dente it was tough and not appetizing. We received a complementary dessert which was great, as was the lemon cheesecake. My decaf arrived barely hot. Also, 22.00 for the valet??! $12.00 for the service and the suggested tip of 10.00 was not earned. Sad I won’t be going back -!it wasn’t good value for the money.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Sarah was awesome at the Scottsdale location! It was a great first experience. We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.text: Incredible family dining experience led by Shyreese and team. Recommendations, accommodations, and delightful service throughout the evening. I look forward to dining again.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food was absolutely amazing and customer service is probably the best considering it’s in downtown Scottsdale. Jokes aside Shareese made sure we had everything we needed, so when you book, ask for her, 10/10!!
reviews.author: Waseem

reviews.text:
Girls night! Great service and food!
Will be back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Prices are very high for what you get. My cocktail was simply ok, we waited a long time for wine to come-entree was almost finished but manager comped them. The tomatoes on caprese salad were barely ripe and my friend’s zucchini pasta was bland and cold. And it was $38 I think with no protein on it. I probably won’t return.
reviews.author: Marissa

reviews.text: We heard about this restaurant for some time and decided to try it with friends on a Wednesday night.  The hotel and decor are amazing but we encountered a few issues from the start.  The service was extremely slow with our first drink taking 20 minutes to receive.  Our waitress did not regularly check back with us while waiting for our drinks and to order.  The appetizers were good and the pasta dishes (which they are known for) came out lukewarm at best!  The manager was alerted and promptly remade not 1 but 2 pasta dishes for us to enjoy which we appreciated, great customer service!  However by the time they came out, the rest of our party were already done with their meals.  WE all had higher expectations for such an anticipated restaurant but sadly were disappointed.
reviews.author: Denise

reviews.text:
What a lovely experience for my birthday. The menu is limited but everything we ordered and everything we saw was exceptional.
The front dining area is quite loud, we asked to move to the back dining room and it was no problem
The manager ( I think ) came by to check on us and mentioned my birthday- very nice touch and when we left he shook my husband ‘s hand and thanked him for bringing me there for my birthday

Not something we can afford on a regular basis but for a celebration we’ll be back
reviews.author: Phyllis

reviews.text: It was a wonderful experience. Food was creative & excellent. Sara was our server & she was outstanding…knowledgeable, attentive & professional. The atmosphere was great. There was one section of the restaurant that was louder with music & chatter. However, there is also an option to sit in the part of the restaurant which was much quieter & conversation friendly. Overall, our experience was great & we would return the next time we’re in town.
reviews.author: Diana

reviews.text: The meal was amazing the service was on point t and our sever Jay couldn’t have been more helpful. Had the risotto with asparagus and scallops and the petite filet with Parmesan mashed potatoes we finished with the limoncello soufflé
reviews.author: Denise

reviews.text: food was delicios and the service eas outstanding. our server, Sarah, was very attentive and took my friend's mother to all the food areas at tge buffett snd explained everything.
reviews.author: Pamela

reviews.text: We were early but seated quickly. Kendall, our server, was EXCELLENT!  She knows the menu well, provided fast service and is very friendly. It is such a beautiful venue and the food is outstanding. We kept the bar tenders busy and they did not disappoint!! The chef was outstanding and all of our meals were delicious. We will be back.
reviews.author: DinaV

reviews.text: Food and drinks were unreal! Sherese was our server, and she was an angel. Knew the menu so well and helped us with all the recommendations. Amanda, the manager, was so sweet, and took care of us well. 11/10 recommend!!
reviews.author: Carly

reviews.text: Kendall our hostess was great. Friendly. Always smiling. Great experience. Will come back
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.text: Lemon pasta is rich and delicious. Recipe is available online and easy to make. Service was spot on and all four of us loved our dishes. Great environment to take your time eating dinner and enjoying drinks.
reviews.author: Genie

reviews.text: Christian our sever was amazing. The entire staff were so nice. The food!!!!!
reviews.author: Teri

reviews.text: Food reminds me of Olive Garden in quality and taste.  Prices are appropriate for fine dining.  Half the clientele had loud children spread through out the restaurant   Too many great options in Scottsdale.  Either price need to drastically change or needs a food quality overhaul
reviews.author: Corinne

reviews.text: We just weren't beyond thrilled with the food or the atmosphere. It was a lot of money spent for something that was 'equal' to what we could have received elsewhere for a lot less. Also, so noisy we had to shout to hear each other. We will not go back.
reviews.author: Jeni

reviews.text: The restaurant is lovely.  LOTS of energy so if you have someone in your party that’s hard of hearing - not the place for them.  Both the arugula salad and arribiata were very good.  My husband added spicy sausage which gave it more heat.  We opted out of dessert because the meal was filling.  Good portion size.  Would definitely come back!
reviews.author: Sara

reviews.text: Fantastic experience wonderful food and experience we will definitely be going back.
reviews.author: john

reviews.text: Outstanding food and service! Everyone in our group was was blown away by the dishes they chose, and our server (Charice) was one of the best servers we’ve ever had! We can’t wait to go back!
reviews.author: Chrissy

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant, patio, and building. Food was over rated especially for the price. Waiter was very sales person-esk. trying to sell is on something every single time she came over. Did not make the most enjoyable experience.
reviews.author: Grady

reviews.text: Food was meh, not a ton of flavor, overpriced and just boring. Service was great, staff were great, nice space. The bacon wrapped figs were pretty good, but not much else.  The manager came by, asked how everything was, we told him service was good, good was meh, and he said ok, and walked on. Huh?
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: A little pricey, but the food was excellent. Giada’s Lemon Spaghetti was awesome.
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.text: Excellent food and service and ambiance.  Will come back
reviews.author: Larry

reviews.text: Food excellent, staff very friendly and knowledgeable. Gorgeous setting ( outdoor patio).
reviews.author: Sharon

reviews.text: Excellent chef. Food was prepared perfectly. Wait staff did an amazing job. We go back time after time because this place gets it right…always!
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.text: Food for that price point was not impressive, passable but not memorable or anything to make us wanting to hurry back.
reviews.author: Shawn

reviews.text: Really enjoyed our evening at Luna. The food and the service was very good. The only thing that bothered me is that when I booked our table, it asked me which room I wanted to be seated in, the Luna or the Jade room. I contacted the restaurant to get clarification on the difference and was told Luna has a kitchen room while Jade room tends to be more intimate, so I booked the jade room. When we arrived for our reservation, we had to wait 15 minutes for our table and then we were sat in the Luna room. I didn’t ask to be moved because I didn’t want to wait even longer for our table, but why ask me which room when booking if you aren’t going to accommodate it? Just annoyed me a bit.
reviews.author: Jillian

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing!!! My husband and I will be back!
reviews.author: Tracy

reviews.text: Worth the trip. Food was delicious, ambience even better. Open light concept, fabulous decor and ambiance.
reviews.author: Melanie

reviews.text: Amazing food and exceptional service. We all had a great experience!
reviews.author: Tarrah

reviews.text: Beautifully decorated, but very noisy, and service was a bit slow. Difficult to have a conversation across the table so we had to sit side by side.  Lemon spaghetti was tasty but only 2 shrimp!  Expensive place.  Dippings for focaccia very good.  A little too much cheese on pizza for our taste.
reviews.author: linda

reviews.text: Food and ambience was on par. Can’t wait to go back and try some of the other dishes. Scallop risotto was so yummy!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful evening. Our server, Kendal, was superior. Best server I’ve had in a long time. Knowledgeable, smiling, helpful, and efficient. She made our evening. 

It is a bit noisy, as most restaurants are these days, with all the modern decor being hard surfaces and the like. That being said, it’s a BEAUTIFUL restaurant. 

The focaccia was the best I have ever had, ever!

The Signature Lemon Pasta with shrimp was delicious, with two huge prawns. Wonderful!

The rigatoni, I’m sorry to say wasn’t cooked enough, very chewy. The sauce was thick, like it had cooked down too much. We had it with Italian sausage and there was just way too much of it, overtaking the taste of the sauce and pasta.  

We had tiramisu for dessert which was delightful. 

We would definitely return, and look forward to trying some of the other dishes on the menu.
reviews.author: ellen

reviews.text: The best service and the food was beyond delicious … Caesar salad, bacon wrapped dates, lemon pasta & asparagus simply amazing . Thank you for the wonderful evening! Oh and the lemon soufflé for dessert  was  “magnifico”
reviews.author: sara

reviews.text: Private room for party of 11. Exceptional service. Team did a great job taking care of us. Menu was explained and family style was recommended for party our size. This was great. We got to taste many of the items on the menu. Delicious food. Lots of happy tummies! Looking forward to our next visit. Thank you for a wonderful experience.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text:
We have been dining at Luna since they opened.  Food and service is always excellent.  Manager Kenny is always pleasant and very accommodating.  Both our servers Sheerise and Kendall are some of the best in the industry.
Don’t hesitate to try Luna .
Rob and Roz
reviews.author: Rob

reviews.text:
Dinner at this restaurant was amazing, the chef and kitchen staff are virtuosos at creating delicious, yet light  Italian fares !!
Branzini, rigatoni with vegetarian bolognese, stuffed dates,bresaola… and more… perfectly executed!
Shereese was our server, a truly enthusiastic and energetic young lady who doesn’t “serve” but instead creates an “experience “, an amazing one if I may say !
Years ago I remember hearing that say : a bad waiter will ruin a great meal. A great waiter will save a bad one !
Nevertheless the food was amazing, shereese service was the sine qua non compliment to a perfect evening, highly recommend her and her knowledge of this menu are impressive!
This was an elevated dining experience!
Thanks to all of you at Luna
reviews.author: Jean

reviews.text: Outstanding selection of brunch dishes.  Good and attentive service.
reviews.author: Gwendolyn

reviews.text: We expected the same quality of food as the Vegas restaurant and we were disappointed. The mortadella Bianca pizza left a lot to be desired - crust was soggy and the cheese was still cold.
reviews.author: Kathy

reviews.text: The food was definitely above average, not top notch to justify top tier prices of other high end restaurants in AZ.  Was also hoping for a more vibrant atmosphere, had a sleepy vibe.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.text: Delicious food, although somewhat overpriced. Would recommend.
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: We went to Luna for our anniversary. We had the bacon wrapped dates as an appetizer, the lemon pasta and scallops. Amazing!
reviews.author: Karie

reviews.text: We had a great server! Appetizer’s were really good! Bacon wrapped dates and the bread! Lemon spaghetti was tasty! Atmosphere was really cool! Great bar area! Definitely would go again!
reviews.author: Patty

reviews.text: Excellent service , ambiance parfaite et nourriture excellente
reviews.author: Stephane

reviews.text:
Luna is a lovely restaurant with impeccable service and delicious food. Best to share dishes to experience an array of deliciousness.
The staff was wonderful. Very attentive  and knowledgeable about all the food they were serving us.  Staff  is very friendly and made our night special as we celebrated my husband’s birthday. Highly recommend Luna.
reviews.author: Lyvier

reviews.text: A culinary destination. If you enjoy Giada you will like every aspect of this dining experience.
reviews.author: Don

reviews.text: the location, people and food are as close to perfect as it can be in Scottsdale, Arizona.  Please note that i've lived and traveled all over the world.  this is classic and a must try.
reviews.author: dr michael

reviews.text: Brunch at Luna by Giada at Caesars Republic Scottsdale is heavenly!
reviews.author: kim

reviews.text: The Host (can't remember her name), Jay (Server/Birthday Boy- haha), and Jake (Support Service) were outstanding! Mom and I had a wonderful Sunday brunch (Management is also worthy of mention)! The food was delicious, especially the crab claws, eggs benedict, salads, and pasta inside the parmesan wheel.
reviews.author: Takisha

reviews.text: The ambiance was beautiful and the food was delicious. It was definitely experience worth paying for. Looking forward to coming back
reviews.author: Alicia

reviews.text:
Went for my husbands birthday, Food was good definitely not worth the $27 for calamari appetizer, or the $44 for lemon spaghetti, there are better places to spend the money.  Portions and quality didn't justify the cost.  Service was great, Restaurant is beautiful, but insanely loud.
Glad we tried, it so now we know.
reviews.author: Carrie

reviews.text: Wouldn’t waste your time. The food was terrible, the only thing saving this place is the ambience and terrific server (that they will be losing) the management is lacking and extremely expensive. There are so many better places in Scottsdale to go
reviews.author: Anna

reviews.text: Overall amazing experience. From walking into the door everyone is very polite and nice. The ambience is great, sat outside with a view of sunset going down over camelback mountain. Even at 5:45 with the sun still somewhat up it was nice outside and not hot! Food was great and service was amazing.
reviews.author: Jaden

reviews.text: Beyond tasty! Everything we ordered was just outstanding! Went with a group of 5 of us and we ordered everything family style. The staff was super nice and made sure we had a great night out. Just super cool restaurant with great food. A new addition to the regular Scottsdale scene that is sure to impress!
reviews.author: Erin

reviews.text:
We did a couples date night and It was our first time attending. The ambiance is very nice and enjoyable. We sat next to the kitchen and it was impressive to watch the staff create the dishes.
Our server Sheree ? Was very well versed on each item on the menu and gave very good recommendations.
Drinks
The drinks at the table were the Moderno for the men and the women enjoyed the the La Starada both were amazing
Apps
Our table really enjoyed the CRAB ARANCINI was a must have and the FRITTO MISTO
Mains
The mains were all fantastic
The ladies shared the Lemon Spaghetti and Mediterranean Branzino.
Both ladies we’re very impressed with the dishes
The men had shared the BISTECCA ALLA FIORENTINA FOR TWO porterhouse was perfectly done and we also shared the sausage pizza witch was cooked to perfection
Dessert
We had the brownie cheese cake (wow)  and cookies (wow ) and cake(wow)

Overall
it was a 10 out of 10 experience for us. We will definitely be back solo date night or with extra couples definitely recommend this restaurant
reviews.author: Aaron

reviews.text: The service was fantastic, and the food was world-class.
reviews.author: Ruben

reviews.text:
Very skilled, polite, funny, engaging staff. Mixologist makes a nice cocktail. Server was very attentive and went above & beyond normal service for us. Management doubled my order of scallops at no charge when it was forgotten. He was very professional and courteous. Food was high quality. They use high end ingredients. Menu has an array of choices. They should try a gluten meal like steak & veggies by adding the GF next to it for visual effect. They have vegetarian options as well.  Tables could use salt and pepper grinders but that's nickpicking. Lobster for 2 needs lemon & butter options. Parking is reasonable. Atmosphere is high end and very upscale inside a nice resort. Pricing is a little high but expected with the Scottsdale demographic and surrounding restaurants options. Overall, I give it a 4.7 out of 5.  The staff was our favorite part of the evening. 
Don't forget to order a pizza.....the dough is very good there.
reviews.author: Ty

reviews.text: The service from the hostess seating us to the server was excellent. But the food though beautifully presented was mediocre at best.
reviews.author: Rohan/Janaki

reviews.text:
Very  very loud, chairs and tables to close together
The table next to us was so close that it felt like they were part of our party. Chairs not comfortable and hard to move.
Service was ok, the lemon pasta wasn’t as good as hoped. Pasta and sauce to heavy. Pizza was good, pasta ala vodka wasn’t that great .
Expensive as expected, but didn’t really enjoy the overall experience to go back.
reviews.author: Richard

reviews.text:
Food and service are top notch at Luna. Likewise the expertly prepared cocktails. Ambiance is quite nice as well. All of the above has been well thought out and is well executed. But there is a problem that has nothing to do with the actual dining experience.
On the bottom of the menu, in very small print, is the following statement:
“A 3.5% administrative fee is added to every check. Thank you.”
Administrative fee?  Really?
Towards the end of our meal, before he was about to bring us dessert - and then the check - I called our server over. I said “See this 3.5% thing?  I don’t want to pay that. It’s just bs.”  He said “No problem. I’ll have it removed”.  That was definitely the right way to handle it. And to be clear, he was a great guy who provided us with great service.  He claimed that the fee was required by Cesar’s Republic, who are the owner of the hotel in which Luna is located. However, when I actually reviewed our receipt (which wasn’t until we returned back home for the evening), I saw that the 3.5% fee was still on there.  Which meant it wasn’t removed, and that we did pay it.  Unfortunately, this is the type of episode that can sour people on returning to even the best restaurant.  And it might cause us not to return to Luna any time soon.
reviews.author: Ronnie

reviews.text: Amazing food and service. Sat outside on a nice patio.
reviews.author: JJ

reviews.text:
One of the best experiences and the food was absolutely amazing and so delicious.

I will return for sure for special occasions
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our server Melanie was amazing! Everything was cooked perfectly and tasted delicious! We had the lemon spaghetti, sausage pizza and the salmon. We also had the caprese salad, and the focaccia bread to start. The focaccia bread was fresh and warm!

reviews.text: Great food and service . Would definitely one of the best pasta’s I’ve had outside Italy.

reviews.text: Gilbert was undoubtedly the finest waiter we have ever encountered. He exceeded our expectations by assisting us in discovering other dining options for the remainder of our stay and offering exceptional recommendations for both food and drink. reviews.text: What an amazing dining experience! From the moment we arrived, the service was top level at the bar and with our server Melanie. The drinks and food were one thing better than the next. Definitely recommend the lemon pizza, sounds weird - tastes phenomenal. I would highly recommend Luna as one of my favorite AZ restaurants.

reviews.author: john

reviews.text: Spectacular food (scallops & risotto and a fish special) + attentive and knowledgable service from wait staff to water, plate-clearing, etc.  Nice modern feel and a decent crowd even on an off-season Sunday evening.  Not cheap….$400 including cocktails, wine and a shared app, but worth it.
reviews.author: Jay and Laureen

reviews.text: Arrived Early for our Dinner reservation - we were taken immediately to our table and seated by hostess - greeted by Spencer and another team member who welcomed us to Luna and took our initial drink order - Shortly thereafter greeted by Amanda who would be handling our table for the evening.  Amanda explained the concept behind Luna and her goal of providing an incredible dining experience for our party.  After hearing about the items both on the menu and off-menu Chef curated items, we were left to discuss our options.  Amanda reappeared, took our orders and made suggestions as to the timing of items arriving and providing enough time between courses to enjoy each individual course.  Rib-eye steak & pork chop were excellent & the Branzino and Salmon entrees were perfectly cooked.  Service was impeccable from beginning to end - plates were promptly cleared, while uneaten portions reappeared in containers & carrying bag to take home to enjoy the next day.  This was our second time dining at Luna and were not disappointed by the food or service --- if you could change one thing, bring on the chef curated 'Tasting Menu' like is available in Las Vegas.

reviews.text:
It was good.

reviews.author: Maya

reviews.text:
Decided to visit Luna given the fanfare about Giada's cooking and half of what we tried was a let down. 

Service is good but can use some improvement, i.e. offering ground pepper or any potential seasoning that would pair/enhance the specific choice at the time of serving the plate and not have to hunt down the waiter or one of the staffers supporting the waiters. 

As I mentioned at the start of this review, half of what I ordered was not great: 1. the citrus Caesar was soggy and not even the croutons were particularly good- usually is the hard to fail part of this type of salad; 2. the signature dish- Lemon Spaghetti- come dirlo in Inglese senza essere uno stronzo.....? Subpart at best. 

Now, there were good things: the crab arancini were a nice opener- well prepared and the crab meat is evidently present; additionally, the jumbo shrimp were fantastic [tip: if you order the Lemon Spaghetti make sure to order the 4 jumbo shrimp or you will be eating mainly carbs and little protein].

The part that was surprising was that last night I was connecting with a well known real estate agent in town and this person had the same impression of the restaurant. 

In full transparency, I think their bistecca looked good but will not go back to try it [by the way, cara Giada- come italiana dovresti garantire che almeno il menu sia veramente in italiano: si escrive "Fiorentina" e no "Florentina". Spero sia stato un errore di stampa!

JZ.
reviews.author: Javier

reviews.text:
First time at the hotel and restaurant. It’s beautiful. Staff was very friendly. A place to see and be seen.
The food was ‘okay’. It may have been because I ordered salmon at a pasta restaurant. Of course, Giada is known for the Italian cuisine. I thought the salmon placed on a big bed of white beans was unappealing. Perhaps, rice, polenta, or Fresh vegetables.

reviews.text: This was our second time at Luna and we will be back when in Scottsdale. We love the ambience, the service is fantastic and of course the food is amazing. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We celebrated our anniversary at Luna. Our server Randi was wonderful. She made perfect suggestions for food and wine. Everything was delicious and service was well timed!

reviews.text: If you go to this fabulous restaurant you have to ask for Gilbert. He was our server who made our experience so fun. He was the best. He was so attentive to our table. So sweet and funny. Love love loved him. We’ll be going back for sure. Great food
reviews.author: MindyG

reviews.text:
Overall, we thought Luna can do better.

We were kept waiting for 5 minutes when we arrived at Luna.  No hostess to greet us -- neither were at their station yet.  We've never been to a high end restaurant where that's the case, and none of the tables were yet occupied.  Not even the manager was anywhere to be found!  When one hostess finally arrived, she seated us at the noisiest part of the restaurant -- near the bar.  We asked to be re-seated.

Brandy greeted us in a timely fashion.  But she got our order wrong (we asked for a Caesar salad, not a caprese salad).  She should have written down the order at the table.  And we were the only table she was serving to start.   She spent most of the time addressing my wife, not me, which is another mistake, since I'm paying the bill and I'm her tipper.

Nonetheless, the antipasti platter was good.  A big enough "small" platter for 2-3 people.  Unfortunately, we could not handle the grapes and honey, and the crostini was smeared with it as well.  The Caesar salad was excellent -- very fresh, and loved the crispy capers with adequate shavings of parmigiano.

The signature lemon pasta we asked for a gluten-free creste di gallo.  Much too lemony for me, although my wife enjoyed it.  I felt it would have been perfect without the lemon, and the creste was a touch overcooked.  For an Italian restaurant of this caliber, that's not forgivable.

The branzino was well prepared -- crispy skin and no bones.  Well-done!

We finished with the chocolate amaretti cake.  This was light and refreshing, but deceptive.  It was called a cake, but it's not a cake at all -- all chocolate mousse disguised as a "cake."  Since it was called a cake, we were expecting a deep dark chocolate cake with almond mousse as listed on the menu.  So we were very disappointed.

The kitchen was also very slow.  It took 2 hours to get through 3 courses -- same time it took Cafe Monarch for 6 courses.  Go there instead or to Francine, Course, Sel, or Americano.

reviews.text:
It was lovely.  The staff were very friendly and clearly love working there.  Great recommendations!

reviews.text:
This was our first time visiting. Most likely will be our last. There is nothing super special that would cause me to come back. If I was staying at the hotel definitely a good place to eat.
The service was great. The food was mediocre. Although I did see the seafood Tower at the table next to me and it looked delicious! So someone to try that.

reviews.text: Everything was great! Food, cocktails, ambience and service  were all wonderful. Marcus our server who was also the bartender makes a great cosmo!! Also, we were able to have a conversation without shouting. The lemon spaghetti was amazing!!

reviews.text:
Outstanding service, the staff was wonderful. Absolutely disappointed in the food. The pizza was decent, and everything else missed the mark. Even the Lemon Spaghetti (which I love in Vegas) was awful.
If it wasn’t for the staff, good cocktails and a fairly decent Antipasto appetizer the whole evening would have been a bust. At a $500 price point for dinner it’s unacceptable.
