reviews.text: Was very good, the ribeye was incredible and the lemon pasta was a flavor explosion.
reviews.author: Cody

reviews.text: It took our breath away! We were treated like royals.. FAMILY!! We can’t wait to go back!!! Giada’s spirit and flare is reflected everywhere and in every kind and thoughtful staff she has… WONDERFUL is not enough to describe our experience!
reviews.author: MaryAnn

reviews.text:
Luna by Giada in Scottsdale is an absolute delight. From the moment you step in, the space feels warm and sophisticated, with just the right touch of modern Italian charm.

The pasta? Spot on. Each dish is cooked to perfection, with flavors that taste both fresh and authentic. Whether you go for the classic spaghetti or something more adventurous, you really can’t go wrong.

The wine list is outstanding—plenty of options, and the staff knows their stuff. They’re more than happy to help you find the perfect glass to complement your meal, without being pushy.

As for the service, it’s everything you’d hope for: attentive, friendly, and always professional. You can tell the team takes pride in making sure guests have a great experience.

Overall, Luna by Giada hits all the right notes. If you’re looking for delicious Italian food in Scottsdale, this is the place to go.
reviews.author: Heavenly

reviews.text: Lemon pizza was delicious!  Cocktails were crisp and refreshing!
reviews.author: CarolM

reviews.text: This is a very over-rated restaurant.  Our entrees were disappointing and the choices were rather minimal
reviews.author: Gayle

reviews.text: Loved the lemon spaghetti with shrimp, the fritto misto and Mediterranean branzino.  Service and ambience were great!
reviews.author: Shanda

reviews.text:
The flavors of each dish was out of this world!
I loved the unique little twists in each serving, the balsamic pearls are burst of flavor and look interesting on the plate, the basil infused oil under mashed potato’s with steak.. hmhmhmhmh ! We had a “real” Italian dinner : with appetizers followed by pasta (lemon white sauce was superb)  and main course.. salmon was done to perfection-so soft inside like from sous vide  it outside very thin layer had a crunch (!) how is that possible!? Our filet minion couldn’t disappoint the most picky critics..
Perfection !

I can’t wait for better weather so they can open the glass doors … the space is a bit noisy but.. the staff moved us to different table! Amazing!
reviews.author: Agnieszka

reviews.text: Below average. Hard to have a conversation because the stay kept interrupting to ask if everything was ok. Hostess stand was not friendly at all. Food was average. Restaurant/hotel is in the parking lot in front of Macys at the mall. Zero atmosphere outside and inside is ok. I will not go back - not sure what all the hype is about.
reviews.author: Deb

reviews.text: The food and service was amazing!!! The seafood tower was good but the steak for 2 with the ravioli and caccio Pepe was incredible. Cooked perfectly.
reviews.author: Lainey

reviews.text: Food and service were amazing. Our server, Shereese, had an in depth understanding of the menu and was able to help guide us to amazing selections. Not a fan of the last minute introduction of the surprise "venue admin service fee" aka credit card surcharge that is not listed anywhere before getting the check. At the prices charged, it's a petty, nickle and dime irritant that tarnishes and otherwise amazing experience.
reviews.author: Lyndon

reviews.text: The food preparation was outstanding and the flavors were incredible. The service was impeccable and very kind. We love this restaurant a perfect place for a superior dining experience. ￼
reviews.author: Douglas

reviews.text:
I was even more pleasantly surprised than I expected by the cuisine and experience at Luna. The food was delicious. The servers were efficient and friendly and we truly had no complaints throughout our experience. 
The servers were accurate in letting us know which were the most popular dishes and we tried those such as the lemon pasta entree and crab arancini appetizer. Those were standouts. 
Beyond that I felt like I could sense the bubbly nature of Giada herself in the menu and the ingredients. The ingredients were just as peppy as she is. She has taken simple dishes and added a bit of zest to them. 
We will happily return!
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text:
Was very excited to finally try Luna by Giada,
We took our friends for a special treat and we all enjoyed our meals very much!!!
Our waiter Basil was excellent as was the additional staff.
The only thing I would recommend is getting the hostess additional help to get guests seated as it took too long .
The hostess was very nice but, overwhelmed.
reviews.author: Joan

reviews.text: Food and service were very good! The restaurant is beautiful too!
reviews.author: Vicki

reviews.text: This was my second time and it was just as good if not better! Everything is top notch. The menu has something for every appetite and do not miss out on the pizza.🍕
reviews.author: Jarrod

reviews.text: Enjoyed our dinner at Luna. We have been to Giada in Las Vegas several times and were happy to try this restaurant while in town.
reviews.author: James

reviews.text: Another amazing experience at Luna… your 5th time here and never disappoints. Food and service is always outstanding!
reviews.author: Jeffrey

reviews.text: This was our 5th time coming to Luna.  We absolutely love this restaurant and are quickly becoming regulars here. This time we were well taken care of by a combination of Kenneth, Kendall and Lynette, as well as the managers, Paul and Kenny, who checked in on us.  We have never had a bad meal here (not even a bad dish). Besides the unique dishes that Luna has (like the fabulous lemon spaghetti and lemon pizza), what really makes Luna special is the way they elevate dishes you can get at most Italian restaurants. The fritto misto, caesar salad and caprese salad are just heads and tails above those at other restaurants (my favorite Fritto Misto in town). Food comes out quickly, but we don't feel rushed, and portions are huge (we always end up with leftovers to take home).  Keep up the excellent job everybody!
reviews.author: Mitch

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant! Got very loud as it filled up. Food good- not exceptional for the price. Felt rushed with how fast food came out. We had our entrees before our bottle of wine. Overall a fun place but a tad pricey.
reviews.author: Tracy

reviews.text: We spoke so much about this restaurant that we brought our friends to experience what we so enjoyed and it did not disappoint!   Thank you to the wonderful staff and management!
reviews.author: Deanna

reviews.text: Incredible service by Ken and an excellent meal we had the Bistecca for two and the vodka sauce. You absolutely have to get the lemon pizza with the arugula salad to put on top. It’s an amazing pairing and the lemon potatoes will blow your mind. We had lemon berry soufflé and biscotti with cappuccinos for dessert fantastic wine list incredible experience all around.
reviews.author: Wendy

reviews.text: Food is pretty good. Service is adequate. It's LOUD. It is not a place to have a conversation.
reviews.author: Zaheer

reviews.text: We loved the place, the food was delicious and the service was excellent.
reviews.author: Ian

reviews.text: Our server Gilbert was excellent.  Had a bit of a snafu as we arrived 15 minutes early for our reservation.  The hostess suggested we wait at the bar because our table was being cleaned but after 30 minutes I had to find her to ask if it was ready. She said they sent me a text but I didn’t see it.  We were 20 feet away so I expected she would have come got us.  Not a big deal but was less than ideal.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
This was our second visit to Luna’s. It was my Birthday so we stayed in the hotel and got a taste of all 3 of Giada’s restaurants.
The dinner last night in Luna was exceptional with Amanda as our server. Brandi did stop by and say hello which is always a treat.
The Scallop and Risotto dish was a perfect 10.
And the Lemon pizza was a a home run again.
The Lemon soufflé for dessert was amazing.
Another stellar dining experience.

Thank you for making a memorable Birthday for me.

Dawn and Mark
Scottsdale
reviews.author: DawnP

reviews.text:
My first visit to Luna was with family. The service was nice, but our drink orders had a few hiccups. My son's drink was forgotten during the first drink order and my father's coffee was overlooked during the dessert order. The waiter was accommodating with recommendations. The whole family agreed the Fritto Misto was the best! I ordered the Risotto and it was cooked correctly but very rich. 

A thing to note, as I did not see a disclaimer when making our dinner reservation; there is a fee just to be in the restaurant. Oddly, the fee for our visit was called an "Entry Fee" which cost around $13. However, when my sister and her husband dinned at Luna the week prior the fee they incurred was a "Resort Fee" of $30.  Given the restaurant has been open for 6 months now I hope the inconsistencies will be remedied quickly.
reviews.author: Shelly

reviews.text: Patricia and her assistants were amazing and definitely made our night. The food was very good also.

reviews.text: The food was nice but exceptionally pricey for what it was . Compared to other fine dining Italian experiences , it was too overpriced. The ambience was very hotel feeling and thought it would have been more Italian feel to it. Very disappointed and I never give bad reviews but felt people need to know that Gaida’s personality is not reflected in any way in this restaurant.
reviews.author: Monica

reviews.text:
What a great dining experience! The food and service were both great!

They have some very nice wines to choose from, both Italian and American.
The restaurant is beautiful as well.
Will definitely go back!

reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.text: Food was amazing! Our server Sharice was AMAZING! She was so sweet and attentive and helpful! She was one of the best servers we have ever had anywhere - she is an absolute gem!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our first time at this fairly new offering in Scottsdale. I live in LA so we have our fair share of truly find dining options. Phx and Scottsdale don't always live up to the quality we would like to see. But Luna did!  The space is beautiful. The staff was incredibly attentive and kind throughout our evening. Our waiter was excellent. Cordial, kind, and made us feel like special guests. Management also checked in with us more than once to see if everything was to our satisfaction. The food was excellent. The drinks were also. And the martini cocktails are served in the most beautiful glasses. It was also nice that they have separate dining spaces which are both lovely but one is quieter than the other so it is better for groups wishing to hear each other talk. Many restaurants now are so loud you can't have a conversation. This was an overall great experience.

reviews.text: This was our first visit to Luna and we were both completely satisfied. The staff was outstanding!!! Our waitress was great at clearly explaining the menu and the specials. reviews.text: Excellent dinner. They were late seating us by 20 minutes but other than that everything was perfect!

The crab arancini appetizer and the Caesar salad was flavorful and plentiful. I had the lemon spaghetti, her signature dish, and it was outstanding! My wife enjoyed her salmon. Drinks were expensive but made to perfection.
reviews.author: CWFdining

reviews.text: Outstanding food and service. Menu is not robust but everything that's on it is very good. Lemon pasta is a must, spicy sausage pizza was crazy good and the focaccia bread is the best I've ever had. Our waitress was Sherrece...she was fantastic.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Wonderful dinner. Service was outstanding. Thank you Jay and Paul (manager)

reviews.text:
Kenneth was outstanding- wonderful food!

Thank you for all the attention to details!
reviews.author: Kathy

reviews.text: Luna is a beautiful restaurant with excellent food selection. Everything we had was perfection! Sherese was our server and very knowledgeable about the menu. Customer service is top notch.
reviews.author: VanessaF

reviews.text: We were so excited to finally get a reservation here. That being said, WAY over priced for what you get. They also add on a 3.5% ad min fee. Service was great, but $190 for two bowls of pasta and 2 glasses of wine is ridiculous. Food was good.
reviews.author: Elizabeth

reviews.text: We loved celebrating at Luna! Such a beautiful restaurant and Giada always serves the best food!
reviews.author: Alyssa

reviews.text: Excellent tasting food made even better by our excellent service. Best service we've had in many a moon!
reviews.author: Ron

reviews.text: I took my husband for his birthday at Luna by Giada,everything was great, the food was delicious and our waitress Gilbert was awesome he made my husband’s birthday special thank you Gilbert.
reviews.author: Gladys

reviews.text: We’ve been to Luna 3 times. Sure it’s a bit pricey but it’s worth it. Will definitely be back. Kudos to our Server, Tucker.
reviews.author: LarryM

reviews.text: This restaurant did not really impress us nor meet our expectations considering the high prices and area. The service and food were just okay, but again not nearly worth what was paid. We dined on a Wednesday evening so it was quite noisy for a week-day evening.
reviews.author: Whitney

reviews.text: We shared a few plates and everything was excellent!  Enjoyable evening!
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.text: Personally, we did not care for the food. The flavors felt off to us. To each their own.
reviews.author: Lacey

reviews.text: Excellent quality and flavor of food! The service was outstanding! We were able to order vegetarian items for the people in our group. The pasta dishes are hearty and the margherita pizza was amazing.  You will enjoy the dining experience at Luna by Giada!
reviews.author: Parag

reviews.text: Good food and good service, definitely not outstanding, but good.
reviews.author: Cory

reviews.text:
An unexpected experience at Luna which I wish would have been better. This self proclaimed high energy and sophisticated location tonight fell short of its description. The menu has an array of Roman inspired fine Italian dishes which I was eager to try. To begin, service from the staff was lacking for such a premier location. When we placed the order we expected to get the starter first, which never came. To our surprise however our main dishes came quite quick, I had to decline the starter from coming later (timing is everything in service).
We ordered the chefs special bone in ribeye and the lobster bucatini. Both dishes were well prepared and temperature (which I tend to critique the most) were perfect. The pasta and the sauce had a unique flavor with a bit of a spice to it but the lobster that accompanied required a bit more of attention. The ribeye was a good steak but not note worthy, expected more from the lemon potatoes. While my desire to have rated this visit greater was diminished by a visible lack of attention to service, the atmosphere and newly opened hotel were a missing piece to the area.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food was so very delicious! The Gluten free noodle option was much appreciated and tasted just like a “normal” pasta. We’ll be back!
reviews.author: Betsy

reviews.text: Un lugar excepcional, la comida, las bebidas y los postres de 1er nivel. Una experiencia culinaria de primera. Volvería muchas veces
reviews.author: JAVIER

reviews.text: Very loud, food is good, service was great, but it’s just too loud
reviews.author: Francis

reviews.text: Luna was everything we wanted it to be. The food was fantastic from starters to dessert and the service was first class. Our server Shereese was extremely helpful in guiding us through the menu and her recommendations were perfection. She recognized that we were out for a special evening with my 90 year old grandmother and made sure to deliver the full experience. We will be back to Luna very soon.
reviews.author: Lindsey

reviews.text: First off. It’s a great atmosphere and despite other reviews it wasn’t that noisy.  The staff was amazing. Our waiter Jay and his assistant Viktor really made an okay meal into a great night.  The appetizers were delicious and so was the desert. The main course(I had the Lemon spaghetti and the wife had the scallop risotto) They were okay just lacked seasoning.  Like salt.  Ya know, the basics.   But the corn sausage for a side was awesome!!   It wasn’t a bad experience by any means but I’m not sure we will return.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Firstly, ambiance is excellent. Cool vibe, modern hotel with amazing views of Camelback Mountain, sunsets, etc... 7th floor viewing can't be beat elsewhere. Next... the customer service, wait staff, bartenders etc... all were very kind and courteous.   Sadly... thats were the 5 stars end and 1 star begins. The food is nothing to look forward to or return for.  Celebrity chef Giada would  or should be embarrassed to be serving poor dishes like this...    Her Signature dishes, pastas, etc.. had no flavor at all. Lemony, creamy pasta (supposed her famous signature dish) had zero flavor and boring...  pork chop as a deep fried greasy mess over oily prosciutto, topped with parmesan shavings with a little side cup of sauce to dip into...I guess?    Waiter described it wonderfully except forgot the part about it was a FRIED, breaded pork chop?  aside from that...... it was greasy, overcooked and very bland...    We had a appetizer and 2 sides as well that aren't worth even mentioning because I almost forgot them already.  Smashed crisp potatoes that weren't smashed and creamy corn /sausage in a little cup that was just ok...  Everything is very expensive ...especially for this low level quality of food.  For these prices... then need to  really up their game the food quality.  I have zero problem paying for this level of expected food and fun... but I have a big problem when its this poor.  Drinks were good, but i'm a simple Tito on the rocks guy... but $22 a cocktail is a bit crazy nonetheless.  

I was hoping the food would match and/or surpass the service, views and decor.. but it was a huge disappointment of which I don't plan to be returning back to again.
reviews.author: Glenn

reviews.text: I took my brother here for his 70th Birthday. The manager came to our table and welcomed us, that was a very nice touch. The staff was amazing and paid so much attention to detail! Our server Melanie, is one of the best waitress's I have had anywhere. She could easily work at Dominick's or the Monarch. I think many of the staff member could. Managements must treat them right for them to be so professional. The food was good. My brother said the bread was the best he ever had. The oysters were small but fresh and tasty. The salads where unique and fresh and quite good, but do not closely resemble Caesar or Caprese. I think the one called Caprese, my brother had, may have been better than a traditional caprese salad. My salad was not a Caesar salad, they should call it something else IMHO, but it was exactly as Melanie described to me, so I was not surprised nor disappointed when I got it. Light Lemon dressing was refreshing for the summer. For my cocktail I had the "LA STRADA" Stoli Cucumber Vodka, Belle de Brillet, Re'al Kiwi puree, Lemon Juice & Club Soda. My brother has 2 Mocktails of it. It was delicious and refreshing. Perfect for summer. When it came time for dessert, I explained to Melody I wanted a desert as well, and my brother does not share his food (not kidding) so she brought me a birthday dessert as well. Wow! I never expected that! LOL! Melanie ROCKS!!! The entire staff does. We sat in the Jade room because we a bit older and needed a quiet place to hear each other's conversation. By the time the restaurant was full, we could no longer hear each other at all unfortunately. But it was very good, I had the Lemon Spaghetti with scallops instead of Shrimp. The scallops were a bit underdone, a bit translucent in the middle, but I did not mention it. I'll fix it when I make the left overs. My brother's rare ribeye was excellent he said, and he raved about the corn and sausage side dish. The gelato and cookie dessert were heaven! Thank you, Melanie and staff,
reviews.author: Shannon

reviews.text: The restaurant was very nice. Meals were somewhat reasonable. Appetizers were expensive for the size portion. The drinks were absolutely expensive. $25 for a drink is a little ridiculous.  I would have been fine if we had an out of this world experience, but our waitress barely came back to the table and we had to constantly flag someone down just to get water which we didn’t get very much of.  We waited three months for the reservation and I was definitely disappointed.
reviews.author: Mickey

reviews.text: Apparently waiters have too many tables and the noise level made it very hard to hear, seafood tower was expensive and very tough to chew, not enough red cocktail sauce to serve all and no one checked back to get more. We were a party of 8. Maybe our expectations were too high, we were disappointed.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great food and extremely nice and knowledgeable staff. This was my 3rd time in but I brought in two new work friends so they can share in the experience.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food was good but the price was double of what it should have been.  $44 for risotto with two scallops was ridiculous. Won’t be going back as the food was good but not great.  Service was great and the design and ambiance of the restaurant was nice. For the food quality, there are many other options in Scottsdale with the same or better quality for a lower price.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The server and bus staff were very attentive. Excellent job!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Not only was the food amazing, but our server Gilbert was fantastic. My new favorite restaurant in Scottsdale for sure!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great food.  Very noisy, hard to have a conversation.
reviews.author: PattyJ

reviews.text:
We totally enjoyed our evening as you can tell with my response to your questions above!!! Also, we want to let you know that your server, Landiss
was outstanding! He was warm and extremely knowledgeable and professional without being stuffy and animated! My father was with me along with our friends and Landiss made the evening very special for him! I am bringing my nephew and his wife next Thursday, August 1st,  to celebrate both of their birthdays just because we enjoy your restaurant so much!!!!!

Thank you, Marcie Saban
reviews.author: MarcieS

reviews.text: Amanda was one of the best servers we've ever had. Very knowledgeable, descriptive, and friendly. My rissoto was a little runny but overall the dish was great with scallops and crab. My wife loved the lemon spaghetti.
reviews.author: Mesafoodie

reviews.text: First time at Luna and we had a good time. The food was excellent and the service was impeccable. The restaurant and look or the hotel are high class. Cost is not worth it. $14 for focaccia and sides are a bit over priced. Then the 3.5% charge just to be in the hotel is outrageous. spending 250.00 for a meal for two then getting a charge for eating there???
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: There were good parts about this place, the open kitchen, separate party room, wine wall, the bar area were all super cool. We started with the bread, arancini and oysters, they were all delicious. The signature lemon pasta was very bland, sadly.  We sent back the dish that was like ravioli in broth with veal inside, the texture was off. However, the Noni and the scallop risotto were both delicious. Our server was attentive and helpful. After we returned our dish the manager came over immediately, he asked to replace the item, which they did very quickly. He also sent out a beautiful selection of desserts as we were celebrating a birthday to make up for the food we disliked. The over all decorative feel was quite plain really not what I was expecting from a Giada restaurant. It seemed kind of cold and very plain. The restaurant was extremely loud, so if you’re going for a quiet romantic dinner, Luna isn’t the spot. Overall 3 Stars, I’m really sad to say. I’d been anticipating this place for my birthday for some months. We’ll definitely do happy hour for appetizers or dessert, you must try brownie cheesecake and limoncello cookies!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Absolutely loved the service and food!!
Highly attentive & gracious staff! Food was outstanding—bit expensive and was a bit surprised but generous portions.
Only disappointment was the noise level. We were off to the perimeter with a 4 top table, near a window, beautiful atmosphere, arrived at 6pm…Got very loud as tables filled up. Hard to talk without noticing noise level. Disappointing and distracting. Only reason to be discouraged to return.
reviews.author: CatherineT

reviews.text: Beautiful place and the service was good, but too loud.
reviews.author: BeverlySteve

reviews.text: We went to Promo to celebrate 4 birthdays. We have been to Giada’s restaurant in Vegas and we’re so excited to try her new restaurant in Scottsdale. Everything was average at best. Our pork chop was undercooked. We ordered 2 lemon soufflés and they both came out very undercooked. The manager came out and said they would remake them. Again, they came out looking and tasting like liquid egg whites. The chef came out and asked what was wrong. We poured out the liquid from the cup it came in and explained that the lemon soufflé at Giada’s in Vegas was so good and our reason for coming. He apologized and took them off the bill. Just a very disappointing experience.
reviews.author: JandD

reviews.text:
Worst ever!  Giada should stay in Las Vegas!
Such a talented chef- truly disappointed.
reviews.author: John

reviews.text: Appetizers were great, main course is less than to be expected. Wine options were poor
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Nice decor, limited menu and high prices. Very high noise level. Easy parking but weird location in the parking lot of a mall.
reviews.author: JLFD

reviews.text: Bad wine list with no Italian wine, $42 dollar pasta with two shrimp and cream sauce that could have come from Olive Garden. Ok for tourists but otherwise stay home. Disappointing after an incredible meal at her Las Vegas restaurant.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Beautiful place but overpriced, food was just OK,

reviews.text: We had a great experience. Our server, Gilbert was amazing. He was fun and a delight to chat with. He also had great recommendations for our dinner choices. The food all tasted delicious. We loved the lemon pizza and lemon spaghetti. Brava!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Excellent service and food!!!  We will definitely be back!

reviews.text: The service was outstanding as well as every single item we ordered. Starting with the focaccia bread.the sausage pizza then the lemon pasta branzino fish and the scallop risotto was true perfection!!! Beverages were all outstanding and the ambiance and noise level we could actually visit with our guests!!!

reviews.text: Staff from hostess, to waitress & managers were extremely professional! Food was not overhyped, Giada’s cooking is everything you watch on tv! Try blueberry soufflé  desert, it’s phenomenal!￼
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I love Giada but the restaurant was just ok. Small space, very noisy and what’s with the long red pepper grinders?
reviews.author: kristin

reviews.text: My husband and I were excited to try this new restaurant in the Valley. We made a reservation but realized we wanted to make it earlier for our movie and it was easy to change the time. The hostesses were kind and sat us right away. We enjoyed a few cocktails and split a Cesar salad that was delicious. My husband then had a steak which he said was a little too over-seasoned for his liking and was disappointed that the potatoes weren’t mashed but more of a fingerling potato. Overall he was not impressed. I asked the waitress if the lobster bucatini could made into a single portion (as it is listed for 2 on the menu) she agreed she could do that and it was no problem. Unfortunately when it was served it was for 2 portions and the price was not reduced. She said “we can box up your leftovers” which was not the point of me ordering the dish. We were going to a movie and I did not want leftovers. It’s disappointing that they were not able to accommodate someone wanting a smaller portion to try the dish while their partner wanted something else for their entree. Overall it’s not something to rave about or try again. We likely won’t be back based on the food alone and not at the prices of $92 for pasta.
reviews.author: EliseSchnack

reviews.text: Simple elevated menu. Lots of thought and detail went into each item We ate the lemon pasta bone in ribeye bacon wrapped dates caprese salad (with balsemic vinegar pearls 😋) and souffle with blueberry sauce. All were spot on! Our team of  Brody and Sherese we so attentive and kept the meal moving along nicely with great conversation throughout 👌 Cant wait to come back!

reviews.text:
FOOD AND SERVICE WERE EXCELLENT. 
IT IS VERY LOUD AND HARD TO TALK, BUT
THE FOOD AND SERVICE EXCEEDED EXPECTIONS.

reviews.text: Would be nice if we were comped desert for our 48th anniversary but we did not

reviews.text: Amazing attentive service for my birthday dinner! Loved all the food especially the mushroom rigatoni.

reviews.text: It was amazing. A little on the pricey side. But still good food.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Fantastic!  Everything was just perfect!  The food and service were outstanding.  We really enjoyed the Arancini and the focaccia as our appetizers.  But the entrees were just to die for - the signature lemon spaghetti, the porcini mushroom Bolognese, and the agnolotti were exceptional.  Just a wonderful evening in a great place ,we will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Blazesfolks

reviews.text: The Lemon dessert was insane and make me want to go back!
reviews.author: Nicki

reviews.text: Amazing location, great food, very personable server, and incredible food! My one hang up was the acoustics — it’s SO loud in here, and it shouldn’t be! The four of us just sat there awkwardly at a few points of the night while nearby tables roared in laughter at their own conversations and just completely drowned us out. This is a tough place to come to with anyone that you want to try to converse with during dinner.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We absolutely love this restaurant!!  We have dined here twice and plan on making this one of our regular spots.  Everything we have eaten here has been fantastic! We have had the citrus caesar salad, caprese salad, crab arancini, lemon spaghetti, mezzi rigatoni, lemon pizza, limoncello souffle and cookie plate. We want to keep coming back to try more dishes, but at the same time are conflicted about whether to pass on all the ones we loved so far.  While a restaurant of this high quality can be a little pricey, the portions are pretty good sized, so you can split them if you want to get more value (or take the leftovers home). Service has been excellent! Last time, Ken was our server and did an awesome job!  Even though we were mostly full, he convinced us to try the limoncello souffle for dessert.  It was to die for and I'm so glad we listened to him.  The manager does a great job checking in on everyone and even remembered us from the first time we were there.  As far as drinks, we've enjoyed the Riso Amaro and the Vecchio Amico.  We can't wait to come back this weekend!!!
reviews.author: PhylisP

reviews.text: Our server was amazingly knowledgeable of the menu and the vision behind the restaurant.  We were very satisfied.
reviews.author: Jarrod

reviews.text: Drinks are amazing and the wine selection is great.  Food was great!  I will go back again for Lemon pizza the signature pasta dish. Noise level is way too high to talk during dinner time.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We were disappointed in our experience here. We made our reservation several weeks in advance but when we arrived we were taken to a very wobbly table in the very back corner. It was also near an area for the servers to put in orders, talk, and have plates/silverware. It was very noisy and my chair was right up against this and would continuously be bumped, along with the servers running around and me feeling like people were going to run into me. We also felt very rushed to order our drinks and food. I had to ask for my second glass of wine and by the time it arrived I had already finished eating.The food was average and pricey. We may not have minded paying so much for a simple bowl of pasta and dry chicken(that cost extra) if the overall experience had been better but it ultimately put a damper on our anniversary celebration.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The service was top notch and food was outstanding! Chef Logue was amazing-the lemon spaghetti was excellent along with Arancini. Would highly recommend it. The Focaccia-is a must! Can hardly wait to go back!!

reviews.text: The waitress had to be reminded to fill out waters numerous times but the food and ambiance were amazing!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great positive reviews include that seating were spaced out well, the service was great, and we loved the servers. The food was excellent as always.

reviews.text:
No options for pasta for person with dairy allergy. Was really looking forward to trying some.
Very expensive and added 3.5 percent to all checks.

reviews.text: The husband and I decided to try Giada’s restaurant for our wedding anniversary dinner and it did not disappoint. I have been a huge fan of Giada since the Food Network days and I am so excited that she has a restaurant here in the Phoenix area! My husband had the lemon pizza which was absolutely phenomenal and I had the lemon spaghetti with shrimp that was to die for. ￼

reviews.text: The food and service were excellent as I expected based on previous visits to Giada’s restaurant in Las Vegas. Unfortunately I won’t be returning due to the noise level. It was impossible to have a conversation, and I really didn’t enjoy the experience. It didn’t help that there was a table near us with screaming children, but I think the noise would have been too much without them.

reviews.text: Food and service was excellent. Desserts were a little disappointing.

reviews.text: Food and service was excellent.  Very professional.

reviews.text: We asked if they gave Veterans discount. Just wondering thats all so the waitress asked the manager if they did. The manager was cold and just said no thats all. Everything was going great up until then all he had to say was I’m sorry no we don’t, but he was unfriendly. Sorry.  Everything else was great
