reviews.text: Muy bonito restaurante, nuevo y comida todo muy bien
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Others than it being kind of hard to hear we had a lovely meal and wonderful service! Would definitely go back again.
reviews.author: mommiestone

reviews.text: Everyone raved about the lobster bucatini. The Sangiovese wine recommendation was excellent; everyone enjoyed it. Our servers were polite and helpful, not pushy. Thanks for a great evening.
reviews.author: JohnD

reviews.text:
Our first view of Luna was beautiful. The color palette is soft and inviting. The noise level is high and hard for someone with a hearing impairment to hear conversations. We sat at the bar and waited almost 10 minutes before anyone ever spoke to us. I asked if we could please order and was told "just give me a minute". After another five minutes the manager arrived. I asked him if we could order and of course, we were immediately helped. Our other guests arrived, and same thing. After almost ten minutes, I had to ask to please order drinks for them. Again, it was almost five minutes before their order was taken.

When our table was ready (15 minutes past our reservation time), we were escorted by a lovely lady who walked at an appropriate pace. The table was set nicely with all items needed. Our waiter, Kenny, was AMAZING!! He is truly what made our time at Luna the best. He was attentive, knowledgeable, and efficient in all aspects of his service. The Foccacia was wonderful. Arancini was mistakingly delivered to our table, but we got to enjoy it as opposed to Luna having to throw them away. The lemon pizza was bright in flavor, but the crust was very limp, and the cheese slid off easily. The pasta dishes were rich in flavor, but dish of the pasta was overcooked and soggy. The lobster was cooked nicely. The Risotto was flavorful and the scalloped cooked to perfection. We did not have dessert as we were too full from our meal.
reviews.author: OSUTheta

reviews.text:
The Caesar salad full of dressing and croutons. Could not even taste the lettuce.
A server walked past our table swing a ponytail with hair flying everywhere, at least five times.
reviews.author: Patticakes

reviews.text: This is the first time we ate here, we are pleasantly surprised. Food was amazing. started off with the citrus Cesar salad, lemon spaghetti and Branzino . We had the limoncello souffle which was delicious and not too sweet.Jay our server was very attentive and his crew was on top of everything. Definitely would recommend this place for a nice dating spot and this will be on our list of our favorite spots to eat..
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I was expecting to be blown away with the food and beverages but everything was just good. Not great. My beverage was strong but almost tasteless and definitely overpriced. The focaccia and arancini starters were great. The lemon pizza was good but I was disappointed in the Caesar. Tasted a bit like a bagged Caesar from the store where the dressing is too heavy and anchovy forward, not lightly dressed. I felt the leaves were drenched and too powerful. Our server was lovely and the ambiance was nice.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
It’s a pretty place. The acoustics weren’t great and despite not being particularly crowded in a week night, it seemed loud. The staff greeted us 3x, and there appeared to be some confusion over whose table we were.

Our waiter was fun, and kindly brought me a taste of the pasta sauce I was interested in so I could try it and determine the spice level. Very smart of him

Drinks tho pricey were good - yes you’re at a resort - so be prepared

We shared a very generous portion of the Caesar salad. The romaine was crisp, the fried capers ere salty and crunchy and the dressing flavorful

We were however disappointed in the lobster bucatini for two.   For $97 there was plenty of pasta and sauce, which made for great leftovers but the smallish HALF a lobster was in my opinion ridiculous in size - or lack of.

Sorry but knowing the cost of pasta, and sauce, even expertly prepared, I was disappointed when it arrived to find so little lobster on the tray

I’d go back but I’ll try something like the pizza instead
reviews.author: Nancyz

reviews.text: FABULOUS! We started with cocktails at the bar--my cocktail was served in a beautiful martini glass and was so yummy (think bellini in flavor) and I wish I could remember the name--perhaps morning in Venice? At our table, we selected 2 starters with recommendations from our excellent server, Lynette.  The Sicilian Focaccia is the lightest and tastiest focaccia I've ever had!  It is served with 3 dipping sauces, a homemade lemon mascarpone, pesto, and thinking the third was a balsamic and oil--all were delicious!  We also enjoyed the Fritto Misto, a combination of breaded shrimp, calamari, Calabrian peppers, and lemon aioli--so good! Moving to our next course we had the risotto with scallops, crab, and asparagus--risotto was perfectly prepared and the presentation was beautiful.  Note this is a heavier dish, and quite rich.  We decided to try the lemon pizza which sounded a bit unusual to us--great decision!  One of the best pizzas I have ever had and not too lemony for those who don't prefer a heavy lemon flavor.  Although we were more than full, who can resist dessert?  Our choice was the Limoncello Souffle.  It was SO light and fluffy which was perfect since we were not overly hungry at this point. The presentation again is lovely, and they pour a special blueberry sauce in the middle tableside which is fun.  There is ample sauce to enjoy more on your plate alongside the 2 biscotti cookies accompanying the dessert.  They were a perfect ending, tasting more like shortbread to me and much softer than biscotti which was a good match.  We interacted with different servers throughout the evening who were all knowledgeable and engaging.  They offer seating in three locations--outdoor patio, Luna Room, and Jade Room. I believe we were in the Luna Room which was fun because we could see into the kitchen.  We waited 3 months for this reservation since the grand opening and it was worth the wait!  We cannot wait to go back!
reviews.author: SallyA

reviews.text: Love love the pasta specifically the vodka sauce! It was excellent. Also ordered chicken panzella. It was disappointing but honestly her specialty is pasta so I don’t know what I was thinking! The focaccia bread is out of this world! Will definitely be returning!
reviews.author: Bethbeau

reviews.text: This was my first time here. I’ve been to her restaurant in Vegas and loved it. Wonderful restaurant. The service was incredible. Our server Gilbert was so knowledgeable and the perfect amount of attention. Pretty expensive but worth it. He was so knowledgeable about the wine options and guided our experience! We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: What a great restaurant.  Excellent food, service was courteous and friendly, and a great ambiance too!  Will definitely go back.
reviews.author: Luv2Eat

reviews.text: We had an amazing dinner at Luna.  The ambiance was great, although slightly loud for deep conversations, and the service was impeccable.  Everyone enjoyed their meal!  Luna did not disappoint.
reviews.author: ShellyL

reviews.text:
Food is great - service is that of a mid range restaurant.  I would say up your game .
.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Our second visit was even better than the first, better idea of menu items. 
This visit was for my wife's Birthday. Shereese treated us well and was very professional and attentive. The food was perfect and very well prepared and spiced appropriately. Super delicious. 

Very nice modern decor.

We will be back soon.
reviews.author: John500

reviews.text: Great service, great interior design. Will be back
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Was there at opening 5pm service was very slow food portion small the 3.5% add on was a waste of my time the four of us would not go back there ..
reviews.author: RuarkM

reviews.text: For a first date spot this place was marvelous! thank you so much for an awesome experience and making it a memorable night for me and my lady! you guys are phenomenal people and hospitality was was amazing
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food was delicious and courses spread out in a timely manner. Our server was exceptional shout out to Brandi she made our experience extra special. You can be sure we will be back.
reviews.author: CarolL

reviews.text: Overall, 4 stars, what made our evening great was the service from Brody and Kendall. The food- meh- nothing spectacular. It’s your basic Italian dishes that you can get anywhere. The flavors were good, but not earth shattering. We would go back and ask for Brody and Kendall.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.text: The service was really not what you would expect. Generally speaking, the fine dining in Scottsdale includes 5 star service. Beginning with the first experience at the bar and ending with a very awkward attempt at service recovery Luna missed the mark. We ordered the arugula salad which paired perfectly with the lemon pizza. We ordered the carpaccio, but our server forgot to put the order in so we didn’t get to try it. After reminding her, she said it wasn’t very good anyway. We tried the lemon spaghetti, which was very good but incredibly rich. I could not finish the plate. It was a very mediocre experience.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Terrible service. Food was mid. VERY disappointed — I had high hopes for dining with “Giada”.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Amazing experience!!!! The service and the food was amazing highly recommend 🫶
reviews.author: Michelle

reviews.text: The servers were very nice and doing their job, but there were so many we felt like we didn’t have an opportunity to really sit and visit and enjoy. The food was Great
reviews.author: JudyS

reviews.text: You will find the Luna by Giada to be expensive ....... However, once you realize that you may just have experienced one of the best meals that you have ever eaten you will agree that it was well worth it.  I went in knowing that I wanted to order the Risotto with sea scallops and found it to be absolutely delicious, perfectly prepared Risotto with 2 plump and tasty sea scallops that actually filled me up.  My wife of many years ordered her favorite steak and admitted that the Petite Filet was the best steak she has ever eaten.  Great food, outstanding service (our friendly and knowledgeable waitress Melanie with 2 assistants), and Giada's influenced ambience all added up to a wonderful dining experience.  That petite filet is now on my radar for our next visit.
reviews.author: Ernie

reviews.text:
10/10 experience! The food was amazing. Beef carpaccio, caprese salad, lemon spaghetti and the cheesecake. Everything was so well done in presentation and taste.

The interior of the restaurant is classy, clean, modern and it didn’t feel like we were in Scottsdale!

Gilbert was our server and was so knowledgeable about the menu, coursed the meal out perfectly and had great recommendations.

We will definitely be back many many times being local and having this delicious spot so close by! Ask for Gilbert for your server - he is one of the best by far.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We had heard wonderful things about Luna so we decided to try it. The wine list had a good variety of wines and the focaccia bread and appetizers were large and delicious. Our friends had raved about the lemon spaghetti. They said it was lemony and very creamy so 4 of us ordered it. The presentation was beautiful but there was hardly any lemon flavor and there wasn’t any creaminess. It was quite thick and paste like. It almost seemed like the sauce had been sitting around for awhile.
We were so disappointed!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Outstanding addition to Giada's restaurants --- We always go to Giada's in Las Vegas whenever we visit - Now we have a Giada's in our hometown.  Impeccable service, spotlessly clean & tidy - food was excellent, portions appropriate and presented well.  
Exterior parking has a small roundabout close-by that's perfect for unloading/loading a guest with walker/wheelchair & for entry into the air-conditioned lobby.  Only issue was after initial access into the hotel lobby - we had a bit of a walk around to access a wheelchair/walker accessible ramp that goes from the lobby area to the restaurant seating area.
reviews.author: SandMreviews

reviews.text: We had a pleasant experience. Nothing remarkable other than the service which was impeccable.
reviews.author: Barbara

reviews.text: Our  Monday Nght Supper Club celebrated a lovely dinner at Luna! Our server was Landiss who was very attentive and personable! The food was delicious and we loved the atmosphere! We will return!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Wonderful!
The pizza was lacking but the pasta was amazing!
I would choose a different dessert than the tiramisu.
reviews.author: ClintS

reviews.text: The restaurant is so beautiful.  Our group sat at one of the large booths and it was so comfortable. The food was absolutely delicious!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
First of all Shereece is a fantastic waiter - she made our time at Luna most enjoyable.   Great personality, honest recommendations, great time management- excellent service.
Some food dishes were wonderful- others ehhhh (mushroom pasta). Loved the pizza and focaccia, also dessert was delicious :)
$22 for a glass of wine:(
Tall stem martini glasses are fun.
Pricey overall.   There are so many great places in Scottsdale not sure I’d go back.
reviews.author: KarinN

reviews.text: The food and service were exceptional.  My husband ordered the lemon spaghetti and the arugula salad.  I ordered the mezzi with the same salad.  The food was cooked to perfection.  Our server was very attentive.  The pricing is very high end so best for special occasion.
reviews.author: Cubette

reviews.text:
The food was delicious. Over priced in my opinion, but that seems to be standard nowadays. The staff was incredible, one main waiter and two assistants,  so want for nothing.
Ambience seems a little off- cavernous space, non cohesive decor. Loud. Very mixed crowd.
Not sure the vibe they’re going for but you have to really stand out to make it in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: LisaS

reviews.text: Food was outstanding and our server Sharisse was amazing!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The risotto with scallops was extremely bland and overall lacked flavor but the scallops were delicious.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Luna was overall excellent! The food was amazing and the ambiance was perfect.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Services and food were amazing! The lemon spaghetti and the focaccia bread were our favs.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Excellent experience! Everything was perfect and we enjoyed our time so much. We’ll be back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We were really excited to visit Giada's new restaurant, but overall, I was left feeling a bit underwhelmed. First, the atmosphere is beautiful - gorgeous decor, and great views into the kitchen one way, and camelback the other way. Wonderful!   The focaccia was incredible. However, someone in our party had a dairy allergy, and we felt like they weren't  prepared to deal with this. The main course presented was both expensive, and very, very underwhelming.  We've had better sauce from a jar. Presentation was basic.  It was so disappointing!   Voicing complaints to the staff - and I'm not one to complain - confirmed that others had said the same thing.  But no attempt was made to right this.  Just a "yeah, we know".  Service was also basic, and perhaps everyone is still working things out because it's new... Hopefully it improves.
But given the big name behind this restaurant, I would have thought it would have been more prepared for those with dietary restrictions.   Others in our party enjoyed their food, and the tiramisu was apparently amazing.  However, overall,  some of us were left, both literally and figuratively, with a bad taste in our mouth.
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.text: Food and service  was outstanding!  Can’t wait to go back!
reviews.author: DinerD

reviews.text: I was so happy with everything at this restaurant. It was an incredible experience from the service to the food and the ambience. It was amazing. This was our first time and we came with friends And we all said we are definitely coming back.  If you enjoy Italian food you have to go!!!
reviews.author: Judy

reviews.text: Wonderful experience! Enjoyed it. The branzino and lemon spaghetti was so delicious.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Very $$$. Lemon pasta undercooked but everything else was delicious. Only 2 bathrooms for a large facility was unsatisfactory. Had a line to the bathroom
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Everything about Luna is great except the prices.  Way over valued ...
reviews.author: ScottG

reviews.text: Good was good but service was not great.   Had a reservation but They tried to sit us in the bar area to start and then we had to wait 25 min to get a table in the dining room.  Took 20 minutes to close out drink tab at the bar.    Tried to serve us other tables orders several times.  Would think service would be better since opened several months but it wasn’t great.   The food was good though which made up for the service.  The ambiance felt like you were sitting in a Marriott breakfast dining room.  I think they could have done better with the design.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food was absolutely superb and perfectly served in courses so that it came out perfect temperature.  Melinda, our server was knowledgeable and so fun to speak with. Her recommendations were spot on!!  Everyone was so attentive and friendly!  Cannot wait to return to try more of the delicious menu!!  Well done Giada, well done!!😊￼
reviews.author: RandiJ

reviews.text: First time visit to Luna and was not disappointed! Beautiful, bright environment; welcoming team. The food & bevvies were delicious! Oysters, focaccia, delicious & generous salads, all brought in a short amt of time.  Would definitely recommend & go back!
reviews.author: Disappointing

reviews.text:
I was excited to visit Luna and anticipated an amazing experience. Unfortunately, the food didn't meet our expectations.

The restaurant is beautifully designed, with a modern and well-decorated interior. The service was outstanding, especially our server, Sheereze. She was amazing, explaining all the menu options in detail and providing exceptional service.

Some of the dishes we ordered were excellent. The bone-in ribeye was delicious, as were the shrimp and scallops. However, the lemon pasta had too much cheese, overpowering the other flavors. The branzino was good but not great. The desserts were generally good, though the soufflé tasted too eggy for my liking.

Sheereze noticed our dissatisfaction with some items and kindly removed two desserts from our bill. Thanks to her excellent service, we’ve decided to give Luna another try when they open for brunch.
.
reviews.author: GaryB

reviews.text: Excellent food and service; had the lemon pizza. Does not sound delicious, but it was. Salads were a.good size.
reviews.author: AngieF

reviews.text:
The restaurant is very modern and comfortable. Food preparation still needs some work. The signature dish- Lemon spaghetti, was mediocre. Sauce was grainy and shrimp overcooked. The scallops dish was very good. 
The carpaccio was good and went with the focaccia well. Pesto sauce was YUMMY. We had a special occasion dinner and they gave us a special dessert-this was very thoughtful!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I will be be back many times and tell my positive thoughts to everyone!!
reviews.author: MarcieS

reviews.text: Another beautiful place from Giada!  The place was immaculate and the decor was perfect for the setting in the Boutique hotel.  The staff was friendly and professional and very knowledgeable of the menu items.  Food was divine and the presentation impeccable as always.  Pricing was a bit high considering the portion sizes.  Drinks could be better priced as well.  I hope they take in the feedback and make changes as they receive them.  This place will do well or if word gets out "too pricey" for what you get may hurt them as many amazing places are near them that have been holding its high five status well.
reviews.author: LISAB

reviews.text: Nice atmosphere. Melanie, our server, was excellent. She thoroughly explained the menu as it was our first visit. Lemon spaghetti was flavorful but not memorable. Chicken pazanella was very good.
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.text:
I have dinned here three times - and each time my satisfaction decreased a little more...this will probably be my last time to Luna sadly.
Service slow...food was not hot...really hard to get an drink order in...decor-average!  wish my review was better.
reviews.author: Andykat

reviews.text: Service started out great but the restaurant started filling up and it went downhill
reviews.author: DerekS

reviews.text: The ambiance and restaurant as a whole was fantastic however as someone in the service industry our service was subpar at best. We received better from the server assistant/ busser than we did from our actual server which was a let down. We were also there to celebrate a birthday which we noted on our reservation so we expected at a restaurant as high caliber as this to do something special but all we got was a happy birthday from our server which was kind of a let down
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great location, nice restaurant and atmosphere, great service, food can be improved for the value
reviews.author: Tony

reviews.text: Our server Kendall was amazing she explained the menu to a T. All her recommendations spot on. The service was great the food was great and the atmosphere was perfect. Beautiful new restaurant and hotel.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great scene and excellent food/service. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: TM101

reviews.text: Melanie was an excellent waitress!! Very knowledgeable and sweet!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Another great dinner at Luna.  Everything was very friendly.  The food was great!  Enjoyed every thing about the dinner.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great vibe and experience! Pizza and Signature Lemon Pasta huge favorites, and even the vegetable bolognese was a hit with the meat lovers. Great service and a fabulous night out!
reviews.author: BS525

reviews.text: It was our third time there the food and service was great as always.  Wine selection could be much better.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food and service were good but everything is significantly overpriced. Could have got more for less at steak 44…
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: This was one of the best meals we have ever had. The food and service were outstanding. It was clear everyone at the restaurant takes pride in what they do. We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Excellent dinner and service! Definitely will be back! ❤️
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Reservations were for 8:15. We got seated close to 9. Otherwise all was lovely!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Brody was AWESOME!!! Jay was a great sever and his recommendations were spot on!! We will be back!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Everything was great, including our server, Tony.
reviews.author: KariR

reviews.text: Excellent service & food! Unfortunately a bit noisy & hard to hear the group at our table, acoustics needs some work.
reviews.author: luv2eat

reviews.text: Absolutely terrific food and great service! Best restaurant I’ve been to in a while.
reviews.author: SaraG

reviews.text:
Went for our second time and brought another couple to celebrate our anniversary. The food we ordered is some of the best food you can have in the restaurant world, the citrus caesar, the salmon, the corn and sausage side, etc.

We did have a service issue where the other couples main entree somehow got lost in the shuffle and was late and then was wrong and late again and finally delivered. At that point, first the manager and then the GM of the Hotel came over, sat down to discuss the evening with us and made it all right.

We look forward to going back and appreciate how customer focused they were given the mix up on one of the entries. Truly can't wait to have the salmon again, wish I could cook like that!
reviews.author: Bobbo

reviews.text: The food was good. Service was very good. The noise level was not good. We had to literally shout at each other to be heard. Mouse was louder than the music.  Too bad because it's a beautiful place.
reviews.author: Funfan8

reviews.text: We enjoyed our experience at Luna by Giada. The service was outstanding. The food is good.  We had the arancini appetizer, signature lemon spaghetti, margherita pizza, and mascarpone brownie cheesecake for dessert. It is loud in the restaurant, which makes it difficult to have a conversation with the person who is across the table from you. There is a 3.5% venue fee (we were staying at the hotel) automatically added to your bill, which is insane considering the prices are already high for what you get. I will not return to this restaurant or hotel. There are so many other options in the area.
reviews.author: JessicaT

reviews.text: Best bread we have ever had. The lights kept going up super super bright for like a minute of intense bright lights and then would dim. this happened over the course of six times while dining and was very annoying and distracting. Service was very mediocre. We had a hard time getting our waiter to refill our water and had to continually ask.
reviews.author: StacyL

reviews.text: Very over priced for the quality. $38 for spaghetti with 2 pieces of shrimp. $28 for small pizza. I don’t mind paying for expensive meals, but this time it was not worth it. Server was a little slow bringing drinks
reviews.author: Brian

reviews.text: Very noise, limited menu, prices were higher than the menu warranted. Walked in and the noise hits you in the face. Waiter was aggressive just on the verge of annoying. Would  have thought such an inventive chef, the menu would have been more exciting, the menu was disappointing. Very disappointing experience.
reviews.author: PaulD

reviews.text:
Amazing food the taste exceeded expectations.
Amazing service!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Maybe my expectations were too high considering it's Giada's and at a Caesar's property, but it was nothing special.  The food was mostly good or great; the exception was the inedible crab appetizer.  But the service was mediocre if not less.  Again, nothing special to meet my expectations.  I've had far superior service at Preston's, or Mastro's, or Fleming's, or even Grimaldi's.  It was pretty apparent that Luna puts no emphasis on training the service staff on how to properly serve a customer.  I will not return nor will I recommend.
reviews.author: RocaBruja

reviews.text: Enjoyed dinner at Luna on the last night of a mother-daughter weekend in Scottsdale. The service was very professional, from the offer to taste a certain wine before ordering, to the friendly wait staff’s attention to our needs. The focaccia is a must, served warm and with the most delicious assortment of dips. I enjoyed the lemon spaghetti with shrimp immensely. There is a chic, feminine quality to the dining room ambience evocative of Giada’s style. I’d return!
reviews.author: RitaG

reviews.text: I’m gluten free and the friendly staff went out of their way to accommodate me. The menu is also clearly labeled with GF options. If you are a fan of Giada, this restaurant is a must.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: After reading mixed reviews we didn’t know what to except and were pleasantly surprised. Excellent service, and delicious food. The only thing that was disappointing was not being able to get one of these signature cocktails as they were out of an ingredient. I ordered a godfather instead not sure what they gave me, especially since I asked for Eagle rare status, though everything else was fantastic.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Paul was amazingly insightful as a waiter and helped me find an entree dish.  The ambiance here is so bright and lovely.  Service cannot do any better from the water refills to the heated coffee cups for desert drink!  Wow this restaurant is doing great.
reviews.author: JonD

reviews.text: We are glad that we tried this new restaurant in Scottsdale. Good food, superb service. (by our server Paul).
reviews.author: IrvineCouple

reviews.text: Everyone was very sweet and provided wonderful service. Special shout out to Brody!
reviews.author: JanisseB

reviews.text:
Second time in 4 weeks the wife and I have dined at Luna.  I will summarize this dining experience in two words:  lemon and salt.

We tried new dishes this time and we both found the menu’s play on lemon to be exceptional.  A lemony Caesar salad, crab arancini which somehow had a delicious lemon essence in it as well, and an utterly divine lemon soufflé highlighted the freshness of that citrus fruit.  I thought it was the best soufflé I’ve ever had, although my wife said that was blasphemy as chocolate soufflé trumps all things to her palette.

As far as salt…we had the Margherita pizza as a course, not an entree.  Best damn pizza I’ve ever had.  Pizzeria Bianco can kiss Giada’s butt on that one.  The way they finished the crust with salt gave a perfect counterbalance to the sweetness of the tomato.

What else can I say except to quote Arnold…I’ll be back.
reviews.author: TimR

reviews.text: We celebrated our 15th anniversary here and it was an excellent choice. Great wine list - not too terribly expensive. Food was absolutely fantastic! It's fairly noisy due to the setup of the tables, but overall a great experience. Our server Preston was awesome! Would definitely go back!
reviews.author: havasusteve

reviews.text: We were hoping the experience would be similar to Giada's in Vegas, unfortunately it falls short.  The cocktails were on point, however the after dinner cappuccino was subpar.  There were a few highlights to the meal, the Noble foccacio and the signature dish which was a glorified spaghetti with lemon alfredo sauce, everything else was average.   The biggest disappointment was the bill.  We were erroneously charged for TWO "luna specials" for $139 each at the very bottom of our bill.  When our bill tipped over $800 we were wondering why it was so expensive until we found the error.  We brought it to the waiters attention and received a muted and sheepish response.   The manager asked us about our experience on the way out and his only response is that it shouldn't happen and they hope to see us again soon.  We were disappointed and will not be returning.  Check your bill closely, or for the same amount they want to charge you, just hop a flight to Vegas for the original Giada's. Caveat emptor!
reviews.author: dreaT

reviews.text: Everything was above and beyond amazing!  Staff was very accommodating and service was impeccable!  The food was absolutely delicious and the presentation of the dishes was exceptional.   I will definitely be going back.
reviews.author: GrayS

reviews.text: Excellent food and service. I would Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Shereese our server was absolutely terrific...her recommendations were spot on. Food was amazing and the GM Paul is definitely an asset to the restaurant. We will be back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I think I expected the food to be much better and the atmosphere. Fairly small portions. It was good just not great. The staff was amazing
reviews.author: KaitlinT

reviews.text: We dined outside on the patio. The view of Camelback mountain was beautiful especially as the sun set behind it. Our waiter Tony was great, very attentive and informative. The food was amazing as usual. We had the Sicilian Focaccia which was made to perfection along with the caprese salad which was different than the norm…highly recommended. The lemon spaghetti was to die for and the margherite pizza. My husband and I celebrated our 27th anniversary and they surprised us with the lemon soufflé for dessert. All I can say is amazing. Brava Giada🥰
reviews.author: FrankM

reviews.text: Very pretty space- friendly staff - great food. Started with crab app then  salmon entree, tripolini pata, grilled asparagus and lemon chello dessert. Never had goat cheese drissle on asparagus but was very good and the asparagus was thick and tender all the way through.
reviews.author: sassy10

reviews.text: Food was fair. Prices are high and you get to pay an added "resort fee'
reviews.author: JAJA

reviews.text: Server was very nice. She jet us before we were seated and let us choose our table.
reviews.author: RyanL

reviews.text: We are locals and couldn’t wait to visit Luna. From the beautiful hotel entrance, to the swanky bar and friendly bar tender our experience was top notch. Our server Melinda did a fantastic job recommending dishes. It made my husbands birthday celebration that much better!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Way too much noise - People dine to enjoy each other. Your place is over the top on noise - couldn't hear each other at the same table - not good, we will not be back due to this issue. Food, to many tastes of Lemon - make it optional, service was overall outstanding with the exception below. The noise & loud environment gives you a very poor experience. 
We came to celebrate our wedding anniversary which was acknowledged on check- in but nothing mentioned or acknowledged by server, disappointing as all your competition would have make it special.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Don’t ask for a review. It’s very uncomfortable for your employees to say we need to mention their names online. I’m 33 years and find it ridiculous I need to review online. Can’t I just tell your manager or be given a survey on my invoice.  I was asked 4 times to leave a review. It ruins the experience. Kenneth was the best though!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Everything from cocktails to pizza to pasta and dessert were incredible. We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Excellent service from the hostess, server and runner. Luxurious atmosphere and high class place to have dinner. Food was good (but not great). Manager and staff went above and beyond to make sure it was a very special dining experience.
reviews.author: JohnT

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautiful and the service was outstanding.  We enjoyed our food but it was overpriced.  I had the lemon spaghetti with shrimp and was surprised the dish had only two medium sized shrimp.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Gilbert made our night so special. Ask to be seated with him when you come in. We also saw celebs there, so exciting!
reviews.author: SK16

reviews.text: Must try!! Exceptional Italian as expected. Delicious cocktails and incredible pizza. The lemon biscotti was scrumptious. Dates wrapped in bacon OMG! Soooo goood. I’ve been here 5x and would go more often if we lived closer. It’s a bit far south for us. I’ve made many of Giada’s recipes from several of her cookbooks each meal has been remarkable.
reviews.author: USAdinediva

reviews.text: Loved the atmosphere and the food was delicious!  Gilbert, our server, treated us like royalty and made our anniversary dinner truly memorable!
reviews.author: KaJo

reviews.text: We really enjoyed the experience at Luna by Giada. The food was delicious and the service was outstanding.
reviews.author: AndreaK

reviews.text:
The restaurant was overhyped.

The food was not great. I ordered a pesto pasta dish and the sauce was brown. There were a lot of flavors, but pesto wasn’t one of them.

The only good dish was the focaccia which did have delicious pesto dipping sauce.

They are lacking good liquor brands at the bar as well. Very little in blanco tequila.

Ambience is good. Service was so-so.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We waited a minute to be greeted. The manager immediately apologized and sent over 4 complimentary appetizers. Gilbert, our server, was amazing! So knowledgable, friendly and extremely entertaining. He made the entire experience so enjoyable. He was attentive to every detail and made our daughter’s 21st birthday extra special. We will definitely be back and request Gilbert.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Was excited to give Luna a try.  Food was very expensive, with nothing special about it.  Wait staff was friendly but not attentive.
One meal was sent back and there was never an offer to make it right

I never mind paying for great food and service… this was not it however.
Would not go back
reviews.author: AngelaD

reviews.text: Came here for the first time for our 20 year anniversary. The food was great and Kenneth, our server, was just a great person and extremely knowledgeable.  Ask for him if you can. He made our special night better than we could have imagined. The lemon pizza was excellent and the scallops were next level but there wasn’t a bad bite out of all 4 meals as we shared a little family style to try more new things. The corn and sausage side is epic as well. Thank you Kenneth!
reviews.author: Dean

reviews.text: Incredible food and service. Was disappointed in the wine selection.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Extremely disappointed in my evening at Luna, especially since I was very much looking forward to the evening. We were a party of four, and ordered four different dinners and two different appetizers. I’m sad to say we were disappointed in all. An extremely high end Italian restaurant that does not provide complimentary bread…not good. As an example, a Risotto Dish that had a grand total of two scallops and tons of Risotto.  The finale was a bill of $416.00, that included a 3.5% Venue Admin fee. Noise level was extremely high and service was slow (2 1/2 hrs) without dessert. I’m sure that people will continue to dine at Luna because of Gida’s well deserved reputation as a great chef. Not up to her standards.  Sorry Gida!
reviews.author: JoeC

reviews.text: So disappointed. From the horrible booths to the cafeteria vibe to the overpriced food. I love Giada in Vegas. This didn’t even come close. Don’t recommend.
reviews.author: MelissaS

reviews.text: Second time we dined here, unfortunately, the food was not very flavorful this time. Very bland salmon, the pasta was low on flavor and the tenderloin was under cooked. We were underwhelmed and won’t be back. I noticed no Italian  cooks in the kitchen, this place is lacking real Italian cooking expertise, also not sure the ingredients are authentic. We had hoped we had found our new go to place.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Wonderful experience. Highly recommend. Food,service and ambience were all great
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Big deal - worth it!  The food lives up to the hype. Branzino, lemon pasta & Arugula salad were unbeatable.
reviews.author: DeniseP

reviews.text: The food was very good. The service was very good. the ambiance was very good and the decor was superior. the total visit was outstanding. Overall the visit was much better than the sum of its parts.
reviews.author: JimboF

reviews.text: Should be called Lemonuna.  Lots of lemon dishes, which are mostly good.  Falls short of the signature lemon spaghetti which tastes much like piccata with Giada adding mascarpone cheese.  The lemon soufflé missed the target tasting the egg and cream masked the potential of this desert.  The corn and sausage side dish was amazing as was the porterhouse, which is served with a big ravioli.    The house made focaccia was excellent and was served with  both butter and olive oil, which had lemon.  Restaurant was beautiful decorated with odd booths scattered and some back to back much like Vegas.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Amazing food and service. Great for special occasions.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: It was a great experience overall. Very elegant design and ambiance, and delicious food. And, to top it off, one of our servers, Brody, was hilarious, definitely enjoyed that added humor to the experience.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Everyone from the hostess to management and bartenders were great except the waiter. He had a very rehearsed script. When we informed him of dietary allergies he continued to recommend itmes we could not eat. Very loud and energetic environment.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant with excellent food and service. We will be back
reviews.author: DarrenT

reviews.text: Lemon spaghetti, Sicilian focaccia, location, atmosphere 🔥🔥🔥
reviews.author: msjo

reviews.text: Good was excellent. Arancini was the best I ever had. Love the calamari.  My drink was incredible. Tony was our server and he did a fabulous job. Can’t wait to go back. Noise level was very high
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Shereese was an outstanding server and made our anniversary dinner a great experience. We went opening night and the food was just as delicious as the first time, if not better.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The lemon spaghetti was to die for and the service was incredible. Would go back again!
reviews.author: JessieLeeMac89

reviews.text: Twice in one month! Fabulous experience on every level!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I had such an amazing experience here! We started with the focaccia which was probably the best I’ve ever had! All 3 sauce options were amazing. Next we had the bacon rolled dates and my friend loved them - we went there for her bday! For the main course we split the margarita pizza and their famous lemon spaghetti - the spaghetti I will forever dream about! They finished off by surprising us with free dessert for my friend’s 30th bday - the cheesecake was again a 10/10. Most of all, our server Gilbert was amazing - we will be back just for him and the amazing GM Paul! Thanks again and can’t wait to come back with more of my friends and family!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Brandi our waitress is amazing !!! 5 stars!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Disappointed in the menu.  Was expecting more since a well know chef.  I have been to a lot of “authentic” Italian restaurants, and frankly, other locally owned restaurants with a varied menu, and their Italian entrees were much better.  Maybe my anticipation was too high to begin with.  Probably won’t go back.
However, it was very busy.  So good luck!
reviews.author: Diane

reviews.text: First the bad. Prices were about 20% higher compared to similar restaurants. My main dish had a very sour taste and was sent back to the kitchen and replaced by a delightful and unique lemon spaghetti, a specialty of the house. The wine prices were very reasonable and there was a nice selection. All the other food was fantastic. Unique cocktails priced at $21, a little high, or well crafted and my wife and I had refreshing choices.
reviews.author: robert

reviews.text: The service and our server Gilbert was exceptional.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Super disappointed in this restaurant. It is pretty and in a good location. The server was nice but very slow. Appetizers came out without utensils. Then entrees were served and had to wait again on utensils. Food was extremely bland and just mediocre. My son’s spaghetti came out sitting in a puddle of water… for such a renowned chef to be the owner the food should be much better… hope they fix the kinks or it won’t last long!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Excellent service.  Delicious food.  Bit noisy but normal these days.
Fun evening.  Pizzas special.  Loved the salads
reviews.author: pretheater

reviews.text: What a lovely location with a view of Camelback mountain. An open kitchen concept with glass walls to mute the noise but you could see everything going on. We were seated quickly with a great table and greeted promptly by our host. The cocktail menu is inventive really enjoyed our gin-based drink. When you get to the menu though it’s really really hard to decide what to order because there’s so many things that sound amazing. For our first trip to Luna, we started with the focaccia that served with three sauces well one is oil and vinegar. The other is pesto and the third is a lemon mascarpone butter, which was really the bomb. To go with those we had the bacon wrapped spicy sausage, stuffed dates on Gorgonzola sauce with a Calabrian chili oil, and crab arancini. The delicious fried balls of crab and rice were so perfect on their own. They really didn’t need the spicy Pomodoro sauce that came with. I will for sure order those again. The next time the dates were tasty I would have liked if they were wrapped in prosciutto instead of bacon and had a little more of the Gorgonzola sauce, but all in all they were delicious, we had the Caesar salad so we get some vegetables in which was very nice tender and crunchy croutons and then we got to the pasta dishes. Gia‘s classic lemon spaghetti. It was served with a couple of enormous shrimp and amazing delicious creamy silky sauce. A huge serving size it could’ve served two. My husband had the Agnolotti in brodo which was also very nice. by this time we were pretty full so we didn’t actually get it to any of the secundi dishes although the Brandino and fillet sounded amazing and if I had room I would’ve tried one of those, but we had been watching this lemon soufflé coming out of the kitchen all night and I knew I had to have dessert. The lemon soufflé was one of the best desserts I’ve had in a long time. We will be back.
reviews.author: knoopsinaz

reviews.text: The food was phenomenal!!! The atmosphere was beautiful and the service was top tier
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I really wasn’t impressed with the service . With these kind of prices for mah pasta i  expect superior service. Very slow services . Waited a long time to get our order taken and to get the food and drinks . Again every time tip is included we’ve gotten crappy service. The food was good (but not good enough for me to go back )but way over price . We spent 248.00 for 2 plates of pasta 1 appetizer and 2 drinks  . It was a new restaurant in town so we did want to try it for a birthday .  We were a group of 7 and every couple spent just as much .  Try it and be your own judge .
reviews.author: MelinaH

reviews.text: Really nice evening, food excellent, Shereese was  the best!
reviews.author: NeitaB

reviews.text: My first time at Luna by Giada and I would say it was OK to good.  It definitely doesn't stand out as a great restaurant for the expectations in Scottsdale. Pizza was ok, the bread and caprese were very good. My dates pasta was a bit too spicy for her tastes, but she was warned.  It's a very beautiful restaurant and property.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Exceptional Food and Service at the Luna Restaurant and Caesar's Republic.

Our neighborhood farewell dinner for the summer was a great success with excellent food and service.  The waiter knew exactly what we should order and the assistant, Cody, was perfect with the photo taking and positive attitude.

Blake from Security was exceptional.  He identified our group of women going into an uncertain situation at the mall parking and ensured our safe passage to our vehicle.  We are very grateful for his attention!

Great night out!!!
reviews.author: JenniferG

reviews.text: Great experience! The service was wonderful and the food was amazing!  ￼
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Fantastic and can’t wait to go again! The food was delicious and we shared 3 main courses between 4 people. The dessert was outstanding as well.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: positive experience overall. the check in staff, wait staff (kendall) was excellent. food was tasty. portions were small. we had branzino and chicken for main course with caprese salad as a starter. i did not think the food was spectacular and portions were small. without wine the overall charge was 100 dollars per person. not sure we would return.
reviews.author: sunils

reviews.text: Here for Mother's Day and wanted to try out a new restauant.  Food is just ok, nothing special and over price. The only good thing to say is good service. Another thing is they charged 3.5% for Venue Admin fee.  It seems like i have to pay for their rent. I wouldnt come back here, there are plenty of good options in Scottdale.
reviews.author: Minh

reviews.text: I love this restaurant!  Such a very beautiful space in the Caesar's Hotel with views of Camelback Mountain from many tables.  I witnessed the chefs cooking pizzas in Giada's "Ferrari" pizza oven from my seat very near the bar.  My waitress, Deva, took great care of me and helped me choose orders.  Try the Moderno cocktail, it's phenomenal.  I love the Lemon Spaghetti as well.  Overall a great place for a date or a special treat.
reviews.author: JonD

reviews.text: Our party of 4 had a wonderful dining experience with Amanda. From recommendations, service level and quality of food, our evening was excellent and we walked away delighted by Luna by Giada!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Missed the mark for us. Started with a cocktail at the bar and the cucumber one was good but the Moderno was a big miss. The orgeat syrup overpowered everything. Once seated for dinner we noticed it was super loud and you could hardly hear anyone talking. Ordered the crab arancini which had too much rice and not enough crab (but overall one of the better things we ordered), the antipasto plate which had no crackers or bread aside from the crostini which had ricotta on top already, and then like 2lbs of grapes which was weird. We ended up ordering the bread as well as we had a bunch of meats and cheese still on the board and nothing to put them on.

For dinner, two of our party got the signature lemon spaghetti, one spicy sausage pizza and one scallop risotto. I know it’s fancy and all but an entree with just 2 scallops or 2 shrimp felt like a ripoff. The pizza was fine but the general consensus was a lack of seasoning (everything tastes like lemon).

Side note, ordered an old fashioned at the table and was charged $4 for a large ice cube?!?? Why???

Final annoyance- order still water then they just refilled it with tap water (yet still charged for still). We will not be back with so many other great options in the area.
reviews.author: JeffG

reviews.text: Fantastic ambiance and food was very delicious. Wine was tasty as well.
reviews.author: TylerL

reviews.text: After months of waiting to get a reservation, dinner at Luna was “okay.” The team who work there deliver outstanding service. The food is an average to underwhelming and overpriced. The tomatoes in a Caprese salad are intended to be room temperature, not ice cold. Risotto was overall good, would have been more flavorful had the chef backed off on the rich cream sauce. The branzino was overcooked and dry. Our expectations were high and we walked away disappointed.
reviews.author: Bellpine1

reviews.text: Our server Tony was so beyond amazing! He made our whole experience so special and is such a kind person. He knew the menu inside and out and just really went above and beyond. Food was great too!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere was wonderful!  We will definitely go back soon!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Service and food was excellent, from our appetizer through desert exceeded expectations.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Very impressed, beautiful venue, drinks well poured, good attention from staff AND management, Giada’s and the hotel Mgr!
Food was good came out quick, great menu for my Italian liking!
Put it on your list , you won’t be disappointed.
reviews.author: JeffL

reviews.text: Beautiful ambiance however the food was very mediocre.
reviews.author: Marsha

reviews.text: Outstanding. We had the Fritto Misto, lemon spaghetti and the Nodi. And the lemon souffle for dessert. Would definitely go back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: My husband and I had a date night last week and really enjoyed ourselves!  All the food items are very “lemon inspired” and never felt too heavy or greasy.  We had the arrancini and caprese for appetizers and I highly recommend both!  Arrancini came with arrabiata sauce and the caprese had balsamic pearls, so good!  We split the scallop risotto which was my favorite and the lemon pizza.  The lemon pizza was a recommendation from our server and it was so good and different!  Our dessert was the blueberry lemon soufflé, different and fun but personally just a once for me.  Overall great dinner and we’re looking forward to coming back!
reviews.author: WhitneyH

reviews.text:
Our dining experience at Luna by Giada was nothing short of extraordinary. From the moment we stepped in, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality, setting the tone for a memorable evening ahead.

The ambiance of Luna exudes elegance and charm, with its stylish decor and cozy atmosphere. It was the perfect setting for date night.

Now, let's talk about the star of the show - the food. Each dish we tried was a masterpiece, meticulously crafted with the finest ingredients and bursting with flavor. From the appetizers to the dessert, every bite was a culinary delight that left us craving for more. The menu offers a selection of Italian-inspired dishes, each showcasing the culinary expertise of the chef.

The wine list at Luna is extensive, featuring a curated selection of varietals to suit every palate. Our server, Gilbert Hernandez, guided us through the wine list with expertise, recommending the perfect wine to complement our meal.

Speaking of Gilbert, we must commend him for his impeccable service throughout the evening. He was attentive, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond to ensure that our dining experience was nothing short of perfection. His passion for hospitality truly shone through, making our evening at Luna even more memorable.

In summary, Luna by Giada is a culinary gem that deserves all the accolades it receives. Whether you're a food enthusiast, a wine connoisseur, or simply looking for a memorable dining experience, Luna is the place to be. We can't wait to return and indulge in another unforgettable meal at this exquisite restaurant.

Thank you, Giada, for an evening filled with delectable cuisine, fine wine, and exceptional service. We'll be back soon!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food was really delicious and the presentation beautiful but unfortunately the service was not commensurate with the prices being charged nor was the service commensurate with the food being served.   The kitchen and the wait staff and the bar seemed to have very different standards.  We received our first course and we still had not received our drinks.  Apparently the delay with drinks was that they were out of grapefruit juice (!) and out of a beer that was on the menu (!).  For a restaurant at this level I would expect the bar to be fully stocked.  The service and bar need to be improved.   As for ambience, it was a bust.  The restaurant is in a hotel and it feels like a hotel restaurant.   We felt like we were sitting in the area that is open for breakfast and lunch.   We waited two months to get this reservation and the experience overall was disappointing.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Noisy and expensive for what it was. Decor was minimal for a restaurant in this price point. Although the Branzino was very good, it was plated with two small pieces and nothing else on the plate, not even garnish. The signature pasta dish had two shrimp for $39.00. Service was adequate but not particularly attentive. Many other choices in Scottsdale at this price point.
reviews.author: DianeM

reviews.text: I am ambivalent about the restaurant.  Is it trying to be a neighborhood restaurant with luxury prices or is it a luxury restaurant with neighborhood appointments.  The servers wear jeans ... tables do not have cloths ... but prices are quite high.  The busboy service was excellent ... our server was quite mediocre.  She was very nice when she came to our table, but it was seldom.  Although I enjoyed the 3-hour dinner, it was not by choice.  I think next time I will try Seven and forget Luna.
reviews.author: whyg

reviews.text: Phenomenal experience. The wait staff was very accommodating and attentive
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We’ve dined at Giada’s Vegas restaurant and were  super excited to dine at Luna.  The restaurant is gorgeous and staff so courteous and professional. We were thrilled with our appetizers of crab arnica and carpaccio.  Our entrees were truly perfection!   We chose 4 different entrees and shared family style.  Each dish was  superb. We shared the branzino, saltimbocca, salmon and prime filet.  Totally outstanding. Don’t miss the lemon soufflé - light as a cloud and delicious!!
Prices are a bit dear but meals exceeded expectation.   We are definitely returning.
reviews.author: WilliamL

reviews.text: The ambiance, service, and food was impeccable. The assistant general manager Kenny ensured our dining experience was exquisite. He made amazing recommendations in addition to being one of the most personable managers I’ve had the pleasure to dine with. Our server Tony was also top notch. He had amazing food & beverage knowledge and maintained superb service throughout the entirety of our time there. 15/10 would recommend dining here to anyone.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We went for Mother's Day 2024 and it was such a wonderful experience and such exceptional food!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Heard mixed reviews but we had an amazing meal! Great service, food and ambiance!!
reviews.author: Kelly

reviews.text: This was a very underwhelming experience for the price.  Very disappointed
reviews.author: AZMOMinNYC

reviews.text: Our server Rae was amazing. The clientele seemed to be mostly tourist.  The food was good, but for the value there are more local restaurants that deliver an amazing meal for less.  The patio is beautiful, but needs more shade as they head into the summer months.  Overall I would recommend the restaurant.
reviews.author: TabbathaW

reviews.text: Went to Mother’s Day brunch and the hotel and restaurant itself was beautiful. Buffet style for Mother’s Day was a bit overpriced for what we got. I would definitely like to try just the regular menu next time. I was pretty bummed spending $150 per person for buffet that was just “ok” when I could have got better food somewhere near by for less. Maybe next time have a regular menu for special occasions or have an option.
reviews.author: Lovetotrynewthings

reviews.text: The physical space is beautiful; the food was excellent. Our waiter was friendly but I felt he wasn’t attuned to things like asking if I wanted more coffee or refilling our water glasses. But overall things were great for the Mother’s Day brunch; we plan to return for dinner
reviews.author: JohnD

reviews.text: My family and I attended Luna's Mother's Day brunch. The service at the host stand, at our table and throughout the restaurant was impeccable. What a great crew! The food was delicious although the brunch offering did not include their famous Lemon Spaghetti. We enjoyed the excellent mimosas, food quality and variety. The restaurant itself is beautiful and very spacious. We had no issue with noise level... it was comfortable for us. The brunch was very expensive at $160 per person; however, we left feeling grateful for an excellent experience and we plan to make reservations for dinner soon. Way to go Giada and team!
reviews.author: ScottR

reviews.text: I felt like I paid for the name not the food. Very pricey
reviews.author: BrianL

reviews.text:
The whole experience is fantastic!
We love this place!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Early Saturday evening reservations, we were quickly escorted to our table.  Hostess was engaged in dialogue with us and knowledgeable of the concept. The dining room(s) quickly filled up but never seemed overly crowded.
Service team were very engaged and quick to refill water and clear plates.
Our lead waiter (Tony) was incredibly knowledgeable, hospitable and genuine with us…never felt rushed or disengaged.
Menu suggestions from Tony were spot on.
Cocktails:
La Strada - cucumber, kiwi, pear, citrus soda
Riso Amaro - gin, Campari, vermouth,  blood orange, apricot
Menu standouts:
Sicilian Focaccia, Crab Arancini, Risotto & Scallops and the Branzino.
All items were prepared nicely, flavorful and substantial.
Will definitely need to come back soon!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The hotel and restaurant are very well appointed. The service was good, albeit slow. They appear to still be working out the opening kinks. The food was average and the menu limited / not many options to keep locals coming back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Where to even began, from the very start we were greeted with the friendliest maitre d' and got seated at what I thought was best seat in house, right next to the kitchen. It’s a glass wall so you can see the phenomenal chef’s and kitchen staff in action. It is a work of art they way they are operating, it was a joy to watch. Our waiter; Tony was incredible. He was beyond friendly and truly cared about us and delivered an extrodinary experience. He was on it and made us feel like the only people in the restaurant. During our time multiple staff members checked on us and made sure we were good and having a good time. It’s refreshing to see how friendly everyone was. Last but not least, the food! It was truly a culinary experience that did not disappoint! Each item you can tell was made with love, as cliche as that sounds you can really tell as the food was simply amazing!  We got the SICILIAN FOCACCIA, BISTECCA ALLA FIORENTINA FOR TWO, PAN SEARED SALMON, ROASTED BROCCOLINI and LEMON SMASHED POTATOES. Again, everything is incredible! You MUST end the night with the Limoncello soufflé it was mind blowing. Thank you for making this experience one we will never forget. I am so thankful we got to celebrate my mom at Luna!
reviews.author: Outstanding

reviews.text: Fantastic Food, Service and Ambience!  It will be a huge success for the area!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Really fun, great food, unique dining experience ... loved it.
reviews.author: DebbieM

reviews.text:
The staff was fantastic. Attentive and friendly with an effort to make you feel welcome. My wife and I started off with the Foccacia and wine which was wonderful. We were disappointed at the Chardonnay choices by the glass.
We both had pasta, my wife Lemon shrimp and I had the Risotto with Scallops. Both were very tasty and I would reccomend. My wife added extra shrimp to hers making it a large pasta dish. We had a plate of cookies for dessert which was honestly underwhelming and I wouldn’t reccomend.
reviews.author: Jneel

reviews.text: Three things made this evening: restaurant is certainly beautiful, the food was excellent but what made this 5 out of 5 was the staff. Thank you for going above and beyond to make our experience exceptional.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
I was so excited to dine at Giada’s new restaurant, having been a long time fan, watching her on Food Network, buying her cookbooks, and enjoying so many of her favorite recipes with family.

I wanted to love the restaurant even after reading some of the reviews, I was still optimistic.

Let’s start with the ambiance.  I felt like I was dining in a large cafeteria.  The noise level was so bad I couldn’t have a conversation with my date seated across from me.  Over crowded dining hall.

Starters- Bacon Wrapped Dates. The bacon was hard it was difficult to bite into. Maybe they made the dish a day or two before or way overcooked the bacon.  My date and I had one each, and didn’t finish the appetizer.  The Carpaccio…  not what I expected and not in a good way.

We split the Brazzino.  It was just okay. The side of Lemon Roasted Potatoes was more like roasted lemons… way too much citrus!

Passed on dessert.

So disappointed.
reviews.author: Heidi

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant. Great service. Not as good of food as Vegas though, specifically the lemon spaghetti :(  The focaccia is great. And cocktails tasty.
reviews.author: ElizabethS

reviews.text:
Our experience at Luna was overall a very pleasant one. The waiter was very good at explaining the menu and offering up suggestions. We were seated outside and it was a very lovely patio with a nice view in the background.

The team members were constantly coming up to our table to make sure everything was to our liking. Our food took a little long to arrive at our table but the team addressed it quickly and comped us a free dessert which was very nice!

The food was delicious!! We loved the focaccia bread, the crab arincini, the lemon spaghetti and of course the soufflé!

The only minor issue that I have is when it was time for the bill my friend and I asked if it could be split down the middle. The waiter was hesitant but said he would figure it out so we gave him both of our credit cards. He ended up splitting it but charged one card twice! So my friend didn’t get her card charged at all and my card got both transactions on it…so much for splitting it on two cards…

Luckily it’s an easy fix with my friend just Venmoing me her half that she was supposed to get charged.

Overall it was a great experience and I would go back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Seldom have had such friendly service as this. The food was also prepared well .. the branzino was a 9. That said,the are on the expensive side.. chicken for $42 ? Really? Worse yet are their wine and cocktail prices.. 25 a glass? Crazy.Few tables ordered wine.
reviews.author: skos

reviews.text: The decor of the restaurant is amazing - just beautiful. Martini came full of ice, had to ask three times for lemons. Brazino was delicious but the pizza was burnt and the lemon pasta was okay not outstanding. Many other places to go where pasta isn’t $30 a plate.
reviews.author: AndreyaB

reviews.text: Great experience all the way around.  As we walked in, Caesars Republic hotel smelled amazing.  You felt like you were entering a spa.  It set the tone.  The host gave us a mini tour and was super friendly. Our server in bar area was extremely knowledgeable and tailored our drinks just how we like them and our meal was timed perfectly.  Even down the food runners, everyone was very professional.  The manager checked in on us.  Devaughn from upstairs whom we'd inquired with about event space came down to chat.  It was just great customer care and something you don't get very often in busy new restaurants.  The food was delicious, pasta cooked perfectly and the souffle for dessert was dreamy.  We will be back and bring our friends.  Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a perfect night out.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Well was my second time there had reservations we had to wait 35 minutes plus for our table never
They apologized or anything a drink could have made it
Not so bad had guests from out of town the food was not the same as the time before
Will be a while before I go back.
reviews.author: GUSTAVOT

reviews.text: The evening started off nice. It was slow because it was early. We were seated early and our waiter came right over. He was very prompt and super friendly. His name was Tucker. However, everything just kind of went downhill from there. The margarita pizza was Unseasoned mostly tasteless. My fish when it arrived 30 minutes after the appetizers were cleared was very overcooked and on the hot plate, which is never a good sign. The pasta noodle with the spaghetti sauce was not special at all and very bland. They didn’t clear our dinner plates until after , the desserts arrived. I didn’t want to complain anymore because I knew how long it was gonna take to get service. It seemed as though our waiter was avoiding our table because he knew it was taking so long to get dinner. Definitely underwhelmed. The best thing about the evening was Tucker and the lemon ricotta cookies.  My husband and I agreed We would not go back
reviews.author: Bamspeech

reviews.text: Food was good but service was slow and it was very loud.
reviews.author: DonnaV

reviews.text: Wish you would soften surfaces to filter out the noise
reviews.author: Hungrywolf

reviews.text:
Fabulous from start to finish.
Our server, Brandi was extremely knowledgeable and helpful.
Beautiful space and delicious food.
Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Acekolb12

reviews.text:
The restaurant is beautiful and the food is delicious. The service was good but not exceptional. I take it that they are new and not seasoned. 
The only complaint is the noise level. I is very hard to hear the conversation between the four of us.
reviews.author: LizD

reviews.text: Made a reservation for a special occasion (party of two). The restaurant is beautiful, clean, and comfortable. The bacon wrapped date appetizer was amazing.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Would be cheaper and tastier to just fly to Rome
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Incredible place. So good we had to go back even though as out of towners we like to explore other places. 2nd time did not disappoint. The flavour in each of their items is perfect. Food, presentation are both some of the best I have even experienced. Need this to come to Canada.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Everything was excellent from the service to the food to the drinks. Had many unique and lovely dishes. Will definitely go back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The service was excellent. The restaurant was very loud. The salmon was very dry and lacked any flavor. The Tiramisu was good but not anything special.
reviews.author: JAnelleW

reviews.text:
Review of the new Caesar's Hotel in Scottsdale and the LUNA restaurant.  

The hotel was less than impressive walking in the front doors.  We had a 7:15pm dinner reservation but we came early to check out the rooftop bar on the 7th floor.  When we arrived off the elevator, we seated ourselves at a small table.  There were several waitresses scurrying about but none of them came over to take our drink order.  In regard to the waitresses, I must comment on their "R" rated outfits.  The shorts they wore were so skimpy that their butt cheeks were partially hanging out.  We finally waved at the bartender and he came over to our table and took our order. The drinks were fine, generous portions and well made.  The view from the 7th floor is quite nice if you walk out and stand at the glass safety barrier.  However, the glass barrier wall has a wide horizontal metal strip running down the middle of it which blocked the view if your were sitting down at a table.   

At 7:10pm we went back downstairs to be seated in the LUNA Restaurant on the first floor.  There are two greeters behind a desk at the entrance that took a very long time to acknowledge our presence.   Once they did, we were told our table was not available and there would be a 10-15 minute wait. We waited 15 minutes and then were finally seated.  The restaurant was very busy and the crowd noise in the room was deafening.  It was hard for us to have a discussion at our table.  Why can't architects design dining spaces which incorporate some noise muting properties??

For such a renown chef (Giada DeLaurentis) the LUNA menu was rather mundane. I had grilled salmon and my husband ordered the scallops served on risotto.  He said his dish was tasty but it came with only two scallops.  The salmon was a large serving and it was just "okay".  We also ordered a side dish of asparagus ($17 for 4 asparagus !) that was served to us very undercooked. We sent it back to the kitchen and asked that it be taken off our bill.
reviews.author: CherylK

reviews.text:
This is our second experience dining here.  The first experience was about a week after opening.  At that time, the food was excellent and the service was quite good.  This is the reason we booked to go again.

On both occasions, the noise in the restaurant ranged from 85-88 dB (I measured with my phone) almost constantly, which is too much, and not safe for the serving staff.  We had to basically yell at each other all night to be able to have a conversation.

This restaurant appears to be a case of a "Celebrity Chef" putting their name on the restaurant transactinoally - and then abandoning it.  I suspect that expert managers, cooks and chefs were retained to get the restaurant going....and then they left....leaving the restaurant to the care of insufficiently proficient staff.

Had a reservation for 7:15.  Ended up not getting seated until almost 8:00 - and only after I toured the restaurant and let the front desk know that there were several tables empty that we could have been seated at over 20 min earlier.  She seemed surprised by this and left to verify.....which made no difference.  We still had to wait.

Service was inattentive at best. 1 Waitress for numerous tables.  Manager was helping out - but clearly focused on the larger tables instead of my table of 3.  Our food didn't start arriving until almost 2 hours after our reservation time.

Arugula Salad: very good.  But the described "candied lemons" non-existant.  They were just normal lemon pieces.

Frutti Misto: Very good.  Light and tasty with a reasonable proportion.

Lemon Spaghetti: Wallpaper paste with gloppy tasteless sauce congealed on top

Margarita Pizza: Razor thin, tasteless and so soggy in the middle that the crust was dissolving.  Bottom was cremated to black carbon.  Not good at all. 

Restaurant comped the meals.  Thank-you. 

Might return one day but not unless major changes are made.  

All of this is fixable - and I hope they fix it!

reviews.text: Highly recommend! The focaccia is a must! The lemonchello soufflé was the best dessert I have ever had! Make sure you get pepper added to your meal.

reviews.text: The Ceasars Republic is a very nice new hotel in Scottsdale. I was excited about having dinner at Giada, but I was not impressed with the food. Me and my friend ordered 4 different things, and I, particularly, couldn’t eat their carpaccio. It was too salty to my taste. We didn’t feel like we’ll go back to another dinner or lunch experience based on the other dishes we had. For a restaurant of this standard and prices, I was expecting the food to be accordingly.
reviews.author: Lovefood48

reviews.text:
Luna is a fabulous new addition to the Phoenix/Scottsdale restaurant scene. This new fine dining come-as-you-are Italianish restaurant easily distinguishes it self in the greater Phoenix market and Scottsdale sub-market with hundreds of Italian food restaurants with creative twists on the traditional northern Italian menu and a new and beautiful restaurant in the new and beautiful Caesar’s Republic hotel on Goldwater Blvd.  


Service is first class from the moment you enter the hotel to being shown to your table while being told the inspiration behind the restaurant. Our server Cherisse (sp?) is about the most the most knowledgeable and passionate about the menu we have seen.


Like most modern eateries targeting 30 and 40 year olds, the architecture includes minimal soft surfaces and the design elevates the normal buzz or talking to a conversation blocking crescendo. We were in the Jade room (the other room is the Luna room), which seemed the quietest. Our party of two struggled to hear each other, which dissuades us from inviting friends because our ground would not be able to have normal conversation. 

But the food and ambiance were so good maybe we will bring walkie-talkies for our next meal.
reviews.author: Traveler0000000001

reviews.text: My wife and I have dined at Giada’s in Las Vegas many times; Luna maintained the same exceptional quality of food and ambiance.  All courses—apps, pasta, entree, and dessert—were sublime and delicious.  Drinks were top notch as well.  Our evening was made special by our server, Shereese.  She gave us some wine recommendations to pair with the pasta and entrees, and they did not disappoint.  What can I say?  We liked it so much I made a second reservation before we departed for the evening.
reviews.author: TimR

reviews.text:
The wait staff employees from start to finish were fantastic… we ordered three drinks that took 25 minutes for two of them and the other 10 additional which was very disappointing … I feel the bar was servicing the bar customers  not the restaurant and  that’s an issue…￼
Ordered some appetizers the focaccia bread and a pizza which both came burnt and we were waiting for a specific sauce that we ordered, which never came until after the pizza was finished .…
Entrées were fabulous. We had lemon pasta that was wonderful. Ordered a side of the smashed potatoes they  were ok not great. ..
Dessert was the best part the mascarpone brownie which was absolutely delicious….￼￼￼
Would I try this restaurant again, probably at some point, but I’ll wait awhile until they get all their issues ironed out…

reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience at this restaurant. The ambience is beautiful, and our waiter, Gilbert, was a rockstar! The menu is well-priced and every item we ordered was cooked to perfection. Thank you for an amazing experience!
