reviews.text: We really enjoyed Luna and will most certainly return. Pasta dishes were great, pork was fine. Service across the board was excellent and friendly. Parts of restaurant were really loud, back room was a bit quieter.  All in all definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Foodie

reviews.text: We enjoyed our table in the Luna room but became aware they have VIP tables that are not for everyone. We started with two aperol spritz and the bacon wrapped dates which were excellent with the spicy sausage twist. We shared an arugula salad which had a nice tangy bite. The scallop risotto and the signature lemon pasta were also both very good with a Prosecco and a NZ Sauv Blanc. The corn and sausage side was spicy and delicious. We finished trying both the lemon souffle, which was outstanding, and the chocolate hazelnut creme cake which was also delicious. We also were treated to the cookies with ice cream as an anniversary treat. The lemon biscotti style cookie is yummy while the chocolate chip style cookie was okay. We obviously had leftovers but truly enjoyed trying all the dishes. The true standout is the staff especially our waiter Gilbert. It was a very fun evening. They definitely have Las Vegas prices. I was surprised they didn’t have any sparkling by the glass between an inexpensive but quality brut Prosecco and a $55 glass of champagne.  Being local, we’ll be looking forward to trying the more casual items on the menu as well.
reviews.author: AZLolly

reviews.text:
Had the absolute best experience for my sister in laws birthday! The entire experience was beautiful from start to finish. We had an entire team waiting on us to ensure the best experience.

Shereese made the best recommendations, made us feel welcome and was so knowledgeable about everything! Austin and Andy were amazing too! We got to hear the story behind the constellation on the ceiling in the Jade Room!

To top things off, Giada stopped by our table and made our night! The food was delicious and she showed us the proper way to eat the lemon spaghetti!

Thank you for making our first experience so memorable! We will be back soon! ❤️
reviews.author: MarshaG

reviews.text: Overall, an outstanding dining experience at this new restaurant. It all started with our server, Melanie, who just got us off to great start recommending cocktails and just kept it going with her food recommendations. We especially enjoyed the calamari & shrimp, and the lemon spaghetti was excellent as advertised. Attentive staff was always around to provide great service.  A resort fee was added to the bill as listed on the menu so we were not surprised. Price of dining was a bit on the high side which may limit how often we'll return.

reviews.text: Just had a fantastic dinner at Luna! We are in town for a family wedding and made reservations about 2 months ago. Love the restaurant layout and vibe, watching the chefs cook is such a bonus! I have been watching Giada’s Everyday Italian since it started! What an incredible treat she was there tonight. We had The Arincni , focaccia bread, lemon spaghetti, caprese salad, vodka pasta, and the most delicious dessert, limoncello soufflé! Everything was perfection including our top notch server Melanie! Thank you Giada, Luna is Bellissimo!! Bravo 👏🏼 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼

reviews.text: We were interested in a light dinner so our waiter suggested the Lemon pizza and we added the sous vide shrimp for our protein, it was delicious! To top off our evening Giada was at the restaurant and stopped to chat and take a photo with us. She’s a class act!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: My husband and I had a wonderful evening at Luna last night. We had a 7pm reservation and sat on the patio, enjoying the beautiful weather. (A big thank you to the manager for suggesting the patio!) The patio was quiet, the tables set apart from each other, good selection of popular music playing as background music- not overpowering or loud and the patio furniture was comfortable and aesthetically pleasing (though we heard there may be more greenery added in the future, which would be a nice added touch). We were not forgotten on the patio, quite the opposite. Our main server was Gilbert and he was attentive, but not over the top and actually added to our delightful evening. (Even taking the initiative to bring an extra glass for water, for my thirsty husband.) He also insured that the meal was paced well and not rushed. We so appreciated that. As for the food, we went in knowing that it would be on the pricey side, and as such didn't stress over it. We chose to have fun and sample a few different starters: the focaccia, crab arancini, and arugula salad. We chose the lemon spaghetti as our entrees. All the food was delicious with stand out flavors, and a unique twist not found at every other Italian restaurant in town (of which there are plenty). And at the end of the evening, we were delighted with the gift of a celebratory dessert- delicious cookies (especially the lemon ricotta) and gelato. We'll be back.

reviews.text: Our server Melanie was very friendly, knowledgeable and efficient.  The food was excellent.

reviews.text:
Dining at Luna is traveling through Milan and Rome.

Our dining experience brought back those wonderful memories of the trattorias and pizzerias.
The clean fresh high quality ingredients prepared with a passion.
If you are expecting large portions of heavy sauces-this is not what you will see in front of you.
This is a traditional Italian restaurant.

Our service team of Basil and Jose were outstanding, and they were seasoned vets.
From the friendly host stand to the maitre de, professionalism and friendly hospitality was exhibited.
The GM - Paul is experienced and knowledgeable in the art of hospitality.  His demeanor is a welcoming touch.

We are planning our return visit to celebrate with very close friends.

reviews.text: Overall it was a very good restaurant, but I agree with other reviews saying it’s overpriced. $39 for the signature lemon spaghetti that had 2 pieces of shrimp and the pasta was undercooked (and I love Al dente pasta but this wasn’t cooked enough). We also had the mortadella pizza for $28. There was no sauce on it at all so it was like a cheesy flatbread with mortadella on top. It was good, but should’ve been $20 max. The focaccia starter and crab arancini were both delicious! The Virgil cocktail was amazing. Bubbly, lemony and fresh. But again, $21 is a lot for a cocktail when it’s not a martini. The ambience was cool, very modern and neutral. Server was very nice, took at least 5 minutes to come greet us but was timely after that. They also charge a 3.5% “venue admin” fee which is annoying and I’m not sure what it’s for? I might come back here in the future but there are several other places I’d go before coming here again that have better food and cheaper pricing.

reviews.text: Horrible service last night. I made a reservation for 3 people back in February for dinner last night. We arrive exactly on time at 6:30. The 5 hostesses behind the counter told us they are clearing some tables and would be seated soon. I was fine with that. We ended up not being seated until 45 minutes later!! We couldn’t believe it. We sat on the couches and just stared for 45 minutes. We were here to celebrate a friends birthday and were so excited to try Luna. They didn’t apologize for the wait AND didn’t comp us for anything. I asked the hostess if they could comp something for us to make the situation right and she offered a complimentary desert for the bday girl. Little did she know I actually already called before dinner to make sure she got a bday dessert and that it would already be complimentary. So still nothing was comped. I’m not sure what the problem was last night but they seemed to have been over booked and we got punished for it. It was absolutely ridiculous to have waited that long when I had a reservation. We were starving and to not be comped for anything was poor customer service, it was the least they could do. It’s a shame because other than that, the food was actually amazing and our server was great.
reviews.author: JosephinaCarlygirl1994

reviews.text: Our server Tony was great. Very energetic and helpful
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Had a lovely evening at Luna by Giada’s
Our server Ken was so delightful and made our night so special. So glad we ate outside as we were able to listen to the music and still hear each other! LOL
Everything we ordered was so delicious!
We will definitely be coming back again!
Thank you for opening a restaurant here in Arizona Giada!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our server, Ken was phenomenal! I am so glad that we sat outside because inside was very very loud! It was a beautiful evening to sit outside!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Incredible experience! Top notch service and food! Spectacular views of Camelback Mt. from bar on 7th floor. Giada’s food is the best- love the lemon spaghetti. We will be back soon.
reviews.author: BruceF

reviews.text: We want to Luna by Giada because of the famous viral video that we saw of the Parmesan wheel pasta. Once we showed up- it was not busy and made us wait 20 minutes. When we looked over the menu, there was no Parmesan wheel pasta, so we asked the server about it. They said it was only used at a VIP party. This was an item that was not on the menu. Manager was amazing, staff was friendly, but very expensive and we both left hungry.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our waiter was gone throughout the time we were there, we came near the end of closing time and lacked customer service. Food was good, I think the waiter needs to tell us the right price for add-ons as it was more than what they stated.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The restaurant is new . The food was not good as we expected and the service is poor
reviews.author: PoonamS

reviews.text: Everything was fine. Nothing remarkable, especially for the price. The wines by the glass list was especially disappointing. I was dining solo so didn’t need a bottle. I was hoping how some interesting Italian selections.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Waiters and hostesses were excellent, but the kitchen was very slow. Food was excellent, however, price point was high. Inside noise level was extremely loud, & I was so thrilled that I had ask for outside seating, where the pleasant weather and view of Camel back made it a wonderful evening.
reviews.author: RoseD

reviews.text: Extremely slow service.  Very loud. Disappointing
reviews.author: JimmyW

reviews.text: This was our second time to visit.  Great service.
reviews.author: MelissaG

reviews.text: Pretty simple menu, nothing to rave about though. Beautiful place, esthetically pleasing.
reviews.author: CamilleH

reviews.text:
Welcoming friendly personnel
Who would have thought but Lemon Pizza is delicious as was the signature dish lemon spaghetti with shrimp.
Our server Cherise was the best, providing selections and descriptions and was attentive but not overbearing. We will definitely dine here again and request Cherise as our server!!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Everything was absolutely delicious worth every penny, the server was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu. Excited to dine here because of Giada’s name being attached and I was so pleased with the whole experience. Restaurant’s like Luna once again showcase why Scottsdale Arizona has some of the best restaurants in the nation.
reviews.author: JoleenT

reviews.text: The food was spot on- five of us did a bit of a family style experience. Highly recommended spot. Lemon pasta dish is a must
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
I was a little hesitant to go because the reviews have not been great.   We had Chelese and she was amazing.  She made great recommendations and everything was great.  The flavor and the food was very fresh.

Definitely will be back
reviews.author: Storman

reviews.text: Great service, food, and wine!  Loved everything about the experience.    Will be back - such a great place to bring out of town guests.
reviews.author: SteveR

reviews.text: We had a great experience at Luna. Our waitress Brandy did a great job of explaining everything to us. And help us make good decisions. She is what made the evening special. We started off with the crab puffs and the amazing focaccia bread with all the dips. Then we went into the lemon pasta and decided to add to additional prawns by far the best prawns I have ever eaten. I was told they did sous vide day cooking, and then warm them as needed. The pasta was flavorful and plenty of sauce. Then we ended the evening with the brownie cheesecake. The presentation is amazing and it was the perfect serving size. The manager actually help take our photo on the way out, we have nothing but good to say about this place and look forward to returning and trying other things on the menu. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: LoriT

reviews.text: The food was amazing.  It was hard to decide what to order.  We plan to return and eat our way through the whole menu. The server was knowledgeable and was very helpful in helping us make our food and wine selections.
reviews.author: LindaM

reviews.text: Great experience, attentive staff, easy to get a reservation via OpenTable. I enjoyed everything - focaccia bread, caprese salad, mortadella pizza, branzino and limoncello souffle. And let’s not forget that AMAZING cocktail - The Moderno
reviews.author: MikeF

reviews.text:
Food was delicious except for seafood platter lobster so undercooked
Melanie our server was great
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food was excellent! Although we were told that it was family style and meals were able to be shared, they were not. Each meal was a nice portion for one. Everything we had tasted wonderful.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Lemon spaghetti with shrimp was delicious and the lie cocktails as well as well as their vodka pastas was good
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: So starting off with the highlight, my service that I received from Preston was amazing! The ambience was warm and inviting, although it was louder than I would’ve thought. I believe the music played a role with that the food was just OK. I expected more and the delivery of food and beverage took a lot longer than average and there were little Misses such as delay in receiving my martini because all of the martini glasses were dirty and asking for a bag to put my leftovers in they ran out of bags and we’re waiting for a delivery. Expected more from the restaurant being linked to big names, like Giada and the Cesar Brand.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Patio feels like an afterthought… boring and empty and right on the street. Giada can do better than this!
Service was a mess getting order wrong, missing a full course of salads, although they eventually corrected it after sitting for 20 minutes..the server then cold shouldered us. No one asked how our food was … it was not great at all…and we had to pour our own wine. They were great at keeping water glass filled!? That’s about it.
Our bill was over $500…. Huge waste of $ and big disappointment! Giada Vegas is 10x better!
reviews.author: CaroleR

reviews.text:
Great experience.
Love Giada’s!
Great location. Awesome vibe and ambience
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our waiter, Tony and the assistant waiter were outstanding.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We were very excited to dine at this restaurant and scheduled a reservation. Upon being sat at our table, we noted that the noise level was above what we would deem comfortable. After looking at the menu, we ordered two alcoholic beverages, focaccia, and two pasta dishes. All of our food and drinks were good. However, at $40 for an entree, we found it absurd that neither pasta had any protein (you could add it for an additional $16+.) The entire menu was very overpriced for the quality of food we received. In addition, it felt like the meal was rushed and the table needed to be turned quickly. I would like to note that Jay and Andy were fantastic - the service we received matched the cost of the menu. Overall, the restaurant is overpriced for the quality of food and total experience received.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
So fun to go the newest place in town!  Scottsdale seems to be the testing ground for hip places and this one is right up there.  We could only get a table at 5:15, very early for us, but we took it.  We thought the service was excellent,  and a manager type guy checked on us at least 2 times in addition to our waiter and busser.  As we were leaving and admiring the pizza oven (behind glass) a different waiter offered to take us into the kitchen and show us the oven.  He went above and beyond, escorting us in, introducing us the the chef, and explaining the fancy made- in -Italy oven.  
   We had the focaccia which many reviewers raved about, and at $14.00 we'd get it again.  Delicious!  Food is relatively pricey but to be expected, and wine list was over the top.  Would have liked some mid range wines.  Yes it's noisy, we can handle that even if we'd like it quieter, but the music was godawful.  Please, fix that!
reviews.author: Tahoegal

reviews.text: The restaurant is loud and the tables are very close together, at least in the front by the kitchen perhaps a little more intimate towards the back the food was just OK I think they’re trying to work the kinks out still
reviews.author: ShellyM

reviews.text: Evening did not start off well with a miss charge at the bar for our pre-dinner cocktail. Instead of a credit, bartender, just overfilled my husband’s drink to make up for it.  It was a beautiful evening so sitting on the patio was a good choice, but it is barren. Concrete floors,  no centerpieces, No plants around the perimeter, no lighting, just tables and chairs.  Chairs are comfortable, however as another viewer commented no place to hang your purse.  After the sun was down, the manager did bring tiny lamps to add just a bit of ambience.   Food quality was the only item that was up to a Giada restaurant. Server was extremely friendly however, the kitchen was slow. Also, Entrées were not timed so as my husband and I could not eat at the same time.  When bringing this to their attention that I still did not have my food, we were told that the concept is to share plates. The wine list is nothing special as well and wine and food is definitely on the higher priced end.  Hoping when they’ve been open a little longer, they make adjustments.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Very nice restaurant! Great dishes and service. Our waitress Amanda was especially awesome! She was so knowledgeable and helpful! I enjoyed all of her recommendations! Definitely go there again!
reviews.author: JohnG

reviews.text: Excellent experience! The service from start to finish was refreshing. I could really tell they are making your experience a main focus. The specialty cocktails were on point. The Caprese salad was perfect. The Leman Spaghetti…superb and simple. The risotto with two perfectly cooked scallops was amazing and filling. I will be back. The menu is loaded with Italian specialties. Contrary to other reviews, the prices are fair with the market.
reviews.author: RLee

reviews.text: The food was mediocre for the high price tag. The frito misto was the same as any run-of-the-mill Italian restaurant.
reviews.author: food4life

reviews.text: It was an outstanding meal and evening all around.  Was so excited to try this new venue.  Will be back and excited to try all next time we are in town.
reviews.author: BethB

reviews.text: It was very expensive and I don’t feel like the food was worth it. A small plate of pasta for $38 that only has two shrimp in the plate?!
reviews.author: sherylm

reviews.text: Food was delicious! Service was a bit slow but had a great table outside so we didn’t mind. We asked to substitute a protein on a pasta for a cheaper alternative and was told yes, but when receiving the bill they up-charged us for an entire extra side of protein. When bringing this up to the server she let us know they can take things off but can’t substitute them, we wished they would have communicated this at the time of ordering.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Luna was my choice for my birthday dinner and it was an excellent one. We opted to sit outside and our table had a beautiful view of Camelback as the sun was setting. Our server, Gilbert, was friendly and attentive…his suggestions were spot on and everyone loved everything we ordered. Not surprisingly, the restaurant was gorgeous and every detail was perfection. A fabulous addition to Scottsdale and I’m already looking forward to our next visit.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great location, very attractive inside. Delicious food and appetizers, excellent cocktails!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: It was our first time dining at Luna and it did not disappoint. A must try￼
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Our server was attentive and the vibe was okay in the patio. We wished we had eaten inside. We thought there was a view but it was actually from the 7th floor lounge/restaurant not affiliated to Luna. Had we known about that, we probably would have dined there instead of Luna. From photos and descriptions that we viewed, we thought Luna was on an upper level. The food was OK. Everyone at our table ordered an entree. Our pasta and selected protein were lacking a bit of flavor. We anticipated our bill to be quite elevated, but for the type of food we ordered, including cocktails, appetizers and dessert, the menu was overly priced. We were all hoping Giada’s place would be outstanding but we all agreed there were better Italian restaurants to be had.
reviews.author: FoodieGuy

reviews.text: The food is pricey but I was surprised to see decent portions. The crab arancini were to die for and the lemon spaghetti was a 10/10 but everything else was amazing too. The Caesar salad comes with a lb of parmesan and can easily be split between 3 or 4 people. Would definitely recommend trying the lemon spaghetti and arancini if you visit.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We were seated a little bit late for our reservation unnecessarily. There were tables available and it should not have happened. Setting that aside, the food was very, very good. Extremely nice quality and reasonable prices. However, the service was very disjointed and the waiters are always rushing by scampering around fast. The problem is the waiter does not stay long enough for you to even ask for what you want. The effort was certainly there but it was not an enjoyable interaction and the service always seemed to be behind from the beginning and seemingly trying to catch up. Everyone was friendly but the experience could be a bit more relaxing and calming. It’s was a bit loud and hectic for the overall beautiful atmosphere.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great night on the patio. First trip in since they opened. Celebrated my wife’s birthday. Really enjoyed the lemon pasta (magnifico) and pork chop (huge). Also the focaccia bread was so so good. Don’t skip it. Finished off the night with the cheese cake to go as we were so stuffed. Our server was excellent and great atmosphere. We’ll be back Giada! So much more to try.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food was great, service was good but distracted. I asked twice if they had an after dinner drink I liked and she kept saying she would find out and never did.
reviews.author: Julie

reviews.text: I wanted to love this Bec I love Giada’s recipes, maybe I was expecting more. Sea food tower turned us off sea food! No flavor to sauces, seaweed around it made it smell bad. The bread and bresola were excellent. Pasta again lacked anything special. Too bad! Won’t go again
reviews.author: Randa

reviews.text:
It is so disappointing to write this review. I've been waiting to go to Luna for my parents to come into town from Michigan. First, we waited 20 minutes for our server to come to our table and when I asked for any recommendations he said "can I get you a drink first" rudely and I just said any drink suggestions. He noted he had another table he was needing to go to and left. Another 10 minutes go by and we have a new waitress, Suzanne. Very lovely. We ordered focaccia and oysters, which were good. Ordered 4 entrees to come out in two waves, per servers advice. The 2nd round of entrees came out and we didn't have plates or flatware. It took 10 minutes for another server to notice and come bring us plates. He said "I didn't want your food getting any more cold". At this point I was frustrated, since it was a last night together dinner with my parents and when they brought the bill, it had an additional pizza and was $400. I asked for a manager and expressed how upsetting this experience was since my mother had been so excited. They took off our $60 bottle of wine from our bill and said they were "sending us with to go desserts". 5 minutes later we were given our new $320 bill and 4 prepackaged cookies, which were lack luster. I truly hate having to give reviews like this but with the amount of quality restaurants from maple & ash, pyro, steak 44, bourbon and bones, and more... I would choose elsewhere for a better experience. I'm happy to pay for quality but unfortunately, this restaurant and staff left me missing the Scottsdale staples everyone knows and loves.

We were also told we'd get a phone number for a direct line and receive 50% off our next visit... that never came. I'd rather receive a complete refund and move on from this experience.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Went with friends for my husband’s birthday. Service was great! We ordered Focaccia bread and dates, both so good.  Ordered the Lobster pasta for two and it was fabulous!!! Our friends ordered lemon pasta with shrimp, which they said was fantastic!!!
The restaurant is beautiful inside…we will definitely go again. Forgot to mentioned my drink…vodka with kiwi and cucumber….loved it! Great job Giada!!!
reviews.author: Linda

reviews.text: Everything was great.  Theresa our sever was helpful with suggestions and the food was innovative and had great flavor. Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Buckeyefan

reviews.text:
Food was amazing. The ciabatta was great. So was the Branzino and risotto.

The service was fair. Had an 8pm reservation but waited 25 minutes for our table. Made a note on Open Table that it was an anniversary celebration and she mentioned it yet no special accommodation for that, no complimentary dessert offered nor did the server did even offer to take our photo.
reviews.author: GinaK

reviews.text: Our server, Brandi, decribed the menu well and provided a well paced meal so we could enjoy our conversation and time together.  We were well attended to.  Fresh seafood and handmade pasta is hard to find in Arizona, but they do an amazing job at it.  Cocktails were well thought out.  The atmosphere was energetic, but not overly loud.  The space was trendy.  Lighting and mood were perfect.  Staff was very friendly and accomodating.  We will definitely be coming back.
reviews.author: nathanc

reviews.text:
Went to Luna by Giada's last night for our anniversary dinner. The food was outstanding. My husband had the Risotto with Scallops and I had the Nodi Marini Alla Vodka. We had the focaccia bread for an appetizer. They served it with a lemon marscapone cheese butter, as well as olive oil with balsamic vinegar and an olive oil with pesto for dipping. Outstanding! Elegant yet simple.
Highly recommend! Service was outstanding! Really go above and beyond!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I have been anticipating the opening of this restaurant and it did not disappoint! I grew up watching Giada on the Food Network and to experience her food was a full circle moment. The lemon spaghetti, lemon pizza and mascarpone cheesecake were heavenly. So much so I booked my next reservation before leaving! Cherese was incredibly attentive and personable!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Worst wine list of a nice restaurant
Food is not that interesting or imaginative
reviews.author: MichaelG

reviews.text: The meal was Excellent! We sat outdoors and it was a perfect evening at Giana’s new restaurant ❤️
reviews.author: Darlened

reviews.text: The service was great and the restaurant is beautiful. The food was VERY heavy with lots of butter and heavy cream.
reviews.author: KatrinaR

reviews.text: From the moment we were greeted by name, to the details the waitress provided to the constant attention to our beverage, all the way through entree and dessert it was an amazing treat.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food and service was absolutely fabulous!  We started with the crab arancini ( so tender and great flavor)and the margarita pizza. Both were so good! The margarita pizza had a little touch of lemon, which was heavenly. The risotto with scallops was incredible   The risotto was perfect cooked. We ordered lemon spaghetti and lobster bucatini . Also both were delicious. We also got the petite fillet, which was perfectly cooked!  ￼
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Weve come here twice now……Not impressed at all with the food! Service was OUTSTANDING!  Maybe Giada needs to spend more time with her restaurant improving the food! Wont be back…….
reviews.author: DarlaR

reviews.text: Our server Tony made the experience worth it!  He was outstanding!  Food was nothing spectacular- except the focaccia bread!
reviews.author: Krarr

reviews.text:
We had such an amazing dinner and time at Luna. Our food order came from recommendations from our server, Jay, and he did not disappoint. We tried a little bit of everything, appetizers, drinks, pizza, pasta and desert. It was all wonderful. We also got to meet the new GM, Kenny! He was so welcoming. We are looking forward to our next visit 
Thank you to everyone!
reviews.author: Foodmoto

reviews.text: Waitress was fantastic but food was overpriced and it felt like we were in a hotel lobby (which we were basically)
reviews.author: MegH

reviews.text: Absolutely fabulous!! Food & service!! Beautiful restaurant !! Thank you! ￼
reviews.author: CarlaW

reviews.text: Service was extremely slow. Took almost half an hour being at the table to get drinks. Food was good, but wasn’t anything that can’t be found at most Italian restaurants for half the price. We ordered drinks and appetizers together, and then food when drinks arrived, and it still took over an hour and a half. Unfortunately was a similar experience that we had going to Giada’s in Vegas a few years ago. Extremely slow service and ok food that wasn’t worth the price.
reviews.author: JustinD

reviews.text: Do not waste your time or your money at Luna.  We went there to celebrate my husband’s birthday.  It was anything but celebratory.  The hostess on the way in said Happy Birthday.  The waiter was unaware, apparently.  We sat by the door coming out from the kitchen.  We witnessed the line of waiters who await the dishes to be delivered to the tables.  They were yawning!  The food was ordinary and expensive.  Our check for the appetizer, two pastas, two cocktails and two glasses of wine was $247.00.  Giada should be ashamed of herself!  There is nothing special about this restaurant and we will certainly not return.  By the way, my husband did not even get a cookie for his birthday!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
The restaurant although nicely decorated had an atmosphere was loud and cafeteria like. At some moments the noise level was so high my wife and I couldn't carry on a normal conversation. It sounded like everyone was trying to speak over the music.
Our waiter Paul did come by shortly after we were seated and got our drink, appetizer & entrée order.  
We did receive our drinks and appetizers in a timely manner by another server, but it did take quite some time (approx~30 mins) to get our main meal which was brought to us by another server. After we did receive our entree’s my wife's salmon was extremely dry and my pasta plater was not what I expected.
The manger did come by our table and asked if everything was ok. I did mention that it was a bit loud and that our waiter hadn't been around, I did request another sparkling water, but instead he brought mineral water, I had to stop him and remind him that we requested sparkling water. 
It was another 60 or so minutes before our waiter Paul came back and asked us if we needed anything else, by that time it was too late to request a change.
We did order dessert, but too was also disappointing. The tiramisu tasted more like a double chocolate mousse and my wife's chocolate cake with orange mousse was overpowered with an orange flavor with barely any cake.
I know the restaurant has only been open for about a month, but for the money spent, one would expect much better service and a higher quality cuisine.
Will I recommend this restaurant to my colleagues, family, and friends...probably not.  I truly expected a much higher standard for a restaurant stamped with a very reputable person such as Giada. But to my dismay it was not
reviews.author: Mango62

reviews.text: Delicious food!  Superb service and great ambiance--lively but okay for the six of us to have a conversations.  Good looking libations, too. The Signature lemon pasta was superb as was the salmon with beans and the caprese. Don't skip dessert--our favorite was Tiramisu.
reviews.author: LaraineR

reviews.text: Everything we ordered was delicious, fresh, and unique. We definitely plan on going back and trying more items from the menu. ￼
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Restaurant is nice.  Food was good, but nothing really stood out as extraordinary.  Our meals were delivered to our table at different times, which was different.
reviews.author: April

reviews.text: The restaurant was beautiful. Food was okay. I ordered the pan seared salmon, I thought the salmon was perfect, but I didn’t like it paired with the white beans. My husband ordered the chicken panzanella and said it was okay, he also ordered the lemon smashed potatoes that he didn’t like. For dessert we ordered the tiramisu and it was not what we expected, it was way too sweet.
reviews.author: CarmenC

reviews.text: For the price I was expecting perfection. I have lived in many places around the world, and I have also lived in Italy, so I know good cuisine, and I know Italian cuisine. Our waiter was excellent but we had to pay for the bread. They knew it was my birthday, but didn’t offer a dessert or even put a candle in the one I ordered. The Fritto Misto was good but had a lot of cheese on it which I’ve never seen. My lemon spaghetti was very lemony but dry. My friend did not like her margarita pizza but I thought it was ok. My other friend had a large Caesar salad. It was marginally better than most restaurants would serve. The brownie cheesecake was excellent.
reviews.author: KarenG

reviews.text: We were all pleased with our experience-really good food and appropriately priced. Shoutout especially to the focaccia, the branzino and limoncello souffle. Just too noisy
reviews.author: ShelleyD

reviews.text: Very good for a new restaurant .  With time it will be a great experience for dining
reviews.author: stevenR

reviews.text: The food is mediocre and high priced.  Nothing special at all.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
tony our waiter was completely knowledgeable and super efficient!   food was great!
we started with the caesar salad and bacon wrapped date.
main dishes were the signature lemon spaghetti,  rigatoni bolognese and we had the salmon dish.
all delicious.
reviews.author: rusty

reviews.text:
Excellent service and delicious food.  Wonderful experience.
Need to get the rewards program figured out..that was the only disappointment.  Had us sign up for rewards points but the restaurant did not know how to implement.
reviews.author: SusanS

reviews.text: Loved our service and food. Jay was a phenomenal server.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We were very disappointed at the beginning because we were seated 20 mins later than our original reservation as the reservation was at 9 pm waiting that long made us really hangry. However, the food won over everything. Food was delicious the pasta I had a very good lemony zest flavor to it . The dessert was amazing as well. Our server was great too.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food was good, but they need to tighten up the rest of the experience. Although we were right on time for our reservation, we had about a 20 minute wait because they gave guests that were previously seated outside our table before we arrived. We were told we could get a drink while we waited; it took quite awhile to order drinks at the bar. In the meantime, our table became ready but we were told we had to wait for our drinks and close out at the bar before being seated. This took quite a while and the host came back to see what was taking us so long. They should adjust these policies rather than rushing us as we were just waiting on them. Other than that the food and dinner service were both well done.
reviews.author: FoodieKim

reviews.text: We had a great experience. The restaurant is very loud and the wine menu doesn’t have vintage wines. The food was fantastic and our server was amazing.
reviews.author: Squaredbm

reviews.text: Overall, this was a fun new place to try.  The food was amazing!  Everything was absolutely delicious!  Our server was great too.  I was a little disappointed that our reservation was at 6:30 but we couldn’t get in until 7pm.  I thought that’s why I made reservations in the first place?  But the service and food certainly made up for the delay.  Recommend you try at least once.  This is best Italian food in the valley!
reviews.author: HeatherW

reviews.text: Watch out for the “venue fee” they add on at 3.5%. Just more nonsense to increase the cost despite already having an overpriced menu.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We were a party of 2 and shared all.  It was just perfection.
The service was impeccable. The food was incredible. The dishes were exactly as our server explained.
Started with their bread (a loaf with crispy topping & salt)which came with choices of butter with hint of lemon, and oil/balsamic mix & delicious pesto. Next was salad(version of caprese), scallop risotto was next, and the Branzino was amazing .
Definitely make a visit here.
reviews.author: AudreyS

reviews.text: We were very excited to check out this new restaurant! I booked my reservation a month in advance, but we were disappointed we didn't get restaurant seating, but rather in the bar area (note - when booking, ask for the restaurant area seating). The earliest we could get in was 9:15pm. But apparently they close at 10pm on a weeknight. Unfortunately, they did not allow us time to order dessert drinks and coffee as they shut everything down at exactly 10pm. We were told the bar is closed (bartenders still there), and the espresso machine was shut down. They also turned off the TV in the bar area at exactly 10pm, giving us a HUGE hint it was time to leave, although we still had dessert to finish. Overall the food was AMAZING! They still need to work on the customer service skills.
reviews.author: NatalieS

reviews.text: Over priced for what you get. Food decent and atmosphere is nice
reviews.author: russell

reviews.text:
Indoors was loud..... too loud. 
Food was very good, but pricey.
Not worth the price.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.text: My bestie and I decided to try Luna for our monthly girls night dinner. We had reserved the bar but quickly realized we would rather be in the beautiful dining room. The hostess was more than happy to walk through and check availability and then accommodate our request. We had Shereese (sp?) and Gilbert in training as our servers. They were superb! You can tell they really know the menu and care about the guest experience. They made sure everything was perfect and checked back often with recommendations. I also love that they asked for honest feedback because they care so much. The FOOD. Omg. I am 100% Italian and the pasta did not disappoint. We shared the lemon spaghetti and the filet. Meat was cooked perfectly. Martini glasses were the talk of the dining room and the blue cheese stuffed olives were somehow better than Mastro’s. Great job team- will be back soon.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Outstanding meal and service. Especially from Schereese and Gilbert!  Thank you Giada for bringing this restaurant to Scottsdale. Started with oysters and tomatoes and stracciatela cheese and balsamic pearls.
Main coarse shared lemon pizza, vodka arrabiata pasta and branzino.  Recommend all of them!!
reviews.author: brianh

reviews.text: First time trying this restaurant.  I hate to say it but it is average at best.  The Foccia bread was excellent but the entrees were so so. $30+ for pasta noodles with two shrimp I think is expensive, even in Scottsdale.  Seared Salmon over white beans and Artichoke was $40+.  Both of these I could easily have made at home.  I eat out a lot and there are just some restaurants that are over hyped and over priced for what you actually get.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food and service was excellent! We loved the drinks too.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: My husband and I first went for dinner to Luna last Thursday. We had a reservation at 5:45 for the bar area, and we were seated very promptly. The restaurant is beautifully decorated in a California style that separates itself from the usual Scottsdale restaurants. we loved all of the food selections we had that evening—the Caesar salad, the lemon pasta, and the Margarita pizza. They all  had Giada’s touch on them, were very light and very appealing and exceptionally tasty. We would recommend this to any foodie without hesitation!!￼￼
reviews.author: barryh

reviews.text: Food was ok, service was ok, vibes was much more “hotel bar” than expected which was potentially my fault but much more casual than pictures led on. Overpriced for what it is.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Luna by Giada experience was fabulous! The interior is stunning yet comfortable, service was courteous and prompt and the food was delicious. Can’t wait to go back! Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: It’s a beautiful restaurant. Timing of the food is off. We got our pizza but not the salad. We got the desert bit later the coffee. They use a lot of salt in their food. People are super nice and helpful. Just needs a little more time to get it all going
reviews.author: Heatherm

reviews.text:
We could see our cocktails sitting at the bar waiting to be delivered for at least 10 minutes
No purse hooks
My purse was on the floor but they provided a napkin not classy at all
Music did not add to ambiance
We love Taylor Swift but not at Luna
Our server was gone for long periods of time
Beautiful Restaurant definitely
Needs refining
reviews.author: FrankT

reviews.text: The service was very slow and our food must have sat in the kitchen. Pasta was getting cold and mushy and the pizza crust was soggy like it had been sitting too.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food is delicious. I wasn’t especially thrilled with the specialty cocktail. Service was fantastic. Our table for two felt like we were in the middle of nowhere but had a good view of the kitchen. Beware of the perfume/strong scent the hotel pipes in. Overly strong the night we were there.
reviews.author: Sonotcrowded

reviews.text: Had dinner here on a Wednesday evening. Tucker was our server and his energy and recommendations were amazing! All the food we ordered was tasty and left very satisfied with the experience and food.
reviews.author: Elijah

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing service and excellent food. LOVED loved loved the Focaccia with the amazing dipping sauces. The crab arancini and  lemon shrimp pasta so yummy. Only thing we didn’t care for was the lemon soufflé, slightly undercooked .Highly recommend this new restaurant and can’t wait to go back!!
reviews.author: LoriL

reviews.text: The food was absolutely delicious! But $22 for a glass of wine is just offensively over the top even for a swell joint like this.
reviews.author: Marjomor

reviews.text: My daughter and I had a dinner reservation made since opening day and it was definitely worth the wait. Our server Shereese was a rock star. She went above and beyond describing the menu is great detail and suggested a nice wine pairing for our meal. She was so lovely and kind! Tony was assisting as well and even came up and spoke with us several times, just checking in and brought us another wine to taste. Our food was delicious and presented beautifully! We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Still working the kinks out.  Server was great but drinks and food took a while and runners seemed to not know where to go.
reviews.author: TorS

reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel and Luna restaurant! Drinks way overpriced! Most Wine by the glass $20+ - food good, but small portions. They advertised for the restaurant $30 and under..
In checking menu that meant pizza only.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We enjoyed great service. Especially for a newly opened restaurant. The mood was elegant but casual and the food was spot on. Will definitely make this a regular place.
reviews.author: TraciG

reviews.text:
We were celebrating a birthday with friends…the service was fantastic and all of our food was delicious!  Appetizers to dessert were wonderful and presentation of the food was beautiful.

Great place for dinner for 2 to 6!  Would recommend!
reviews.author: Suz98

reviews.text: Jay our waiter was excellent and very attentive. Food was excellent
reviews.author: CarynF

reviews.text:
Hi Giada! I’ve been following you for years on Food Network & have been a big fan of all your cookbooks!

My significant other took me tonight for my 47th birthday to your new restaurant Luna in Old Town Scottsdale, AZ.

Unfortunately, it was the worst restaurant experience that I’ve ever had. For my birthday, they threw 2 plastic wrapped cookies at me as if it was at McDonald’s “happy meal”. It was very disheartening & tacky! Especially, after ordering apps, entrees & a bottle of wine…along with/ cocktails earlier in the evening. Even when the server approached the manager… The manager said this is how we do it from now on.

I will still continue to purchase your cookbooks, but doubt that I will ever return to one of your establishments ever again.

Very disappointed
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Food was good
Overpriced
Dessert $19
Added chicken to pizza another $16
reviews.author: Meredith

reviews.text: Great new restaurant. The pasta options are unique, rather than run-of-the-mill options that most Italian places offer. The focaccia was phenomenal. Great vibe and service.
reviews.author: MichaelB

reviews.text: Excellent service and the food was delicious! The ambiance was amazing. This was my first time here and I cannot wait to return.
reviews.author: JanG

reviews.text:
Best focaccia I’ve ever had, the caprese appetizer also amazing Giada use of lemon in her recipes is so amazing!

My only constructive criticism is the font and shade on menus is soo difficult to read and this was shared by the 20 year olds that dined with us. However, we loved our experience!
reviews.author: DoraR

reviews.text:
Had a beautiful meal and wonderful experience.
Ate at the bar.  Everyone was so friendly and the food was amazing.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Didn’t love this place. I heard good things, but I was super disappointed. Horrible drinks, mediocre food, pretty loud inside. Service was fine at first until we tried sending back a drink because of how bad it was. Instead of accepting it, she URGED us to get a different drink. Second drink comes it was even worse. Would not come back here. Not to mention the pricing is not worth it at all for the experience and food
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We have  dined  at Giada’s Las Vegas restaurant several times prior to dining at Luna by Giada.  The portions and quality of food were much better in Vegas.
Service was very slow, and spotty, didn’t act like they wanted us there.
It was super noisy in the room that they put us with many large loud families.
Our server had a very bad attitude, and was not at all welcoming.
We may give Luna another try once they get over their growing pains, but will request to not be in our server’s section.  Very disappointing:(
reviews.author: 01seafoodlover

reviews.text: Very noisy!  Also, the menu was hard to read under each entree. Food was very good, as was the service
reviews.author: SusanD

reviews.text:
Wonderful service. Knowledgeable staff.
Pizza dough was well cooked.  Pasta sauces were delicious.
Desserts were delicious as well as attractive.
Energetic surroundings.  Smaller wine choice for the amount of showcasing.
Food and experience were great but overpriced.
reviews.author: marys

reviews.text:
Everything about our experience was incredible! Our service was excellent! Amanda knew the menu well and guided us on our selections for the meal. She was incredibly sweet! Everyone working there was friendly and attentive. We had a great view by the window and the ambiance was warm and inviting.
My only one comment: is  that diners should be aware of is this 3.5% venueadminfee that at the moment is a not a removable fee that is added to the check.  I do feel like this fee should be disclosed in advance.
Aside from that silly fee the entire experience was wonderful and I would go back again!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We enjoyed the food, the service and the ambience! I was especially happy that the restaurant chose to use high-end glassware, which was beautiful. We noticed a nice private dining room, where I know my husband can plan larger corporate dinners with more privacy. We met the manager who stopped by to introduce himself and we assured him that we enjoyed our meal and would be back.
reviews.author: TheresaK

reviews.text: I was really looking forward to our date night at Luna. We adore Giada’s in Vegas & had high hopes for the newest location. Sadly, we were not alerted for a ready table or sat promptly even though we arrived early for our reservation & waited to be contacted. It was only after checking into the front desk again that we were sat. Our server failed to come to the table many times throughout the meal to check on us. We were ignored by other available staff who had their backs to us nearby. We did not receive our drinks until after appetizers arrived which was also very delayed. We were never offered cracked pepper or anything to enhance the meal. It was a disappointment.
reviews.author: KristenM

reviews.text: The meal was fabulous and so were the drinks.  It was loud and hard to hear each other but it was a busy Saturday night
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Food was not worth the price. Pasta was undercooked and shrimp extremely over cooked.
They charge for still water. Seems a little obnoxious for the desert. We are not Vegas. I will not be returning for the overall price and food quality.
reviews.author: JordannP

reviews.text: We have been to Giada’s restaurant in Las Vegas and absolutely loved it so we were very excited about her new location.   We checked in with the host for our reservation and were told to wait.   After 20 min and watching other people walking in and being sat right away we followed up with the hosts.  They all seemed confused and completely forgot about us.   The host was trying to give us information about the restaurant but she was speaking too quietly to hear anything.   Finally we were sat and the server training (it was his first day) greeted us.  We had to wait quite some time for our main server.   By the time he finally greeted us and told us about the menu it took 45 minutes to receive our drinks.  The food was delicious but for the price, I expect the service to be amazing.   It’s always hard to open a new restaurant so hopefully the service improves soon.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The service was impeccable and they clearly are proud of their product which makes it fun to consider your options. The food was fantastic and we sat on the patio and had a great view of Camelback.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Our experience at Luna was absolutely amazing! From the minute we walked in we felt so welcomed. The service was outstanding! Tony, our server, was truly the most genuine person & so attentive to our every need. He made us feel like we were family. The food was outstanding! We ordered several dishes to try as a family and every bite was delicious. It's hard to find a restaurant that gives you a well-rounded experience with delicious food. Luna has accomplished this!
We have never felt so much warmth and appreciation from a restaurant. Everyone went above and beyond to give us the most incredible night. We can't wait to return!
reviews.author: CrystanL

reviews.text: Food was bland. Half way through our meals my wife and I both stopped eating because the food was just boring. However our server Tucker was phenomenal and deserves a raise because he was the best part of the entire experience.
reviews.author: NickolasC

reviews.text: Why do you have a venue fee 3.5% ?  Are we still in covid? Supplemental employee salary/benefit? Giana’s cut?
reviews.author: Hugepain1

reviews.text: Has potential but needs a lot of polish!  Service was slow and seemed untrained at the lower levels. Food was not well seasoned and neeoto be checked. Not sure we will be back for the price.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We had a nice dining experience but there are still kinks for this restaurant to figure out. I’m sure things will continue to improve as they’ve only been open for 3 weeks.

Service: everyone seemed overwhelmed. We were seated 25 minutes past our reservation time and had to go back up to ask the host about our table. We were able to sit at the bar while waiting which took time to get a free bartender to serve us. While dining, simple requests like pepper took 5 minutes. Everyone was incredibly friendly but for the price point, they could use more staff on the floor.

Food: We had the focaccia and caprese to start. I really loved both, could be a little on the salty side but really delicious overall. The signature spaghetti was the star. The shrimp was perfectly cooked. We also had the salmon which was a really nice tasty dish but the fish was overcooked
reviews.author: Kelly

reviews.text: Our first time at Giada‘s establishment looked nice very very loud, menu was written in light silver very dark and dining area could not read. They may want to recommend changing the color of writing. Food was OK but lemon lemon lemon lemon what’s up with that? I am also Italian and never had lemon in my food only lemon cello, probably wouldn’t recommend
reviews.author: TracyM

reviews.text: The overall dining experience at Luna was perfect. The ambiance was beautiful. The service was excellent from the moment we were seated. The menu was fantastic- so many choices. We enjoyed the lemon spaghetti and the pork chop, and for dessert the lemon soufflé and the cookies. Highly recommend dining here for any occasion - it was truly a wonderful evening.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food great!!! I love it, the place love it, its new, the service, was not that good, they forgot to bring the wine, first  arrived food than drink, we have to ask to change plates after appetizers, we wanted a clean ones for the entree,  for a  restaurant that level, they do it without asking !!! But overall I like it, for sure, I will go again
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Lovely dining room, enjoyable experience but very pricey.  There is a $20 venue charge added to the bill which was surprising & annoying.

Very loud which made it difficult to hear across the table .  Linen tablecloths & soft elements like that would help with sound absorption.

Friendly, knowledgeable & helpful wait staff.

Beautiful garnet etched water glasses & heavy silverware were very nice. Overall a lively & lovely restaurant for a special occasion.
reviews.author: BonnieM

reviews.text:
Food was just okay. Overall lack of taste. Probably could do each dish better myself. Olive Garden and Buca di Beppo has more taste. Then you add in the cost, not worth it. Her food looks better on TV. Too bad TV doesn’t have smell and taste-a-vision! 

Ambiance and service was good.
reviews.author: StevenA

reviews.text: Giving them the benefit of the doubt, they are a new restaurant and perhaps working out some kinks. Central location and a beautiful hotel with a wonderful dining space, but the dinner and service fell a little flat from what we expected. The starting focaccia was delicious, but dinners came out lukewarm and not very refined, i.e. the flavor profile of the Signature Lemon Spaghetti was fine, but the Parmesan tasted gritty and powdery, almost like it was store-bought, instead of creamy and freshly grated. Perhaps service was meant to be laid back, but came across as slow with some staff seeming to mosey around aimlessly. Overall, given their location under a hotel, they seem to approach dining to appease hotel guests one time instead of providing quality dishes that will keep locals coming back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We ordered the Fritto Mito and Focaccia to start. The Focaccia is to die for and a MUST! Our entrees were exceptional- Scallop Risotto and Lemon Spaghetti. We ended the night with the Lemoncello Soufflé and Cheesecake Brownie. Would recommend the soufflé over the brownie.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: While the food was delicious, and the plates were well curated, the service was below average. Our server seemed uninterested and was frankly rude. The agnolotti was good but not worth $41 for the portion that was served.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We had a reservation for 6:15.  We had to wait 10 min to be seated. The hostess seemed confused about which table to sit us & just in general. Then once seated, water arrived immediatley but we didn’t get our menus for 15 min. Once we did though, the service was great. Amanda more than made up for the wait with her knowledge of the menu.  Table setting was beautiful. We ordered had the focaccia app with 3 dips - was to die for. We also had the signature lemon spaghetti (amazing!), veggie bolognese (smokiness was delicious), and agnolotti (splendid).  Our waitress really saved the experience.
reviews.author: blnick328

reviews.text: The focaccia and caprese salad were terrific. It was a little difficult to hear people at your table and the menu could be a challenge to read once the the restaurant was dimly lit for dinner. It took about three hours for us to have two appetizers and main entrees and there were plenty of open tables. Took about an hour for each appetizer to come out and another hour before our dinner arrived. Server apologized for the delay. No discount, no visit by the manager. Hopefully it will become more efficient over time. Will try again but with some hesitation. If it were not for some of Giada's recipes that we would like to still try, we would not return. Didn't have time to order any dessert and had been looking forward to trying a few items.
reviews.author: JenniferB

reviews.text: service was slow never asked if we wanted desert just gave me the bill slow to bring a glass of wine about 20 min also had to wait 15 min for the table when restaurant was almost empty it was 5:15 reservations
reviews.author: JohnM

reviews.text: The lemon spaghetti was exceptional! Tony our server was exceptional! The frito misto was not great and the prices were 10-15 more than they should have been based on the food and the portion sizes
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We were welcomed by a friendly hostess who sat us promptly upon arrival. The bar, which flows effortlessly into the dining room, are both very visually appealing. Floor to ceiling glass windows bring the outdoor surroundings in. The modern decor with a mixture of white and grey stone and ornate lighting offers a clean yet elegant look. The beautiful display kitchen is encased in glass and visible to the majority of guests seated in the main dining with comfortably spaced booths and tables. Our server was professional, knowledgeable and at first very attentive. As dinner progressed, she was a bit elusive. Having a good view of her section, she wasn't hiding in the back, she was working too many tables at once.  As a former GM, there are two ways to swamp a good server, triple or quadruple seat their section, or believe them when they say, "sure I can take another table." Regardless, our service suffered.  The food, with the exception of the Agnolotti pasta, which had little taste and was visually unappealing, was excellent. The signature dishes, lemon pizza and the lemon pasta as well as the Crab Arancini app were very good. Our server, who was very present when table side, did offer to bring a replacement for the Agnolotti, which we agreed to, the lemon pasta came out quickly, and it too was excellent! I understand this is a newly opened restaurant, and the kinks need to be ironed out, so the issues we had will not keep us away, and we will pass on the positive vibes to others who would like to dine in this beautiful restaurant.  One last observation, on the physical menu, the descriptions printed below each food item are hard to read. The small and very light gray print over a glossy white paper/background, makes reading the menu an unnecessary challenge!
reviews.author: TimM

reviews.text: What a fabulous and fun evening!  Our expectations were high going in  given the number of years we have enjoyed Giada's cooking on TV.  But the whole experience exceeded them!  The food is just amazing...all of it!  Given they just opened a couple weeks ago, we were ready for a few bumps in the service.  But the service was top notch as if they have been in business for years already!  We will return!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Excellent and attentive service! Loved the lobster bucattini and lemon soufflé for dessert.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: First experience at Luna, our server Tony was great!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Tony was awesome
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food was nice. Everything else is lacking. Will not be coming back for a while.
reviews.author: Cam43

reviews.text: Everyone loved everything we ordered and Jay(our server) was helpful, courteous and made our evening even better.
reviews.author: PattyL

reviews.text:
Good food
Cafeteria service
Glitzy
Expensive
3.5 % venue charge un heard of
This is like the first restaurant a chef with no business or marketing experience would open
reviews.author: BernardL

reviews.text:
No greeter available to check reservation or seat us.
Menu: blue/gray print hard to read unless you turn it the correct angle.
Waiter: clearly not his chosen profession.
Caesar salad: Only had cheese, lettuce and capers.  No olive oil or lemon, etc.
Broccolini was burned and impossible to eat stems should have been blanched
Ordered double espresso, got single and it was ice cold.
reviews.author: Disappointed

reviews.text: We had trouble reading the menu... typeface was too small and most copy was at 50% ink. Server had to step up with descriptions of everything. The meal was excellent, albeit pricey. When asked, we said we were celebrating both birthdays and an anniversary. Wondered why they asked, because no dessert was served. Following dinner, we went upstairs to Seven, the alternative restaurant. For many reasons (menu, price, ambiance), we will go there on our next visit.
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.text: What a beautiful restaurant in the brand new Caesar's Republic Hotel building.  The decor, as one would expect, reflect Giada's aesthetics.  The Lemon Spaghetti, their signature dish, is remarkable and beautifully presented.  Service was top-notch and quite attentive.
reviews.author: JonD

reviews.text:
Food was great, Service will continue to improve as the staff gets more experience.  We asked for the Jade room, but not placed there.  Will do it next time.
Great to have a new place to go and have a good meal.
reviews.author: DennisH

reviews.text: Overall 5 star experience. Food was delicious and unique gourmet. We enjoyed very much for our anniversary.
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.text:
Like many others said overcooked pasta, elevated prices not really matching quality you expect for these kind of dishes.
Super loud inside, service was fine, but again, - not excellent. Okay to visit once.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great service but very expensive for food that was a little hit or miss. Focaccia bread and rigatoni were delicious but other dishes were so-so. Great cocktails but really disappointing wine list with outrageous markups. There is also an annoying 3.5% venue access fee added to your check.
reviews.author: Jenn

reviews.text: Nice ambience but food was disappointing and came out cold.  Staff was pleasant but very little attention to detail.  Would not recommend for the price.
reviews.author: JaimeG

reviews.text: I have patiently waited pre-Covid for this restaurant open. I’m a huge Giada fan.  However, my reservations were last Saturday night, and I was heavily disappointed. They were plenty of open  tables to be sat out and they sat us to the farthest in the back near the restrooms. We had to wait 30 minutes for menus and we had to ask for them. Our service was horrendous. We were forgotten about so many times. This is a very very expensive date night, and we were sadly disappointed.
reviews.author: AmyI

reviews.text:
Giada did a great job.  From the friendly hostesses to the great meal and service.  We tried a variety of dishes, from the signature spaghetti which was rich and flavorful, the lemon pizza which my son loved, rigatoni which was extremely good and had great flavor and the scallops were amazing.  

Definitely worth trying out, this was my second time there.  Both times were fantastic.
reviews.author: Keith

reviews.text: The food was outstanding.  The pan seared salmon and the arugula salad were delish.  The spicy sausage pizza was also wonderful.  Food prep and delivery were timed perfectly.  The only thing was that we ordered a bottle of white wine and it was served warm without an ice bucket.  Eventually they brought an ice bucket and after a short delay in chilling the wine, we were fine.  The young server’s helper made sure our water glasses were full at all times and our plates picked up so we were always prepared for the next entree.  The patio was beautiful with sunset views.  Overall a wonderful experience.
reviews.author: CherieG

reviews.text:
My husband and I have been excited for Luna to open for a very long time.  I made our reservation for his birthday as soon as they were taking them.  We are both huge Giada fans as well as my late father, who discovered her on the Food Network and we also enjoyed seeing her on the Today Show years ago.....
Well, I'm happy to say that we were not disappointed..... being it's only open a few weeks, I kind of expected a few slip ups, and would have been fine with that.
But I have to say, our server, Preston was 100% on point as was his assistant, Hayden, who is also absolutely adorable.
We had the focaccia to start.  Best we've ever had, and the dipping sauces were so tasty.
I had the Pork Chop Saltimbocca.  It was fabulous.... and OMG huge, and the Presentation!!
My husband  had the Lemon Spaghetti....it was to die for.  Again, best pasta dish ever.
Not too large of a portion, but it worked out perfect because he was able to help me finish the pork chop.
No room for dessert, but we had friends meet us for an after dinner drink which we had outside.  It was a little chilly, so Parker was nice enough to roll over one of the heating lamps for us.  He was so sweet and informative about the restaurant .
Well it was a win, win for us.  We will be back for another special occasion.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Amazing experience! Food was 5 stars! Branzino and lemon spaghetti! Our waitress Ashley was fantastic. We will definitely return soon!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
I normally don’t write reviews and I understand that just opened
But the food was horrible
The lemon pasta that according to server was the best dish on the menu was awful. Over cooked and the sauce not even close to what a lemon pasta should taste.
Restaurant was empty so no reason for over cook a pasta and have sauce off
Arancini was blend
They also seat us 3 on a 7 top table
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Got there 45 minutes early with the intentions of getting a few drinks before dinner. There were 3 hostesses. They said they would seat us shortly. Sat outside waiting for them to come get us. No one ever came. Went back to check on the reservation after our reservation time had passed. Waited another 20 min and no one came to get us. Went up there for the third time and they now told us our table was ready. Server was excellent and made up for the rough start though.
reviews.author: Cindy

reviews.text: Good food at high price in an extremely loud environment. Since there are other Italian restaurants that are just as tasty at less pricing and better comfort, we won’t be back. The hotel lobby was beautiful.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Poor delayed start of service. Waited almost 20 minutes after being seated before waitress showed up with menus. Went back in hiding for a bit. The rest of staff stepped up and meal ended on a positive note. Very good food and worth a try.
reviews.author: Rambo

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful evening! Brandi was our server and gave us an excellent run down on the menu. Her recommendations were excellent from starters to dessert.
Brandi suggested family style ordering which was right up our ally. We had the Antipasto platter and Caprese salad, both were excellent as starters. We shared three pastas (Lemon spaghetti with shrimp- huge shrimp, Nodi Marini alla vodka with sausage and Anolotti- Nodi and Spaghetti were our favs) and the focaccia (excellent bread-best we’ve ever had).

Soufflés and gelato for dessert along with cappuccino with the best biscotti ever!

A big shout out to Andy how took great care of us helping Brandi with all the follow up service, excellent attitude as well! We had a fun evening and great dining experience.

We will be back!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I was very excited to try Luna for my birthday. The food was ok a bit over the top with lemon on everything but the noice was horrible. My expectations of the food and atmosphere was much higher. The waitress was pretty absent once she took our order. The buser was great keeping our water full but I never got offered a second drink by the waitress. We unfortunately will not go back.
reviews.author: foodie

reviews.text: We have been to the restaurant in Las Vegas and was an unbelievable wonderful experience. When we saw that the restaurant was opening here in Scottsdale, we were so excited we could not get in till 8:30 PM and when we did get there, there were many tables open. It took over 30 minutes to get a drink. We felt like the service was very disorganized And slow. The food was wonderful. Not sure if we will go back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Very disappointed in this new place in Caesar’s Republic Scottsdale. Items were unavailable because of out of stock ingredients. Pasta was overcooked and we had to return it. I don’t believe there was any crab in Arancini and it lacked spice as described in menu. Food came out very slow from kitchen. Lights in the restaurant were flickering on and off throughout the evening. Cmon Giadi! Train the staff how to order ingredients and cook pasta!!
Very loud in dining room. At Pronto (fast casual) there were no Sin City Choc chip cookies. Staff said they were out and never had since opening 3 weeks ago. A HUGE disappointment!
reviews.author: MikeC

reviews.text: Delicious food.  Expensive but expected from a celebrity named restaurant and in Scottsdale. Lights were going on and off but restaurant and building are very new so maybe some glitches still? Overall, I am glad I tried this restaurant.
reviews.author: HollyM

reviews.text: The hosts were very accommodating and the service was fantastic. Unfortunately, they still have a lot of work to do to make the restaurant 5 stars. The lights went completely off no less than 20 times the evening we were there. It really changed the mood and affected our dining experience. It seemed like the managers or staff should have said or done something but we didn't notice anything being done about it. We will go back because our Mushroom Rigatoni was EXCELLENT. We are just hoping that they will work out all of these kinks before that. It was also a beautiful hotel and buildout!
reviews.author: Shushu

reviews.text: Amanda, our server was wonderful and lovely. Everything was amazing. It was a surprise for my hubby as he used to love watching Giada on the cooking shows! We will definitely be back!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Delicious dinner! Our server Tony did a great job explaining everything to us since it was our first time at the restaurant.  They were having issue with the lighting all evening.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: You can’t read the menu descriptions. Service was mediocre, had to send all of our steaks back due to incorrect temperature. Restaurant was not busy , yet it took over 20 min to get a drink or water .
reviews.author: HeatherH

reviews.text: Fabulous experience! Enjoyed the lemon pizza, scallop risotto, lemon spaghetti with shrimp, branzino, and the lemon soufflé and cookies for dessert. The service was excellent, the ambience fantastic and the food was exquisite! We sat right by the kitchen and had a wonderful view of the inner workings of the restaurant! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: CakeArtist

reviews.text: Not good.  Looked last me we were dining at a typical hotel restaurant.
reviews.author: WilliamM

reviews.text: The food and service from our server, Tony, were top-notch.  We got the carpaccio, scallops with risotto, mortadella pizza, broccolini, and tiramisu.  Everything was delicious.  The meal was very well paced. We never felt rushed.  The only downside is that it was loud in there and a bit difficult to hear anyone we were talking to. I would definitely go back for a special occasion.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The service and the food was excellent one of my best Italian meals in the valley
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Loved it all except the inability to hear what my friend was saying. The noise level is deafening.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Brandi the server was very good!  She knew a ton about the area - so service was on point.  Food was ok, not stellar.  My scallops were overcooked but risotto was good.  Crab Arancini were very good and dipping sauce was delicious.  Lemon spaghetti w shrimp - shrimp were overcooked and it had too much EVOO in the dish.  Pasta was fantastic though.  Pizza app had lots of flavor in topping and crust but could use a few more moments in the oven. Limoncello soufflé was very good.  Biscotti was phenomenal- they should sell these on their own!  I would have bought 2 dozen.  Overall 4-stars.  Team is still learning to deliver  a solid service.  Give it time and it’ll be just like Giadas Vegas venue.
reviews.author: ReachS

reviews.text: The room had great energy and it was so fun to see the open kitchen.  The food was prompt and the service was timely. The hand made pasta was very Al dente and flavorful.  Would highly recommend this place, a great addition to Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: What a fantastic addition to the Fashion Mall food options, outstanding menu, service is absolutely impeccable, however wish the restaurant didn’t feel like it’s in a hotel lobby, would have liked to see it stand on its own a little more. Will for sure be back again!!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: It's just opened up recently, so perhaps all the kinks have not been worked out yet. Food quality was so so. The server was adequate at best.
reviews.author: Scottsdale

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautiful as well as the hotel lobby. The hostesses were beautiful young girls but they told me I was the first to arrive from my party of 4 when I found my guests at the bar. Our waiter was actually the best. Very friendly and helpful with the menu. The drinks are priced for tourists and not locals. Do not love the drinks priced at 20$. And up. My guests and I all had the pasta. I enjoyed the signature lemon pasta. The pasta was homemade fresh spaghetti. The lemon sauce was very good. The shrimp however were a bit mushy which is not what you want from shrimp. It was disappointing. The best part of the meal was the fresh hot loaf of bread with several accouterments.  Delicious. The food was honestly overpriced at 38$ for pasta and 2 shrimp. Not going to recommend to friends. I’m sorry. Their are too many fabulous restaurants in this town with more reasonable prices.
reviews.author: daniellek

reviews.text: I’ll give grace because the food and drinks were amazing. The room is too large and the service was rocky but friendly. They will work out the kinks and appreciate the restaurant but green and growing.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Wife and I dined at Luna Rea was our waitress food and drinks were top notch! Don’t miss out get the caprese salad, the lemon pasta, the spicy rigatoni, and the cheesecake brownie. Rea is a superb waitress and a very nice young lady.
reviews.author: johnm

reviews.text: Our reservation did not appear to matter.  We were seated over 30 minutes late.  However, food and ambiance was very good.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
My second time in this wonderful restaurant, food was great, fresh and tasty !
Jay the GM is very professional and nice.
Shereese, my server is amazing, very attentive and helpful, she went over and beyond to provide a great dining experience !
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: First timer and was really pleased with the experience and the flavor!  The service was amazing !
reviews.author: RASlocalpatron

reviews.text: It was a great experience. It was nice to talk to staff about the new restaurant. We will be back☺️
reviews.author: sisters

reviews.text:
Our third visit to Luna was great. Sat in lounge area by bar for early Sunday evening dinner.  This restaurant lives up to its expectations!! Great menu, service, and food.   The staff are exceptional and accommodating. Everyone is well trained.  Don’t hesitate - just be prepared to be impressed!!
Rob and Roz
reviews.author: RobR

reviews.text:
It was just ok. Not the quality experience that we expected. We were seated in the rear dining room. The furniture seemed odd for the scale of the room. almost too small or too spaced out. It felt very cafe like.
The servers are still learning and don’t have the polish, knowledge of the menu, or presence needed for a fine dining restaurant.
