The menu was limited, but no issues with that provided the dishes are well executed. nothing was bad, but not much finesse.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: The food was below average which was very disappointing. We had high expectations as we dined at Giada’s restaurant in Las Vegas in years past. We felt like we were dining in a cafe open at 1:00am in Vegas where you’d order a club sandwich. Very underwhelming!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: I hope it is just time until they get the food worked out.  Many of our dishes were inedible which was a huge disappointment considering I have been to one of Giada’s other restaurants and had a lovely meal.  The restaurant is pretty but it is unbearably loud, we could barely talk to the people at our own table.  Overall a big disappointment.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We had heard about the Pasta Limone so we had to try and it was amazing.  We will be back!
reviews.author: LisaM

reviews.text:
Nothing done for celebration of a 50th day $400 tab warrents a small free bday treat  in my opinion
Otherwise food was delicious served was  nice
Wait for food wasn’t long at all
reviews.author: Anabanana

reviews.text: Fantastic dinner at Luna!  Great new place.  Definitely recommend the lemon pizza!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food waa excellent.  Decor and ambience was also excellent.  Service i thought was ok for a chain restaurant but not for this restaurant with these prices.  The noise level was high but personally it is not a game changer.  Would go again.
reviews.author: SusanG

reviews.text: Food was subpar at best. Service was horrible! For how much hype and PR this place has had it was very underwhelming… save your money and go elsewhere
reviews.author: Nicole

reviews.text: All of our food was very delicious! Some of the portions were small for the price but the flavors were all excellent! Service was top notch! I will be back!
reviews.author: CocoP

reviews.text: Fantastic restaurant with fantastic food, the lemon pasta was to die for. ￼
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Lovely restaurant but very expensive. As the restaurant became busier it was difficult to hear and have a conversation due to the noise level.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Fabulous dinner and thank you to Preston for making sure of that!!! The food was absolutely delicious and his service was immaculate. Will definitely be returning for the lemony pasta and the chicken… AMAZING. Also, the lemon ricotta cookies were CHEFS KISS.

Beautiful restaurant, wonderful hotel, fantastic service!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: What an incredible evening! The food was perfection and I’ll be dreaming about the lemon soufflé until I can go back. More than anything, the service deserves all the credit. Landiss is clearly a lover of food and his knowledge of the menu, chef’s intentions, and pairings were so spot on, I truly was in heaven. He made the night so special and his recommendations were 10/10. Might have to make this a regular spot… if I can request Landiss for more impeccable service, vibes, and suggestions!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Food was fantastic! Caprese salad and sausage pizza amazing.
Knowledgeable, friendly & attentive staff!
reviews.author: localgirl

reviews.text:
Our first dinner experience last night was exceptional.  Great menu and Restaurant decor is beautiful and flows well from main hotel lobby.  The large bar is beautiful and wall to wall open glass kitchen.

Our sever Seth was very helpful and excellent service.  Jay is the GM whom really was traveling the entire restaurant making sure guests were pleased and comfortable.  The entire team was welcoming and well trained for this nice restaurant.

Highly recommend this restaurant as well as heading upstairs after dinner to new lounge called Seven.  Again, met Deveon who took great care of us.

Look forward to returning soon.
Rob & Roz
reviews.author: RobR

reviews.text: Loved our food and the ambiance!  The service was great!
reviews.author: Sherrycorg

reviews.text:
Enjoyed the lemon Caesar salad but did not care for the lemon pizza.  The server suggested I get it for a starter rather than a main course and I’m glad he did. It was rich and very lemony.  One piece was all I could eat. I also ordered the scallop risotto, it was delicious but was a very small portion with only 2 Scallops
The service was outstanding!
I didn’t love the vibe of the restaurant, found it very loud and kind of cafeteria ish.
reviews.author: AudK

reviews.text: rushed and ignored ,water terrible taste, cappuccino one cold one bitter
reviews.author: WayneC

reviews.text: We went here for our anniversary dinner, I indicated this in the reservation, not a single person acknowledged this. We sat outside, by choice, the arrangement was odd. It was basically a coffee table (low to the ground), couch, and two sitting chairs, this made it difficult/awkward to eat our meal. We ordered an appetizer which came before we got plates, silverware, or napkins. We ordered the filet and scallops which came out with steak knives. Luckily the food was better than the service.
reviews.author: BenjaminC

reviews.text:
Great atmosphere. Bit loud but still could have a conversation.  The service was great at the bar and out table.  The crab arancini and Fritos misto starters are really good.  My wife had the lemon spaghetti and loved it.  I had the Tripolini and really did care for it.  Our waiter saw this and insisted on getting me something else. I really did care for anything else.  Later the manager came over and apologized for the meal.   I told her it wasnt their fault I just was expecting something different.  Again she wanted to get me something different. Since I didn’t want anything she insisted talking it off my bill and give us a dessert.  I told that wasn’t necessary but she insisted.  That’s good service.
We look forward to coming g back. O ya we also had the arugula salad and it was very good.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Seating for two could have been better. Restaurant was half empty but were sat at the very last seat at the end of the restaurant. I understand zones but.. being a new restaurant I would imagine they would sit you towards the center of the restaurant to make a better impression, cozier dining experience.

Ambience: Music can be turned down a bit. Purse holders are definitely needed due to chair design not allow for easy hanging.

Had the Lobster Bucatini for two. The pasta needs to be shorter, especially if served in the center for two… there was no end to the pasta, really messy to serve. I would suggest maybe serving it for the guest or providing better utensils to share (not a knife).

Loved the hints of lemon through out the dishes. Overall enjoyed our visit but I feel needs small improvements to be great.
reviews.author: Harol

reviews.text: We had a family Dinner on 3-13-2024 at 8:45pm. The building looks new and modern.  The ambiance was good but was very cold inside the restaurant.  We were seated on a large round table. It was  different and we had a hard time listening to each other because of how far apart we were.  Service was okay, but the server brought the wrong meal  for my son in law.  He did leave the wrong order on the table for him to eat while he was waiting for the correct meal.  The food was okay, my order was good which was the Risotto. My daughters order LOBSTER BUCATINI FOR TWO the pasta seemed overcooked and the flavor was ok but dry.  My son in law order the Spicy sausage he was not impressed not sure if it had to do with the pizza dough? And my other son in law order NODI MARINI ALLA VODKA he seemed to like it.  Last my husband ordered MEZZI RIGATONI.  He did not like it, we all tasted it and it did not had flavor and had a burned taste? 2 out of 5 plates were ok.  We feel that the price of the plates were pretty high being that they were pasta dishes.  With the exception of the lobster spaghetti and the scallops.  The cocktails drinks were pretty up there too on the price but they were good.  We all talked and said we don’t think we would come back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Service was great although the portion of food was small relative to the price. Wine mark up is high and they ran out of cheesecake which was very disappointing. Fair at best.
reviews.author: BobbyB

reviews.text:
What a lovely experience! My friend and I were visiting Scottsdale from Niagara,  Canada and booked these reservations without hesitation. We both loved watching Giada on the Food Network and were not disappointed by the newly opened Luna by Giada! We ordered the bacon wrapped dates as a shared app and both agreed on its unique and enjoyable flavour profile! Our pasta dishes were so delicious. 
The highlight of the evening was decor related:) Our waiter noticed me counting the lights(stars) on the ceiling for confirmation that it was constellations and informed us that the ceiling lights represented the constellations in the night sky when Giadas daughter Jade was born. What an intimate and heartfelt detail.

Highly recommend:)
reviews.author: ShannonR

reviews.text: We realize that this location just opened last week but they may need a few more weeks to iron out the many kinks. Atmosphere is lively but we encountered many difficulties including timing, service and quality of food. Our cocktails arrived haphazardly with the last to be served during appetizers. Some were incorrect. No attempt was made to take an order for another round. The Caesar salad was so tart that we couldn’t finish it. Almost all forks were caked with dried food and the scallop dish was a bit frugal with just 2 in the entree. The lemon pasta was Luke warm. Our server made no attempt to introduce us to the menu or explain dishes until asked. We also felt that we were rushed through the entire process including the main course when dishes were served sporadically.  Overall a disappointment especially when we have a few giada fans
reviews.author: DianneT

reviews.text: Tony L is the best server in Scottsdale by far. Thanks for everything Tony! - Jeff and Des
reviews.author: Sinjef

reviews.text: Paul was wonderful, appreciated his suggestions. View were very relaxing.
reviews.author: GreggS

reviews.text:
We had the best experience with Shereese! She was helpful in guiding us through the menu - highlighted some of her favorites to help us decide, and provided incredible customer service!!
Don’t skip the arincini. The branzino is absolutely incredible. And yes, you absolutely NEED your own souflee!!
reviews.author: AiyaR

reviews.text: We came on March 12, and we were so disappointed with our experience I am just now bringing myself to leave a review.  For background, we have been to Giadas in Vegas 4x and it is one of our most favorite restaurants!! Everything is fantastic from the service to the views and of course the food. We were so excited  for Lunas to open in Scottsdale.  What a complete disappointment. We reserved a table outside, assuming the inside would be packed, but we were surprised when we got there that more than half the inside tables were empty and there only one other group outside. For March it was chilly. We asked the host, water service staff, and a different server if we could have a heater at our table. Everyone apparently forgot. My husband finally went over himself and dragged one to our table after 15 minutes. Which, it took 15 minutes for our server to greet our table. We were one of two tables outside. He apparently knew the other group bc he stopped by their table often to chat. We finally ordered wine and when our drinks came out, my friend was served the wrong white wine. The server apologized and said both started with a C and he forgot and hit the wrong button. There are other examples of poor service throughout the night but you get the jist. I ordered Gianas signature lemon shrimp pasta bc I always get that in Vegas. I talked my friend into ordering it too. It was AWFUL. The shrimp tasted like giant pieces of cold chewy rubber. I don’t even know how to explain it. So bad. Maybe the chef over cooked the shrimp and then left it sitting in an ice tray before it was plated? Had our server come back to check on us, we probably would have said something. Instead I pushed it off my plate and ate my dry chilled pasta. My friends pasta had alittle more sauce so hers was ok. My husband got something else and said his was ok but not hot. But we were there THREE HOURS. Service was unbelievably slow. Hopefully they get it figured out but nothing about it was worth $450!
reviews.author: Jennifer

reviews.text: We had an unbelievable experience last night. Our waiter Preston was fantastic and made my mom’s birthday extra special. The food was delicious, the service was very attentive and the restaurant is beautiful!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Wonderful meal and service!  We regularly visit the Giada’s in Las Vegas and were excited for the Scottsdale location to open up.  The lemon pizza was exceptional, as was the pork chop.  Our server Brandy was very attentive and friendly.  We have already made reservations to return and hope to be seated in her section.  Great addition to Scottsdale dining!
reviews.author: etam

reviews.text:
Let’s just say they have some growing pains on the first week of being open.  The staff seems unorganized and needs some experience.

The food is pretty good.  We enjoyed the lemon spaghetti, the risotto and scallops and the Milanese pork chop

A big problem they will have is charging a 3.5% admin fee to the bill.  This apparently is an add on from the Ceasar’s hotel?  Couldn’t get a clear picture answer from the manager when I asked about it.  They did remove it however.

We will try it again in a month after they’ve been open for a while and hopefully worked out the kinks in the service. ￼
reviews.author: SB888

reviews.text: Tony our server did an outstanding job!  You can tell he had actually tasted the food because he described each dish wonderfully, he was very attentive and had a great welcoming personality.  The food was amazing, just what you would expect from Giada.  Luna is a must dine new restaurant in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Dawn

reviews.text: The Food was Amazing! We loved everything we had! We will be back soon!
reviews.author: Snyder72

reviews.text:
Our first experience at Luna by Giada completely exceeded our expectations.  The space is beautiful, comfortable and extremely welcoming.
The food was delicious with plenty of special little touches & flavors that you would not expect, but will throughly enjoy.
One of the highlights of our exceptional dining experience was the service.  
We were fortunate enough to have Preston take care of us and he was outstanding!
Preston was extremely personable and patient as he guided us perfectly through the menu which definitely made for the most perfect night for all of us.
reviews.author: TinaH

reviews.text: They were out of a large number of ingredients and the food was very bland. Not worth what they charge
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Best appetizer was the Caprese. A unique take and delish. The lobster bucatini for two had a generous helping and quality lobster. The pomodoro sauce wasn’t my favorite, but the pasta being homemade makes all the difference! The service is impeccable! They are all so kind, generous, and proud to be working there. Any request was answered quickly and kindly! Especially by Tony, he is a gem! Thank you for a great evening and congrats on the opening!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We had a very enjoyable experience dining here.  From the moment we checked in at the hostess stand we were greeted by friendly and attentive staff. The front manager greeted us upon our seating and checked on us regularly along with our waitstaff.
Started with the very interesting and delicious caprese salad. Uniquely presented with mascarpone and balsamic pearls. A fresh twist on one of my favorites.  I couldn’t decide between Giada’s signature shrimp and lemon spaghetti or the scallops, so our server offered to do the spaghetti with one shrimp and one scallop. I appreciated her interest in crafting a dish to my liking. It was delicious!
My wife ordered the bacon wrapped dates and sausage pizza. She loved both.
We were staying at the hotel (Caesar’s Republic) and the hotel staff had informed the restaurant that we were celebrating our anniversary, so along with a number of congratulations given by restaurant management and servers, they offered us a complimentary dessert. Nice touch!
There’s a lively vibe with a full seating, so it was a little noisy.  Beautifully designed restaurant with a full glass wall for viewing the busy kitchen.
reviews.author: DavidS

reviews.text: Big fans of her cooking show and cook books. We started with the Bresaola Carpaccio which was excellent. Then we shared the Agnolotti and Pork Chop Saltimbocca which  to me was alright. To me the  Agnolotti pasta the lemon zest overtook any other flavor of the dish, and I love lemon!  The pork chop was crisp and juicy w light breaded flavor. Ask for more of the sage and shea sauce. Overall atmosphere was trendy and comfortable.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Staff was incredibly helpful and professional. Food was served quickly after ordering.
reviews.author: Keith

reviews.text:
Visited for our anniversary dinner.

Restaurant is great looking, flows very well, great energy, super clean, beautiful layout
Like any new spot, food / wait staff usually needs time to get acclimated & give chef’s time to really dial in dishes… this experience spoke exactly to that…

We booked the Luna Room, confirmed the Luna Room- hostess sat us in the Jade Room. We weren’t moved, we mentioned it but no change. No one knew how to work the curtains to bring in some light & views- decorated beautifully, but the room itself still felt a little dark.
Food overall wasn’t the very best of its kind that we’ve had & unfortunately, didn’t live up to other restaurants by Giada we’ve had the pleasure to eat at, but again… We committed to having some grace. It’s new.
Service & the kitchen seemed pretty behind - we sat down around 6:15pm. Paid & walked out by 8pm.
Drinks were ok. Not what we were hoping for or even used to with that caliber of a restaurant but …presented beautifully. Taste just didn’t match.
Dessert was ok, unique, but good.
Overall, experience was just good.
With it being Giada’s- Lots & lots of potential with some things that could be changed for experience & improvements with food flavor, presentation & mixed drink tastes.
We may or may not give it an another try but we’ll plan of giving it 3-6 months to allow the staff ample time to settle in if we do.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Truly one of the best meals I’ve ever had. DELICIOUS!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We decided to sit inside, we thought it was a lovelier setting. Brandy, our server was delightful, knowledgeable, and attentive but not pushy at all. We enjoyed 3 courses and everything was delicious. The manager was walking around and asked everyone specific questions, which I love seeing…means they care. We will be back for sure.
reviews.author: Courtney12

reviews.text: The restaurant was lovely and food was great!  Biggest complaint is the noise level!  There was only my husband and I and we had a hard time having a conversation. Would be even more difficult if we return with others.
reviews.author: PatrickT

reviews.text:
They seemed short handed but I guess that’s to be expected with a new restaurant. The manager was very gracious and understanding saying that things will improve.
The lemon pizza was the best thing we had. It was outstanding. The other items were just ok.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Just wonderful food and service. We love the coastal Italian style. The focaccia cooked in the wood oven was light and came with 3 dips. My husband raved about the petit filet. I had the signature lemon pasta, only 2 shrimp but it was delicious. I tried my friend's lemon pizza and OMG! Perfect crust and so delicious. Creative cocktail menu, good but overpriced wine selection. The rest of the food has a range of prices so you can find lower priced and more expensive dishes. All worth it IMHO. The space is large and light. The negative reviews are ridiculous. There was one slightly salty dish and they offered to redo it. Best Italian food we've had outside of Italy. Service was outstanding, thank you Sheree! We can't wait to come back.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We were anxious to try this new restaurant from Giada as we are big fans of her cooking show and dishes. While the food and drinks were delicious, the price points were higher than we anticipated and portion sizes varied. Giada wasn’t there physically, but we felt her presence everywhere throughout the restaurant even on the bar TV’s with her looped cooking shows. The restaurant is expansive and beautiful with views of Camelback Mountain.
reviews.author: AmyC

reviews.text: I am a Scottsdale venue promoter and I was one of the first to reserve a table after the restaurant opened. I was disappointed the staff didn’t acknowledge my business even though it’s in my OT bio. I am usually greeted and offered a sample to highlight- but not this time. The waitress was incredibly knowledgeable about the menu and friendly. I ordered the “signature dish” and it was delicious, but only came with one caper. I would definitely go back for the pizza and wine to save $ and I recommend sitting outside if possible! The resort itself is phenomenal! @toastofluxury
reviews.author: ToastofLuxury

reviews.text: I had an amazing experience ! Tucker (main waiter), Andy and Hayden were all 3 exceptional! Tucker's recommendations were perfect and the meal was wonderful!  Classy vibe but comfortable!
reviews.author: MaryC

reviews.text: Increíble amounts of salt on food. We could not eat the bisteca
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We were so disappointed in the whole experience.  We got seated on time (great hostesses) waited for 25 minutes at our table to have a very nervous new waiter.  Did not introduce himself, took our drink and appetizer order. Waited another 15 minutes for drinks, was told they were out of the appetizer we ordered.
Food arrived but cold.  Overall we know it was the first Saturday night, but very sloppy, very loud and very overpriced!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food wasn’t great.  Waiter has no personality. It’s seemed like a cafeteria type setting.  Hotel is beautiful and the bar area is cool but I have had much better food and service
reviews.author: RandyG

reviews.text: Overall was good. They have some kinks to work out, as it was opening weekend. Beautiful setting and service was pleasant (but fell behind a lot). Would definitely give another shot once they get their footing.
reviews.author: SamR

reviews.text: Amanda, Ray and CJ made an amazing evening fantastic service, amazing food and a great host that made the evening possible.  A must if you are in Scottsdale.  Coming back tomorrow night. Vegetable bolognese was off the hook.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We took a later than normal reservation due to availability.  We showed early and seated right away.  There are three distinct dining rooms. One full when you walk in. The second room where we ate was empty compared to the front one. Back private dining area with glass doors and walls.  The food was very  good. We frequently go to Giada’s in Vegas so we are familiar with her menu & enjoy the food. We had an appetizer and two courses one bottle of wine with dessert and the total was $200.00. Pricey but as expected.  Service was enthusiastic and lots of staff.
I thought the wine choices were weak and way over priced for this level of dining experience, not winning any wine spectator awards.
Overall we were very happy and will return.
reviews.author: josephL

reviews.text: Really, a beautiful dining experience. Giada’s menu is always on point. Service is outstanding, ambiance is perfect sheik, yet cozy. I am hoping they add a lobster dish for one. Lobster Ravioli please!! Focaccia Bread is to die for. And do NOT leave without trying the brownie cheesecake!
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
We enjoy the Giada brand but…

Nothing exceptional about anything at Luna. Service was super trained but artificial. Atmosphere was fine, but the portraits of Giada and videos of her shows were kinda culty creepy.

There are so many excellent restaurants in the neighborhood, celebrity isn’t enough. Even the tourists will want to punt, because…

The prices are cray cray. We stuck with apps, mostly so we could get a line on quality (and not ask for a grant). Very little flavor, just decent ingredients and not a lot of imagination in what gets to the table.

We live across the street and have been watching and waiting for this thing to come together. Disappointing.
reviews.author: DougB

reviews.text:
It was a 3 hr meal for 4 people.

Pizza was delicious.
Bacon wrapped dates were good
Carpaccio wasn't your typical carpaccio
Bread was delicious
Lemo spaghetti was good, a little heave on the gorgonzola and wasn't very saucy
Gluten free pasta was delicious
Scallops. 2 for 41 dollars with al Dente risotto

3%Venue administration fee on the check to pay by credit card on the bill before even paying with credit card.

Not impressed with ambience or service and expect service to get better with time.

Lots of other great restaurants options in the area.
May or may not come back
reviews.author: Jelle

reviews.text: First thought’s. Too loud I like the atmosphere and the open kitchen look. I had scallops risotto it was too salty and the scallops were the size of a quarter and you get 2 very disappointing. My final thought when the bill came was you hit to be kidding me there was a 3.5% fee for paying the benefits for employees really??? Complete bull crap. Now when I asked for this to come off the bill they acted like they didn’t know what that fee was for please don’t lie about. They didn’t give it back but took off a dessert. Oh the brownie cheesecake was very good. So this would not be a place on my rotation that’s for sure. Sorry Giada Love you but please find a better way or educate your employees on your fees.
reviews.author: Jimbo

reviews.text: We had a great time that included excellent food and service.  We felt the prices are on par with other high end restaurants
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Granted it is the first week the restaurant is open. The service was chaotic and slow. The food was ok.  The highlight was the pizza and focaccia. We really wanted to have an amazing Italian restaurant in our neighborhood. Still looking. If I were staying at the hotel I would dine here for convenience but I would not go out of my way to dine here.
reviews.author: Steakeater

reviews.text:
Sat us in the back room at a 2 seater table.  The table was wobbly.  Being that it’s new it would’ve been nice to sit in the main dining room where we could see the kitchen.  That’s part of the ambience.  We were there for a 5:30 reservation so there was lots of room.  The waitress did not know if there was only one Chardonnay.  Need to educate the staff more on wine.  We ordered the Caprese.  It was very tasty but very salty!  Even my husband who loves salt said it was too salty.

We both got a pasta dish.  I ordered the vegan bolognese which was very tasty and I don’t even like mushrooms.  The rigatoni was cooked perfect al dente.   It would’ve been nice if they offered additional Parmesan.  I had to ask,

Overall it was a good experience.  A bit pricey but it’s in Scottsdale.  Have some kinks to work out and hope they change up the menu.
reviews.author: OCfoodiesinCO

reviews.text: Party of 6, food was very good and service was excellent.  Prices are a little high for what you get.  Extremely disappointed with the 3.5% venue admin fee surcharge automatically added on our bill. They said it’s because the restaurant is in a hotel and the servers don’t get it, the hotel does. I would be extremely unhappy if I was a guest at the hotel, paid the resort fee then was charged that surcharge while dining there.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Manager Ray went above and beyond to ensure our experience. Amanda our server was wonderful. Super helpful in navigating the menu with food allergies and overall excellent service.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Great décor, delicious food and wonderful service! Can’t wait to go back.
reviews.author: annie

reviews.text:
Food was amazing and so was my server Shereese, well trained and very professional !
Great looking restaurant with truly tasty food !
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We went for our anniversary on the second day after opening and had a fantastic evening. Our server Daniella was attentive and very sweet. The food was fantastic and the venue itself was beautiful.
reviews.author: JD505

reviews.text: Restaurant was gorgeous.  Service was excellent for only 2nd night being open.   Appetizers were delicious.  Tried their Signature Spaghetti dish and it was excellent.   Price was about the same for a good steak dinner.   Definitely would recommend.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Food was good, but not even close to exceptional. Prices very high for the quality you would expect. Will be back for a pizza or something, but not their higher priced dishes. Our server was great.
reviews.author: KarinaJ

reviews.text: Mediocre food for a high price.  Twice as much salad dressing as needed.   Pasta overcooked.   Wait staff not trained well or prepared.   Sat for 5 minutes before anyone came to our table.  High noise level.   Basically nothing memorable in a positive way, we will not be coming back anytime soon.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Incredible experience on the second night of opening.  Greeter and server were amazing.  Even with dietary restrictions, the food was incredible. I'll definitely return!
reviews.author: nunu

reviews.text:
Most of the meals were excellent but my wife had the signature dish lemon pasta.
The pasta was hard and stuck together, sauce was tasty but too thin and not enough.
The shrimp was excellent in the pasta dish.
reviews.author: ronr

reviews.text: It’s a gorgeous restaurant and we were there the second day it opened, but the service was pretty slow, got the wrong order (which was quickly corrected), not a lot of variety with wines by the glass and our food was barely warm. There’s a lot of competition in Scottsdale and for that price point, everything has to fire on all cylinders.
reviews.author: DedriaR

reviews.text: To be fair, this was day two  so they’re still working out some kinks.  That brings said, the issues weren’t on the staff and service side—every member of the service team I interacted with (and because my guest was late, there were many) was friendly, personable, knowledgeable and accommodating.  Since this was the first go, I polled staff to find out their favs and selected the general consensus—arancini, lemon pasta, margherita  pizza and the chocolate orange cake dessert.  The arancini on their own were pretty bland and the texture was a little gluey BUT with the accompanying sauce, they were pretty good.  The lemon pasta was extremely disappointing.  Texture of the pasta was good, the sauce was very bland—they need to punch it up with lemon zest and maybe capers. We ate two bites each and left the rest on the plate.  The pizza, however, was absolutely delicious, nice char on the crust with just enough sauce.  The dessert was also nicely done.  Decaf coffee was surprisingly strong and delicious.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text:
Their food is so good!!!
Best Focaccia Bread in town for sure.
Please order the lemon pasta.
reviews.author: Diana

reviews.text: Met Giada on Opening Night. Restaurant staff and experience was exceptional. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Was a fun experience for the first night open.  We got to meet Giada too! Love her Vegas location at the Cromwell, so we were excited to grab a table when it became available on OpenTable. Yay! Waiter Kenneth was spectacular, despite the first night craziness of it all.  The focaccia and bacon wrapped dates were delicious.  We had ordered a third app to share, the arugula salad, but that was forgotten despite being on the bill(we didn't realize till we got home and actually read the receipt...). Anyways, I'm sure it was just a opening night glitch but it soured my mom's experience. We loved the wine selection and she was happy they had the Prisoner on the list. She was also a fan of the martini glasses! The lemon spaghetti is phenomenal but the angolotti was underwhelming. It was a nice 2.5hr experience but after $270 + a $70 tip for the great service, we still wonder how good that salad could have been.  I would recommend it to people when they need something in the area, but I don't think I will be back again.  Well....the Vegas location for sure. Thanks!
reviews.author: Kylw

reviews.text: Food, service, and ambiance all hit the marks but the prices are a bit delusional. Giada nails it with lemons and parmesan here, especially on the lemon pizza and lemon pasta. Why is a generic fritto misto $27 though? The lemon aioli was fantastic but we're missing a few grams of truffles at this price point. Salad selection is abysmally mediocre unfortunately. The crispy skin on the branzino was very well executed and great flavors on the pork chop, just at the wrong price point for not-so-luxury dishes. Get there at sunset and enjoy the fantastic views!
reviews.author: Beard

reviews.text: Love this new restaurant… even met Giada who is the nicest chef I’ve ever met!
reviews.author: JBBronstein

reviews.text: Amazing opening night! Service was a little bit slow to start but it was busy and there was so much going on, so we understand. Our server was super friendly and made the best recommendations! We can’t wait to be back :)
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: Exciting to be dining “with Giada” on her opening night.  She was very personable, humble, and gracious.  We loved the Fritto Misto.  It was so well prepared.  Light and flavorful.  Highly recommend to share.  We also had the Lobster Bucatini.  Flavors were good.  We were dining on the patio and the pasta cooled down quickly.  Lobster was tender.  We finished with Limocello soufflé.  Biscotti was outstanding.  Flavors and texture were unlike any we’ve had.  Soufflé was in a coffee cup and felt it needed to be in a different serving dish for it to thoroughly cookthrough.
reviews.author: Eriegrammy

reviews.text: I was expecting to be “wowed” considering it was opening night and Giada was on-site. However, the pasta was limp and the quality did not come close to the prices that they commended. It’s a one & done for me.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.text: We were there on opening night. The staff was all very courteous and accommodating. The service was amazing. The food was outstanding. Considering it was opening night, we were very impressed! We will definitely go back. ￼
reviews.author: Smb555

reviews.text: Went to the first night open and it was a perfect occasion. Service was perfect from our server Savannah. She explained the new menu perfectly. We had the Bistecca porterhouse, for two. One of the best, if not the best, we have ever had. Very nice and unique Costal Italian menu. Even a surprise visit from Giada herself. She was so pleasant and applicative of our visit and comments. Truly a wonderful lady. Looking forward to our next visit. A++++
reviews.author: John500

reviews.text: Amazing food and atmosphere. Great new restaurant by Giada. Will be back often.
reviews.author: Anonymous
